title: Enhancing Safety of Large Language Models via Embedding Space Separation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved impressive capabilities, yet ensuring their safety against harmful prompts remains a critical challenge. Recent work has revealed that the latent representations (embeddings) of harmful and safe queries in LLMs typically exhibit linear separability, a property that has been exploited to construct attacks by perturbing the embeddings of harmful queries towards the safe subspace. Motivated by this observation, we propose a representation-level fine-tuning approach, named Embedding Space Separation (ES2), which improves LLM safety by explicitly enlarging the distance between harmful and safe representations in the embedding space. To prevent degradation of model's general capabilities, we introduce a Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence regularization term into the loss function, which constrains the logits of the fine-tuned model to align with those of the original base model on harmless inputs. We evaluate our method on several open-source LLMs using standard safety benchmarks. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that our approach substantially improves model safety while maintaining comparable general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Embedding Space Separation (ES2)的表示层微调方法，通过扩大有害和安全查询在嵌入空间中的距离来提高LLM的安全性，同时使用KL散度正则化保持模型通用能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在安全防护方面面临挑战，研究发现有害和安全查询的潜在表示具有线性可分性，攻击者可以利用这一特性通过扰动嵌入向量来绕过安全防护。因此需要开发能够增强模型安全性的方法。
AI.method: 提出ES2方法：1）在嵌入空间层面进行微调，明确扩大有害和安全表示之间的距离；2）引入KL散度正则化项到损失函数中，约束微调模型在无害输入上的输出与原始基础模型的对齐，防止通用能力退化。
AI.result: 在多个开源LLM上使用标准安全基准进行评估，实验结果表明该方法显著提高了模型的安全性，同时保持了可比的通用能力。
AI.conclusion: ES2方法通过表示空间分离和KL正则化的结合，有效提升了LLM的安全防护能力，为解决模型安全与通用能力平衡问题提供了有效方案。

title: RedacBench: Can AI Erase Your Secrets?
summary: Modern language models can readily extract sensitive information from unstructured text, making redaction -- the selective removal of such information -- critical for data security. However, existing benchmarks for redaction typically focus on predefined categories of data such as personally identifiable information (PII) or evaluate specific techniques like masking. To address this limitation, we introduce RedacBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating policy-conditioned redaction across domains and strategies. Constructed from 514 human-authored texts spanning individual, corporate, and government sources, paired with 187 security policies, RedacBench measures a model's ability to selectively remove policy-violating information while preserving the original semantics. We quantify performance using 8,053 annotated propositions that capture all inferable information in each text. This enables assessment of both security -- the removal of sensitive propositions -- and utility -- the preservation of non-sensitive propositions. Experiments across multiple redaction strategies and state-of-the-art language models show that while more advanced models can improve security, preserving utility remains a challenge. To facilitate future research, we release RedacBench along with a web-based playground for dataset customization and evaluation. Available at https://hyunjunian.github.io/redaction-playground/.

AI.tldr: RedacBench是一个用于评估策略条件化信息脱敏的综合基准，包含514个人工撰写的文本和187个安全策略，通过8,053个标注命题来衡量模型在去除敏感信息同时保持原始语义的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有脱敏基准通常只关注预定义的数据类别（如个人身份信息）或评估特定技术（如掩码），缺乏对策略条件化脱敏的全面评估，因此需要一个新的基准来评估模型在不同领域和策略下的选择性信息去除能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含514个人工撰写文本（涵盖个人、企业和政府来源）和187个安全策略的RedacBench数据集，使用8,053个标注命题来捕获每个文本中所有可推断的信息，从而能够同时评估安全性和实用性。
AI.result: 实验表明，虽然更先进的模型可以提高安全性（更好地去除敏感信息），但保持实用性（保留非敏感信息）仍然是一个挑战。
AI.conclusion: RedacBench提供了一个全面的基准来评估策略条件化脱敏，有助于未来研究，并提供了基于Web的交互式平台用于数据集定制和评估。

title: Children's Intelligence Tests Pose Challenges for MLLMs? KidGym: A 2D Grid-Based Reasoning Benchmark for MLLMs
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) combine the linguistic strengths of LLMs with the ability to process multimodal data, enbaling them to address a broader range of visual tasks. Because MLLMs aim at more general, human-like competence than language-only models, we take inspiration from the Wechsler Intelligence Scales - an established battery for evaluating children by decomposing intelligence into interpretable, testable abilities. We introduce KidGym, a comprehensive 2D grid-based benchmark for assessing five essential capabilities of MLLMs: Execution, Perception Reasoning, Learning, Memory and Planning. The benchmark comprises 12 unique tasks, each targeting at least one core capability, specifically designed to guage MLLMs' adaptability and developmental potential, mirroring the stages of children's cognitive growth. Additionally, our tasks encompass diverse scenarios and objects with randomly generated layouts, ensuring a more accurate and robust evluation of MLLM capabilities. KidGym is designed to be fully user-customizable and extensible, allowing researchers to create new evaluation scenarios and adjust difficuly levels to accommodate the rapidly growing MLLM community. Through the evaluation of state-of-the-art MLLMs using KidGym, we identified significant insights into model capabilities and revealed several limitations of current models. We release our benchmark at: https://kidgym.github.io/KidGym-Website/.

AI.tldr: KidGym是一个基于2D网格的综合性基准测试，用于评估多模态大语言模型的五种核心能力：执行、感知推理、学习、记忆和规划，灵感来自韦氏儿童智力量表。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型结合了语言模型的优势和多模态数据处理能力，能够处理更广泛的视觉任务。为了评估这些模型更通用、更接近人类的能力，研究者从韦氏儿童智力量表获得灵感，希望设计一个能够分解智能为可解释、可测试能力的评估框架。
AI.method: 开发了KidGym基准测试，包含12个独特任务，每个任务针对至少一种核心能力。基准采用2D网格环境，包含多样化场景和随机生成的物体布局，确保评估的准确性和鲁棒性。基准设计为完全可定制和可扩展，允许研究人员创建新的评估场景并调整难度级别。
AI.result: 通过对最先进的多模态大语言模型进行评估，发现了模型能力的重要见解，并揭示了当前模型的若干局限性。基准测试网站已公开发布。
AI.conclusion: KidGym提供了一个全面、可定制且可扩展的基准测试框架，能够有效评估多模态大语言模型的五种核心认知能力，为模型发展和评估提供了有价值的工具。

title: AgenticGEO: A Self-Evolving Agentic System for Generative Engine Optimization
summary: Generative search engines represent a transition from traditional ranking-based retrieval to Large Language Model (LLM)-based synthesis, transforming optimization goals from ranking prominence towards content inclusion. Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), specifically, aims to maximize visibility and attribution in black-box summarized outputs by strategically manipulating source content. However, existing methods rely on static heuristics, single-prompt optimization, or engine preference rule distillation that is prone to overfitting. They cannot flexibly adapt to diverse content or the changing behaviors of generative engines. Moreover, effectively optimizing these strategies requires an impractical amount of interaction feedback from the engines. To address these challenges, we propose AgenticGEO, a self-evolving agentic framework formulating optimization as a content-conditioned control problem, which enhances intrinsic content quality to robustly adapt to the unpredictable behaviors of black-box engines. Unlike fixed-strategy methods, AgenticGEO employs a MAP-Elites archive to evolve diverse, compositional strategies. To mitigate interaction costs, we introduce a Co-Evolving Critic, a lightweight surrogate that approximates engine feedback for content-specific strategy selection and refinement, efficiently guiding both evolutionary search and inference-time planning. Through extensive in-domain and cross-domain experiments on two representative engines, AgenticGEO achieves state-of-the-art performance and demonstrates robust transferability, outperforming 14 baselines across 3 datasets. Our code and model are available at: https://github.com/AIcling/agentic_geo.

AI.tldr: AgenticGEO：一种自演化的智能框架，用于生成搜索引擎优化，通过内容条件控制问题提升内容质量，适应黑盒引擎的不可预测行为，减少交互成本
AI.motivation: 现有生成搜索引擎优化方法存在局限性：依赖静态启发式、单提示优化或易过拟合的引擎偏好规则蒸馏，无法灵活适应多样化内容或变化的引擎行为，且需要大量不切实际的交互反馈
AI.method: 提出AgenticGEO框架，将优化问题表述为内容条件控制问题；使用MAP-Elites存档演化多样化组合策略；引入协同演化批评器作为轻量级代理模型，近似引擎反馈以指导进化搜索和推理时规划
AI.result: 在两个代表性引擎上进行广泛域内和跨域实验，AgenticGEO实现了最先进的性能，展现出强大的可迁移性，在3个数据集上优于14个基线方法
AI.conclusion: AgenticGEO通过自演化智能框架有效解决了生成搜索引擎优化的关键挑战，实现了对黑盒引擎的鲁棒适应，同时显著降低了交互成本

title: Fast-Slow Thinking RM: Efficient Integration of Scalar and Generative Reward Models
summary:
Reward models (RMs) are critical for aligning Large Language Models via Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). While Generative Reward Models (GRMs) achieve superior accuracy through chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, they incur substantial computational costs. Conversely, Scalar Reward Models (SRMs) offer efficiency but suffer from limited performance and adaptability in complex scenarios.
  We introduce Fast-Slow Thinking Reward Models (F/S-RM), a hybrid RM architecture inspired by Dual Process Theory. It trains a single model to integrate two distinct reward paradigms: first-token prediction as a scalar score (fast thinking) and CoT-based judgment (slow thinking), regulated by a dual-confidence activation mechanism that determines when to activate slow thinking.
  F/S-RM achieves a 1.2% relative performance improvement over state-of-the-art models while reducing token consumption by 20.8%. Code and data will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合快速思考和慢速思考的混合奖励模型架构，在保持高准确性的同时显著降低计算成本
AI.motivation: 生成式奖励模型虽然通过思维链推理获得高准确性，但计算成本高昂；标量奖励模型虽然高效，但在复杂场景下性能和适应性有限。需要一种既能保持高准确性又能降低计算成本的解决方案。
AI.method: 引入快速-慢速思考奖励模型架构，受双过程理论启发，训练单个模型整合两种奖励范式：快速思考（首词预测作为标量分数）和慢速思考（基于思维链的判断），通过双置信度激活机制决定何时激活慢速思考。
AI.result: 相比最先进模型，F/S-RM实现了1.2%的相对性能提升，同时减少了20.8%的token消耗。代码和数据将公开可用。
AI.conclusion: F/S-RM通过结合快速思考和慢速思考的混合架构，在保持高准确性的同时显著降低了计算成本，为大语言模型的对齐提供了一种高效且有效的奖励模型解决方案。

title: Understanding Pruning Regimes in Vision-Language Models Through Domain-Aware Layer Selection
summary: Transformer-based vision-language models (VLMs) contain substantial depth redundancy, yet the effect of removing specific decoder layers remains poorly understood, especially for domains that require tight coupling between perception and multi-step reasoning. We study structured decoder layer pruning through the lens of domain-aware activation similarity, measuring how strongly each layer transforms representations for math versus non-math inputs. This yields simple math-aware, non-math-aware, and mixed ranking criteria that identify layers whose input-output activations change least within a target domain. Across two state-of-the-art VLMs and a broad suite of math and general multimodal benchmarks, we uncover a consistent three-regime structure: at low pruning budgets, performance is highly sensitive to which layers are removed; at moderate budgets, methods converge as structural damage accumulates; and at high budgets, structural continuity dominates, favoring spacing-aware strategies. Our domain-aware rankings achieve the strongest stability in the ranking-sensitive regime, while matching or exceeding structure-aware baselines at larger budgets. These results provide a clearer picture of how depth contributes to domain-specific behavior in VLMs and offer a practical, interpretable approach to reducing model depth without sacrificing essential mathematical or general vision-language capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉语言模型中解码器层的结构化剪枝，通过领域感知的激活相似性分析，发现数学推理任务中的三层结构剪枝规律，并提出有效的剪枝策略。
AI.motivation: 基于Transformer的视觉语言模型存在深度冗余，但移除特定解码器层的影响尚不清楚，特别是在需要感知与多步推理紧密耦合的领域（如数学推理）。
AI.method: 通过领域感知的激活相似性分析，测量每个层对数学与非数学输入的表示转换强度，提出数学感知、非数学感知和混合排名标准，识别在目标领域中输入输出激活变化最小的层。
AI.result: 在两个最先进的视觉语言模型和广泛的数学与通用多模态基准测试中，发现一致的三层结构：低剪枝预算时性能对移除哪些层高度敏感；中等预算时方法收敛；高预算时结构连续性占主导。领域感知排名在排名敏感区域实现最强稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果揭示了深度如何影响视觉语言模型中的领域特定行为，并提供了一种实用、可解释的方法来减少模型深度，同时不牺牲基本的数学或通用视觉语言能力。

title: ProMAS: Proactive Error Forecasting for Multi-Agent Systems Using Markov Transition Dynamics
summary: The integration of Large Language Models into Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) has enabled the so-lution of complex, long-horizon tasks through collaborative reasoning. However, this collec-tive intelligence is inherently fragile, as a single logical fallacy can rapidly propagate and lead to system-wide failure. Most current research re-lies on post-hoc failure analysis, thereby hinder-ing real-time intervention. To address this, we propose PROMAS, a proactive framework utiliz-ing Markov transitions for predictive error anal-ysis. PROMAS extracts Causal Delta Features to capture semantic displacement, mapping them to a quantized Vector Markov Space to model reasoning as probabilistic transitions. By inte-grating a Proactive Prediction Head with Jump Detection, the method localizes errors via risk acceleration rather than static thresholds. On the Who&When benchmark, PROMAS achieves 22.97% step-level accuracy while processing only 27% of reasoning logs. This performance rivals reactive monitors like MASC while reducing data overhead by 73%. Although this strategy entails an accuracy trade-off compared to post-hoc meth-ods, it significantly improves intervention latency, balancing diagnostic precision with the real-time demands of autonomous reasoning.

AI.tldr: PROMAS是一个用于多智能体系统的主动错误预测框架，通过马尔可夫转移和因果增量特征来预测推理错误，在减少73%数据开销的同时实现接近反应式监控的性能。
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体系统（MAS）中的大语言模型集成虽然能解决复杂任务，但集体推理具有脆弱性，单个逻辑谬误会迅速传播导致系统级失败。现有研究多依赖事后分析，缺乏实时干预能力。
AI.method: 提出PROMAS框架：1）提取因果增量特征捕捉语义位移；2）映射到量化向量马尔可夫空间，将推理建模为概率转移；3）集成主动预测头和跳跃检测，通过风险加速而非静态阈值定位错误。
AI.result: 在Who&When基准测试中，PROMAS达到22.97%的步骤级准确率，仅处理27%的推理日志，性能与反应式监控方法MASC相当，但数据开销减少73%。
AI.conclusion: 虽然相比事后方法存在准确率折衷，但PROMAS显著改善了干预延迟，在诊断精度与自主推理的实时需求之间取得了平衡，为多智能体系统的鲁棒性提供了主动监控方案。

title: Multi-Agent Debate with Memory Masking
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have recently demonstrated impressive capabilities in reasoning tasks. Currently, mainstream LLM reasoning frameworks predominantly focus on scaling up inference-time sampling to enhance performance. In particular, among all LLM reasoning frameworks, *multi-agent debate* (MAD), which employs multiple LLMs as agents to perform reasoning in the way of multi-round debate, has emerged as a powerful reasoning paradigm since it allows agents to access previous memories to alleviate fallacious content and refine their reasoning iteratively in each debate round. However, although MAD significantly improves the reasoning capabilities of LLMs, in this paper, we observe that there remain erroneous memories, and LLM agents are vulnerable to these erroneous memories. To explore this phenomenon, we provide a theoretical insight that the performance of MAD is highly dependent on the quality of memories derived from the previous debate, indicating that the existence of erroneous memories poses a threat to the performance of MAD. To address this problem, we introduce a simple yet effective multi-agent debate framework, *multi-agent debate with memory masking* (MAD-M$^2$), to improve the robustness of MAD by allowing LLM agents to mask erroneous memories from the previous debate round at the beginning of each debate round. In this way, MAD-M$^2$ can polish the contextual information before each debate round by preserving informative and meaningful memories while discarding the erroneous memories. Extensive experiments and analyses on mainstream mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that MAD-M$^2$ can identify the erroneous memories and achieve better performance in reasoning than MAD.

AI.tldr: 提出MAD-M²框架，通过记忆掩码机制在多智能体辩论中识别并屏蔽错误记忆，提升推理鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 当前多智能体辩论框架存在错误记忆问题，智能体容易受到错误记忆影响，这威胁到推理性能。需要提高MAD框架的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出MAD-M²框架，在每轮辩论开始时让LLM智能体屏蔽前一轮辩论中的错误记忆，保留有意义信息，丢弃错误记忆。
AI.result: 在主流数学和逻辑推理基准测试上的实验表明，MAD-M²能够有效识别错误记忆，推理性能优于原始MAD框架。
AI.conclusion: MAD-M²通过记忆掩码机制提高了多智能体辩论的鲁棒性，能够更好地处理错误记忆问题，提升LLM推理能力。

title: Mix-and-Match Pruning: Globally Guided Layer-Wise Sparsification of DNNs
summary: Deploying deep neural networks (DNNs) on edge devices requires strong compression with minimal accuracy loss. This paper introduces Mix-and-Match Pruning, a globally guided, layer-wise sparsification framework that leverages sensitivity scores and simple architectural rules to generate diverse, high-quality pruning configurations. The framework addresses a key limitation that different layers and architectures respond differently to pruning, making single-strategy approaches suboptimal. Mix-and-Match derives architecture-aware sparsity ranges, e.g., preserving normalization layers while pruning classifiers more aggressively, and systematically samples these ranges to produce ten strategies per sensitivity signal (magnitude, gradient, or their combination). This eliminates repeated pruning runs while offering deployment-ready accuracy-sparsity trade-offs. Experiments on CNNs and Vision Transformers demonstrate Pareto-optimal results, with Mix-and-Match reducing accuracy degradation on Swin-Tiny by 40% relative to standard single-criterion pruning. These findings show that coordinating existing pruning signals enables more reliable and efficient compressed models than introducing new criteria.

AI.tldr: Mix-and-Match Pruning：一种全局引导的层间稀疏化框架，通过结合敏感度评分和简单架构规则，为不同层和架构生成多样化的高质量剪枝配置，实现更优的准确率-稀疏度权衡。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备上部署深度神经网络需要强压缩同时最小化准确率损失。现有单一策略剪枝方法存在局限性，因为不同层和架构对剪枝的响应不同，导致效果不理想。
AI.method: 提出Mix-and-Match剪枝框架，利用敏感度评分（幅度、梯度或其组合）和简单架构规则，生成架构感知的稀疏度范围，系统采样这些范围，为每个敏感度信号产生10种策略，避免重复剪枝运行。
AI.result: 在CNN和Vision Transformer上的实验显示Pareto最优结果，Mix-and-Match将Swin-Tiny的准确率下降相对标准单准则剪枝减少了40%，提供部署就绪的准确率-稀疏度权衡。
AI.conclusion: 协调现有剪枝信号比引入新准则能实现更可靠和高效的压缩模型，为边缘设备部署提供有效的全局引导层间稀疏化解决方案。

title: Domain-Specialized Tree of Thought through Plug-and-Play Predictors
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced complex reasoning, prominent methods like the Tree of Thoughts (ToT) framework face a critical trade-off between exploration depth and computational efficiency. Existing ToT implementations often rely on heavyweight LLM-based self-evaluation or rigid heuristics for branch pruning, making them prohibitively expensive and inflexible for broad application. To address this, we introduce DST, an adaptable, plug-and-play predictor that serves as a lightweight, supervised heuristic to guide the ToT search process. Our predictor enables dynamic, context-aware pruning, allowing the search to proceed with near-greedy efficiency on simpler reasoning steps while adaptively expanding the search beam only when encountering uncertainty or task complexity. We evaluate our approach on a diverse suite of benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, general reasoning, and complex logical reasoning. Experimental results demonstrate that our method achieves accuracy competitive with or superior to strong baselines, including standard ToT, while reducing computational overhead by 26-75%. Our work effectively resolves the accuracy-efficiency trade-off in tree-based reasoning, transforming ToT from a resource-intensive technique into a scalable and practical paradigm for complex problem-solving in LLMs.

AI.tldr: DST是一种轻量级监督启发式预测器，用于指导思维树搜索过程，在保持或提升准确性的同时显著降低计算开销（26-75%）
AI.motivation: 现有思维树框架在探索深度和计算效率之间存在关键权衡，依赖重量级LLM自评估或刚性启发式剪枝，导致计算成本过高且不够灵活
AI.method: 引入DST（可适应的即插即用预测器），作为轻量级监督启发式来指导思维树搜索，实现动态、上下文感知的剪枝，在简单推理步骤上保持接近贪心的效率，仅在遇到不确定性或任务复杂性时自适应扩展搜索束
AI.result: 在数学推理、一般推理和复杂逻辑推理等多个基准测试中，该方法在保持或优于标准思维树基线准确性的同时，将计算开销降低了26-75%
AI.conclusion: DST有效解决了基于树的推理中的准确性与效率权衡问题，将思维树从资源密集型技术转变为可扩展且实用的复杂问题解决范式

title: Locally Coherent Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) have emerged as a promising alternative to autoregressive (AR) models, offering sub-linear generation latency and bidirectional capabilities that are particularly appealing for code generation and editing. Achieving sub-linear latency in discrete DLMs requires predicting multiple tokens in parallel. However, standard DLMs sample tokens independently from conditional marginal distributions, failing to capture the joint dependencies among concurrently generated tokens. As a result, they often lead to syntactic inconsistencies and break multi-token structures. In this work, we introduce CoDiLA (Coherent Diffusion with Local Autoregression), a method that reconciles parallel sampling with local dependency modeling. Rather than forcing the DLM to resolve fine-grained syntax, CoDiLA delegates local decoding to a small, auxiliary AR model operating on the diffusion latents. This design allows for parallel block generation while ensuring sequential validity within each block and maintaining core DLM capabilities, including bidirectional modeling across blocks. We demonstrate that using a highly compact auxiliary AR model (e.g., 0.6B parameters) effectively eliminates coherence artifacts, establishing a new Pareto frontier for accuracy and speed in code generation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: CoDiLA方法通过结合扩散语言模型的并行生成优势与小型自回归模型的局部依赖建模，解决了离散DLMs在多令牌并行生成时缺乏联合依赖的问题，在代码生成任务中实现了准确性与速度的新帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLMs）作为自回归模型的替代方案，具有亚线性生成延迟和双向建模能力，特别适合代码生成和编辑。但标准DLMs在并行生成多个令牌时独立采样，无法捕捉并发令牌间的联合依赖关系，导致语法不一致和多令牌结构破坏。
AI.method: CoDiLA（Coherent Diffusion with Local Autoregression）方法将局部解码委托给在扩散潜在空间上运行的小型辅助自回归模型。这种设计允许并行块生成，同时确保每个块内的序列有效性，并保持DLMs的核心能力，包括跨块的双向建模。
AI.result: 使用高度紧凑的辅助自回归模型（如0.6B参数）能有效消除一致性伪影，在代码生成基准测试中建立了准确性和速度的新帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: CoDiLA方法成功地将并行采样与局部依赖建模相结合，解决了离散DLMs在多令牌并行生成时的关键限制，为代码生成任务提供了既高效又准确的解决方案。

title: STAC: Plug-and-Play Spatio-Temporal Aware Cache Compression for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
summary:
Online 3D reconstruction from streaming inputs requires both long-term temporal consistency and efficient memory usage. Although causal VGGT transformers address this challenge through a key-value (KV) cache mechanism, the cache grows linearly with the stream length, creating a major memory bottleneck. Under limited memory budgets, early cache eviction significantly degrades reconstruction quality and temporal consistency.
  In this work, we observe that attention in causal transformers for 3D reconstruction exhibits intrinsic spatio-temporal sparsity. Based on this insight, we propose STAC, a Spatio-Temporally Aware Cache Compression framework for streaming 3D reconstruction with large causal transformers. STAC consists of three key components: (1) a Working Temporal Token Caching mechanism that preserves long-term informative tokens using decayed cumulative attention scores; (2) a Long-term Spatial Token Caching scheme that compresses spatially redundant tokens into voxel-aligned representations for memory-efficient storage; and (3) a Chunk-based Multi-frame Optimization strategy that jointly processes consecutive frames to improve temporal coherence and GPU efficiency.
  Extensive experiments show that STAC achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction quality while reducing memory consumption by nearly 10x and accelerating inference by 4x, substantially improving the scalability of real-time 3D reconstruction in streaming settings.

AI.tldr: STAC提出了一种时空感知的缓存压缩框架，用于解决流式3D重建中因果变换器KV缓存线性增长的内存瓶颈问题，通过时空稀疏性压缩缓存，实现10倍内存减少和4倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 流式3D重建需要长期时间一致性和高效内存使用。现有因果VGGT变换器使用KV缓存机制，但缓存随流长度线性增长，在有限内存预算下，早期缓存逐出会显著降低重建质量和时间一致性。
AI.method: STAC包含三个关键组件：1) 工作时间令牌缓存机制，使用衰减累积注意力分数保留长期信息令牌；2) 长期空间令牌缓存方案，将空间冗余令牌压缩为体素对齐表示；3) 基于块的多帧优化策略，联合处理连续帧以提高时间一致性和GPU效率。
AI.result: 实验表明STAC实现了最先进的重建质量，同时将内存消耗减少近10倍，推理加速4倍，显著提高了流式设置中实时3D重建的可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: STAC通过利用注意力中的时空稀疏性，有效解决了流式3D重建中因果变换器的内存瓶颈问题，为实时3D重建提供了可扩展的解决方案。

title: FactorSmith: Agentic Simulation Generation via Markov Decision Process Decomposition with Planner-Designer-Critic Refinement
summary: Generating executable simulations from natural language specifications remains a challenging problem due to the limited reasoning capacity of large language models (LLMs) when confronted with large, interconnected codebases. This paper presents FactorSmith, a framework that synthesizes playable game simulations in code from textual descriptions by combining two complementary ideas: factored POMDP decomposition for principled context reduction and a hierarchical planner-designer-critic agentic workflow for iterative quality refinement at every generation step. Drawing on the factored partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) representation introduced by FactorSim [Sun et al., 2024], the proposed method decomposes a simulation specification into modular steps where each step operates only on a minimal subset of relevant state variables, limiting the context window that any single LLM call must process. Inspired by the agentic trio architecture of SceneSmith [Pfaff et al., 2025], FactorSmith embeds within every factored step a three-agent interaction: a planner that orchestrates workflow, a designer that proposes code artifacts, and a critic that evaluates quality through structured scoring, enabling iterative refinement with checkpoint rollback. This paper formalizes the combined approach, presents the mathematical framework underpinning context selection and agentic refinement, and describes the open-source implementation. Experiments on the PyGame Learning Environment benchmark demonstrate that FactorSmith generates simulations with improved prompt alignment, fewer runtime errors, and higher code quality compared to non-agentic factored baselines.

AI.tldr: FactorSmith是一个从自然语言描述生成可执行游戏模拟的框架，通过分解POMDP和分层代理工作流来减少上下文并提升代码质量
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型在处理大型、互连代码库时推理能力有限，难以从自然语言规范生成可执行的模拟。需要一种方法来减少上下文负担并提升生成代码的质量。
AI.method: 结合两种互补思想：1) 基于分解POMDP的上下文缩减，将模拟规范分解为模块化步骤，每个步骤仅操作相关状态变量的最小子集；2) 分层规划师-设计师-批评家代理工作流，在每个生成步骤中进行迭代质量优化，支持检查点回滚。
AI.result: 在PyGame Learning Environment基准测试中，FactorSmith相比非代理分解基线，生成了更符合提示要求、运行时错误更少、代码质量更高的模拟。
AI.conclusion: FactorSmith通过分解POMDP表示和分层代理工作流的结合，有效解决了从自然语言生成可执行模拟的挑战，显著提升了生成代码的质量和可靠性。

title: Expected Reward Prediction, with Applications to Model Routing
comment: ICML 2025 Workshop on Models of Human Feedback for AI Alignment
summary: Reward models are a standard tool to score responses from LLMs. Reward models are built to rank responses to a fixed prompt sampled from a single model, for example to choose the best of n sampled responses. In this paper, we study whether scores from response-level reward models lifted to score a model's suitability for a prompt, prior to seeing responses from that model. Specifically, we show that it is straightforward to predict the expected reward that an LLM would earn from the reward model under repeated sampling. Further, we show that these expected reward predictions are precise and discriminative enough to support an application to a model routing protocol that routes prompts to models at inference time to maximize reward while controlling computational cost. We demonstrate the performance of this routing procedure on the open-perfectblend dataset, using a model pool composed of Llama3.1-Instruct 8B/70B, Gemma2-IT 9B/27B, and Gemma1-IT 7B models. Our simple expected reward prediction--based routing (ERP) outperforms baselines that route prompts to models with the best average performance within each prompt's category, and explains the success of more complex routing protocols that implicitly estimate an expected reward. Our approach has the added advantage of being trivially extensible as new models are added to the pool.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于预期奖励预测（ERP）的模型路由协议，能够在推理时根据提示预测LLM的预期奖励，从而在控制计算成本的同时最大化奖励。
AI.motivation: 传统的奖励模型通常用于对固定提示下单个模型的响应进行评分和排序。本研究探索是否能在看到模型响应之前，将响应级奖励模型的评分提升到模型对提示的适用性评估，以支持模型路由决策。
AI.method: 提出预期奖励预测（ERP）方法，通过预测LLM在重复采样下从奖励模型获得的预期奖励。该方法支持模型路由协议，在推理时根据提示将请求路由到不同模型，以最大化奖励同时控制计算成本。
AI.result: 在open-perfectblend数据集上，使用包含Llama3.1-Instruct 8B/70B、Gemma2-IT 9B/27B和Gemma1-IT 7B的模型池进行测试。ERP路由方法优于基于类别平均性能的路由基线，并能解释更复杂路由协议的成功原因。
AI.conclusion: 预期奖励预测方法能够准确区分不同模型对特定提示的适用性，支持有效的模型路由决策。该方法具有可扩展性，易于在新模型加入池时进行扩展。

title: Efficient Visual Anomaly Detection at the Edge: Enabling Real-Time Industrial Inspection on Resource-Constrained Devices
summary: Visual Anomaly Detection (VAD) is essential for industrial quality control, enabling automatic defect detection in manufacturing. In real production lines, VAD systems must satisfy strict real-time and privacy requirements, necessitating a shift from cloud-based processing to local edge deployment. However, processing data locally on edge devices introduces new challenges because edge hardware has limited memory and computational resources. To overcome these limitations, we propose two efficient VAD methods designed for edge deployment: PatchCore-Lite and Padim-Lite, based on the popular PatchCore and PaDiM models. PatchCore-Lite runs first a coarse search on a product-quantized memory bank, then an exact search on a decoded subset. Padim-Lite is sped up using diagonal covariance, turning Mahalanobis distance into efficient element-wise computation. We evaluate our methods on the MVTec AD and VisA benchmarks and show their suitability for edge environments. PatchCore-Lite achieves a remarkable 79% reduction in total memory footprint, while PaDiM-Lite achieves substantial efficiency gains with a 77% reduction in total memory and a 31% decrease in inference time. These results show that VAD can be effectively deployed on edge devices, enabling real-time, private, and cost-efficient industrial inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出了两种面向边缘部署的高效视觉异常检测方法：基于PatchCore的PatchCore-Lite和基于PaDiM的Padim-Lite，显著减少了内存占用和推理时间，适合工业实时检测需求。
AI.motivation: 工业质量控制的视觉异常检测系统需要满足严格的实时性和隐私要求，必须从云端处理转向边缘部署。但边缘设备内存和计算资源有限，需要设计高效的VAD方法。
AI.method: 1. PatchCore-Lite：先在产品量化内存库上进行粗搜索，然后在解码子集上进行精确搜索。2. Padim-Lite：使用对角协方差将马氏距离转换为高效的元素级计算。
AI.result: 在MVTec AD和VisA基准测试中验证了方法的有效性。PatchCore-Lite总内存占用减少79%，PaDiM-Lite总内存减少77%，推理时间减少31%。
AI.conclusion: VAD可以有效地部署在边缘设备上，实现实时、私密且成本效益高的工业检测，解决了边缘部署的资源限制问题。

title: Me, Myself, and $π$ : Evaluating and Explaining LLM Introspection
comment: 20 pages, 12 figures, ICLR 2026 Workshop: From Human Cognition to AI Reasoning: Models, Methods, and Applications
summary: A hallmark of human intelligence is Introspection-the ability to assess and reason about one's own cognitive processes. Introspection has emerged as a promising but contested capability in large language models (LLMs). However, current evaluations often fail to distinguish genuine meta-cognition from the mere application of general world knowledge or text-based self-simulation. In this work, we propose a principled taxonomy that formalizes introspection as the latent computation of specific operators over a model's policy and parameters. To isolate the components of generalized introspection, we present Introspect-Bench, a multifaceted evaluation suite designed for rigorous capability testing. Our results show that frontier models exhibit privileged access to their own policies, outperforming peer models in predicting their own behavior. Furthermore, we provide causal, mechanistic evidence explaining both how LLMs learn to introspect without explicit training, and how the mechanism of introspection emerges via attention diffusion.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种形式化的内省能力评估框架，通过Introspect-Bench测试套件发现前沿大语言模型能够更好地预测自身行为，并揭示了内省机制通过注意力扩散自然涌现的因果证据。
AI.motivation: 当前对大语言模型内省能力的评估存在缺陷，无法区分真正的元认知与一般世界知识或文本自我模拟的应用。需要建立更严谨的评估方法来理解LLMs是否真正具备内省能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个原则性分类法，将内省形式化为对模型策略和参数的特定算子的潜在计算。开发了Introspect-Bench多面评估套件，用于严格的能力测试，并提供了因果机制证据来解释内省如何在没有显式训练的情况下学习。
AI.result: 前沿模型在预测自身行为方面表现出特权访问能力，优于同类模型。研究提供了因果机制证据，解释了LLMs如何在没有显式训练的情况下学会内省，以及内省机制如何通过注意力扩散涌现。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为评估和理解大语言模型的内省能力提供了严谨的框架和证据，表明前沿模型确实具备一定程度的元认知能力，这种能力通过注意力机制自然涌现，而非简单的知识应用。

title: An experimental study of KV cache reuse strategies in chunk-level caching systems
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation improves large language models' accuracy by adding relevant retrieved text to the prompt. Chunk level caching (CLC) accelerates inference by precomputing KV caches for these retrieved chunks and reusing them. However, these caches miss cross-attention dependencies between chunks, which can reduce output quality. Several methods try to improve CLC accuracy using different techniques. We make two main contributions. First, we show that existing CLC approaches have fundamental limitations that limit their accuracy or their applicability. We back this conclusion with an extensive CLC system experimental evaluation. Second, we observe that existing CLC techniques are complementary. We leverage this insight to propose a new CLC design that carefully combines them and achieves better accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了检索增强生成中的块级缓存技术，指出现有方法存在跨块注意力依赖缺失问题，通过实验证明现有CLC方法有根本性限制，并提出结合多种互补技术的新设计来提升准确性。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成通过添加相关检索文本提升大语言模型准确性，块级缓存通过预计算KV缓存加速推理，但现有缓存方法忽略了块间的跨注意力依赖，这会降低输出质量。
AI.method: 首先通过广泛的CLC系统实验评估证明现有方法存在根本性限制；其次观察到现有CLC技术具有互补性，基于这一洞察提出新的CLC设计，精心组合多种技术。
AI.result: 实验评估显示现有CLC方法在准确性或适用性方面存在局限性；提出的新CLC设计通过结合互补技术实现了更好的准确性。
AI.conclusion: 现有CLC方法存在跨块注意力依赖缺失的根本限制，但不同技术具有互补性，通过精心组合这些技术可以设计出准确性更高的CLC系统。

title: Remote Sensing Image Dehazing: A Systematic Review of Progress, Challenges, and Prospects
summary: Remote sensing images (RSIs) are frequently degraded by haze, fog, and thin clouds, which obscure surface reflectance and hinder downstream applications. This study presents the first systematic and unified survey of RSIs dehazing, integrating methodological evolution, benchmark assessment, and physical consistency analysis. We categorize existing approaches into a three-stage progression: from handcrafted physical priors, to data-driven deep restoration, and finally to hybrid physical-intelligent generation, and summarize more than 30 representative methods across CNNs, GANs, Transformers, and diffusion models. To provide a reliable empirical reference, we conduct large-scale quantitative experiments on five public datasets using 12 metrics, including PSNR, SSIM, CIEDE, LPIPS, FID, SAM, ERGAS, UIQI, QNR, NIQE, and HIST. Cross-domain comparison reveals that recent Transformer- and diffusion-based models improve SSIM by 12%~18% and reduce perceptual errors by 20%~35% on average, while hybrid physics-guided designs achieve higher radiometric stability. A dedicated physical radiometric consistency experiment further demonstrates that models with explicit transmission or airlight constraints reduce color bias by up to 27%. Based on these findings, we summarize open challenges: dynamic atmospheric modeling, multimodal fusion, lightweight deployment, data scarcity, and joint degradations, and outline promising research directions for future development of trustworthy, controllable, and efficient (TCE) dehazing systems. All reviewed resources, including source code, benchmark datasets, evaluation metrics, and reproduction configurations are publicly available at https://github.com/VisionVerse/RemoteSensing-Restoration-Survey.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次系统性地综述了遥感图像去雾领域，涵盖方法演进、基准评估和物理一致性分析，提出了从手工物理先验到数据驱动深度学习再到混合物理智能生成的三阶段演进框架。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像经常受到雾、霾和薄云的干扰，这些大气退化会掩盖地表反射信息，影响下游应用。目前缺乏对遥感图像去雾方法的系统性综述和基准评估，需要建立统一的评估框架来指导未来研究。
AI.method: 1. 将现有方法分类为三阶段演进：手工物理先验方法、数据驱动的深度恢复方法、混合物理智能生成方法；2. 总结了超过30种代表性方法，涵盖CNN、GAN、Transformer和扩散模型；3. 在5个公共数据集上使用12个指标进行大规模定量实验；4. 专门设计了物理辐射一致性实验来评估颜色偏差。
AI.result: 1. 跨领域比较显示，基于Transformer和扩散模型的近期方法平均提高SSIM 12%~18%，减少感知误差20%~35%；2. 混合物理引导设计实现了更高的辐射稳定性；3. 具有显式传输或大气光约束的模型可减少高达27%的颜色偏差；4. 所有资源（源代码、基准数据集、评估指标、复现配置）已公开。
AI.conclusion: 总结了遥感图像去雾的开放挑战：动态大气建模、多模态融合、轻量级部署、数据稀缺性和联合退化处理，并展望了可信、可控、高效（TCE）去雾系统的未来研究方向。

title: Thinking into the Future: Latent Lookahead Training for Transformers
summary: Autoregressive language models trained with next-token prediction generate text by sampling one discrete token at a time. Although very scalable, this objective forces the model to commit at every step, preventing it from exploring or reflecting upon multiple plausible continuations. Furthermore, the compute allocation across tokens is uniform; every token is formed based on a single forward-pass, potentially limiting the model's expressiveness in cases where difficult tokens require inherently more compute. Towards addressing these limitations, we introduce latent lookahead, a training strategy that enables models to "think" before generating: at selected positions in the sequence, before committing to the next token, the model performs a multi-step lookahead in latent space. More precisely, instead of sampling future tokens, we leverage the network's latent space by recursively feeding its hidden states back into the context for $τ$ steps, investing more compute on predicting that token. This produces $τ$ latent predictions that are supervised against the next $τ$ ground-truth tokens, encouraging the model to "lookahead" and refine its prediction. We show that latent lookahead substantially outperforms both autoregressive and non-autoregressive baselines on planning tasks such as maze solving, Sudoku, and ProsQA, where foresight is essential.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"潜在前瞻"的训练策略，让语言模型在生成前能够"思考"，通过在潜在空间进行多步前瞻来改进预测质量。
AI.motivation: 传统的自回归语言模型使用下一个词预测目标，存在两个主要限制：1) 模型在每个步骤必须立即决定，无法探索多个可能的延续；2) 计算分配是均匀的，每个词都基于单次前向传播生成，对于困难词可能需要更多计算。
AI.method: 提出潜在前瞻训练策略：在序列的选定位置，模型在提交下一个词之前，在潜在空间进行多步前瞻。具体来说，不是采样未来词，而是将隐藏状态递归地反馈到上下文中进行τ步，投入更多计算来预测该词。这产生τ个潜在预测，监督其与接下来τ个真实词对齐，鼓励模型"前瞻"并优化预测。
AI.result: 潜在前瞻在需要前瞻能力的规划任务（如迷宫求解、数独和ProsQA）上显著优于自回归和非自回归基线模型。
AI.conclusion: 潜在前瞻训练策略通过让模型在生成前进行多步潜在空间思考，有效解决了传统自回归模型在探索性和计算分配方面的限制，在需要前瞻能力的任务上表现出色。

title: Transparent Fragments Contour Estimation via Visual-Tactile Fusion for Autonomous Reassembly
comment: 17 pages, 22 figures, submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence
summary: The contour estimation of transparent fragments is very important for autonomous reassembly, especially in the fields of precision optical instrument repair, cultural relic restoration, and identification of other precious device broken accidents. Different from general intact transparent objects, the contour estimation of transparent fragments face greater challenges due to strict optical properties, irregular shapes and edges. To address this issue, a general transparent fragments contour estimation framework based on visual-tactile fusion is proposed in this paper. First, we construct the transparent fragment dataset named TransFrag27K, which includes a multiscene synthetic data of broken fragments from multiple types of transparent objects, and a scalable synthetic data generation pipeline. Secondly, we propose a visual grasping position detection network named TransFragNet to identify, locate and segment the sampling grasping position. And, we use a two-finger gripper with Gelsight Mini sensors to obtain reconstructed tactile information of the lateral edge of the fragments. By fusing this tactile information with visual cues, a visual-tactile fusion material classifier is proposed. Inspired by the way humans estimate a fragment's contour combining vision and touch, we introduce a general transparent fragment contour estimation framework based on visual-tactile fusion, demonstrates strong performance in real-world validation. Finally, a multi-dimensional similarity metrics based contour matching and reassembly algorithm is proposed, providing a reproducible benchmark for evaluating visual-tactile contour estimation and fragment reassembly. The experimental results demonstrate the validity of the proposed framework. The dataset and codes are available at https://github.com/Keithllin/Transparent-Fragments-Contour-Estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于视觉-触觉融合的透明碎片轮廓估计框架，用于自主重组任务，在精密光学仪器修复、文物复原等领域有重要应用价值。
AI.motivation: 透明碎片的轮廓估计面临光学特性严格、形状不规则等挑战，传统方法难以处理。为解决这一问题，需要开发结合视觉和触觉信息的融合方法。
AI.method: 1) 构建TransFrag27K透明碎片数据集；2) 提出TransFragNet视觉抓取位置检测网络；3) 使用带Gelsight Mini传感器的双指夹爪获取触觉信息；4) 提出视觉-触觉融合材料分类器；5) 基于多维度相似度度量的轮廓匹配与重组算法。
AI.result: 实验结果表明所提框架的有效性，在真实世界验证中表现出色。提供了可复现的基准测试，数据集和代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 提出的视觉-触觉融合框架能够有效解决透明碎片轮廓估计的挑战，为自主重组任务提供了可行的解决方案，在多个应用领域具有实用价值。

title: LLM-Enhanced Energy Contrastive Learning for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Text-Attributed Graphs
summary: Text-attributed graphs, where nodes are enriched with textual attributes, have become a powerful tool for modeling real-world networks such as citation, social, and transaction networks. However, existing methods for learning from these graphs often assume that the distributions of training and testing data are consistent. This assumption leads to significant performance degradation when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) data. In this paper, we address the challenge of node-level OOD detection in text-attributed graphs, with the goal of maintaining accurate node classification while simultaneously identifying OOD nodes. We propose a novel approach, LLM-Enhanced Energy Contrastive Learning for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Text-Attributed Graphs (LECT), which integrates large language models (LLMs) and energy-based contrastive learning. The proposed method involves generating high-quality OOD samples by leveraging the semantic understanding and contextual knowledge of LLMs to create dependency-aware pseudo-OOD nodes, and applying contrastive learning based on energy functions to distinguish between in-distribution (IND) and OOD nodes. The effectiveness of our method is demonstrated through extensive experiments on six benchmark datasets, where our method consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving both high classification accuracy and robust OOD detection capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为LECT的新方法，用于文本属性图中的节点级OOD检测，通过结合LLM和基于能量的对比学习，在保持准确节点分类的同时识别OOD节点。
AI.motivation: 现有文本属性图学习方法通常假设训练和测试数据分布一致，但在面对分布外（OOD）数据时会导致性能显著下降。需要解决节点级OOD检测的挑战，在保持准确节点分类的同时识别OOD节点。
AI.method: 提出LLM增强的能量对比学习方法（LECT）：1）利用LLM的语义理解和上下文知识生成依赖感知的伪OOD节点作为高质量OOD样本；2）应用基于能量函数的对比学习来区分分布内（IND）和OOD节点。
AI.result: 在六个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，该方法在节点分类准确性和OOD检测能力方面均优于现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: LECT方法通过整合LLM和能量对比学习，有效解决了文本属性图中的节点级OOD检测问题，实现了高分类准确性和鲁棒的OOD检测能力。

title: Linguistic Signatures for Enhanced Emotion Detection
summary: Emotion detection is a central problem in NLP, with recent progress driven by transformer-based models trained on established datasets. However, little is known about the linguistic regularities that characterize how emotions are expressed across different corpora and labels. This study examines whether linguistic features can serve as reliable interpretable signals for emotion recognition in text. We extract emotion-specific linguistic signatures from 13 English datasets and evaluate how incorporating these features into transformer models impacts performance. Our RoBERTa-based models enriched with high level linguistic features achieve consistent performance gains of up to +2.4 macro F1 on the GoEmotions benchmark, showing that explicit lexical cues can complement neural representations and improve robustness in predicting emotion categories.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了情感检测中语言特征作为可解释信号的有效性，通过从13个英文数据集中提取情感特定的语言特征，并将其融入RoBERTa模型，在GoEmotions基准上实现了最高+2.4宏F1的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于Transformer的模型在情感检测方面取得了进展，但人们对不同语料库和标签中情感表达的语言规律知之甚少。本研究旨在探索语言特征是否能作为文本情感识别的可靠可解释信号。
AI.method: 从13个英文数据集中提取情感特定的语言特征，将这些高级语言特征融入RoBERTa模型中，评估其对情感识别性能的影响。
AI.result: 融入高级语言特征的RoBERTa模型在GoEmotions基准上实现了最高+2.4宏F1的稳定性能提升，表明显性词汇线索可以补充神经表示并提高情感类别预测的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 语言特征可以作为情感识别的可靠可解释信号，显性词汇线索与神经表示的结合能够有效提升模型性能，为情感检测提供了更稳健的方法。

title: HSI Image Enhancement Classification Based on Knowledge Distillation: A Study on Forgetting
summary: In incremental classification tasks for hyperspectral images, catastrophic forgetting is an unavoidable challenge. While memory recall methods can mitigate this issue, they heavily rely on samples from old categories. This paper proposes a teacher-based knowledge retention method for incremental image classification. It alleviates model forgetting of old category samples by utilizing incremental category samples, without depending on old category samples. Additionally, this paper introduces a mask-based partial category knowledge distillation algorithm. By decoupling knowledge distillation, this approach filters out potentially misleading information that could misguide the student model, thereby enhancing overall accuracy. Comparative and ablation experiments demonstrate the proposed method's robust performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于教师模型的知识保留方法，用于高光谱图像增量分类，通过增量类别样本缓解模型对旧类别的遗忘，无需依赖旧类别样本，并引入基于掩码的部分类别知识蒸馏算法提升准确性。
AI.motivation: 在高光谱图像增量分类任务中，灾难性遗忘是一个不可避免的挑战。虽然记忆回忆方法可以缓解这个问题，但它们严重依赖旧类别样本。本文旨在开发一种不依赖旧类别样本的增量学习方法。
AI.method: 提出基于教师模型的知识保留方法，利用增量类别样本缓解模型对旧类别的遗忘，不依赖旧类别样本。引入基于掩码的部分类别知识蒸馏算法，通过解耦知识蒸馏，过滤可能误导学生模型的错误信息。
AI.result: 对比实验和消融实验表明，所提出的方法具有鲁棒的性能表现，能够有效缓解灾难性遗忘问题，提升增量分类的整体准确性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为高光谱图像增量分类提供了一种不依赖旧类别样本的有效解决方案，通过教师模型知识保留和掩码知识蒸馏算法，显著缓解了灾难性遗忘问题。

title: Compression is all you need: Modeling Mathematics
summary: Human mathematics (HM), the mathematics humans discover and value, is a vanishingly small subset of formal mathematics (FM), the totality of all valid deductions. We argue that HM is distinguished by its compressibility through hierarchically nested definitions, lemmas, and theorems. We model this with monoids. A mathematical deduction is a string of primitive symbols; a definition or theorem is a named substring or macro whose use compresses the string. In the free abelian monoid $A_n$, a logarithmically sparse macro set achieves exponential expansion of expressivity. In the free non-abelian monoid $F_n$, even a polynomially-dense macro set only yields linear expansion; superlinear expansion requires near-maximal density. We test these models against MathLib, a large Lean~4 library of mathematics that we take as a proxy for HM. Each element has a depth (layers of definitional nesting), a wrapped length (tokens in its definition), and an unwrapped length (primitive symbols after fully expanding all references). We find unwrapped length grows exponentially with both depth and wrapped length; wrapped length is approximately constant across all depths. These results are consistent with $A_n$ and inconsistent with $F_n$, supporting the thesis that HM occupies a polynomially-growing subset of the exponentially growing space FM. We discuss how compression, measured on the MathLib dependency graph, and a PageRank-style analysis of that graph can quantify mathematical interest and help direct automated reasoning toward the compressible regions where human mathematics lives.

AI.tldr: 人类数学(HM)只是形式数学(FM)的极小可压缩子集，通过分层定义实现指数级表达扩展，MathLib数据支持这一理论。
AI.motivation: 探究人类数学(HM)与形式数学(FM)的本质区别，理解为什么人类只关注FM中极小部分，以及这种选择背后的数学结构原理。
AI.method: 使用幺半群模型分析数学压缩性：在自由阿贝尔幺半群$A_n$中，对数稀疏的宏集实现指数扩展；在自由非阿贝尔幺半群$F_n$中，多项式密度宏集仅得线性扩展。用MathLib(Lean~4数学库)作为HM代理进行实证检验。
AI.result: MathLib数据显示：未包装长度随深度和包装长度呈指数增长；包装长度在不同深度基本恒定。这些结果与$A_n$模型一致，与$F_n$模型不一致，支持HM占据FM中多项式增长子集的理论。
AI.conclusion: 人类数学通过分层定义实现高效压缩，占据形式数学中可压缩的指数扩展区域。压缩性和PageRank式分析可量化数学兴趣，指导自动推理向人类数学所在的可压缩区域发展。

title: Beyond Test-Time Compute Strategies: Advocating Energy-per-Token in LLM Inference
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate exceptional performance across diverse tasks but come with substantial energy and computational costs, particularly in request-heavy scenarios. In many real-world applications, the full scale and capabilities of LLMs are often unnecessary, as Small Language Models (SLMs) can provide accurate responses for simpler text generation tasks. When enhanced with advanced reasoning strategies, such as Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting or Majority Voting, SLMs can approach the performance of larger models while reducing overall computational requirements. However, these strategies can also introduce additional energy costs, creating an energy-accuracy trade-off. Our analysis examines these trade-offs in test-time compute strategies for smaller models compared to larger ones, using the MMLU benchmark. Additionally, we explore the input-output token dynamics of transformer architectures, which result in nonlinear hardware energy operation curves for LLMs. To bridge AI research with its physical impact, we propose \textit{energy efficiency metrics}, including Energy-per-Token, as complements to traditional accuracy benchmarks. Beyond model selection, we propose controlled reasoning in CoT token generation, using operating curves to regulate reasoning depth dynamically. This vision integrates a energy-aware routing mechanism, ensuring that model selection and inference strategies balance accuracy for sustainable AI deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型(LLMs)与小语言模型(SLMs)在能耗与准确性之间的权衡，提出能量效率指标和可控推理策略以实现可持续AI部署。
AI.motivation: LLMs虽然性能卓越但能耗巨大，而许多实际应用中并不需要LLMs的全部能力。SLMs在增强推理策略后可以接近大模型性能但能耗更低，然而这些策略本身也会增加能耗，形成能耗-准确性权衡问题。
AI.method: 1. 分析SLMs与LLMs在测试时计算策略中的能耗-准确性权衡，使用MMLU基准测试；2. 探索transformer架构的输入-输出token动态特性导致的非线性硬件能耗曲线；3. 提出能量效率指标（如Energy-per-Token）作为传统准确性基准的补充；4. 提出可控推理策略，利用操作曲线动态调节推理深度；5. 设计能量感知路由机制平衡模型选择和推理策略。
AI.result: 研究发现transformer架构的输入-输出token动态导致LLMs的非线性硬件能耗曲线。通过能量效率指标可以更全面地评估模型性能。可控推理策略和能量感知路由机制能够在保持准确性的同时显著降低能耗，实现更可持续的AI部署。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出将能量效率指标纳入AI评估体系，通过可控推理和能量感知路由机制平衡模型性能与能耗，为可持续AI部署提供了新的方法论框架，将AI研究与其物理环境影响相结合。

title: InjectFlow: Weak Guides Strong via Orthogonal Injection for Flow Matching
summary: Flow Matching (FM) has recently emerged as a leading approach for high-fidelity visual generation, offering a robust continuous-time alternative to ordinary differential equation (ODE) based models. However, despite their success, FM models are highly sensitive to dataset biases, which cause severe semantic degradation when generating out-of-distribution or minority-class samples. In this paper, we provide a rigorous mathematical formalization of the ``Bias Manifold'' within the FM framework. We identify that this performance drop is driven by conditional expectation smoothing, a mechanism that inevitably leads to trajectory lock-in during inference. To resolve this, we introduce InjectFlow, a novel, training-free method by injecting orthogonal semantics during the initial velocity field computation, without requiring any changes to the random seeds. This design effectively prevents the latent drift toward majority modes while maintaining high generative quality. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach. Notably, on the GenEval dataset, InjectFlow successfully fixes 75% of the prompts that standard flow matching models fail to generate correctly. Ultimately, our theoretical analysis and algorithm provide a ready-to-use solution for building more fair and robust visual foundation models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InjectFlow方法，通过注入正交语义来修复Flow Matching模型中的数据集偏差问题，无需重新训练即可显著改善少数类别样本的生成质量。
AI.motivation: Flow Matching（FM）模型虽然在高保真视觉生成方面表现出色，但对数据集偏差高度敏感，导致在生成分布外或少数类别样本时出现严重的语义退化问题。
AI.method: 提出InjectFlow方法：1）在FM框架中形式化"偏差流形"概念；2）识别条件期望平滑导致推理过程中轨迹锁定的机制；3）在初始速度场计算时注入正交语义，无需改变随机种子或重新训练。
AI.result: 在GenEval数据集上，InjectFlow成功修复了75%的标准Flow Matching模型无法正确生成的提示，有效防止潜在表示向多数模式漂移，同时保持高生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析和算法设计，InjectFlow为构建更公平、更鲁棒的视觉基础模型提供了即用型解决方案，解决了FM模型中的数据集偏差问题。

title: Leveraging Natural Language Processing and Machine Learning for Evidence-Based Food Security Policy Decision-Making in Data-Scarce Making
comment: 25 pages, 12 figures, 2 tables. Submitted for academic publication
summary: Food security policy formulation in data-scarce regions remains a critical challenge due to limited structured datasets, fragmented textual reports, and demographic bias in decision-making systems. This study proposes ZeroHungerAI, an integrated Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) framework designed for evidence-based food security policy modeling under extreme data scarcity. The system combines structured socio-economic indicators with contextual policy text embeddings using a transfer learning based DistilBERT architecture. Experimental evaluation on a 1200-sample hybrid dataset across 25 districts demonstrates superior predictive performance, achieving 91 percent classification accuracy, 0.89 precision, 0.85 recall, and an F1 score of 0.86 under imbalanced conditions. Comparative analysis shows a 13 percent performance improvement over classical SVM and 17 percent over Logistic Regression models. Precision Recall evaluation confirms robust minority class detection (average precision around 0.88). Fairness aware optimization reduces demographic parity difference to 3 percent, ensuring equitable rural urban policy inference. The results validate that transformer based contextual learning significantly enhances policy intelligence in low resource governance environments, enabling scalable and bias aware hunger prediction systems.

AI.tldr: ZeroHungerAI是一个结合NLP和ML的框架，用于在数据稀缺地区进行基于证据的粮食安全政策建模，通过DistilBERT架构整合结构化指标和文本嵌入，在1200个样本上实现91%准确率，比传统方法提升13-17%。
AI.motivation: 数据稀缺地区的粮食安全政策制定面临结构化数据有限、文本报告碎片化以及决策系统存在人口统计偏差等挑战，需要开发能够在极端数据稀缺条件下工作的智能系统。
AI.method: 提出ZeroHungerAI框架，结合结构化社会经济指标和上下文政策文本嵌入，采用基于迁移学习的DistilBERT架构，进行公平感知优化以减少人口统计偏差。
AI.result: 在25个地区的1200个样本混合数据集上，实现了91%的分类准确率、0.89精度、0.85召回率和0.86 F1分数；比传统SVM提升13%，比逻辑回归提升17%；公平性优化将人口统计差异降至3%。
AI.conclusion: 基于Transformer的上下文学习显著增强了低资源治理环境中的政策智能，实现了可扩展且具有偏见意识的饥饿预测系统，为数据稀缺地区的粮食安全政策制定提供了有效解决方案。

title: Transferable Multi-Bit Watermarking Across Frozen Diffusion Models via Latent Consistency Bridges
summary: As diffusion models (DMs) enable photorealistic image generation at unprecedented scale, watermarking techniques have become essential for provenance establishment and accountability. Existing methods face challenges: sampling-based approaches operate on frozen models but require costly $N$-step Denoising Diffusion Implicit Models (DDIM) inversion (typically N=50) for zero-bit-only detection; fine-tuning-based methods achieve fast multi-bit extraction but couple the watermark to a specific model checkpoint, requiring retraining for each architecture. We propose DiffMark, a plug-and-play watermarking method that offers three key advantages over existing approaches: single-pass multi-bit detection, per-image key flexibility, and cross-model transferability. Rather than encoding the watermark into the initial noise vector, DiffMark injects a persistent learned perturbation $δ$ at every denoising step of a completely frozen DM. The watermark signal accumulates in the final denoised latent $z_0$ and is recovered in a single forward pass. The central challenge of backpropagating gradients through a frozen UNet without traversing the full denoising chain is addressed by employing Latent Consistency Models (LCM) as a differentiable training bridge. This reduces the number of gradient steps from 50 DDIM to 4 LCM and enables a single-pass detection at 16.4 ms, a 45x speedup over sampling-based methods. Moreover, by this design, the encoder learns to map any runtime secret to a unique perturbation at inference time, providing genuine per-image key flexibility and transferability to unseen diffusion-based architectures without per-model fine-tuning. Although achieving these advantages, DiffMark also maintains competitive watermark robustness against distortion, regeneration, and adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: DiffMark是一种即插即用的扩散模型水印方法，通过在每个去噪步骤注入持久扰动实现单次多比特检测、每图像密钥灵活性和跨模型可迁移性。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型水印方法存在局限：基于采样的方法需要昂贵的DDIM反演进行零比特检测；基于微调的方法虽然能快速提取多比特但将水印与特定模型检查点耦合，需要为每个架构重新训练。
AI.method: DiffMark在完全冻结的扩散模型的每个去噪步骤注入持久学习扰动δ，水印信号在最终去噪潜在空间z0中累积并通过单次前向传播恢复。使用潜在一致性模型作为可微分训练桥梁，将梯度步骤从50步DDIM减少到4步LCM。
AI.result: 实现单次检测时间16.4毫秒，比基于采样的方法快45倍；提供真正的每图像密钥灵活性；无需每个模型微调即可迁移到未见过的扩散架构；同时保持对失真、再生和对抗攻击的竞争性鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: DiffMark解决了现有扩散模型水印方法的局限性，提供了一种高效、灵活且可迁移的即插即用水印解决方案，在保持鲁棒性的同时显著提高了检测速度。

title: FinReflectKG -- HalluBench: GraphRAG Hallucination Benchmark for Financial Question Answering Systems
summary: As organizations increasingly integrate AI-powered question-answering systems into financial information systems for compliance, risk assessment, and decision support, ensuring the factual accuracy of AI-generated outputs becomes a critical engineering challenge. Current Knowledge Graph (KG)-augmented QA systems lack systematic mechanisms to detect hallucinations - factually incorrect outputs that undermine reliability and user trust. We introduce FinBench-QA-Hallucination, a benchmark for evaluating hallucination detection methods in KG-augmented financial QA over SEC 10-K filings. The dataset contains 755 annotated examples from 300 pages, each labeled for groundedness using a conservative evidence-linkage protocol requiring support from both textual chunks and extracted relational triplets. We evaluate six detection approaches - LLM judges, fine-tuned classifiers, Natural Language Inference (NLI) models, span detectors, and embedding-based methods under two conditions: with and without KG triplets. Results show that LLM-based judges and embedding approaches achieve the highest performance (F1: 0.82-0.86) under clean conditions. However, most methods degrade significantly when noisy triplets are introduced, with Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) dropping 44-84 percent, while embedding methods remain relatively robust with only 9 percent degradation. Statistical tests (Cochran's Q and McNemar) confirm significant performance differences (p < 0.001). Our findings highlight vulnerabilities in current KG-augmented systems and provide insights for building reliable financial information systems, where hallucinations can lead to regulatory violations and flawed decisions. The benchmark also offers a framework for integrating AI reliability evaluation into information system design across other high-stakes domains such as healthcare, legal, and government.

AI.tldr: FinBench-QA-Hallucination：针对SEC 10-K文件KG增强金融QA系统的幻觉检测基准，包含755个标注样本，评估6种检测方法，发现LLM法官和嵌入方法表现最佳，但大多数方法在噪声三元组下性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 随着AI问答系统在金融信息系统中的广泛应用，确保AI生成输出的真实性成为关键工程挑战。当前基于知识图谱的QA系统缺乏系统化的幻觉检测机制，这些事实错误的输出会损害系统可靠性和用户信任。
AI.method: 构建FinBench-QA-Hallucination基准数据集，包含755个来自300页SEC 10-K文件的标注样本，采用保守的证据链接协议（需要文本块和提取的关系三元组双重支持）。评估六种检测方法：LLM法官、微调分类器、自然语言推理模型、跨度检测器和嵌入方法，在有/无知识图谱三元组两种条件下进行测试。
AI.result: LLM法官和嵌入方法在清洁条件下表现最佳（F1：0.82-0.86）。大多数方法在引入噪声三元组时性能显著下降，MCC下降44-84%，而嵌入方法相对稳健，仅下降9%。统计检验（Cochran's Q和McNemar）确认性能差异显著（p < 0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前KG增强系统的脆弱性，为构建可靠的金融信息系统提供了见解，其中幻觉可能导致监管违规和错误决策。该基准还为其他高风险领域（如医疗、法律和政府）的信息系统设计中集成AI可靠性评估提供了框架。

title: The Global-Local loop: what is missing in bridging the gap between geospatial data from numerous communities?
summary: We face a unprecedented amount of geospatial data, describing directly or indirectly the Earth Surface at multiple spatial, temporal, and semantic scales, and stemming from numerous contributors, from satellites to citizens. The main challenge in all the geospatial-related communities lies in suitably leveraging a combination of some of the sources for either a generic or a thematic application. Certain data fusion schemes are predominantly exploited: they correspond to popular tasks with mainstream data sources, e.g., free archives of Sentinel images coupled with OpenStreetMap data under an open and widespread deep-learning backbone for land-cover mapping purposes. Most of these approaches unfortunately operate under a "master-slave" paradigm, where one source is basically integrated to help processing the "main" source, without mutual advantages (e.g., large-scale estimation of a given biophysical variable using in-situ observations) and under a specific community bias. We argue that numerous key data fusion configurations, and in particular the effort in symmetrizing the exploitation of multiple data sources, are insufficiently addressed while being highly beneficial for generic or thematic applications. Bridges and retroactions between scales, communities and their respective sources are lacking, neglecting the utmost potential of such a "global-local loop". In this paper, we propose to establish the most relevant interaction schemes through illustrative use cases. We subsequently discuss under-explored research directions that could take advantage of leveraging available data through multiples extents and communities.

AI.tldr: 论文探讨了地理空间数据融合的挑战，指出当前主流方法采用"主从"范式，缺乏多源数据的对称利用和跨尺度、跨社区的反馈循环，提出了建立更相关交互方案的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 面对海量多尺度、多来源的地理空间数据，当前数据融合方法主要采用"主从"范式，即一个数据源辅助处理"主"数据源，缺乏多源数据的对称利用和跨尺度、跨社区的反馈循环，限制了数据融合的潜力。
AI.method: 通过说明性用例建立最相关的交互方案，讨论利用多尺度、多社区数据的未充分探索研究方向。
AI.result: 论文识别了当前地理空间数据融合的局限性，特别是缺乏对称利用多源数据和"全局-局部循环"的潜力，提出了需要建立更相关交互方案的研究方向。
AI.conclusion: 需要超越当前的"主从"范式，建立对称的多源数据融合方案，促进跨尺度、跨社区的反馈循环，以充分发挥地理空间数据融合的潜力，为通用或专题应用带来更大效益。

title: DiffGraph: An Automated Agent-driven Model Merging Framework for In-the-Wild Text-to-Image Generation
summary: The rapid growth of the text-to-image (T2I) community has fostered a thriving online ecosystem of expert models, which are variants of pretrained diffusion models specialized for diverse generative abilities. Yet, existing model merging methods remain limited in fully leveraging abundant online expert resources and still struggle to meet diverse in-the-wild user needs. We present DiffGraph, a novel agent-driven graph-based model merging framework, which automatically harnesses online experts and flexibly merges them for diverse user needs. Our DiffGraph constructs a scalable graph and organizes ever-expanding online experts within it through node registration and calibration. Then, DiffGraph dynamically activates specific subgraphs based on user needs, enabling flexible combinations of different experts to achieve user-desired generation. Extensive experiments show the efficacy of our method.

AI.tldr: DiffGraph是一个基于图的智能体驱动模型融合框架，能够自动利用在线专家模型并灵活合并它们以满足多样化的用户需求。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像社区的快速增长催生了丰富的在线专家模型生态系统，但现有模型融合方法在充分利用这些在线专家资源方面仍有限制，难以满足多样化的实际用户需求。
AI.method: 提出DiffGraph框架：1）构建可扩展的图结构，通过节点注册和校准组织不断扩展的在线专家模型；2）基于用户需求动态激活特定子图，实现不同专家模型的灵活组合。
AI.result: 大量实验证明了该方法的有效性，能够更好地利用在线专家资源并满足多样化的生成需求。
AI.conclusion: DiffGraph通过图结构和智能体驱动的方式，为文本到图像生成领域提供了一种更灵活、可扩展的模型融合解决方案，能够更好地适应不断增长的在线专家模型生态系统。

title: Efficient Counterfactual Reasoning in ProbLog via Single World Intervention Programs
summary: Probabilistic Logic Programming (PLP) languages, like ProbLog, naturally support reasoning under uncertainty, while maintaining a declarative and interpretable framework. Meanwhile, counterfactual reasoning (i.e., answering ``what if'' questions) is critical for ensuring AI systems are robust and trustworthy; however, integrating this capability into PLP can be computationally prohibitive and unstable in accuracy. This paper addresses this challenge, by proposing an efficient program transformation for counterfactuals as Single World Intervention Programs (SWIPs) in ProbLog. By systematically splitting ProbLog clauses to observed and fixed components relevant to a counterfactual, we create a transformed program that (1) does not asymptotically exceed the computational complexity of existing methods, and is strictly smaller in common cases, and (2) reduces counterfactual reasoning to marginal inference over a simpler program. We formally prove the correctness of our approach, which relies on a weaker set independence assumptions and is consistent with conditional independencies, showing the resulting marginal probabilities match the counterfactual distributions of the underlying Structural Causal Model in wide domains. Our method achieves a 35\% reduction in inference time versus existing methods in extensive experiments. This work makes complex counterfactual reasoning more computationally tractable and reliable, providing a crucial step towards developing more robust and explainable AI systems. The code is at https://github.com/EVIEHub/swip.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种高效的ProbLog程序转换方法，将反事实推理转换为单世界干预程序，显著降低了计算复杂度并提高了推理稳定性。
AI.motivation: 概率逻辑编程语言（如ProbLog）虽然支持不确定性推理并保持声明性和可解释性，但反事实推理（回答"如果...会怎样"的问题）在PLP中的集成存在计算复杂度过高和准确性不稳定的问题，这限制了AI系统的鲁棒性和可信度。
AI.method: 提出了一种高效的程序转换方法，将ProbLog中的反事实推理转换为单世界干预程序。通过系统地将ProbLog子句拆分为与反事实相关的观察组件和固定组件，创建转换后的程序，将反事实推理简化为对更简单程序的边际推断。
AI.result: 该方法在计算复杂度上不超过现有方法，在常见情况下更小；将反事实推理简化为边际推断；形式化证明了方法的正确性；在广泛实验中实现了35%的推理时间减少。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作使复杂的反事实推理在计算上更加可行和可靠，为开发更鲁棒和可解释的AI系统迈出了关键一步。

title: SciNav: A General Agent Framework for Scientific Coding Tasks
summary: Autonomous science agents built on large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate hypotheses, design experiments, and produce reports. However, prior work mainly targets open-ended scientific problems with subjective outputs that are difficult to evaluate. Scientific coding benchmarks, by contrast, provide executable outputs for objective assessment. Existing approaches remain engineering-driven pipelines, revealing the need for structured, end-to-end science agent frameworks for scientific coding tasks. We address this gap by focusing on scientific coding tasks, where evaluation can be made rigorously, and introducing an agent framework SciNav (Scientific Navigator) that enables more effective solution exploration. Our framework is designed to operate under constrained search budgets, moving beyond reliance on pre-defined success metrics and prolonged search cycles. Inspired by findings that comparative judgments often reveal finer-grained quality differences and therefore provide greater discriminative power than absolute scoring, our framework leverages pairwise relative judgments within a tree search process to select top-K promising solution branches, prune low-potential ones, and progressively narrow down the solution candidates on the selected branches guided by relative comparisons. We demonstrate our agent's effectiveness across different types of tasks on two benchmarks. Experiments show that SciNav significantly outperforms direct prompting and prior agents like OpenHands and Self-Debug across different base models, task types, and difficulty levels, and exceeds different frontier comparators such as random selection and LLM absolute scoring. These results confirm the strength of our agent design and highlight the effectiveness of relative judgment-guided top-K search for high-quality scientific coding, marking a step toward more practical science agents.

AI.tldr: SciNav是一个基于相对判断引导的树搜索框架，用于科学编码任务，通过成对比较而非绝对评分来高效探索解决方案，在有限搜索预算下显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的科学代理主要针对开放式科学问题，其主观输出难以评估；而科学编码基准虽然提供可执行输出便于客观评估，但现有方法多为工程驱动流程，缺乏结构化、端到端的科学代理框架。需要一种能在有限搜索预算下有效探索解决方案的框架。
AI.method: 提出SciNav框架，利用成对相对判断而非绝对评分，在树搜索过程中选择前K个有希望的解决方案分支，剪枝低潜力分支，并通过相对比较逐步缩小选定分支上的候选方案。该方法基于研究发现：比较性判断比绝对评分更能揭示细粒度的质量差异。
AI.result: 在两个基准测试的不同类型任务上，SciNav显著优于直接提示和OpenHands、Self-Debug等现有代理，在不同基础模型、任务类型和难度级别上均表现优异，且超过随机选择和LLM绝对评分等比较器。
AI.conclusion: SciNav框架的设计优势得到验证，相对判断引导的前K搜索对高质量科学编码具有有效性，标志着向更实用的科学代理迈出了一步。

title: Grounded Chess Reasoning in Language Models via Master Distillation
summary: Language models often lack grounded reasoning capabilities in specialized domains where training data is scarce but bespoke systems excel. We introduce a general framework for distilling expert system reasoning into natural language chain-of-thought explanations, enabling compact models to acquire domain expertise and the ability to generate faithful, grounded explanations. Rather than distilling only final outputs, we capture the full reasoning process, transforming opaque expert computations into transparent, step-by-step explanations. We demonstrate this approach in chess, a canonical reasoning domain where language models continue to underperform. Our 4B parameter model, C1, advances from a near-zero baseline to 48.1% accuracy, outperforming all open-source models and most frontier proprietary systems. Notably, C1 surpasses its distillation teacher and generates solutions in two orders of magnitude fewer tokens than baselines. Unlike prior neural chess approaches that predict only best moves, C1 generates explainable solutions revealing strategic reasoning. Our pipeline combines supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with theme-balanced data sampling for comprehensive tactical coverage. Master Distillation demonstrates how to inject expert-level knowledge into compact models for under-optimized domains, offering a recipe for unlocking RLVR where LLMs lack sufficient base capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出一个将专家系统推理蒸馏到语言模型的通用框架，在训练数据稀缺的专业领域（如国际象棋）实现专家级推理和可解释的解决方案生成。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在专业领域缺乏基于推理的能力，特别是训练数据稀缺但专家系统表现优异的领域。需要一种方法将专家系统的推理能力注入到紧凑的语言模型中，使其能够生成忠实、基于推理的解释。
AI.method: 引入专家蒸馏框架，将专家系统的完整推理过程转化为自然语言的思维链解释。采用监督微调和强化学习结合的方法，使用主题平衡的数据采样确保全面的战术覆盖。在象棋领域实现，模型C1（40亿参数）通过蒸馏专家推理过程获得领域专业知识。
AI.result: C1模型从接近零的基线提升到48.1%的准确率，超越了所有开源模型和大多数前沿专有系统。不仅超越了其蒸馏教师，而且以比基线少两个数量级的token生成解决方案。与仅预测最佳走法的先前神经象棋方法不同，C1生成揭示战略推理的可解释解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 专家蒸馏展示了如何将专家级知识注入到紧凑模型中，为优化不足的领域提供解决方案，为在语言模型缺乏足够基础能力的领域实现强化学习价值回归（RLVR）提供了方法。

title: The production of meaning in the processing of natural language
comment: Submitted to HAXD 2026, 9 pages, 3 figures, 2 tables. associated package available at https://github.com/npc-worldwide/qstk
summary: Understanding the fundamental mechanisms governing the production of meaning in the processing of natural language is critical for designing safe, thoughtful, engaging, and empowering human-agent interactions. Experiments in cognitive science and social psychology have demonstrated that human semantic processing exhibits contextuality more consistent with quantum logical mechanisms than classical Boolean theories, and recent works have found similar results in large language models -- in particular, clear violations of the Bell inequality in experiments of contextuality during interpretation of ambiguous expressions. We explore the CHSH $|S|$ parameter -- the metric associated with the inequality -- across the inference parameter space of models spanning four orders of magnitude in scale, cross-referencing it with MMLU, hallucination rate, and nonsense detection benchmarks. We find that the interquartile range of the $|S|$ distribution -- the statistic that most sharply differentiates models from one another -- is completely orthogonal to all external benchmarks, while violation rate shows weak anticorrelation with all three benchmarks that does not reach significance. We investigate how $|S|$ varies with sampling parameters and word order, and discuss the information-theoretic constraints that genuine contextuality imposes on prompt injection defenses and its human analogue, whereby careful construction and maintenance of social contextuality can be carried out at scale -- manufacturing not consent but contextuality itself, a subtler and more fundamental form of manipulation that shapes the space of possible interpretations before any particular one is reached.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了大型语言模型中语义处理的语境性，发现CHSH |S|参数分布的四分位距与外部基准测试完全正交，而违反率与基准测试呈弱负相关但不显著，揭示了语境性作为比传统操纵更根本的形式。
AI.motivation: 理解自然语言处理中意义产生的基本机制对于设计安全、周到、吸引人且赋能的人机交互至关重要。认知科学和社会心理学实验表明，人类语义处理表现出更符合量子逻辑机制而非经典布尔理论的语境性，最近研究在大型语言模型中也发现了类似结果——特别是在模糊表达解释的语境性实验中明显违反了贝尔不等式。
AI.method: 研究探索了CHSH |S|参数（与不等式相关的度量）在跨越四个数量级规模的模型推理参数空间中的变化，并将其与MMLU、幻觉率和无意义检测基准测试进行交叉参考。研究了|S|如何随采样参数和词序变化，并讨论了真正的语境性对提示注入防御及其人类类似物的信息论约束。
AI.result: 发现|S|分布的四分位距（最能区分不同模型的统计量）与所有外部基准测试完全正交，而违反率与三个基准测试均呈弱负相关但未达到显著性。语境性变化受采样参数和词序影响，真正的语境性对提示注入防御和人类类似操纵具有信息论约束。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明语境性度量与传统的模型性能基准无关，揭示了语境性作为一种比传统操纵更根本的形式——通过精心构建和维护社会语境性，可以在大规模上塑造可能的解释空间，这是一种在特定解释形成之前就起作用的更微妙、更根本的操纵形式。

title: LLM-Driven Heuristic Synthesis for Industrial Process Control: Lessons from Hot Steel Rolling
summary: Industrial process control demands policies that are interpretable and auditable, requirements that black-box neural policies struggle to meet. We study an LLM-driven heuristic synthesis framework for hot steel rolling, in which a language model iteratively proposes and refines human-readable Python controllers using rich behavioral feedback from a physics-based simulator. The framework combines structured strategic ideation, executable code generation, and per-component feedback across diverse operating conditions to search over control logic for height reduction, interpass time, and rolling velocity. Our first contribution is an auditable controller-synthesis pipeline for industrial process control. The generated controllers are explicit programs accessible to expert review, and we pair them with an automated audit pipeline that formally verifies key safety and monotonicity properties for the best synthesized heuristic. Our second contribution is a principled budget allocation strategy for LLM-driven heuristic search: we show that Luby-style universal restarts -- originally developed for randomized algorithms -- transfer directly to this setting, eliminating the need for problem-specific budget tuning. A single 160-iteration Luby campaign approaches the hindsight-optimal budget allocation derived from 52 ad-hoc runs totalling 730 iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于LLM的启发式控制器合成框架，用于热轧钢过程控制，通过语言模型迭代生成可读的Python控制器，结合物理模拟器反馈，并采用Luby式重启策略优化搜索预算分配。
AI.motivation: 工业过程控制需要可解释和可审计的策略，而黑盒神经网络策略难以满足这些要求。热轧钢过程控制需要人类可读、可审计的控制器，同时需要高效的启发式搜索方法。
AI.method: 采用LLM驱动的启发式合成框架：1) 语言模型迭代提出和优化人类可读的Python控制器；2) 使用基于物理的模拟器提供丰富的行为反馈；3) 结合结构化战略构思、可执行代码生成和组件级反馈；4) 采用Luby式通用重启策略进行预算分配，无需问题特定的参数调优。
AI.result: 1) 建立了可审计的控制器合成流水线，生成可被专家审查的显式程序控制器；2) 开发了自动化审计流水线，可形式化验证关键安全和单调性属性；3) 单次160次迭代的Luby活动接近从52次临时运行（总计730次迭代）得出的后见最优预算分配。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了工业过程控制中可解释性和可审计性的需求，通过LLM生成人类可读的控制器，并采用通用重启策略优化搜索效率，为工业控制系统的安全可靠部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: Coding Agents are Effective Long-Context Processors
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable progress in scaling to access massive contexts. However, the access is via the latent and uninterpretable attention mechanisms, and LLMs fail to effective process long context, exhibiting significant performance degradation as context length increases. In this work, we study whether long-context processing can be externalized from latent attention into explicit, executable interactions, by allowing coding agents to organize text in file systems and manipulate it using its native tools. We evaluate off-the-shelf frontier coding agents as the general interface for tasks that require processing long contexts, including long-context reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation, and open-domain question answering with large-scale corpus contains up to three trillion tokens. Across multiple benchmarks, these agents outperform published state-of-the-art by 17.3% on average. We attribute this efficacy to two key factors: native tool proficiency, which enables agents to leverage executable code and terminal commands rather than passive semantic queries, and file system familiarity, which allows them to navigate massive text corpora as directory structures. These findings suggest that delegating long-context processing to coding agents offers an effective alternative to semantic search or context window scaling, opening new directions for long-context processing in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将长文本处理从LLM的隐式注意力机制外部化到可执行的代码代理中，通过文件系统和编程工具处理大规模文本，在多个基准测试中平均超越SOTA 17.3%。
AI.motivation: 当前大型语言模型虽然能够访问大规模上下文，但通过隐式、不可解释的注意力机制，在处理长文本时性能显著下降。研究者希望探索是否可以将长文本处理从隐式注意力外部化到显式、可执行的交互中。
AI.method: 使用现成的前沿编码代理作为通用接口，让代理通过文件系统组织文本，并使用原生编程工具（可执行代码和终端命令）操作文本。这种方法替代了传统的语义搜索或上下文窗口扩展。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，包括长文本推理、检索增强生成和包含高达三万亿token的大规模语料库的开放域问答任务，这些编码代理平均超越已发表的最先进方法17.3%。
AI.conclusion: 将长文本处理委托给编码代理为语义搜索或上下文窗口扩展提供了有效替代方案，为LLM中的长文本处理开辟了新方向。关键优势在于原生工具熟练度和文件系统熟悉度。

title: Which Workloads Belong in Orbit? A Workload-First Framework for Orbital Data Centers Using Semantic Abstraction
summary: Space-based compute is becoming plausible as launch costs fall and data-intensive AI workloads grow. This paper proposes a workload-centric framework for deciding which tasks belong in orbit versus terrestrial cloud, along with a phased adoption model tied to orbital data center maturity. We ground the framework with in-orbit semantic-reduction prototypes. An Earth-observation pipeline on Sentinel-2 imagery from Seattle and Bengaluru (formerly Bangalore) achieves 99.7-99.99% payload reduction by converting raw imagery to compact semantic artifacts. A multi-pass stereo reconstruction prototype reduces ~306 MB to ~1.57 MB of derived 3D representations (99.49% reduction). These results support a workload-first view in which semantic abstraction, not raw compute scale, drives early workload suitability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于工作负载的框架，用于决定哪些AI任务适合在轨道上执行而非地面云，并通过语义缩减原型验证了在轨处理的可行性。
AI.motivation: 随着发射成本下降和AI数据密集型工作负载增长，太空计算变得可行。需要确定哪些任务适合在轨道执行，哪些应保留在地面云中。
AI.method: 提出工作负载中心框架和分阶段采用模型，结合轨道数据中心成熟度。通过两个在轨语义缩减原型验证：1) 地球观测管道处理Sentinel-2影像；2) 多视点立体重建原型。
AI.result: 地球观测管道实现99.7-99.99%有效载荷缩减；立体重建原型从~306 MB减少到~1.57 MB（99.49%缩减）。结果表明语义抽象而非原始计算规模驱动早期工作负载适用性。
AI.conclusion: 支持"工作负载优先"观点，语义抽象是决定早期太空计算工作负载适用性的关键因素，而非原始计算能力。

title: Context Cartography: Toward Structured Governance of Contextual Space in Large Language Model Systems
summary:
The prevailing approach to improving large language model (LLM) reasoning has centered on expanding context windows, implicitly assuming that more tokens yield better performance. However, empirical evidence - including the "lost in the middle" effect and long-distance relational degradation - demonstrates that contextual space exhibits structural gradients, salience asymmetries, and entropy accumulation under transformer architectures.
  We introduce Context Cartography, a formal framework for the deliberate governance of contextual space. We define a tripartite zonal model partitioning the informational universe into black fog (unobserved), gray fog (stored memory), and the visible field (active reasoning surface), and formalize seven cartographic operators - reconnaissance, selection, simplification, aggregation, projection, displacement, and layering - as transformations governing information transitions between and within zones. The operators are derived from a systematic coverage analysis of all non-trivial zone transformations and are organized by transformation type (what the operator does) and zone scope (where it applies).
  We ground the framework in the salience geometry of transformer attention, characterizing cartographic operators as necessary compensations for linear prefix memory, append-only state, and entropy accumulation under expanding context. An analysis of four contemporary systems (Claude Code, Letta, MemOS, and OpenViking) provides interpretive evidence that these operators are converging independently across the industry.
  We derive testable predictions from the framework - including operator-specific ablation hypotheses - and propose a diagnostic benchmark for empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"上下文制图"框架，通过分区管理和七种操作符来优化LLM推理，而非简单扩展上下文窗口
AI.motivation: 当前改进LLM推理的方法主要依赖扩展上下文窗口，但实证显示存在"中间迷失"效应、长距离关系退化等问题，表明上下文空间存在结构性梯度、显著性不对称和熵积累
AI.method: 提出上下文制图框架，将信息空间分为黑雾区（未观察）、灰雾区（存储记忆）和可见区（活跃推理表面），并定义七种制图操作符：侦察、选择、简化、聚合、投影、位移和分层，作为信息在区域间转换的变换操作
AI.result: 框架基于Transformer注意力显著性几何，分析四个当代系统（Claude Code、Letta、MemOS、OpenViking）显示这些操作符在行业中独立趋同，提出了可测试的预测和诊断基准
AI.conclusion: 上下文制图提供了一种形式化框架来治理上下文空间，通过分区管理和操作符变换来补偿线性前缀记忆、仅追加状态和熵积累问题，为LLM推理优化提供了新方向

title: A Training-Free Regeneration Paradigm: Contrastive Reflection Memory Guided Self-Verification and Self-Improvement
summary: Verification-guided self-improvement has recently emerged as a promising approach to improving the accuracy of large language model (LLM) outputs. However, existing approaches face a trade-off between inference efficiency and accuracy: iterative verification-rectification is computationally expensive and prone to being trapped in faulty reasoning, while best-of-N selection requires extensive sampling without addressing internal model flaws. We propose a training-free regeneration paradigm that leverages an offline-curated contrastive Reflection Memory (RM) to provide corrective guidance, while regenerating from scratch helps break out of faulty reasoning. At inference time, the method performs RM-guided self-verification followed by a single RM-guided regeneration, avoiding both iterative correction and multi-sample selection. We evaluated our method on nine benchmarks that span algorithmic, reasoning, symbolic, and domain-specific tasks in both small- and large-scale LLMs. Experiment results show that our method outperforms prior methods while maintaining low computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于离线对比反思记忆的训练免费再生范式，通过单次验证和再生提升LLM输出准确性，避免迭代修正和多样本选择带来的计算开销
AI.motivation: 现有验证引导的自改进方法面临推理效率与准确性的权衡：迭代验证-修正计算昂贵且易陷入错误推理，而最佳N选择需要大量采样且不解决内部模型缺陷
AI.method: 提出训练免费的再生范式，利用离线构建的对比反思记忆提供纠正指导，从零开始再生帮助跳出错误推理。推理时执行RM引导的自验证，然后进行单次RM引导的再生
AI.result: 在9个涵盖算法、推理、符号和领域特定任务的基准测试中，该方法优于先前方法，同时保持较低计算成本
AI.conclusion: 提出的基于反思记忆的再生范式在保持计算效率的同时，有效提升了LLM输出的准确性，解决了现有方法在效率与准确性之间的权衡问题

title: NCSTR: Node-Centric Decoupled Spatio-Temporal Reasoning for Video-based Human Pose Estimation
summary: Video-based human pose estimation remains challenged by motion blur, occlusion, and complex spatiotemporal dynamics. Existing methods often rely on heatmaps or implicit spatio-temporal feature aggregation, which limits joint topology expressiveness and weakens cross-frame consistency.
