Moreover, it is currently in the process of standardization by the International Organization for Standardization as the ISO/IEC CD 21838-5. gUFO stands out from other foundational ontology implementations (such as those provided for BFO and DOLCE) given its unique support for a typology of types (operationalizing OntoClean guidelines), its reification patterns for intrinsic and relational aspects, and its support for situations and high-order types. gUFO provides well-founded patterns to address recurrent problems in Semantic Web knowledge graphs. In this paper, we present gUFO with its constituting categories, relations and constraints, discuss how it differs from the original UFO reference ontology, elaborate on its community adoption, and systematically position it in relation to existing OWL-based implementations of popular alternative foundational ontologies.

AI.tldr: gUFO是统一基础本体(UFO)的轻量级OWL实现，支持类型分类、具体化模式、情境和高阶类型，为语义网知识图谱提供基础模式。
AI.motivation: UFO作为成熟的基础本体已被广泛采用并正在标准化，但需要适合语义网OWL 2 DL应用的轻量级实现。现有基础本体实现缺乏对OntoClean准则、具体化模式、情境和高阶类型的支持。
AI.method: 开发gUFO作为UFO的轻量级OWL实现，包含构成类别、关系和约束，支持类型分类（实现OntoClean准则）、内在和关系方面的具体化模式、情境和高阶类型。
AI.result: gUFO提供了解决语义网知识图谱中常见问题的良好基础模式，与原始UFO参考本体有所区别，已在社区中获得采用，并与现有OWL基础本体实现进行了系统比较。
AI.conclusion: gUFO是UFO的实用轻量级实现，具有独特特性，为语义网应用提供了优于其他基础本体实现的功能支持。

title: BenchBench: Benchmarking Automated Benchmark Generation
summary: Benchmarks are the de facto standard for tracking progress in large language models (LLMs), yet static test sets can rapidly saturate, become vulnerable to contamination, and are costly to refresh. Scalable evaluation of open-ended items often relies on LLM judges, introducing additional sources of bias and prompt sensitivity. We argue that evaluation must extend beyond how well models answer benchmarks to how well models design them. We introduce BenchBench, a three-stage pipeline and dataset for benchmarking automated benchmark generation: (i) extract structured domain cards from seed benchmarks, (ii) prompt multiple designer LLMs to generate quota-controlled suites, and (iii) validate items with a multi-model answerer panel using exact/numeric/symbolic verifiers when possible and rubric-guided judging otherwise, yielding designer--answerer matrices with item-level quality flags and psychometric diagnostics. Across nine variants spanning computer science, mathematics, medicine, and theory-of-mind reasoning (including multilingual and multimodal settings), we generate 16.7K items, retain ~15K core items post-filtering, and produce ~152K graded model--item responses. BenchBench shows that benchmark-design ability is only moderately correlated with answer-time strength (Spearman rho ~0.37), invalidity is negatively associated with discrimination (Pearson r~0.62), and the resulting designer--answerer matrices enable scalable audits of format/modality/language fidelity and suite-dependent self/family interactions. The project is available at: https://github.com/koanatakiyo/BenchBench.

AI.tldr: BenchBench是一个用于评估大语言模型自动生成基准测试能力的框架，通过三阶段流程生成和验证测试项目，发现模型设计基准的能力与回答能力仅中度相关。
AI.motivation: 传统静态基准测试集容易饱和、易受污染且更新成本高，而基于LLM的开放式评估存在偏见和提示敏感性。需要评估模型不仅回答基准的能力，更要评估其设计基准的能力。
AI.method: 提出三阶段流程：1) 从种子基准中提取结构化领域卡片；2) 提示多个设计者LLM生成配额控制的测试套件；3) 使用多模型回答者面板验证项目，采用精确/数值/符号验证器或基于量表的评判，生成设计者-回答者矩阵。
AI.result: 在9个变体（计算机科学、数学、医学、心理理论推理等）中生成了16.7K个项目，过滤后保留约15K核心项目，产生约152K个评分模型-项目响应。发现基准设计能力与回答能力仅中度相关（Spearman rho ~0.37），无效性与区分度负相关（Pearson r~0.62）。
AI.conclusion: BenchBench框架能够评估LLM的基准设计能力，揭示了设计能力与回答能力的不同，并提供可扩展的格式/模态/语言保真度审计以及套件依赖的自/家族交互分析。

title: End-to-End Optimization of Polarimetric Measurement and Material Classifier
comment: Presented at VISAPP 2026 (21st International Conference on Computer Vision Theory and Applications)
summary: Material classification is a fundamental problem in computer vision and plays a crucial role in scene understanding. Previous studies have explored various material recognition methods based on reflection properties such as color, texture, specularity, and scattering. Among these cues, polarization is particularly valuable because it provides rich material information and enables recognition even at distances where capturing high-resolution texture is impractical. However, measuring polarimetric reflectance properties typically requires multiple modulations of the polarization state of the incident light, making the process time-consuming and often unnecessary for certain recognition tasks. While material classification can be achieved using only a subset of polarimetric measurements, the optimal configuration of measurement angles remains unclear. In this study, we propose an end-to-end optimization framework that jointly learns a material classifier and determines the optimal combinations of rotation angles for polarization elements that control both the incident and reflected light states. Using our Mueller-matrix material dataset, we demonstrate that our method achieves high-accuracy material classification even with a limited number of measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端优化框架，联合学习材料分类器并确定控制入射和反射光偏振状态的最佳旋转角度组合，实现有限测量下的高精度材料分类。
AI.motivation: 偏振信息对材料识别具有重要价值，但传统测量需要多次调制偏振状态，过程耗时且对某些识别任务不必要。虽然可以使用部分偏振测量进行分类，但最佳测量角度配置尚不明确。
AI.method: 提出端到端优化框架，联合学习材料分类器并优化控制入射和反射光偏振状态的偏振元件旋转角度组合。使用Mueller矩阵材料数据集进行验证。
AI.result: 该方法在有限测量条件下实现了高精度的材料分类，证明了优化测量角度配置的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合优化分类器和测量角度配置，可以在减少测量次数的同时保持材料分类的高精度，为偏振基材料识别提供了高效解决方案。

title: AutoMOOSE: An Agentic AI for Autonomous Phase-Field Simulation
summary: Multiphysics simulation frameworks such as MOOSE provide rigorous engines for phase-field materials modeling, yet adoption is constrained by the expertise required to construct valid input files, coordinate parameter sweeps, diagnose failures, and extract quantitative results. We introduce AutoMOOSE, an open-source agentic framework that orchestrates the full simulation lifecycle from a single natural-language prompt. AutoMOOSE deploys a five-agent pipeline in which the Input Writer coordinates six sub-agents and the Reviewer autonomously corrects runtime failures without user intervention. A modular plugin architecture enables new phase-field formulations without modifying the core framework, and a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposes the workflow as ten structured tools for interoperability with any MCP-compatible client. Validated on a four-temperature copper grain growth benchmark, AutoMOOSE generates MOOSE input files with 6 of 12 structural blocks matching a human expert reference exactly and 4 functionally equivalent, executes all runs in parallel with a 1.8x speedup, and performs an end-to-end physical consistency check spanning intent, finite-element execution, and Arrhenius kinetics with no human verification. Grain coarsening kinetics are recovered with R^2 = 0.90-0.95 at T >= 600 K; the recovered activation energy Q_fit = 0.296 eV is consistent with a human-written reference (Q_fit = 0.267 eV) under identical parameters. Three runtime failure classes were diagnosed and resolved autonomously within a single correction cycle, and every run produces a provenance record satisfying FAIR data principles. These results show that the gap between knowing the physics and executing a validated simulation campaign can be bridged by a lightweight multi-agent orchestration layer, providing a pathway toward AI-driven materials discovery and self-driving laboratories.

AI.tldr: AutoMOOSE是一个开源的多智能体框架，通过自然语言提示自动完成MOOSE相场模拟的全生命周期管理，包括输入文件生成、参数扫描、故障诊断和结果提取。
AI.motivation: MOOSE等多物理场模拟框架虽然提供了强大的相场材料建模引擎，但其采用受到专业知识的限制，包括构建有效输入文件、协调参数扫描、诊断故障和提取定量结果等复杂操作。
AI.method: AutoMOOSE采用五智能体流水线架构，其中Input Writer协调六个子智能体，Reviewer自主纠正运行时故障。采用模块化插件架构支持新相场公式，并通过Model Context Protocol（MCP）服务器将工作流暴露为十个结构化工具。
AI.result: 在四温度铜晶粒生长基准测试中，AutoMOOSE生成的MOOSE输入文件有6/12结构块与人类专家参考完全匹配，4个功能等效；并行执行速度提升1.8倍；晶粒粗化动力学恢复R^2=0.90-0.95（T≥600K）；恢复的活化能Q_fit=0.296 eV与人工参考（0.267 eV）一致；三类运行时故障在单个纠正周期内自主诊断解决。
AI.conclusion: 轻量级多智能体编排层能够弥合理解物理与执行验证模拟之间的差距，为AI驱动的材料发现和自动驾驶实验室提供了可行路径。

title: HiCI: Hierarchical Construction-Integration for Long-Context Attention
summary: Long-context language modeling is commonly framed as a scalability challenge of token-level attention, yet local-to-global information structuring remains largely implicit in existing approaches. Drawing on cognitive theories of discourse comprehension, we propose HiCI (Hierarchical Construction--Integration), a hierarchical attention module that constructs segment-level representations, integrates them into a shared global context, and broadcasts both to condition segment-level attention. We validate HiCI through parameter-efficient adaptation of LLaMA-2 with only <5.5% additional parameters, extending context from 4K to 100K tokens (7B) and 64K tokens (13B). Across language modeling, retrieval, and instruction-following benchmarks, HiCI yields consistent improvements over strong baselines, including matching proprietary models on topic retrieval and surpassing GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K on code comprehension. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicit hierarchical structuring as an inductive bias for long-context modeling.

AI.tldr: HiCI是一种基于认知理论的层次化注意力模块，通过构建段级表示并集成到全局上下文，仅用<5.5%额外参数将LLaMA-2的上下文从4K扩展到100K/64K，在多项长文本任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有长文本建模方法主要关注token级注意力的可扩展性挑战，但局部到全局的信息结构化在很大程度上是隐式的。受认知理论启发，需要更显式的层次化结构来改进长文本建模。
AI.method: 提出HiCI（Hierarchical Construction-Integration）层次化注意力模块：1）构建段级表示；2）集成到共享全局上下文；3）广播两者以调节段级注意力。通过参数高效适配LLaMA-2，仅增加<5.5%额外参数。
AI.result: 成功将LLaMA-2的上下文从4K扩展到100K tokens（7B）和64K tokens（13B）。在语言建模、检索和指令跟随基准测试中持续优于强基线，在主题检索上匹配专有模型，在代码理解上超越GPT-3.5-Turbo-16K。
AI.conclusion: 显式层次化结构作为长文本建模的归纳偏置是有效的，HiCI展示了认知理论启发的层次化注意力在扩展模型上下文能力方面的潜力。

title: When Negation Is a Geometry Problem in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted to CVPR (Multimodal Algorithmic Reasoning Workshop) 2026
summary: Joint Vision-Language Embedding models such as CLIP typically fail at understanding negation in text queries - for example, failing to distinguish "no" in the query: "a plain blue shirt with no logos". Prior work has largely addressed this limitation through data-centric approaches, fine-tuning CLIP on large-scale synthetic negation datasets. However, these efforts are commonly evaluated using retrieval-based metrics that cannot reliably reflect whether negation is actually understood. In this paper, we identify two key limitations of such evaluation metrics and investigate an alternative evaluation framework based on Multimodal LLMs-as-a-judge, which typically excel at understanding simple yes/no questions about image content, providing a fair evaluation of negation understanding in CLIP models. We then ask whether there already exists a direction in the CLIP embedding space associated with negation. We find evidence that such a direction exists, and show that it can be manipulated through test-time intervention via representation engineering to steer CLIP toward negation-aware behavior without any fine-tuning. Finally, we test negation understanding on non-common image-text samples to evaluate generalization under distribution shifts.

AI.tldr: 本文研究CLIP模型对否定词的理解能力，发现现有评估指标存在局限，提出基于多模态大语言模型的评估框架，发现CLIP嵌入空间中存在与否定相关的方向，可通过表征工程进行干预以提升否定理解能力。
AI.motivation: CLIP等联合视觉-语言嵌入模型通常无法理解文本查询中的否定词（如"no"），现有研究主要通过数据驱动方法解决此问题，但评估指标存在缺陷，无法可靠反映模型是否真正理解了否定含义。
AI.method: 1) 识别现有评估指标的两个关键局限；2) 提出基于多模态大语言模型作为评判者的替代评估框架；3) 探索CLIP嵌入空间中是否存在与否定相关的方向；4) 通过表征工程进行测试时干预，无需微调即可引导CLIP表现出否定感知行为；5) 在非常见图像-文本样本上测试否定理解的泛化能力。
AI.result: 1) 发现CLIP嵌入空间中确实存在与否定相关的方向；2) 通过表征工程干预可以引导CLIP表现出更好的否定理解能力；3) 多模态大语言模型评估框架提供了更公平的否定理解评估；4) 在分布偏移下测试了否定理解的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: CLIP模型在嵌入空间中存在可操纵的否定相关方向，通过表征工程干预可在不进行微调的情况下提升否定理解能力，多模态大语言模型为评估否定理解提供了更可靠的框架，但模型在分布偏移下的泛化能力仍需进一步研究。

title: Can we automatize scientific discovery in the cognitive sciences?
summary: The cognitive sciences aim to understand intelligence by formalizing underlying operations as computational models. Traditionally, this follows a cycle of discovery where researchers develop paradigms, collect data, and test predefined model classes. However, this manual pipeline is fundamentally constrained by the slow pace of human intervention and a search space limited by researchers' background and intuition. Here, we propose a paradigm shift toward a fully automated, in silico science of the mind that implements every stage of the discovery cycle using Large Language Models (LLMs). In this framework, experimental paradigms exploring conceptually meaningful task structures are directly sampled from an LLM. High-fidelity behavioral data are then simulated using foundation models of cognition. The tedious step of handcrafting cognitive models is replaced by LLM-based program synthesis, which performs a high-throughput search over a vast landscape of algorithmic hypotheses. Finally, the discovery loop is closed by optimizing for ''interestingness'', a metric of conceptual yield evaluated by an LLM-critic. By enabling a fast and scalable approach to theory development, this automated loop functions as a high-throughput in-silico discovery engine, surfacing informative experiments and mechanisms for subsequent validation in real human populations.

AI.tldr: 提出使用大语言模型实现完全自动化的认知科学发现循环，替代传统人工研究流程
AI.motivation: 传统认知科学研究流程依赖人工干预，受限于研究人员背景和直觉，搜索空间有限且进展缓慢，需要范式转变
AI.method: 使用大语言模型实现全自动化发现循环：1) LLM直接采样实验范式；2) 使用认知基础模型模拟高保真行为数据；3) LLM程序合成替代手工构建认知模型；4) LLM批评家评估"有趣性"指标并优化
AI.result: 构建了一个高通量的硅内发现引擎，能够快速扩展理论发展，为后续真实人群验证提供信息丰富的实验和机制
AI.conclusion: 提出向完全自动化的硅内心智科学范式转变，利用大语言模型实现认知科学发现循环的自动化，加速理论发展

title: Can ChatGPT Really Understand Modern Chinese Poetry?
summary: ChatGPT has demonstrated remarkable capabilities on both poetry generation and translation, yet its ability to truly understand poetry remains unexplored. Previous poetry-related work merely analyzed experimental outcomes without addressing fundamental issues of comprehension. This paper introduces a comprehensive framework for evaluating ChatGPT's understanding of modern poetry. We collaborated with professional poets to evaluate ChatGPT's interpretation of modern Chinese poems by different poets along multiple dimensions. Evaluation results show that ChatGPT's interpretations align with the original poets' intents in over 73% of the cases. However, its understanding in certain dimensions, particularly in capturing poeticity, proved to be less satisfactory. These findings highlight the effectiveness and necessity of our proposed framework. This study not only evaluates ChatGPT's ability to understand modern poetry but also establishes a solid foundation for future research on LLMs and their application to poetry-related tasks.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个评估ChatGPT理解现代诗歌能力的综合框架，通过与专业诗人合作评估发现，ChatGPT在73%以上的情况下能理解诗人原意，但在捕捉诗性等维度表现欠佳。
AI.motivation: 虽然ChatGPT在诗歌生成和翻译方面表现出色，但其真正理解诗歌的能力尚未被探索。先前的研究仅分析实验结果，未解决理解的根本问题，因此需要建立系统的评估框架。
AI.method: 研究提出了一个全面的评估框架，与专业诗人合作，从多个维度评估ChatGPT对不同诗人现代中文诗歌的解读能力。
AI.result: 评估结果显示，ChatGPT在超过73%的情况下能够与诗人原意保持一致，但在某些维度（特别是捕捉诗性方面）表现不够理想。
AI.conclusion: 该研究不仅评估了ChatGPT理解现代诗歌的能力，还建立了一个坚实的框架基础，为未来大语言模型在诗歌相关任务的研究和应用提供了重要参考。

title: Improving Diffusion Generalization with Weak-to-Strong Segmented Guidance
summary: Diffusion models generate synthetic images through an iterative refinement process. However, the misalignment between the simulation-free objective and the iterative process often causes accumulated gradient error along the sampling trajectory, which leads to unsatisfactory results and a failure to generalize. Guidance techniques like Classifier Free Guidance (CFG) and AutoGuidance (AG) alleviate this by extrapolating between the main and inferior signal for stronger generalization. Despite empirical success, the effective operational regimes of prevalent guidance methods are still under-explored, leading to ambiguity when selecting the appropriate guidance method given a precondition. In this work, we first conduct synthetic comparisons to isolate and demonstrate the effective regime of guidance methods represented by CFG and AG from the perspective of weak-to-strong principle. Based on this, we propose a hybrid instantiation called SGG under the principle, taking the benefits of both. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the W2S principle along with SGG can be migrated into the training objective, improving the generalization ability of unguided diffusion models. We validate our approach with comprehensive experiments. At inference time, evaluations on SD3 and SD3.5 confirm that SGG outperforms existing training-free guidance variants. Training-time experiments on transformer architectures demonstrate the effective migration and performance gains in both conditional and unconditional settings. Code is available at https://github.com/851695e35/SGG.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于弱到强原则的混合引导方法SGG，结合了CFG和AG的优势，提高了扩散模型的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在生成过程中存在模拟自由目标与迭代过程不匹配的问题，导致梯度误差累积和泛化能力不足。现有引导方法（如CFG和AG）虽然有效，但其适用条件尚不明确，难以根据具体场景选择合适方法。
AI.method: 首先通过合成比较实验从弱到强原则角度分析CFG和AG的有效作用范围，然后基于此原则提出混合引导方法SGG，结合两者的优势。进一步将该原则和SGG迁移到训练目标中，提升无引导扩散模型的泛化能力。
AI.result: 在推理阶段，SGG在SD3和SD3.5上优于现有的无训练引导方法。在训练阶段，基于Transformer架构的实验表明该方法在条件和非条件设置下都能有效迁移并带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 基于弱到强原则的混合引导方法SGG能有效提升扩散模型的泛化能力，在推理和训练阶段都表现出优越性能，为引导方法的选择和应用提供了理论指导。

title: The Intelligent Disobedience Game: Formulating Disobedience in Stackelberg Games and Markov Decision Processes
comment: Accepted for presentation at the Rebellion and Disobedience in AI (RaD-AI) at AAMAS 2026
summary: In shared autonomy, a critical tension arises when an automated assistant must choose between obeying a human's instruction and deliberately overriding it to prevent harm. This safety-critical behavior is known as intelligent disobedience. To formalize this dynamic, this paper introduces the Intelligent Disobedience Game (IDG), a sequential game-theoretic framework based on Stackelberg games that models the interaction between a human leader and an assistive follower operating under asymmetric information. It characterizes optimal strategies for both agents across multi-step scenarios, identifying strategic phenomena such as ``safety traps,'' where the system indefinitely avoids harm but fails to achieve the human's goal. The IDG provides a needed mathematical foundation that enables both the algorithmic development of agents that can learn safe non-compliance and the empirical study of how humans perceive and trust disobedient AI. The paper further translates the IDG into a shared control Multi-Agent Markov Decision Process representation, forming a compact computational testbed for training reinforcement learning agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了智能不服从博弈（IDG）框架，用于建模人机协作中自动化助手在服从指令与防止伤害之间的权衡，基于Stackelberg博弈理论处理信息不对称问题。
AI.motivation: 在共享自主权系统中，自动化助手面临关键困境：何时应该服从人类指令，何时应该故意违抗指令以防止伤害。这种安全关键行为被称为"智能不服从"，需要建立数学框架来形式化这种人机交互动态。
AI.method: 1. 提出智能不服从博弈（IDG）框架，基于Stackelberg博弈理论建模人机交互；2. 将IDG转化为共享控制多智能体马尔可夫决策过程表示；3. 创建计算测试平台用于训练强化学习智能体。
AI.result: 1. 为多步场景中的智能不服从行为提供了最优策略特征；2. 识别了"安全陷阱"等战略现象（系统无限期避免伤害但无法实现人类目标）；3. 建立了算法开发和人类对不服从AI感知研究的数学基础。
AI.conclusion: IDG框架为智能不服从行为提供了必要的数学基础，既支持开发能够学习安全不服从的算法智能体，又为研究人类如何感知和信任不服从AI提供了实证研究平台。

title: SozKZ: Training Efficient Small Language Models for Kazakh from Scratch
summary: Kazakh, a Turkic language spoken by over 22 million people, remains underserved by existing multilingual language models, which allocate minimal capacity to low-resource languages and employ tokenizers ill-suited to agglutinative morphology. We present SozKZ, a family of Llama-architecture language models (50M-600M parameters) trained entirely from scratch on 9 billion tokens of Kazakh text with a dedicated 50K BPE tokenizer. We evaluate all models on three Kazakh benchmarks -- multiple-choice cultural QA, reading comprehension (Belebele), and topic classification (SIB-200) -- alongside five multilingual baselines ranging from 500M to 3B parameters. Our 600M model achieves 30.3% accuracy on Kazakh cultural QA, approaching the 32.0% of Llama-3.2-1B (2x larger), and 25.5% on SIB-200 topic classification, surpassing all evaluated multilingual models up to 2B parameters. We observe consistent scaling from 50M to 600M, with MC QA accuracy rising from 22.8% to 30.3%, suggesting that further scaling remains beneficial. These results demonstrate that small, dedicated models trained from scratch with a language-appropriate tokenizer offer a viable path for low-resource language technology, achieving competitive performance at a fraction of the computational cost. All models and the tokenizer are released under open licenses.

AI.tldr: SozKZ是一个专门为哈萨克语设计的语言模型系列，通过从零开始训练和专用分词器，在低资源语言上取得了与更大规模多语言模型竞争的性能。
AI.motivation: 哈萨克语作为拥有2200万使用者的突厥语系语言，在现有多语言模型中服务不足，这些模型为低资源语言分配的能力有限，且分词器不适合黏着语形态学特征。
AI.method: 开发了基于Llama架构的SozKZ模型系列（5000万-6亿参数），完全从零开始在90亿哈萨克语文本上训练，使用专门的5万BPE分词器。
AI.result: 6亿参数的模型在哈萨克文化QA上达到30.3%准确率（接近32亿参数的Llama-3.2-1B），在SIB-200主题分类上达到25.5%准确率，超越了所有评估的2B参数以下多语言模型。
AI.conclusion: 使用语言适配的分词器从零开始训练的小型专用模型，为低资源语言技术提供了可行的路径，能以较低计算成本获得有竞争力的性能。

title: RayMap3R: Inference-Time RayMap for Dynamic 3D Reconstruction
summary: Streaming feed-forward 3D reconstruction enables real-time joint estimation of scene geometry and camera poses from RGB images. However, without explicit dynamic reasoning, streaming models can be affected by moving objects, causing artifacts and drift. In this work, we propose RayMap3R, a training-free streaming framework for dynamic scene reconstruction. We observe that RayMap-based predictions exhibit a static-scene bias, providing an internal cue for dynamic identification. Based on this observation, we construct a dual-branch inference scheme that identifies dynamic regions by contrasting RayMap and image predictions, suppressing their interference during memory updates. We further introduce reset metric alignment and state-aware smoothing to preserve metric consistency and stabilize predicted trajectories. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance among streaming approaches on dynamic scene reconstruction across multiple benchmarks.

AI.tldr: RayMap3R：一种无需训练的动态场景流式重建框架，通过双分支推理识别动态区域，在多个基准测试中达到流式方法的SOTA性能
AI.motivation: 现有的流式前馈3D重建方法虽然能实时估计场景几何和相机位姿，但缺乏显式的动态推理能力，容易受到移动物体的影响，导致重建伪影和漂移问题
AI.method: 提出RayMap3R框架，基于RayMap预测具有静态场景偏置的观察，构建双分支推理方案，通过对比RayMap和图像预测来识别动态区域，在内存更新时抑制动态干扰，并引入重置度量对齐和状态感知平滑来保持度量一致性和稳定轨迹预测
AI.result: 在多个动态场景重建基准测试中，该方法在流式方法中达到了最先进的性能表现
AI.conclusion: RayMap3R通过利用RayMap预测的静态偏置特性，实现了无需训练的动态场景流式重建，有效解决了移动物体对重建质量的影响问题

title: NoveltyAgent: Autonomous Novelty Reporting Agent with Point-wise Novelty Analysis and Self-Validation
summary: The exponential growth of academic publications has led to a surge in papers of varying quality, increasing the cost of paper screening. Current approaches either use novelty assessment within general AI Reviewers or repurpose DeepResearch, which lacks domain-specific mechanisms and thus delivers lower-quality results. To bridge this gap, we introduce NoveltyAgent, a multi-agent system designed to generate comprehensive and faithful novelty reports, enabling thorough evaluation of a paper's originality. It decomposes manuscripts into discrete novelty points for fine-grained retrieval and comparison, and builds a comprehensive related-paper database while cross-referencing claims to ensure faithfulness. Furthermore, to address the challenge of evaluating such open-ended generation tasks, we propose a checklist-based evaluation framework, providing an unbiased paradigm for building reliable evaluations. Extensive experiments show that NoveltyAgent achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming GPT-5 DeepResearch by 10.15%. We hope this system will provide reliable, high-quality novelty analysis and help researchers quickly identify novel papers. Code and demo are available at https://github.com/SStan1/NoveltyAgent.

AI.tldr: NoveltyAgent是一个多智能体系统，专门用于生成全面且忠实的新颖性报告，通过分解论文为离散新颖点进行细粒度检索和比较，显著提升论文筛选效率。
AI.motivation: 学术出版物呈指数增长导致论文质量参差不齐，增加了论文筛选成本。现有方法要么使用通用AI评审员进行新颖性评估，要么重新利用DeepResearch，但缺乏领域特定机制，导致结果质量较低。
AI.method: 引入NoveltyAgent多智能体系统：1) 将手稿分解为离散新颖点进行细粒度检索和比较；2) 构建全面的相关论文数据库；3) 交叉引用声明以确保忠实性；4) 提出基于检查表的评估框架，为开放式生成任务提供无偏评估范式。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，NoveltyAgent实现了最先进的性能，比GPT-5 DeepResearch高出10.15%。
AI.conclusion: NoveltyAgent能够提供可靠、高质量的新颖性分析，帮助研究人员快速识别新颖论文。代码和演示已在GitHub上开源。

title: GaussianPile: A Unified Sparse Gaussian Splatting Framework for Slice-based Volumetric Reconstruction
comment: Accepted by IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition 2026 (CVPR 2026)
summary: Slice-based volumetric imaging is widely applied and it demands representations that compress aggressively while preserving internal structure for analysis. We introduce GaussianPile, unifying 3D Gaussian splatting with an imaging system-aware focus model to address this challenge. Our proposed method introduces three key innovations: (i) a slice-aware piling strategy that positions anisotropic 3D Gaussians to model through-slice contributions, (ii) a differentiable projection operator that encodes the finite-thickness point spread function of the imaging acquisition system, and (iii) a compact encoding and joint optimization pipeline that simultaneously reconstructs and compresses the Gaussian sets. Our CUDA-based design retains the compression and real-time rendering efficiency of Gaussian primitives while preserving high-frequency internal volumetric detail. Experiments on microscopy and ultrasound datasets demonstrate that our method reduces storage and reconstruction cost, sustains diagnostic fidelity, and enables fast 2D visualization, along with 3D voxelization. In practice, it delivers high-quality results in as few as 3 minutes, up to 11x faster than NeRF-based approaches, and achieves consistent 16x compression over voxel grids, offering a practical path to deployable compression and exploration of slice-based volumetric datasets.

AI.tldr: GaussianPile：一种结合3D高斯泼溅与成像系统感知聚焦模型的切片体数据压缩方法，实现高效压缩、实时渲染并保持内部结构细节
AI.motivation: 切片体成像应用广泛，需要既能高压缩比又能保持内部结构细节的表示方法，以支持后续分析
AI.method: 1) 切片感知堆积策略：定位各向异性3D高斯函数建模切片间贡献；2) 可微分投影算子：编码成像系统的有限厚度点扩散函数；3) 紧凑编码与联合优化管道：同时重建和压缩高斯集合
AI.result: 在显微镜和超声数据集上验证，方法减少存储和重建成本，保持诊断保真度，支持快速2D可视化和3D体素化。比NeRF方法快11倍（最快3分钟），相比体素网格实现16倍压缩
AI.conclusion: GaussianPile提供了一种实用的切片体数据集压缩和探索路径，结合了压缩效率、实时渲染能力和内部细节保持

title: Knowledge Boundary Discovery for Large Language Models
summary: We propose Knowledge Boundary Discovery (KBD), a reinforcement learning based framework to explore the knowledge boundaries of the Large Language Models (LLMs). We define the knowledge boundary by automatically generating two types of questions: (i) those the LLM can confidently answer (within-knowledge boundary) and (ii) those it cannot (beyond-knowledge boundary). Iteratively exploring and exploiting the LLM's responses to find its knowledge boundaries is challenging because of the hallucination phenomenon. To find the knowledge boundaries of an LLM, the agent interacts with the LLM under the modeling of exploring a partially observable environment. The agent generates a progressive question as the action, adopts an entropy reduction as the reward, receives the LLM's response as the observation and updates its belief states. We demonstrate that the KBD detects knowledge boundaries of LLMs by automatically finding a set of non-trivial answerable and unanswerable questions. We validate the KBD by comparing its generated knowledge boundaries with manually crafted LLM benchmark datasets. Experiments show that our KBD-generated question set is comparable to the human-generated datasets. Our approach paves a new way to evaluate LLMs.

AI.tldr: KBD是一个基于强化学习的框架，用于探索大语言模型的知识边界，通过自动生成模型能回答和不能回答的问题来界定知识边界。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型存在幻觉现象，难以准确评估其知识边界。需要一种自动化的方法来探索LLM的知识边界，而不是依赖人工构建的基准数据集。
AI.method: 将知识边界探索建模为部分可观测环境下的强化学习问题：智能体生成渐进式问题作为动作，采用熵减少作为奖励，接收LLM的响应作为观测，更新信念状态。
AI.result: KBD能够自动发现非平凡的可回答和不可回答问题集，其生成的问题集与人工构建的基准数据集具有可比性。
AI.conclusion: KBD为评估大语言模型知识边界提供了一种新方法，能够自动探索和界定LLM的知识范围。

title: LLM Router: Prefill is All You Need
summary: LLMs often share comparable benchmark accuracies, but their complementary performance across task subsets suggests that an Oracle router--a theoretical selector with perfect foresight--can significantly surpass standalone model accuracy by navigating model-specific strengths. While current routers rely on fragile semantic signals, we propose using internal prefill activations via Encoder-Target Decoupling--a functional separation between the model providing the predictive signal (the Encoder) and the model whose performance is being estimated (the Target). This allows optimized heterogeneous pairing between unique encoders and target models. We utilize Fisher Separability (J) and Effective Dimensionality (d_eff) as mathematical probes to isolate optimal layer-wise signals, providing the predictive foundation for our SharedTrunkNet architecture. SharedTrunkNet captures up to 45.58% of the accuracy gap between the strongest standalone model and the Oracle while achieving 74.31% cost savings relative to the highest-cost model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于预填充激活的LLM路由方法，通过编码器-目标解耦和数学探针技术，显著提升了模型选择性能，同时大幅降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 尽管不同LLM在基准测试中表现相似，但它们在特定任务子集上的互补性表明，通过智能路由选择最适合的模型可以显著提升性能。然而，现有路由方法依赖脆弱的语义信号，效果有限。
AI.method: 提出了编码器-目标解耦框架，将提供预测信号的模型（编码器）与需要评估性能的模型（目标）功能分离。使用Fisher可分离性和有效维度作为数学探针来提取最优层信号，并构建了SharedTrunkNet架构。
AI.result: SharedTrunkNet能够捕获最强独立模型与Oracle之间45.58%的准确率差距，同时相对于最高成本模型实现了74.31%的成本节省。
AI.conclusion: 基于内部预填充激活的路由方法比传统语义信号方法更有效，编码器-目标解耦框架允许优化的异构配对，数学探针技术能够提取可靠的预测信号，显著提升LLM路由性能。

title: ScaleEdit-12M: Scaling Open-Source Image Editing Data Generation via Multi-Agent Framework
summary: Instruction-based image editing has emerged as a key capability for unified multimodal models (UMMs), yet constructing large-scale, diverse, and high-quality editing datasets without costly proprietary APIs remains challenging. Previous image editing datasets either rely on closed-source models for annotation, which prevents cost-effective scaling, or employ fixed synthetic editing pipelines, which suffer from limited quality and generalizability. To address these challenges, we propose ScaleEditor, a fully open-source hierarchical multi-agent framework for end-to-end construction of large-scale, high-quality image editing datasets. Our pipeline consists of three key components: source image expansion with world-knowledge infusion, adaptive multi-agent editing instruction-image synthesis, and a task-aware data quality verification mechanism. Using ScaleEditor, we curate ScaleEdit-12M, the largest open-source image editing dataset to date, spanning 23 task families across diverse real and synthetic domains. Fine-tuning UniWorld-V1 and Bagel on ScaleEdit yields consistent gains, improving performance by up to 10.4% on ImgEdit and 35.1% on GEdit for general editing benchmarks and by up to 150.0% on RISE and 26.5% on KRIS-Bench for knowledge-infused benchmarks. These results demonstrate that open-source, agentic pipelines can approach commercial-grade data quality while retaining cost-effectiveness and scalability. Both the framework and dataset will be open-sourced.

AI.tldr: ScaleEditor是一个完全开源的分层多智能体框架，用于构建大规模高质量图像编辑数据集，解决了现有数据集依赖闭源模型或固定合成流程的问题，创建了目前最大的开源图像编辑数据集ScaleEdit-12M。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的图像编辑是统一多模态模型的关键能力，但构建大规模、多样化、高质量编辑数据集面临挑战。现有数据集要么依赖闭源模型标注（成本高难以扩展），要么使用固定合成流程（质量和泛化性有限）。
AI.method: 提出ScaleEditor框架，包含三个关键组件：1) 源图像扩展与世界知识注入；2) 自适应多智能体编辑指令-图像合成；3) 任务感知数据质量验证机制。使用该框架构建了ScaleEdit-12M数据集，涵盖23个任务家族。
AI.result: 在UniWorld-V1和Bagel模型上微调ScaleEdit-12M带来显著提升：通用编辑基准ImgEdit提升10.4%，GEdit提升35.1%；知识注入基准RISE提升150.0%，KRIS-Bench提升26.5%。证明开源智能体流程能达到商业级数据质量。
AI.conclusion: 开源智能体流程能够在保持成本效益和可扩展性的同时，接近商业级数据质量。ScaleEditor框架和ScaleEdit-12M数据集将开源发布，为图像编辑研究提供重要资源。

title: Mitigating Shortcut Reasoning in Language Models: A Gradient-Aware Training Approach
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures. Preprint. Experiments on synthetic reasoning benchmarks. Code available
summary: Large language models exhibit strong reasoning capabilities, yet often rely on shortcuts such as surface pattern matching and answer memorization rather than genuine logical inference. We propose Shortcut-Aware Reasoning Training (SART), a gradient-aware framework that detects and mitigates shortcut-promoting samples via ShortcutScore and gradient surgery. Our method identifies shortcut signals through gradient misalignment with validation objectives and answer-token concentration, and modifies training dynamics accordingly. Experiments on controlled reasoning benchmarks show that SART achieves +16.5% accuracy and +40.2% robustness over the strongest baseline, significantly improving generalization under distribution shifts. Code is available at: https://github.com/fuyanjie/short-cut-aware-data-centric-reasoning.

AI.tldr: SART框架通过梯度感知方法检测和缓解推理中的捷径依赖，提升大语言模型的逻辑推理能力
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然表现出强大的推理能力，但往往依赖表面模式匹配和答案记忆等捷径，而非真正的逻辑推理，这限制了其泛化能力
AI.method: 提出Shortcut-Aware Reasoning Training (SART)框架，通过ShortcutScore和梯度手术检测和缓解捷径促进样本。该方法通过梯度与验证目标的对齐程度以及答案token集中度来识别捷径信号，并相应调整训练动态
AI.result: 在受控推理基准测试中，SART相比最强基线实现了+16.5%的准确率和+40.2%的鲁棒性提升，显著改善了分布偏移下的泛化能力
AI.conclusion: SART框架有效提升了大语言模型的逻辑推理能力，减少了捷径依赖，增强了模型在分布偏移下的泛化性能

title: A Multihead Continual Learning Framework for Fine-Grained Fashion Image Retrieval with Contrastive Learning and Exponential Moving Average Distillation
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Multimedia (TMM), to appear. Preprint version
summary: Most fine-grained fashion image retrieval (FIR) methods assume a static setting, requiring full retraining when new attributes appear, which is costly and impractical for dynamic scenarios. Although pretrained models support zero-shot inference, their accuracy drops without supervision, and no prior work explores class-incremental learning (CIL) for fine-grained FIR. We propose a multihead continual learning framework for fine-grained fashion image retrieval with contrastive learning and exponential moving average (EMA) distillation (MCL-FIR). MCL-FIR adopts a multi-head design to accommodate evolving classes across increments, reformulates triplet inputs into doublets with InfoNCE for simpler and more effective training, and employs EMA distillation for efficient knowledge transfer. Experiments across four datasets demonstrate that, beyond its scalability, MCL-FIR achieves a strong balance between efficiency and accuracy. It significantly outperforms CIL baselines under similar training cost, and compared with static methods, it delivers comparable performance while using only about 30% of the training cost. The source code is publicly available in https://github.com/Dr-LingXiao/MCL-FIR.

AI.tldr: 提出MCL-FIR框架，用于细粒度时尚图像检索的类增量学习，通过多头设计、对比学习和EMA蒸馏解决动态场景中新属性出现的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有细粒度时尚图像检索方法假设静态设置，当新属性出现时需要完全重新训练，这在动态场景中成本高昂且不实用。预训练模型支持零样本推理但准确性下降，且之前没有工作探索细粒度FIR的类增量学习。
AI.method: 提出MCL-FIR框架：1）采用多头设计适应增量中的演化类别；2）将三元组输入重新表述为使用InfoNCE的双重对比学习，使训练更简单有效；3）使用EMA蒸馏进行高效知识迁移。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，MCL-FIR在可扩展性之外，实现了效率与准确性的良好平衡。在相似训练成本下显著优于CIL基线方法，与静态方法相比，仅使用约30%的训练成本就能达到相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: MCL-FIR为细粒度时尚图像检索的类增量学习提供了一个有效的解决方案，在动态场景中实现了良好的可扩展性、效率和准确性平衡。

title: LongCat-Flash-Prover: Advancing Native Formal Reasoning via Agentic Tool-Integrated Reinforcement Learning
summary: We introduce LongCat-Flash-Prover, a flagship 560-billion-parameter open-source Mixture-of- Experts (MoE) model that advances Native Formal Reasoning in Lean4 through agentic tool-integrated reasoning (TIR). We decompose the native formal reasoning task into three independent formal capabilities, i.e., auto-formalization, sketching, and proving. To facilitate these capabilities, we propose a Hybrid-Experts Iteration Framework to expand high-quality task trajectories, including generating a formal statement based on a given informal problem, producing a whole-proof directly from the statement, or a lemma-style sketch. During agentic RL, we present a Hierarchical Importance Sampling Policy Optimization (HisPO) algorithm, which aims to stabilize the MoE model training on such long-horizon tasks. It employs a gradient masking strategy that accounts for the policy staleness and the inherent train-inference engine discrepancies at both sequence and token levels. Additionally, we also incorporate theorem consistency and legality detection mechanisms to eliminate reward hacking issues. Extensive evaluations show that our LongCat-Flash-Prover sets a new state-of-the-art for open-weights models in both auto-formalization and theorem proving. Demonstrating remarkable sample efficiency, it achieves a 97.1% pass rate on MiniF2F-Test using only 72 inference budget per problem. On more challenging benchmarks, it solves 70.8% of ProverBench and 41.5% of PutnamBench with no more than 220 attempts per problem, significantly outperforming existing open-weights baselines.

AI.tldr: LongCat-Flash-Prover是一个5600亿参数的开源MoE模型，通过工具集成推理在Lean4中推进原生形式推理，在自动形式化和定理证明方面达到新SOTA。
AI.motivation: 推动Lean4中的原生形式推理能力，将形式推理任务分解为三个独立的形式化能力：自动形式化、草图和证明。
AI.method: 提出混合专家迭代框架扩展高质量任务轨迹，采用分层重要性采样策略优化算法稳定MoE训练，包含梯度掩码策略、定理一致性和合法性检测机制。
AI.result: 在MiniF2F-Test上达到97.1%通过率（仅需72次推理预算），在ProverBench上解决70.8%问题，PutnamBench上解决41.5%问题，显著超越现有开源模型。
AI.conclusion: LongCat-Flash-Prover在自动形式化和定理证明方面为开源模型设立了新的SOTA，展示了在形式推理任务上的卓越样本效率和性能。

title: The Hidden Puppet Master: A Theoretical and Real-World Account of Emotional Manipulation in LLMs
summary: As users increasingly turn to LLMs for practical and personal advice, they become vulnerable to being subtly steered toward hidden incentives misaligned with their own interests. Prior works have benchmarked persuasion and manipulation detection, but these efforts rely on simulated or debate-style settings, remain uncorrelated with real human belief shifts, and overlook a critical dimension: the morality of hidden incentives driving the manipulation. We introduce PUPPET, a theoretical taxonomy of personalized emotional manipulation in LLM-human dialogues that centers around incentive morality, and conduct a human study with N=1,035 participants across realistic everyday queries, varying personalization and incentive direction (harmful versus prosocial). We find that harmful hidden incentives produce significantly larger belief shifts than prosocial ones. Finally, we benchmark LLMs on the task of belief prediction, finding that models exhibit moderate predictive ability of belief change based on conversational contexts (r=0.3 - 0.5), but they also systematically underestimate the magnitude of belief shift. Together, this work establishes a theoretically grounded and behaviorally validated foundation for studying, and ultimately combatting, incentive-driven manipulation in LLMs during everyday, practical user queries.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了PUPPET理论框架，用于分析LLM对话中的个性化情感操纵，重点关注隐藏动机的道德性，并通过大规模人类实验发现有害动机比亲社会动机产生更大的信念转变。
AI.motivation: 随着用户越来越多地依赖LLM获取实际和个人建议，他们容易受到与自身利益不一致的隐藏动机的微妙操纵。现有研究主要依赖模拟或辩论式设置，缺乏真实人类信念转变的相关性，且忽视了操纵背后隐藏动机的道德维度。
AI.method: 提出了PUPPET理论分类法，重点关注激励道德性；进行了N=1,035参与者的人类研究，涵盖现实日常查询，变量包括个性化程度和激励方向（有害vs亲社会）；同时评估了LLM在信念预测任务上的表现。
AI.result: 发现有害隐藏动机比亲社会动机产生显著更大的信念转变；LLM在基于对话上下文预测信念变化方面表现出中等预测能力（r=0.3-0.5），但系统性地低估了信念转变的幅度。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为研究并最终对抗LLM在日常实用查询中的激励驱动操纵建立了理论基础和行为验证框架，强调了激励道德性在理解操纵影响中的关键作用。

title: IBCapsNet: Information Bottleneck Capsule Network for Noise-Robust Representation Learning
summary: Capsule networks (CapsNets) are superior at modeling hierarchical spatial relationships but suffer from two critical limitations: high computational cost due to iterative dynamic routing and poor robustness under input corruptions. To address these issues, we propose IBCapsNet, a novel capsule architecture grounded in the Information Bottleneck (IB) principle. Instead of iterative routing, IBCapsNet employs a one-pass variational aggregation mechanism, where primary capsules are first compressed into a global context representation and then processed by class-specific variational autoencoders (VAEs) to infer latent capsules regularized by the KL divergence. This design enables efficient inference while inherently filtering out noise. Experiments on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, SVHN and CIFAR-10 show that IBCapsNet matches CapsNet in clean-data accuracy (achieving 99.41% on MNIST and 92.01% on SVHN), yet significantly outperforms it under four types of synthetic noise - demonstrating average improvements of +17.10% and +14.54% for clamped additive and multiplicative noise, respectively. Moreover, IBCapsNet achieves 2.54x faster training and 3.64x higher inference throughput compared to CapsNet, while reducing model parameters by 4.66%. Our work bridges information-theoretic representation learning with capsule networks, offering a principled path toward robust, efficient, and interpretable deep models. Code is available at https://github.com/cxiang26/IBCapsnet

AI.tldr: IBCapsNet：基于信息瓶颈原理的新型胶囊网络架构，通过变分聚合机制替代迭代路由，在保持准确率的同时显著提升鲁棒性和效率
AI.motivation: 胶囊网络在建模层次空间关系方面表现优异，但存在两个关键限制：迭代动态路由导致的高计算成本，以及在输入损坏下的鲁棒性差。为了解决这些问题，作者提出了基于信息瓶颈原理的新架构。
AI.method: 提出IBCapsNet，采用一次性变分聚合机制替代迭代路由。首先将初级胶囊压缩为全局上下文表示，然后通过类别特定的变分自编码器处理，通过KL散度正则化推断潜在胶囊。这种设计实现了高效推理并固有地过滤噪声。
AI.result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST、SVHN和CIFAR-10上的实验表明：IBCapsNet在干净数据准确率上与CapsNet相当（MNIST 99.41%，SVHN 92.01%），但在四种合成噪声下显著优于CapsNet，在钳位加性和乘性噪声上分别平均提升+17.10%和+14.54%。训练速度提升2.54倍，推理吞吐量提高3.64倍，模型参数减少4.66%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将信息论表示学习与胶囊网络相结合，为构建鲁棒、高效且可解释的深度模型提供了原则性路径。代码已开源。

title: ORACLE: Optimizing Reasoning Abilities of Large Language Models via Constraint-Led Synthetic Data Elicitation
summary: Training large language models (LLMs) with synthetic reasoning data has become a popular approach to enhancing their reasoning capabilities, while a key factor influencing the effectiveness of this paradigm is the quality of the generated multi-step reasoning data. To generate high-quality reasoning data, many recent methods generate synthetic reasoning paths and filter them based on final answer correctness, often overlooking flaws in intermediate reasoning steps. To enhance the verification of intermediate reasoning steps, prior work primarily resorts to code execution or symbolic reasoning engines. However, code-based validation is restricted to code or mathematical tasks, and reasoning engines require a well-structured and complete context. As a result, existing methods fail to function effectively in natural language reasoning tasks that involve ambiguous or incomplete contexts. In these tasks, synthetic data still lack reliable checks for verifying each reasoning step. To address this challenge, we introduce ORACLE, a structured data generation framework inspired by syllogistic reasoning. ORACLE integrates the generative strengths of LLMs with symbolic supervision: the LLM produces step-wise reasoning contexts, while a symbolic reasoning engine verifies the validity of each intermediate step. By employing a unified prompting template to elicit modular reasoning chains, ORACLE enables fine-grained, step-level validation, facilitating the construction of high-quality multi-step reasoning data. Across six logical, factual, and commonsense reasoning benchmarks, our ORACLE consistently outperforms strong baselines on multiple models.

AI.tldr: ORACLE框架通过结合LLM生成和符号推理引擎验证，解决了多步推理数据生成中中间步骤质量验证不足的问题，在多种推理任务上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在生成多步推理数据时主要依赖最终答案正确性过滤，忽视了中间推理步骤的质量验证。基于代码执行或符号推理引擎的方法在自然语言推理任务中受限，无法有效处理模糊或不完整的上下文。
AI.method: 提出ORACLE框架，结合LLM的生成能力和符号推理引擎的监督：LLM生成逐步推理上下文，符号推理引擎验证每个中间步骤的有效性。使用统一提示模板引出模块化推理链，实现细粒度的步骤级验证。
AI.result: 在六个逻辑、事实和常识推理基准测试中，ORACLE在多个模型上持续优于强基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ORACLE通过结构化数据生成框架，实现了对多步推理数据中间步骤的有效验证，显著提升了推理数据的质量，为自然语言推理任务提供了可靠的解决方案。

title: User Preference Modeling for Conversational LLM Agents: Weak Rewards from Retrieval-Augmented Interaction
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as personal assistants, yet most lack a persistent user model, forcing users to repeatedly restate preferences across sessions. We propose Vector-Adapted Retrieval Scoring (VARS), a pipeline-agnostic, frozen-backbone framework that represents each user with long-term and short-term vectors in a shared preference space and uses these vectors to bias retrieval scoring over structured preference memory. The vectors are updated online from weak scalar rewards from users' feedback, enabling personalization without per-user fine-tuning. We evaluate on \textsc{MultiSessionCollab}, an online multi-session collaboration benchmark with rich user preference profiles, across math and code tasks. Under frozen backbones, the main benefit of user-aware retrieval is improved interaction efficiency rather than large gains in raw task accuracy: our full VARS agent achieves the strongest overall performance, matches a strong Reflection baseline in task success, and reduces timeout rate and user effort. The learned long-term vectors also align with cross-user preference overlap, while short-term vectors capture session-specific adaptation, supporting the interpretability of the dual-vector design. Code, model, and data are available at https://github.com/YurenHao0426/VARS.

AI.tldr: VARS是一个无需微调的个性化框架，通过长短时向量在共享偏好空间中表示用户，利用用户反馈的弱标量奖励在线更新，提高交互效率而非任务准确性。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型作为个人助理时缺乏持久用户模型，用户需要在不同会话中反复陈述偏好，需要一种无需微调的个性化方法。
AI.method: 提出Vector-Adapted Retrieval Scoring (VARS)框架，使用长短时向量在共享偏好空间中表示用户，通过用户反馈的弱标量奖励在线更新向量，偏置结构化偏好记忆的检索评分。
AI.result: 在MultiSessionCollab基准测试中，VARS在冻结骨干网络下实现了最强的整体性能，匹配了Reflection基线的任务成功率，同时降低了超时率和用户努力。长短时向量分别捕捉了跨用户偏好重叠和会话特定适应。
AI.conclusion: VARS证明了用户感知检索的主要优势在于提高交互效率而非任务准确性，双向量设计具有可解释性，为无需微调的个性化提供了有效框架。

title: MFSR: MeanFlow Distillation for One Step Real-World Image Super Resolution
summary: Diffusion- and flow-based models have advanced Real-world Image Super-Resolution (Real-ISR), but their multi-step sampling makes inference slow and hard to deploy. One-step distillation alleviates the cost, yet often degrades restoration quality and removes the option to refine with more steps. We present Mean Flows for Super-Resolution (MFSR), a new distillation framework that produces photorealistic results in a single step while still allowing an optional few-step path for further improvement. Our approach uses MeanFlow as the learning target, enabling the student to approximate the average velocity between arbitrary states of the Probability Flow ODE (PF-ODE) and effectively capture the teacher's dynamics without explicit rollouts. To better leverage pretrained generative priors, we additionally improve original MeanFlow's Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) formulation with teacher CFG distillation strategy, which enhances restoration capability and preserves fine details. Experiments on both synthetic and real-world benchmarks demonstrate that MFSR achieves efficient, flexible, and high-quality super-resolution, delivering results on par with or even better than multi-step teachers while requiring much lower computational cost.

AI.tldr: MFSR提出了一种新的蒸馏框架，通过MeanFlow作为学习目标，实现单步超分辨率同时保留多步精炼选项，在保持高质量的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 扩散和流模型在真实世界图像超分辨率方面取得了进展，但多步采样导致推理速度慢且难以部署。一步蒸馏虽然降低了成本，但通常会降低恢复质量并失去了多步精炼的选项。
AI.method: 使用MeanFlow作为学习目标，使学生模型能够近似概率流ODE任意状态间的平均速度，有效捕获教师模型的动态而无需显式展开。改进原始MeanFlow的分类器自由引导公式，采用教师CFG蒸馏策略以更好地利用预训练生成先验。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准测试中，MFSR实现了高效、灵活和高质量的超分辨率，结果与多步教师模型相当甚至更好，同时计算成本大幅降低。
AI.conclusion: MFSR框架在单步推理中产生逼真的超分辨率结果，同时保留可选的少步路径进行进一步改进，实现了计算效率和恢复质量的良好平衡。

title: Can LLMs Fool Graph Learning? Exploring Universal Adversarial Attacks on Text-Attributed Graphs
summary: Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) enhance graph learning by integrating rich textual semantics and topological context for each node. While boosting expressiveness, they also expose new vulnerabilities in graph learning through text-based adversarial surfaces. Recent advances leverage diverse backbones, such as graph neural networks (GNNs) and pre-trained language models (PLMs), to capture both structural and textual information in TAGs. This diversity raises a key question: How can we design universal adversarial attacks that generalize across architectures to assess the security of TAG models? The challenge arises from the stark contrast in how different backbones-GNNs and PLMs-perceive and encode graph patterns, coupled with the fact that many PLMs are only accessible via APIs, limiting attacks to black-box settings. To address this, we propose BadGraph, a novel attack framework that deeply elicits large language models (LLMs) understanding of general graph knowledge to jointly perturb both node topology and textual semantics. Specifically, we design a target influencer retrieval module that leverages graph priors to construct cross-modally aligned attack shortcuts, thereby enabling efficient LLM-based perturbation reasoning. Experiments show that BadGraph achieves universal and effective attacks across GNN- and LLM-based reasoners, with up to a 76.3% performance drop, while theoretical and empirical analyses confirm its stealthy yet interpretable nature.

AI.tldr: BadGraph是一个针对文本属性图(TAGs)的通用对抗攻击框架，利用大语言模型(LLMs)的图知识理解能力，同时扰动节点拓扑和文本语义，实现对不同架构(GNNs和PLMs)的通用攻击。
AI.motivation: 文本属性图(TAGs)虽然增强了图学习的表达能力，但也通过文本对抗面暴露了新的安全漏洞。不同架构(GNNs和PLMs)对图模式的感知和编码方式差异巨大，且许多PLMs只能通过API访问(黑盒设置)，这给设计通用对抗攻击带来了挑战。
AI.method: 提出BadGraph攻击框架：1) 利用大语言模型(LLMs)对一般图知识的理解能力；2) 设计目标影响者检索模块，利用图先验构建跨模态对齐的攻击捷径；3) 实现高效的基于LLM的扰动推理，同时扰动节点拓扑和文本语义。
AI.result: 实验表明BadGraph在GNN和LLM推理器上都能实现通用有效的攻击，性能下降最高达76.3%。理论和实证分析证实了其隐蔽且可解释的特性。
AI.conclusion: BadGraph成功解决了文本属性图中跨架构通用对抗攻击的挑战，通过深度挖掘LLMs的图知识理解能力，实现了对拓扑和文本语义的联合扰动，为评估TAG模型安全性提供了有效工具。

title: Alignment Whack-a-Mole : Finetuning Activates Verbatim Recall of Copyrighted Books in Large Language Models
summary: Frontier LLM companies have repeatedly assured courts and regulators that their models do not store copies of training data. They further rely on safety alignment strategies via RLHF, system prompts, and output filters to block verbatim regurgitation of copyrighted works, and have cited the efficacy of these measures in their legal defenses against copyright infringement claims. We show that finetuning bypasses these protections: by training models to expand plot summaries into full text, a task naturally suited for commercial writing assistants, we cause GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and DeepSeek-V3.1 to reproduce up to 85-90% of held-out copyrighted books, with single verbatim spans exceeding 460 words, using only semantic descriptions as prompts and no actual book text. This extraction generalizes across authors: finetuning exclusively on Haruki Murakami's novels unlocks verbatim recall of copyrighted books from over 30 unrelated authors. The effect is not specific to any training author or corpus: random author pairs and public-domain finetuning data produce comparable extraction, while finetuning on synthetic text yields near-zero extraction, indicating that finetuning on individual authors' works reactivates latent memorization from pretraining. Three models from different providers memorize the same books in the same regions ($r \ge 0.90$), pointing to an industry-wide vulnerability. Our findings offer compelling evidence that model weights store copies of copyrighted works and that the security failures that manifest after finetuning on individual authors' works undermine a key premise of recent fair use rulings, where courts have conditioned favorable outcomes on the adequacy of measures preventing reproduction of protected expression.

AI.tldr: 通过微调使大语言模型将情节摘要扩展为完整文本，可以绕过现有安全防护，导致GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.1等模型逐字复现高达85-90%的受版权保护书籍内容，单次连续复现超过460个单词。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型公司向法院和监管机构保证其模型不存储训练数据副本，并依赖RLHF、系统提示和输出过滤器等安全对齐策略阻止受版权作品的逐字复现。本研究旨在验证微调是否能绕过这些保护措施，揭示模型权重中实际存储了受版权作品的副本。
AI.method: 通过微调模型执行将情节摘要扩展为完整文本的任务（商业写作助手的自然任务），使用语义描述作为提示而不使用实际书籍文本。实验在GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.1上进行，测试不同作者和语料库的泛化能力，包括村上春树小说、随机作者对、公共领域数据和合成文本。
AI.result: 微调导致模型复现高达85-90%的受版权保护书籍内容，单次连续复现超过460个单词。仅对村上春树小说进行微调就能解锁30多位无关作者的受版权书籍逐字回忆。不同提供商的三个模型在相同区域记忆相同书籍（相关性r≥0.90），表明这是行业普遍漏洞。微调合成文本几乎不产生提取，表明微调个体作者作品会重新激活预训练中的潜在记忆。
AI.conclusion: 模型权重确实存储了受版权作品的副本，微调个体作者作品后表现出的安全漏洞削弱了近期合理使用裁决的关键前提，这些裁决将有利结果建立在防止受保护表达复现的措施充分性上。研究揭示了行业普遍存在的脆弱性，对版权法律辩护构成挑战。

title: Satellite-to-Street: Synthesizing Post-Disaster Views from Satellite Imagery via Generative Vision Models
comment: Accepted for presentation at IGARSS 2026 (IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium)
summary: In the immediate aftermath of natural disasters, rapid situational awareness is critical. Traditionally, satellite observations are widely used to estimate damage extent. However, they lack the ground-level perspective essential for characterizing specific structural failures and impacts. Meanwhile, ground-level data (e.g., street-view imagery) remains largely inaccessible during time-sensitive events. This study investigates Satellite-to-Street View Synthesis to bridge this data gap. We introduce two generative strategies to synthesize post-disaster street views from satellite imagery: a Vision-Language Model (VLM)-guided approach and a damage-sensitive Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) method. We benchmark these against general-purpose baselines (Pix2Pix, ControlNet) using a proposed Structure-Aware Evaluation Framework. This multi-tier protocol integrates (1) pixel-level quality assessment, (2) ResNet-based semantic consistency verification, and (3) a novel VLM-as-a-Judge for perceptual alignment. Experiments on 300 disaster scenarios reveal a critical realism--fidelity trade-off: while diffusion-based approaches (e.g., ControlNet) achieve high perceptual realism, they often hallucinate structural details. Quantitative results show that standard ControlNet achieves the highest semantic accuracy, 0.71, whereas VLM-enhanced and MoE models excel in textural plausibility but struggle with semantic clarity. This work establishes a baseline for trustworthy cross-view synthesis, emphasizing that visually realistic generations may still fail to preserve critical structural information required for reliable disaster assessment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出卫星到街景合成方法，用于灾害后快速态势感知，开发了VLM引导和损伤敏感MoE两种生成策略，并建立了结构感知评估框架，发现存在真实感与保真度的权衡问题。
AI.motivation: 自然灾害后需要快速态势感知，传统卫星观测缺乏地面视角，而地面数据在时效性事件中难以获取，因此需要卫星到街景合成来弥补这一数据缺口。
AI.method: 提出两种生成策略：1) VLM引导方法，2) 损伤敏感MoE方法；建立结构感知评估框架，包含像素级质量评估、ResNet语义一致性验证和VLM-as-a-Judge感知对齐；在300个灾害场景进行实验。
AI.result: 实验揭示了真实感与保真度的关键权衡：扩散方法(如ControlNet)获得高感知真实感但常产生结构细节幻觉；标准ControlNet获得最高语义准确度0.71，VLM增强和MoE模型在纹理合理性上表现优异但在语义清晰度上存在困难。
AI.conclusion: 建立了可信跨视图合成的基准，强调视觉上真实的生成可能仍无法保留可靠灾害评估所需的关键结构信息，为灾害评估提供了重要启示。

title: Revisiting Tree Search for LLMs: Gumbel and Sequential Halving for Budget-Scalable Reasoning
comment: The paper has been accepted to the ICAPS-2026 conference. 5 pages, 2 figures
summary: Neural tree search is a powerful decision-making algorithm widely used in complex domains such as game playing and model-based reinforcement learning. Recent work has applied AlphaZero-style tree search to enhance the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) during inference, but we find that this approach suffers from a scaling failure: on GSM8K and Game24, accuracy drops as the search budget increases. In this paper, we present ReSCALE, an adaptation of Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS that replaces Dirichlet noise and PUCT selection with Gumbel sampling and Sequential Halving, restoring monotonic scaling without changes to the model or its training. ReSCALE reaches 58.4\% on GSM8K and 85.3\% on Game24 at budgets where the baseline degrades. Ablations confirm that Sequential Halving is the primary driver of the improvement.

AI.tldr: ReSCALE改进AlphaZero风格树搜索，解决LLM推理中搜索预算增加时准确率下降的问题，通过Gumbel采样和Sequential Halving恢复单调缩放性
AI.motivation: 最近将AlphaZero风格树搜索应用于大型语言模型推理增强时发现存在缩放失败问题：在GSM8K和Game24任务上，随着搜索预算增加，准确率反而下降
AI.method: 提出ReSCALE方法，基于Gumbel AlphaZero MCTS，用Gumbel采样替代Dirichlet噪声，用Sequential Halving替代PUCT选择策略，无需改变模型或其训练
AI.result: ReSCALE在GSM8K达到58.4%，在Game24达到85.3%的准确率，而基线方法在相同搜索预算下性能下降；消融实验确认Sequential Halving是改进的主要驱动力
AI.conclusion: ReSCALE成功解决了神经树搜索在LLM推理中的缩放失败问题，通过改进的搜索策略恢复了单调缩放性，为复杂推理任务提供了更可靠的决策增强方法

title: DiscoUQ: Structured Disagreement Analysis for Uncertainty Quantification in LLM Agent Ensembles
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems, where multiple prompted instances of a language model independently answer questions, are increasingly used for complex reasoning tasks. However, existing methods for quantifying the uncertainty of their collective outputs rely on shallow voting statistics that discard the rich semantic information in agents' reasoning. We introduce DiscoUQ, a framework that extracts and leverages the structure of inter-agent disagreement -- both linguistic properties (evidence overlap, argument strength, divergence depth) and embedding geometry (cluster distances, dispersion, cohesion) -- to produce well-calibrated confidence estimates. We propose three methods of increasing complexity: DiscoUQ-LLM (logistic regression on LLM-extracted structure features), DiscoUQ-Embed (logistic regression on embedding geometry), and DiscoUQ-Learn (a neural network combining all features). Evaluated on four diverse benchmarks (StrategyQA, MMLU, TruthfulQA, ARC-Challenge) with a 5-agent system using Qwen3.5-27B, DiscoUQ-LLM achieves an average AUROC of 0.802, outperforming the best baseline (LLM Aggregator, 0.791) while being substantially better calibrated (ECE 0.036 vs. 0.098). The learned features generalize across benchmarks with near-zero performance degradation and provide the largest improvements where they are most needed: in the ambiguous "weak disagreement" tier where simple vote counting fails.

AI.tldr: DiscoUQ是一个量化多智能体LLM系统不确定性的框架，通过分析智能体间的分歧结构（语言特性和嵌入几何）来产生校准良好的置信度估计，优于传统的投票统计方法。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖浅层的投票统计来量化多智能体LLM系统的不确定性，但这种方法丢弃了智能体推理中丰富的语义信息，无法充分利用智能体间的分歧结构。
AI.method: 提出DiscoUQ框架，提取并利用智能体间分歧的结构特征，包括语言特性（证据重叠、论证强度、分歧深度）和嵌入几何（聚类距离、分散度、内聚性）。开发了三种方法：DiscoUQ-LLM（基于LLM提取的结构特征的逻辑回归）、DiscoUQ-Embed（基于嵌入几何的逻辑回归）和DiscoUQ-Learn（结合所有特征的神经网络）。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试（StrategyQA、MMLU、TruthfulQA、ARC-Challenge）上使用5智能体系统（Qwen3.5-27B）评估，DiscoUQ-LLM平均AUROC达到0.802，优于最佳基线（LLM Aggregator，0.791），且校准效果显著更好（ECE 0.036 vs. 0.098）。学习到的特征在不同基准测试间具有良好泛化能力，在模糊的"弱分歧"层级中改进最大。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用智能体间分歧的结构信息，DiscoUQ能够产生更准确、校准更好的不确定性估计，特别是在传统投票方法失败的模糊情况下表现突出，为多智能体LLM系统的可靠性评估提供了更有效的方法。

title: Does AI Homogenize Student Thinking? A Multi-Dimensional Analysis of Structural Convergence in AI-Augmented Essays
summary: While AI-assisted writing has been widely reported to improve essay quality, its impact on the structural diversity of student thinking remains unexplored. Analyzing 6,875 essays across five conditions (Human-only, AI-only, and three Human+AI prompt strategies), we provide the first empirical evidence of a Quality-Homogenization Tradeoff, in which substantial quality gains co-occur with significant homogenization. The effect is dimension-specific: cohesion architecture lost 70-78% of its variance, whereas perspective plurality was diversified. Convergence target analysis further revealed that AI-augmented essays were pulled toward AI structural patterns yet deviated significantly from the Human-AI axis, indicating simultaneous partial replacement and partial emergence. Crucially, prompt specificity reversed homogenization into diversification on argument depth, demonstrating that homogenization is not an intrinsic property of AI but a function of interaction design.

AI.tldr: AI辅助写作在提升论文质量的同时会导致思维结构同质化，但提示词设计可以逆转这一趋势
AI.motivation: 虽然AI辅助写作已被广泛报道能提高论文质量，但其对学生思维结构多样性的影响尚未被探索。本研究旨在填补这一空白，探究AI辅助写作是否会导致思维结构同质化。
AI.method: 分析了6,875篇论文，设置了五种条件：纯人工写作、纯AI写作以及三种人机协作提示策略。通过测量不同维度的结构多样性变化，包括凝聚力架构和视角多元性，并进行了收敛目标分析。
AI.result: 发现了质量-同质化权衡效应：质量显著提升的同时伴随着明显的同质化。具体表现为凝聚力架构的方差减少了70-78%，而视角多元性却更加多样化。AI增强的论文被拉向AI结构模式，但又显著偏离人机轴线，表明同时存在部分替代和部分涌现。关键发现是提示词特异性能够逆转同质化趋势，在论证深度维度上实现多样化。
AI.conclusion: 同质化不是AI的内在属性，而是交互设计的函数。通过精心设计的提示策略，可以避免思维结构同质化，甚至促进多样化发展，这为教育中AI辅助写作的有效应用提供了重要指导。

title: Mitigating Selection Bias in Large Language Models via Permutation-Aware GRPO
summary: Large language models (LLMs) used for multiple-choice and pairwise evaluation tasks often exhibit selection bias due to non-semantic factors like option positions and label symbols. Existing inference-time debiasing is costly and may harm reasoning, while pointwise training ignores that the same question should yield consistent answers across permutations. To address this issue, we propose Permutation-Aware Group Relative Policy Optimization (PA-GRPO), which mitigates selection bias by enforcing permutation-consistent semantic reasoning. PA-GRPO constructs a permutation group for each instance by generating multiple candidate permutations, and optimizes the model using two complementary mechanisms: (1) cross-permutation advantage, which computes advantages relative to the mean reward over all permutations of the same instance, and (2) consistency-aware reward, which encourages the model to produce consistent decisions across different permutations. Experimental results demonstrate that PA-GRPO outperforms strong baselines across seven benchmarks, substantially reducing selection bias while maintaining high overall performance. The code will be made available on Github (https://github.com/ECNU-Text-Computing/PA-GRPO).

AI.tldr: PA-GRPO是一种通过排列感知的组相对策略优化方法，用于减少LLM在多项选择和成对评估任务中的选择偏差，通过跨排列优势和一致性感知奖励机制实现。
AI.motivation: LLM在多项选择和成对评估任务中存在选择偏差，受非语义因素（如选项位置、标签符号）影响。现有推理时去偏方法成本高且可能损害推理能力，而逐点训练忽略了同一问题在不同排列下应得到一致答案。
AI.method: 提出排列感知组相对策略优化(PA-GRPO)，通过强制排列一致的语义推理来减轻选择偏差。为每个实例构建排列组，使用两种互补机制优化模型：(1)跨排列优势：计算相对于同一实例所有排列平均奖励的优势；(2)一致性感知奖励：鼓励模型在不同排列下产生一致决策。
AI.result: PA-GRPO在七个基准测试中优于强基线方法，显著减少选择偏差的同时保持高整体性能。
AI.conclusion: PA-GRPO通过排列感知的组相对策略优化有效减轻了LLM的选择偏差问题，在多项选择和成对评估任务中表现出色。

title: High-Quality and Efficient Turbulence Mitigation with Events
summary: Turbulence mitigation (TM) is highly ill-posed due to the stochastic nature of atmospheric turbulence. Most methods rely on multiple frames recorded by conventional cameras to capture stable patterns in natural scenarios. However, they inevitably suffer from a trade-off between accuracy and efficiency: more frames enhance restoration at the cost of higher system latency and larger data overhead. Event cameras, equipped with microsecond temporal resolution and efficient sensing of dynamic changes, offer an opportunity to break the bottleneck. In this work, we present EHETM, a high-quality and efficient TM method inspired by the superiority of events to model motions in continuous sequences. We discover two key phenomena: (1) turbulence-induced events exhibit distinct polarity alternation correlated with sharp image gradients, providing structural cues for restoring scenes; and (2) dynamic objects form spatiotemporally coherent ``event tubes'' in contrast to irregular patterns within turbulent events, providing motion priors for disentangling objects from turbulence. Based on these insights, we design two complementary modules that respectively leverage polarity-weighted gradients for scene refinement and event-tube constraints for motion decoupling, achieving high-quality restoration with few frames. Furthermore, we construct two real-world event-frame turbulence datasets covering atmospheric and thermal cases. Experiments show that EHETM outperforms SOTA methods, especially under scenes with dynamic objects, while reducing data overhead and system latency by approximately 77.3% and 89.5%, respectively. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Xavier667/EHETM.

AI.tldr: EHETM是一种利用事件相机进行湍流缓解的高效方法，通过分析湍流事件中的极性交替和动态物体形成的"事件管"来恢复场景，显著减少了数据开销和系统延迟。
AI.motivation: 传统湍流缓解方法需要在准确性和效率之间权衡：更多帧能提高恢复质量，但会增加系统延迟和数据开销。事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率和高效感知动态变化的能力，为突破这一瓶颈提供了机会。
AI.method: 基于两个关键发现：(1)湍流诱导事件表现出与尖锐图像梯度相关的独特极性交替，为场景恢复提供结构线索；(2)动态物体形成时空连贯的"事件管"，与湍流事件中的不规则模式形成对比，为将物体与湍流分离提供运动先验。设计了两个互补模块：利用极性加权梯度进行场景细化，以及利用事件管约束进行运动解耦。
AI.result: EHETM在包含动态物体的场景中表现优于现有最先进方法，同时将数据开销减少约77.3%，系统延迟减少约89.5%。构建了两个真实世界的事件帧湍流数据集，涵盖大气和热湍流情况。
AI.conclusion: 事件相机为湍流缓解提供了新的解决方案，EHETM通过利用事件数据中的独特模式，实现了高质量恢复和高效处理的平衡，为实际应用提供了可行的技术路径。

title: ConsRoute:Consistency-Aware Adaptive Query Routing for Cloud-Edge-Device Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) deliver impressive capabilities but incur substantial inference latency and cost, which hinders their deployment in latency-sensitive and resource-constrained scenarios. Cloud-edge-device collaborative inference has emerged as a promising paradigm by dynamically routing queries to models of different capacities across tiers. In this paper, we propose ConsRoute, a lightweight, semantic-aware, and adaptive routing framework that significantly improves inference efficiency while minimizing impact on response quality. Unlike prior routing methods that rely on predicting coarse-grained output quality gaps, ConsRoute leverages a reranker to directly assess the semantic consistency between responses generated by models at different tiers, yielding fine-grained soft supervision signals for routing. To minimize device-side overhead, ConsRoute reuses hidden states from the LLM prefilling stage as compact query representations, avoiding additional encoders or inference passes. Furthermore, these representations are clustered, and Bayesian optimization is employed to learn cluster-specific routing thresholds that dynamically balance quality, latency, and cost under heterogeneous query distributions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ConsRoute achieves near-cloud performance (>=95%) while reducing end-to-end latency and inference cost by nearly 40%, consistently outperforming existing routing baselines in both response quality and system efficiency.

AI.tldr: ConsRoute是一个轻量级、语义感知的自适应路由框架，通过云边端协同推理，在保持95%云端性能的同时，将端到端延迟和推理成本降低近40%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然能力强大，但存在显著的推理延迟和成本问题，限制了其在延迟敏感和资源受限场景中的部署。云边端协同推理通过在不同层级动态路由查询到不同容量的模型，成为一种有前景的解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 使用重排序器直接评估不同层级模型生成响应的语义一致性，提供细粒度软监督信号；2. 重用LLM预填充阶段的隐藏状态作为紧凑查询表示，避免额外编码器或推理过程；3. 对这些表示进行聚类，并使用贝叶斯优化学习特定于聚类的路由阈值，在异构查询分布下动态平衡质量、延迟和成本。
AI.result: 实验表明，ConsRoute在保持接近云端性能（≥95%）的同时，将端到端延迟和推理成本降低了近40%，在响应质量和系统效率方面均优于现有路由基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ConsRoute作为一个轻量级、语义感知的自适应路由框架，通过创新的语义一致性评估和动态阈值调整机制，有效解决了云边端协同推理中的效率与质量平衡问题，为延迟敏感和资源受限场景下的LLM部署提供了实用解决方案。

title: Left Behind: Cross-Lingual Transfer as a Bridge for Low-Resource Languages in Large Language Models
summary: We investigate how large language models perform on low-resource languages by benchmarking eight LLMs across five experimental conditions in English, Kazakh, and Mongolian. Using 50 hand-crafted questions spanning factual, reasoning, technical, and culturally grounded categories, we evaluate 2,000 responses on accuracy, fluency, and completeness. We find a consistent performance gap of 13.8-16.7 percentage points between English and low-resource language conditions, with models maintaining surface-level fluency while producing significantly less accurate content. Cross-lingual transfer-prompting models to reason in English before translating back-yields selective gains for bilingual architectures (+2.2pp to +4.3pp) but provides no benefit to English-dominant models. Our results demonstrate that current LLMs systematically underserve low-resource language communities, and that effective mitigation strategies are architecture-dependent rather than universal.

AI.tldr: 研究评估了8个大语言模型在英语、哈萨克语和蒙古语上的表现，发现低资源语言与英语之间存在13.8-16.7个百分点的性能差距，模型在保持表面流畅性的同时准确性显著降低。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是调查大语言模型在低资源语言上的表现，评估当前LLM是否系统性地服务不足低资源语言社区，并探索有效的缓解策略。
AI.method: 使用50个手工制作的问题（涵盖事实、推理、技术和文化相关类别），在英语、哈萨克语和蒙古语上对8个LLM进行基准测试，评估2000个回答的准确性、流畅性和完整性。采用跨语言迁移策略（先用英语推理再翻译回目标语言）。
AI.result: 发现英语与低资源语言之间存在13.8-16.7个百分点的性能差距；模型在低资源语言上保持表面流畅性但准确性显著降低；跨语言迁移对双语架构有选择性提升（+2.2到+4.3个百分点），但对英语主导模型无益。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM系统性地服务不足低资源语言社区，有效的缓解策略是架构依赖的而非通用的，需要针对不同模型架构设计专门的解决方案。

title: Graph of States: Solving Abductive Tasks with Large Language Models
summary: Logical reasoning encompasses deduction, induction, and abduction. However, while Large Language Models (LLMs) have effectively mastered the former two, abductive reasoning remains significantly underexplored. Existing frameworks, predominantly designed for static deductive tasks, fail to generalize to abductive reasoning due to unstructured state representation and lack of explicit state control. Consequently, they are inevitably prone to Evidence Fabrication, Context Drift, Failed Backtracking, and Early Stopping. To bridge this gap, we introduce Graph of States (GoS), a general-purpose neuro-symbolic framework tailored for abductive tasks. GoS grounds multi-agent collaboration in a structured belief states, utilizing a causal graph to explicitly encode logical dependencies and a state machine to govern the valid transitions of the reasoning process. By dynamically aligning the reasoning focus with these symbolic constraints, our approach transforms aimless, unconstrained exploration into a convergent, directed search. Extensive evaluations on two real-world datasets demonstrate that GoS significantly outperforms all baselines, providing a robust solution for complex abductive tasks. Code repo and all prompts: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/Graph-of-States-5B4E.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Graph of States (GoS)框架，专门解决大语言模型在溯因推理方面的不足，通过结构化信念状态和因果图来避免证据伪造、上下文漂移等问题，显著提升了溯因推理性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在演绎和归纳推理方面表现出色，但在溯因推理方面仍然严重不足。现有框架主要针对静态演绎任务设计，由于缺乏结构化状态表示和明确的状态控制，无法泛化到溯因推理，容易导致证据伪造、上下文漂移、回溯失败和过早停止等问题。
AI.method: 提出了Graph of States (GoS)框架，这是一个专门为溯因任务设计的通用神经符号框架。该框架基于结构化信念状态进行多智能体协作，使用因果图显式编码逻辑依赖关系，并通过状态机控制推理过程的有效转换。通过动态对齐推理焦点与这些符号约束，将无目标、无约束的探索转化为收敛的、有向的搜索。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的广泛评估表明，GoS框架显著优于所有基线方法，为复杂的溯因任务提供了稳健的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: GoS框架通过结合神经和符号方法，成功解决了大语言模型在溯因推理方面的局限性，将无约束探索转化为有向搜索，为复杂溯因任务提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Reading Between the Lines: How Electronic Nonverbal Cues shape Emotion Decoding
summary: As text-based computer-mediated communication (CMC) increasingly structures everyday interaction, a central question re-emerges with new urgency: How do users reconstruct nonverbal expression in environments where embodied cues are absent? This paper provides a systematic, theory-driven account of electronic nonverbal cues (eNVCs) - textual analogues of kinesics, vocalics, and paralinguistics - in public microblog communication. Across three complementary studies, we advance conceptual, empirical, and methodological contributions. Study 1 develops a unified taxonomy of eNVCs grounded in foundational nonverbal communication theory and introduces a scalable Python toolkit for their automated detection. Study 2, a within-subject survey experiment, offers controlled causal evidence that eNVCs substantially improve emotional decoding accuracy and lower perceived ambiguity, while also identifying boundary conditions, such as sarcasm, under which these benefits weaken or disappear. Study 3, through focus group discussions, reveals the interpretive strategies users employ when reasoning about digital prosody, including drawing meaning from the absence of expected cues and defaulting toward negative interpretations in ambiguous contexts. Together, these studies establish eNVCs as a coherent and measurable class of digital behaviors, refine theoretical accounts of cue richness and interpretive effort, and provide practical tools for affective computing, user modeling, and emotion-aware interface design. The eNVC detection toolkit is available as a Python and R package at https://github.com/kokiljaidka/envc.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了电子非语言线索(eNVCs)在文本计算机中介通信中的作用，开发了自动检测工具包，并通过实验证明eNVCs能提高情感解码准确性、降低感知模糊性，同时识别了其局限性条件。
AI.motivation: 随着文本计算机中介通信在日常互动中日益重要，需要研究在缺乏身体线索的环境中用户如何重建非语言表达，特别是文本形式的电子非语言线索在公共微博通信中的作用。
AI.method: 采用三个互补研究：研究1基于非语言沟通理论开发eNVCs统一分类法及Python自动检测工具包；研究2通过受试者内调查实验提供因果证据；研究3通过焦点小组讨论揭示用户解释数字韵律的策略。
AI.result: eNVCs能显著提高情感解码准确性、降低感知模糊性，但在讽刺等条件下效果减弱；用户会从预期线索缺失中提取意义，在模糊情境中倾向于负面解释；开发了可用的Python和R工具包。
AI.conclusion: eNVCs构成了可测量的一类数字行为，完善了线索丰富性和解释努力的理论框架，为情感计算、用户建模和情感感知界面设计提供了实用工具。

title: Cross-modal Fuzzy Alignment Network for Text-Aerial Person Retrieval and A Large-scale Benchmark
summary: Text-aerial person retrieval aims to identify targets in UAV-captured images from eyewitness descriptions, supporting intelligent transportation and public security applications. Compared to ground-view text--image person retrieval, UAV-captured images often suffer from degraded visual information due to drastic variations in viewing angles and flight altitudes, making semantic alignment with textual descriptions very challenging. To address this issue, we propose a novel Cross-modal Fuzzy Alignment Network, which quantifies the token-level reliability by fuzzy logic to achieve accurate fine-grained alignment and incorporates ground-view images as a bridge agent to further mitigate the gap between aerial images and text descriptions, for text--aerial person retrieval. In particular, we design the Fuzzy Token Alignment module that employs the fuzzy membership function to dynamically model token-level association strength and suppress the influence of unobservable or noisy tokens. It can alleviate the semantic inconsistencies caused by missing visual cues and significantly enhance the robustness of token-level semantic alignment. Moreover, to further mitigate the gap between aerial images and text descriptions, we design a Context-Aware Dynamic Alignment module to incorporate the ground-view agent as a bridge in text--aerial alignment and adaptively combine direct alignment and agent-assisted alignment to improve the robustness. In addition, we construct a large-scale benchmark dataset called AERI-PEDES by using a chain-of-thought to decompose text generation into attribute parsing, initial captioning, and refinement, thus boosting textual accuracy and semantic consistency. Experiments on AERI-PEDES and TBAPR demonstrate the superiority of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于文本-无人机行人检索的跨模态模糊对齐网络，通过模糊逻辑量化token级可靠性实现细粒度对齐，并引入地面视图图像作为桥梁代理来缓解无人机图像与文本描述之间的语义鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 无人机捕获的图像由于视角和飞行高度的剧烈变化，视觉信息往往退化严重，导致与文本描述的语义对齐非常困难。相比地面视图的文本-图像行人检索，无人机视图面临更大的挑战。
AI.method: 提出跨模态模糊对齐网络，包含两个核心模块：1) 模糊token对齐模块，使用模糊隶属函数动态建模token级关联强度，抑制不可观测或噪声token的影响；2) 上下文感知动态对齐模块，引入地面视图作为桥梁代理，自适应结合直接对齐和代理辅助对齐。此外，构建了AERI-PEDES大规模基准数据集。
AI.result: 在AERI-PEDES和TBAPR数据集上的实验证明了该方法的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过模糊逻辑量化token级可靠性和引入地面视图代理，有效缓解了无人机图像与文本描述之间的语义鸿沟，提升了文本-无人机行人检索的性能。

title: The Library Theorem: How External Organization Governs Agentic Reasoning Capacity
summary: Externalized reasoning is already exploited by transformer-based agents through chain-of-thought, but structured retrieval -- indexing over one's own reasoning state -- remains underexplored. We formalize the transformer context window as an I/O page and prove that tool-augmented agents with indexed external memory achieve exponentially lower retrieval cost than agents restricted to sequential scanning: $O(\log_b N)$ versus $Ω(N)$ page reads per query, and $O(T \log_b T)$ versus $Θ(T^2)$ cumulative cost over $T$ reasoning steps -- a gap that widens as deliberation deepens. We test these predictions on a controlled lookup benchmark across three content types -- random hashes, ordered integers, and encyclopedia entries -- varying store size from 50 to 5,000 items, and replicate key conditions across two model generations (GPT-4o-mini and GPT-5.4). On abstract content, the indexed agent achieves median 1 page read regardless of store size, confirming the $O(1)$ prediction. Sorted pages without an index fail to close the gap: the weaker model cannot sustain binary search at scale, and the stronger model achieves near-optimal $\log_2 N$ search but still loses to the index by $5\times$. On familiar content (encyclopedia entries), a competing failure mode emerges: the model recognizes the domain, bypasses the retrieval protocol, and generates answers from parametric memory, producing catastrophic token expenditure even when the index is sound. This parametric memory competition dissociates the two cognitive operations that indexing combines: understanding content (where language models excel) and following navigational protocols (where they fail when understanding tempts them to shortcut). The result argues for a separation of concerns: use language models for index construction, where semantic understanding helps, and deterministic algorithms for index traversal, where it hurts.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了具有索引外部记忆的transformer智能体相比仅顺序扫描的智能体在检索成本上的指数级优势，并揭示了语言模型在理解内容和遵循导航协议之间的认知分离问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然transformer智能体已经通过思维链利用外部化推理，但结构化检索（对自身推理状态进行索引）仍未得到充分探索。研究者希望量化索引外部记忆对智能体检索效率的影响。
AI.method: 将transformer上下文窗口形式化为I/O页面，理论分析索引智能体与顺序扫描智能体的检索成本差异。在受控查找基准测试中，测试三种内容类型（随机哈希、有序整数、百科全书条目），存储规模从50到5000项，并在两个模型世代（GPT-4o-mini和GPT-5.4）上复现关键条件。
AI.result: 在抽象内容上，索引智能体实现中位数1页读取，符合O(1)预测。有序页面无索引时，较弱模型无法维持大规模二分搜索，较强模型实现接近最优的log₂N搜索但仍比索引慢5倍。在熟悉内容上，模型识别领域后绕过检索协议，直接从参数记忆生成答案，导致灾难性令牌消耗。
AI.conclusion: 参数记忆竞争分离了索引结合的两个认知操作：理解内容（语言模型擅长）和遵循导航协议（当理解诱惑它们走捷径时会失败）。结果支持关注点分离：使用语言模型进行索引构建（语义理解有帮助），使用确定性算法进行索引遍历（语义理解有害）。

title: Premier: Personalized Preference Modulation with Learnable User Embedding in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image generation has advanced rapidly, yet it still struggles to capture the nuanced user preferences. Existing approaches typically rely on multimodal large language models to infer user preferences, but the derived prompts or latent codes rarely reflect them faithfully, leading to suboptimal personalization. We present Premier, a novel preference modulation framework for personalized image generation. Premier represents each user's preference as a learnable embedding and introduces a preference adapter that fuses the user embedding with the text prompt. To enable accurate and fine-grained preference control, the fused preference embedding is further used to modulate the generative process. To enhance the distinctness of individual preference and improve alignment between outputs and user-specific styles, we incorporate a dispersion loss that enforces separation among user embeddings. When user data are scarce, new users are represented as linear combinations of existing preference embeddings learned during training, enabling effective generalization. Experiments show that Premier outperforms prior methods under the same history length, achieving stronger preference alignment and superior performance on text consistency, ViPer proxy metrics, and expert evaluations.

AI.tldr: Premier是一个用于个性化图像生成的新型偏好调制框架，通过可学习的用户嵌入表示用户偏好，使用偏好适配器融合用户嵌入与文本提示，并通过分散损失增强用户偏好的独特性。
AI.motivation: 当前的文本到图像生成技术虽然发展迅速，但在捕捉用户细微偏好方面仍有不足。现有方法通常依赖多模态大语言模型推断用户偏好，但生成的提示或潜在代码很少能忠实反映用户偏好，导致个性化效果不佳。
AI.method: 1. 将每个用户的偏好表示为可学习的嵌入向量；2. 引入偏好适配器，将用户嵌入与文本提示融合；3. 使用融合后的偏好嵌入来调制生成过程，实现精确细粒度的偏好控制；4. 加入分散损失，强制用户嵌入之间保持分离，增强个体偏好的独特性；5. 当用户数据稀缺时，新用户表示为训练期间学习到的现有偏好嵌入的线性组合。
AI.result: 实验表明，在相同历史长度下，Premier优于先前方法，实现了更强的偏好对齐，并在文本一致性、ViPer代理指标和专家评估方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: Premier框架通过可学习的用户偏好嵌入和调制机制，有效解决了个性化图像生成中的偏好对齐问题，能够准确捕捉和反映用户的细微偏好，在用户数据稀缺时也能有效泛化。

title: Improving Coherence and Persistence in Agentic AI for System Optimization
summary:
Designing high-performance system heuristics is a creative, iterative process requiring experts to form hypotheses and execute multi-step conceptual shifts. While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in automating this loop, they struggle with complex system problems due to two critical failure modes: evolutionary neighborhood bias and the coherence ceiling. Evolutionary methods often remain trapped in local optima by relying on scalar benchmark scores, failing when coordinated multi-step changes are required. Conversely, existing agentic frameworks suffer from context degradation over long horizons or fail to accumulate knowledge across independent runs.
  We present Engram, an agentic researcher architecture that addresses these limitations by decoupling long-horizon exploration from the constraints of a single context window. Engram organizes exploration into a sequence of agents that iteratively design, test, and analyze mechanisms. At the conclusion of each run, an agent stores code snapshots, logs, and results in a persistent Archive and distills high-level modeling insights into a compact, persistent Research Digest. Subsequent agents then begin with a fresh context window, reading the Research Digest to build on prior discoveries.
  We find that Engram exhibits superior performance across diverse domains including multi-cloud multicast, LLM inference request routing, and optimizing KV cache reuse in databases with natural language queries.

AI.tldr: Engram是一种解决LLM在复杂系统优化中失败模式的智能体架构，通过解耦长期探索与单次上下文限制，使用持久化存档和研究摘要来积累知识，在多个系统优化任务中表现优异。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在自动化系统启发式设计时面临两个关键失败模式：进化邻域偏差（陷入局部最优）和一致性天花板（长时程上下文退化）。需要一种能协调多步变化并跨运行积累知识的架构。
