AI.method: Engram采用智能体研究者架构，将探索分解为一系列迭代设计、测试和分析机制的智能体。每个运行结束时，智能体将代码快照、日志和结果存入持久化存档，并将高层建模见解提炼为紧凑的研究摘要。后续智能体从新上下文窗口开始，通过阅读研究摘要来继承先前发现。
AI.result: Engram在多云组播、LLM推理请求路由、以及使用自然语言查询优化数据库KV缓存重用等多个领域中表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: Engram通过解耦长期探索与单次上下文限制，解决了LLM在复杂系统优化中的关键失败模式，实现了跨运行的知识积累和协调的多步设计改进。

authors: Jose Luis Lima de Jesus Silva
title: Weakly supervised multimodal segmentation of acoustic borehole images with depth-aware cross-attention
summary: Acoustic borehole images provide high-resolution borehole-wall structure, but large-scale interpretation remains difficult because dense expert annotations are rarely available and subsurface information is intrinsically multimodal. The challenge is developing weakly supervised methods combining two-dimensional image texture with depth-aligned one-dimensional well-logs. Here, we introduce a weakly supervised multimodal segmentation framework that refines threshold-guided pseudo-labels through learned models. This preserves the annotation-free character of classical thresholding and clustering workflows while extending them with denoising, confidence-aware pseudo-supervision, and physically structured fusion. We establish that threshold-guided learned refinement provides the most robust improvement over raw thresholding, denoised thresholding, and latent clustering baselines. Multimodal performance depends strongly on fusion strategy: direct concatenation provides limited gains, whereas depth-aware cross-attention, gated fusion, and confidence-aware modulation substantially improve agreement with the weak supervisory reference. The strongest model, confidence-gated depth-aware cross-attention (CG-DCA), consistently outperforms threshold-based, image-only, and earlier multimodal baselines. Targeted ablations show its advantage depends specifically on confidence-aware fusion and structured local depth interaction rather than model complexity alone. Cross-well analyses confirm this performance is broadly stable. These results establish a practical, scalable framework for annotation-free segmentation, showing multimodal improvement is maximized when auxiliary logs are incorporated selectively and depth-aware.

AI.tldr: 提出一种弱监督多模态分割框架，结合声波测井图像和测井曲线，通过阈值引导的伪标签学习和置信度感知融合，实现无需专家标注的井壁结构分割。
AI.motivation: 声波测井图像提供高分辨率井壁结构信息，但大规模解释困难，因为密集专家标注稀缺且地下信息本质上是多模态的。需要开发结合二维图像纹理和深度对齐一维测井曲线的弱监督方法。
AI.method: 提出弱监督多模态分割框架：1）通过阈值引导生成伪标签；2）使用学习模型细化伪标签；3）结合去噪、置信度感知伪监督和物理结构化融合；4）比较多种融合策略，包括直接拼接、深度感知交叉注意力、门控融合和置信度感知调制。
AI.result: 阈值引导的学习细化比原始阈值、去噪阈值和潜在聚类基线更稳健。多模态性能强烈依赖融合策略：直接拼接增益有限，而深度感知交叉注意力、门控融合和置信度感知调制显著提高与弱监督参考的一致性。最强模型CG-DCA（置信度门控深度感知交叉注意力）始终优于基于阈值、仅图像和早期多模态基线。
AI.conclusion: 建立了一个实用、可扩展的无标注分割框架，表明当辅助测井曲线被选择性和深度感知地整合时，多模态改进最大化。置信度感知融合和结构化局部深度交互是关键优势来源，而非仅模型复杂性。

title: Evaluating Reasoning-Based Scaffolds for Human-AI Co-Annotation: The ReasonAlign Annotation Protocol
summary:
Human annotation is central to NLP evaluation, yet subjective tasks often exhibit substantial variability across annotators. While large language models (LLMs) can provide structured reasoning to support annotation, their influence on human annotation behavior remains unclear.
  We introduce ReasonAlign, a reasoning-based annotation scaffold that exposes LLM-generated explanations while withholding predicted labels. We frame this as a controlled study of how reasoning affects human annotation behavior, rather than a full evaluation of annotation accuracy. Using a two-pass protocol inspired by Delphi-style revision, annotators first label instances independently and then revise their decisions after viewing model-generated reasoning.
  We evaluate the approach on sentiment classification and opinion detection tasks, analyzing changes in inter-annotator agreement and revision behavior. To quantify these effects, we introduce the Annotator Effort Proxy (AEP), a metric capturing the proportion of labels revised after exposure to reasoning. Our results show that exposure to reasoning is associated with increased agreement alongside minimal revision, suggesting that reasoning primarily helps resolve ambiguous cases without inducing widespread changes.
  These findings provide insight into how reasoning explanations shape annotation consistency and highlight reasoning-based scaffolds as a practical mechanism for supporting human-AI annotation workflows.

AI.tldr: ReasonAlign：一个基于推理的标注框架，通过展示LLM生成的解释（但不展示预测标签）来研究推理如何影响人类标注行为，发现推理主要帮助解决模糊案例，提高标注一致性。
AI.motivation: 人类标注在NLP评估中至关重要，但主观任务通常在不同标注者之间存在显著差异。虽然大语言模型可以提供结构化推理来支持标注，但它们对人类标注行为的影响尚不清楚。本研究旨在探索推理解释如何影响标注一致性。
AI.method: 提出ReasonAlign框架，采用两轮协议（受Delphi式修订启发）：标注者先独立标注实例，然后查看模型生成的推理后修订决策。在情感分类和观点检测任务上评估，分析标注者间一致性和修订行为的变化。引入标注者努力代理（AEP）指标来量化修订比例。
AI.result: 暴露于推理解释与标注一致性增加相关，同时修订行为最少。这表明推理主要帮助解决模糊案例，而不会引发广泛的标注变化。AEP指标显示标注者在接触推理后修订标签的比例较低。
AI.conclusion: 推理解释有助于提高标注一致性，主要解决模糊案例而不导致大规模标注变化。基于推理的框架可作为支持人机标注工作流程的实用机制，为如何利用AI推理提升人类标注质量提供见解。

title: VSD-MOT: End-to-End Multi-Object Tracking in Low-Quality Video Scenes Guided by Visual Semantic Distillation
summary: Existing multi-object tracking algorithms typically fail to adequately address the issues in low-quality videos, resulting in a significant decline in tracking performance when image quality deteriorates in real-world scenarios. This performance degradation is primarily due to the algorithms' inability to effectively tackle the problems caused by information loss in low-quality images. To address the challenges of low-quality video scenarios, inspired by vision-language models, we propose a multi-object tracking framework guided by visual semantic distillation (VSD-MOT). Specifically, we introduce the CLIP Image Encoder to extract global visual semantic information from images to compensate for the loss of information in low-quality images. However, direct integration can substantially impact the efficiency of the multi-object tracking algorithm. Therefore, this paper proposes to extract visual semantic information from images through knowledge distillation. This method adopts a teacher-student learning framework, with the CLIP Image Encoder serving as the teacher model. To enable the student model to acquire the capability of extracting visual semantic information suitable for multi-object tracking tasks from the teacher model, we have designed the Dual-Constraint Semantic Distillation method (DCSD). Furthermore, to address the dynamic variation of frame quality in low-quality videos, we propose the Dynamic Semantic Weight Regulation (DSWR) module, which adaptively allocates fusion weights based on real-time frame quality assessment. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed method in low-quality video scenarios in the real world. Meanwhile, our method can maintain good performance in conventional scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出VSD-MOT框架，通过视觉语义蒸馏解决低质量视频中的多目标跟踪问题，使用CLIP提取全局语义信息补偿信息损失，并设计动态权重调节模块适应帧质量变化。
AI.motivation: 现有多目标跟踪算法在低质量视频中性能显著下降，主要原因是无法有效处理低质量图像中的信息损失问题。现实场景中视频质量下降时，跟踪性能急剧恶化，需要专门针对低质量视频场景的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出视觉语义蒸馏引导的多目标跟踪框架(VSD-MOT)：1) 引入CLIP图像编码器提取全局视觉语义信息；2) 采用知识蒸馏的师生学习框架，CLIP作为教师模型；3) 设计双约束语义蒸馏方法(DCSD)使学生模型获得适合多目标跟踪任务的语义提取能力；4) 提出动态语义权重调节模块(DSWR)，根据实时帧质量评估自适应分配融合权重。
AI.result: 大量实验证明该方法在现实世界低质量视频场景中具有有效性和优越性，同时在常规场景中也能保持良好的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过视觉语义蒸馏和动态权重调节，VSD-MOT框架成功解决了低质量视频中的多目标跟踪问题，在保持常规场景性能的同时，显著提升了低质量视频场景的跟踪效果。

title: RoboAlign: Learning Test-Time Reasoning for Language-Action Alignment in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Improving embodied reasoning in multimodal-large-language models (MLLMs) is essential for building vision-language-action models (VLAs) on top of them to readily translate multimodal understanding into low-level actions. Accordingly, recent work has explored enhancing embodied reasoning in MLLMs through supervision of vision-question-answering type. However, these approaches have been reported to result in unstable VLA performance, often yielding only marginal or even negative gains. In this paper, we propose a more systematic MLLM training framework RoboAlign that reliably improves VLA performance. Our key idea is to sample action tokens via zero-shot natural language reasoning and refines this reasoning using reinforcement learning (RL) to improve action accuracy. As a result, RoboAlign bridges the modality gap between language and low-level actions in MLLMs, and facilitate knowledge transfer from MLLM to VLA. To validate the effectiveness of RoboAlign, we train VLAs by adding a diffusion-based action head on top of an MLLM backbone and evaluate them on major robotics benchmarks. Remarkably, by performing RL-based alignment after SFT using less than 1\% of the data, RoboAlign achieves performance improvements of 17.5\%, 18.9\%, and 106.6\% over SFT baselines on LIBERO, CALVIN, and real-world environments, respectively.

AI.tldr: RoboAlign：通过零样本自然语言推理采样动作token，并用强化学习优化推理，从而提升多模态大语言模型的具身推理能力，改善视觉-语言-动作模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 提升多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的具身推理能力对于构建视觉-语言-动作模型（VLAs）至关重要，但现有的基于视觉问答监督的方法会导致VLA性能不稳定，增益有限甚至为负。
AI.method: 提出RoboAlign训练框架：1）通过零样本自然语言推理采样动作token；2）使用强化学习（RL）优化推理过程以提高动作准确性；3）在MLLM骨干上添加基于扩散的动作头来训练VLA。
AI.result: 在主要机器人基准测试中，RoboAlign仅使用不到1%的数据进行RL对齐后，相比SFT基线在LIBERO、CALVIN和真实环境中的性能分别提升17.5%、18.9%和106.6%。
AI.conclusion: RoboAlign通过系统化的训练框架有效缩小了语言与低级动作之间的模态差距，促进了从MLLM到VLA的知识迁移，显著提升了VLA性能。

title: SATTC: Structure-Aware Label-Free Test-Time Calibration for Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Retrieval
summary: Cross-subject EEG-to-image retrieval for visual decoding is challenged by subject shift and hubness in the embedding space, which distort similarity geometry and destabilize top-k rankings, making small-k shortlists unreliable. We introduce SATTC (Structure-Aware Test-Time Calibration), a label-free calibration head that operates directly on the similarity matrix of frozen EEG and image encoders. SATTC combines a geometric expert, subject-adaptive whitening of EEG embeddings with an adaptive variant of Cross-domain Similarity Local Scaling (CSLS), and a structural expert built from mutual nearest neighbors, bidirectional top-k ranks, and class popularity, fused via a simple Product-of-Experts rule. On THINGS-EEG under a strict leave-one-subject-out protocol, standardized inference with cosine similarities, L2-normalized embeddings, and candidate whitening already yields a strong cross-subject baseline over the original ATM retrieval setup. Building on this baseline, SATTC further improves Top-1 and Top-5 accuracy, reduces hubness and per-class imbalance, and produces more reliable small-k shortlists. These gains transfer across multiple EEG encoders, supporting SATTC as an encoder-agnostic, label-free test-time calibration layer for cross-subject neural decoding.

AI.tldr: SATTC是一种无标签测试时校准方法，通过几何专家和结构专家优化跨被试EEG-图像检索，解决被试偏移和中心性问题，提高检索准确性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 跨被试EEG到图像检索面临被试偏移和嵌入空间中心性问题，这会扭曲相似性几何结构并使top-k排名不稳定，导致小k候选列表不可靠。
AI.method: SATTC直接在冻结的EEG和图像编码器的相似性矩阵上操作，结合几何专家（被试自适应白化和自适应CSLS）和结构专家（相互最近邻、双向top-k排名和类别流行度），通过专家乘积规则融合。
AI.result: 在THINGS-EEG数据集上，SATTC在严格留一被试协议下显著提高了Top-1和Top-5准确率，减少了中心性和类别不平衡，产生了更可靠的小k候选列表，且增益可跨多个EEG编码器迁移。
AI.conclusion: SATTC作为一种编码器无关、无标签的测试时校准层，能有效改善跨被试神经解码的检索性能，为解决被试偏移和中心性问题提供了实用解决方案。

title: The AI Scientific Community: Agentic Virtual Lab Swarms
summary: In this short note we propose using agentic swarms of virtual labs as a model of an AI Science Community. In this paradigm, each particle in the swarm represents a complete virtual laboratory instance, enabling collective scientific exploration that mirrors real-world research communities. The framework leverages the inherent properties of swarm intelligence - decentralized coordination, balanced exploration-exploitation trade-offs, and emergent collective behavior - to simulate the behavior of a scientific community and potentially accelerate scientific discovery. We discuss architectural considerations, inter-laboratory communication and influence mechanisms including citation-analogous voting systems, fitness function design for quantifying scientific success, anticipated emergent behaviors, mechanisms for preventing lab dominance and preserving diversity, and computational efficiency strategies to enable large swarms exhibiting complex emergent behavior analogous to real-world scientific communities. A working instance of the AI Science Community is currently under development.

AI.tldr: 提出使用虚拟实验室的智能体群作为AI科学社区模型，每个粒子代表一个完整的虚拟实验室实例，通过群体智能特性模拟真实科研社区行为
AI.motivation: 建立模拟真实科学社区的AI框架，利用群体智能的分散协调、探索-利用平衡和涌现集体行为特性，加速科学发现过程
AI.method: 设计基于智能体群的虚拟实验室架构，包括实验室间通信和影响力机制（类似引用的投票系统）、科学成功量化适应度函数、防止实验室主导和保持多样性的机制，以及支持大规模群复杂涌现行为的计算效率策略
AI.result: AI科学社区的工作实例目前正在开发中，尚未提供具体实验结果
AI.conclusion: 虚拟实验室智能体群框架能够模拟真实科学社区行为，通过群体智能机制可能加速科学发现，为AI驱动的科学研究提供了新范式

title: AgentHER: Hindsight Experience Replay for LLM Agent Trajectory Relabeling
summary: LLM agents fail on the majority of real-world tasks -- GPT-4o succeeds on fewer than 15% of WebArena navigation tasks and below 55% pass@1 on ToolBench (Zhou et al., 2024; Qin et al., 2024) -- yet every failed trajectory is routinely discarded, wasting the dominant source of collected experience. We introduce AgentHER, a framework that recovers this lost training signal by adapting the Hindsight Experience Replay (HER; Andrychowicz et al., 2017) principle to natural-language agent trajectories for offline data augmentation. The key insight is simple: a trajectory that fails goal A is often a correct demonstration for some achievable alternative goal B. AgentHER realises this idea through a four-stage pipeline -- failure classification, outcome extraction, LLM-guided prompt relabeling with confidence gating, and data packaging -- that converts discarded failures into high-quality SFT, DPO, and ShareGPT training data, with both zero-cost rule-based and LLM-judge implementations. On WebArena (Zhou et al., 2024) and ToolBench (Qin et al., 2024), AgentHER improves over success-only SFT by +7.1-11.7 pp across four model families (GPT-4o, Qwen2.5-72B/7B, LLaMA-3.1-8B), while achieving 2x data efficiency -- matching baseline performance with only 50% of successful demonstrations. Gains are consistent from 1.5B to 72B parameters (+5.8-9.2 pp) and compound under iterative redeployment (+2.1 pp over additional rounds). Human evaluation confirms 97.7% relabeling precision under multi-judge verification.

AI.tldr: AgentHER框架通过将失败轨迹转化为训练数据，显著提升LLM代理在真实任务中的表现
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理在真实世界任务中失败率很高（如GPT-4o在WebArena导航任务中成功率低于15%），但所有失败轨迹都被丢弃，浪费了宝贵的经验数据
AI.method: 提出AgentHER框架，将Hindsight Experience Replay原理应用于自然语言代理轨迹，通过四阶段流程（失败分类、结果提取、LLM引导的提示重标注与置信度门控、数据打包）将失败轨迹转化为高质量训练数据
AI.result: 在WebArena和ToolBench上，AgentHER相比仅使用成功轨迹的SFT提升了7.1-11.7个百分点，数据效率提高2倍（仅用50%成功演示即可达到基线性能），在1.5B到72B参数范围内均有5.8-9.2个百分点的提升
AI.conclusion: AgentHER能够有效回收失败轨迹中的训练信号，显著提升LLM代理性能，为代理训练提供了高效的数据增强方法

title: Explainable Semantic Textual Similarity via Dissimilar Span Detection
summary: Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) is a crucial component of many Natural Language Processing (NLP) applications. However, existing approaches typically reduce semantic nuances to a single score, limiting interpretability. To address this, we introduce the task of Dissimilar Span Detection (DSD), which aims to identify semantically differing spans between pairs of texts. This can help users understand which particular words or tokens negatively affect the similarity score, or be used to improve performance in STS-dependent downstream tasks. Furthermore, we release a new dataset suitable for the task, the Span Similarity Dataset (SSD), developed through a semi-automated pipeline combining large language models (LLMs) with human verification. We propose and evaluate different baseline methods for DSD, both unsupervised, based on LIME, SHAP, LLMs, and our own method, as well as an additional supervised approach. While LLMs and supervised models achieve the highest performance, overall results remain low, highlighting the complexity of the task. Finally, we set up an additional experiment that shows how DSD can lead to increased performance in the specific task of paraphrase detection.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的任务——差异跨度检测（DSD），旨在识别文本对中语义不同的片段，以提高语义文本相似性（STS）的可解释性，并发布了Span Similarity Dataset（SSD）数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有语义文本相似性方法通常将语义差异简化为单一分数，缺乏可解释性。用户无法了解哪些具体词语或标记影响了相似性评分，这限制了STS在依赖下游任务中的应用。
AI.method: 1. 提出差异跨度检测（DSD）任务；2. 通过结合大语言模型（LLMs）和人工验证的半自动化流程构建Span Similarity Dataset（SSD）数据集；3. 评估多种基线方法：基于LIME、SHAP、LLMs的无监督方法，以及监督方法。
AI.result: 虽然LLMs和监督模型取得了最高性能，但整体结果仍然较低，表明该任务的复杂性。实验显示DSD可以在特定任务（如释义检测）中提高性能。
AI.conclusion: DSD任务能够增强语义文本相似性的可解释性，帮助用户理解影响相似性评分的具体文本片段，并可能改善依赖STS的下游任务性能。尽管当前方法性能有限，但该任务具有重要研究价值。

title: CTCal: Rethinking Text-to-Image Diffusion Models via Cross-Timestep Self-Calibration
summary: Recent advancements in text-to-image synthesis have been largely propelled by diffusion-based models, yet achieving precise alignment between text prompts and generated images remains a persistent challenge. We find that this difficulty arises primarily from the limitations of conventional diffusion loss, which provides only implicit supervision for modeling fine-grained text-image correspondence. In this paper, we introduce Cross-Timestep Self-Calibration (CTCal), founded on the supporting observation that establishing accurate text-image alignment within diffusion models becomes progressively more difficult as the timestep increases. CTCal leverages the reliable text-image alignment (i.e., cross-attention maps) formed at smaller timesteps with less noise to calibrate the representation learning at larger timesteps with more noise, thereby providing explicit supervision during training. We further propose a timestep-aware adaptive weighting to achieve a harmonious integration of CTCal and diffusion loss. CTCal is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing text-to-image diffusion models, encompassing both diffusion-based (e.g., SD 2.1) and flow-based approaches (e.g., SD 3). Extensive experiments on T2I-Compbench++ and GenEval benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of the proposed CTCal. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiefan-guo/ctcal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CTCaL方法，利用扩散模型中较小时间步的可靠文本-图像对齐来校准较大时间步的表示学习，从而改善文本到图像生成的精确对齐问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于扩散模型的文本到图像合成在实现文本提示与生成图像的精确对齐方面仍面临挑战，主要原因是传统扩散损失仅提供隐式监督，难以建模细粒度的文本-图像对应关系。
AI.method: 提出跨时间步自校准（CTCaL）方法，利用较小时间步（噪声较少）形成的可靠文本-图像对齐（交叉注意力图）来校准较大时间步（噪声较多）的表示学习，提供明确的训练监督。同时提出时间步感知自适应加权，实现CTCaL与扩散损失的和谐集成。
AI.result: 在T2I-Compbench++和GenEval基准测试上的广泛实验证明了CTCaL的有效性和泛化能力。该方法与模型无关，可无缝集成到现有的文本到图像扩散模型中，包括基于扩散的方法（如SD 2.1）和基于流的方法（如SD 3）。
AI.conclusion: CTCaL通过利用扩散模型中较小时间步的可靠文本-图像对齐来校准较大时间步的学习，为文本到图像合成提供了有效的显式监督机制，显著改善了文本与生成图像的对齐精度。

title: AdaRubric: Task-Adaptive Rubrics for LLM Agent Evaluation
summary: LLM-as-Judge evaluation fails agent tasks because a fixed rubric cannot capture what matters for this task: code debugging demands Correctness and Error Handling; web navigation demands Goal Alignment and Action Efficiency. We present ADARUBRIC, which closes this gap by generating task-specific evaluation rubrics on the fly from task descriptions, scoring trajectories step-by-step with confidence-weighted per-dimension feedback, and filtering preference pairs with the novel DimensionAwareFilter - a provably necessary condition for preventing high-scoring dimensions from masking dimension-level failures. On WebArena and ToolBench, ADARUBRIC achieves Pearson r=0.79 human correlation (+0.16 over the best static baseline) with deployment-grade reliability (Krippendorff's $α$=0.83). DPO agents trained on ADARUBRIC preference pairs gain +6.8 to +8.5 pp task success over Prometheus across three benchmarks; gains transfer to SWE-bench code repair (+4.9 pp) and accelerate PPO convergence by +6.6 pp at 5K steps - both without any rubric engineering. Code: https://github.com/alphadl/AdaRubrics.

AI.tldr: ADARUBRIC是一个动态生成任务特定评估标准的系统，解决了LLM-as-Judge在智能体任务中因固定评估标准无法捕捉任务关键维度的问题，通过自动生成评估标准、分步评分和维度感知过滤，显著提升了评估质量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM-as-Judge评估方法在智能体任务中存在局限性，因为固定的评估标准无法适应不同任务的关键维度。例如，代码调试需要关注正确性和错误处理，而网页导航则需要目标对齐和行动效率。这种一刀切的评估方式无法准确评估智能体在不同任务中的表现。
AI.method: ADARUBRIC系统包含三个核心组件：1）根据任务描述动态生成任务特定的评估标准；2）对智能体轨迹进行分步评分，并提供置信度加权的各维度反馈；3）使用维度感知过滤器（DimensionAwareFilter）筛选偏好对，该过滤器能够防止高分维度掩盖维度级别的失败。
AI.result: 在WebArena和ToolBench基准测试中，ADARUBRIC达到Pearson相关系数r=0.79（比最佳静态基线提升0.16），部署级可靠性为Krippendorff's α=0.83。使用ADARUBRIC偏好对训练的DPO智能体在三个基准测试中比Prometheus提升了6.8-8.5个百分点的任务成功率，在SWE-bench代码修复任务中转移提升4.9个百分点，并在5K步内加速PPO收敛6.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ADARUBRIC通过动态生成任务特定评估标准解决了LLM-as-Judge在智能体任务评估中的根本问题，显著提升了评估质量、训练效率和任务表现，且无需人工设计评估标准，具有很好的泛化能力。

title: Context Selection for Hypothesis and Statistical Evidence Extraction from Full-Text Scientific Articles
summary: Extracting hypotheses and their supporting statistical evidence from full-text scientific articles is central to the synthesis of empirical findings, but remains difficult due to document length and the distribution of scientific arguments across sections of the paper. The work studies a sequential full-text extraction setting, where the statement of a primary finding in an article's abstract is linked to (i) a corresponding hypothesis statement in the paper body and (ii) the statistical evidence that supports or refutes that hypothesis. This formulation induces a challenging within-document retrieval setting in which many candidate paragraphs are topically related to the finding but differ in rhetorical role, creating hard negatives for retrieval and extraction. Using a two-stage retrieve-and-extract framework, we conduct a controlled study of retrieval design choices, varying context quantity, context quality (standard Retrieval Augmented Generation, reranking, and a fine-tuned retriever paired with reranking), as well as an oracle paragraph setting to separate retrieval failures from extraction limits across four Large Language Model extractors. We find that targeted context selection consistently improves hypothesis extraction relative to full-text prompting, with gains concentrated in configurations that optimize retrieval quality and context cleanliness. In contrast, statistical evidence extraction remains substantially harder. Even with oracle paragraphs, performance remains moderate, indicating persistent extractor limitations in handling hybrid numeric-textual statements rather than retrieval failures alone.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种从科学论文全文中提取假设及其统计证据的两阶段检索-提取框架，重点解决文档长度和科学论证分布带来的挑战。
AI.motivation: 从全文科学文章中提取假设及其支持的统计证据对于实证研究结果的综合至关重要，但由于文档长度和科学论证在论文各部分的分布，这一任务仍然困难。研究旨在解决摘要中的主要发现与正文中相应假设陈述及其统计证据之间的关联问题。
AI.method: 采用两阶段检索-提取框架：首先检索相关段落，然后提取假设和统计证据。研究设计了受控实验，比较不同检索策略：上下文数量、上下文质量（标准RAG、重排序、微调检索器+重排序）以及理想段落设置。使用四种大型语言模型提取器进行评估。
AI.result: 有针对性的上下文选择相对于全文提示持续改进了假设提取，增益集中在优化检索质量和上下文清洁度的配置中。相比之下，统计证据提取仍然困难得多，即使在理想段落设置下，性能也仅为中等水平，表明提取器在处理混合数字-文本陈述方面存在持续限制，而不仅仅是检索失败。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，通过优化检索质量和上下文选择可以显著改善假设提取，但统计证据提取仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务，需要改进提取器处理混合数字-文本陈述的能力，而不仅仅是优化检索策略。

title: A transformer architecture alteration to incentivise externalised reasoning
summary: We propose a new architectural change, and post-training pipeline, for making LLMs more verbose reasoners by teaching a model to truncate forward passes early. We augment an existing transformer architecture with an early-exit mechanism at intermediate layers and train the model to exit at shallower layers when the next token can be predicted without deep computation. After a calibration stage, we incentivise the model to exit as early as possible while maintaining task performance using reinforcement learning. We provide preliminary results to this effect for small reasoning models, showing that they learn to adaptively reduce computations across tokens. We predict that, applied at the right scale, our approach can minimise the amount of excess computation that reasoning models have at their disposal to perform non-myopic planning using their internal activations, reserving this only for difficult-to-predict tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过早期退出机制让LLM成为更简洁推理者的架构改进和后训练流程，使模型能在较浅层退出以减少计算量
AI.motivation: 减少推理模型中的冗余计算，让模型只在难以预测的token上使用深层计算，提高计算效率
AI.method: 在现有transformer架构中加入中间层的早期退出机制，通过强化学习训练模型在保持任务性能的前提下尽早退出
AI.result: 小型推理模型的初步结果显示，模型学会了在不同token上自适应地减少计算量
AI.conclusion: 该方法在适当规模下应用，可以最小化推理模型的冗余计算，只在困难token上保留深度计算能力用于非近视规划

title: Graph Fusion Across Languages using Large Language Models
summary: Combining multiple knowledge graphs (KGs) across linguistic boundaries is a persistent challenge due to semantic heterogeneity and the complexity of graph environments. We propose a framework for cross-lingual graph fusion, leveraging the in-context reasoning and multilingual semantic priors of Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework implements structural linearization by mapping triplets directly into natural language sequences (e.g., [head] [relation] [tail]), enabling the LLM to map relations and reconcile entities between an evolving fused graph ($G_{c}^{(t-1)}$) and a new candidate graph ($G_{t}$). Evaluated on the DBP15K dataset, this exploratory study demonstrates that LLMs can serve as a universal semantic bridge to resolve cross-lingual discrepancies. Results show the successful sequential agglomeration of multiple heterogeneous graphs, offering a scalable, modular solution for continuous knowledge synthesis in multi-source, multilingual environments.

AI.tldr: 提出基于大语言模型的跨语言知识图谱融合框架，通过结构线性化将三元组转换为自然语言序列，利用LLM的上下文推理和多语言语义先验解决语义异构问题，在DBP15K数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 跨语言知识图谱融合面临语义异构和图环境复杂性的挑战，传统方法难以有效处理多语言环境下的语义差异和关系映射问题。
AI.method: 提出跨语言图融合框架，将三元组结构线性化为自然语言序列（如[头实体][关系][尾实体]），利用大语言模型的上下文推理能力和多语言语义先验，在演化融合图与新候选图之间进行关系映射和实体对齐。
AI.result: 在DBP15K数据集上的实验表明，该框架能够成功实现多个异构图的顺序聚合，大语言模型可以作为通用语义桥梁有效解决跨语言差异问题。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了LLM作为通用语义桥梁的潜力，为多源多语言环境下的连续知识合成提供了可扩展、模块化的解决方案。

title: Memory-Efficient Fine-Tuning Diffusion Transformers via Dynamic Patch Sampling and Block Skipping
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have significantly enhanced text-to-image (T2I) generation quality, enabling high-quality personalized content creation. However, fine-tuning these models requires substantial computational complexity and memory, limiting practical deployment under resource constraints. To tackle these challenges, we propose a memory-efficient fine-tuning framework called DiT-BlockSkip, integrating timestep-aware dynamic patch sampling and block skipping by precomputing residual features. Our dynamic patch sampling strategy adjusts patch sizes based on the diffusion timestep, then resizes the cropped patches to a fixed lower resolution. This approach reduces forward & backward memory usage while allowing the model to capture global structures at higher timesteps and fine-grained details at lower timesteps. The block skipping mechanism selectively fine-tunes essential transformer blocks and precomputes residual features for the skipped blocks, significantly reducing training memory. To identify vital blocks for personalization, we introduce a block selection strategy based on cross-attention masking. Evaluations demonstrate that our approach achieves competitive personalization performance qualitatively and quantitatively, while reducing memory usage substantially, moving toward on-device feasibility (e.g., smartphones, IoT devices) for large-scale diffusion transformers.

AI.tldr: DiT-BlockSkip：一种用于扩散变换器的高效微调框架，通过动态补丁采样和块跳过机制，显著降低内存使用，实现资源受限环境下的个性化图像生成。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器（DiTs）在文本到图像生成方面表现出色，但微调过程需要大量计算资源和内存，限制了在资源受限设备（如智能手机、物联网设备）上的实际部署。
AI.method: 提出DiT-BlockSkip框架，包含两个核心技术：1）基于时间步的动态补丁采样策略，根据扩散时间步调整补丁大小并重采样到固定低分辨率；2）块跳过机制，选择性微调关键变换器块，并为跳过的块预计算残差特征，结合基于交叉注意力掩码的块选择策略。
AI.result: 方法在保持竞争性个性化性能的同时，显著降低了内存使用，使大规模扩散变换器在移动设备上部署成为可能。
AI.conclusion: DiT-BlockSkip为资源受限环境下的扩散变换器微调提供了高效解决方案，推动了大规模扩散模型在边缘设备上的实际应用。

title: PivotRL: High Accuracy Agentic Post-Training at Low Compute Cost
summary: Post-training for long-horizon agentic tasks has a tension between compute efficiency and generalization. While supervised fine-tuning (SFT) is compute efficient, it often suffers from out-of-domain (OOD) degradation. Conversely, end-to-end reinforcement learning (E2E RL) preserves OOD capabilities, but incurs high compute costs due to many turns of on-policy rollout. We introduce PivotRL, a novel framework that operates on existing SFT trajectories to combine the compute efficiency of SFT with the OOD accuracy of E2E RL. PivotRL relies on two key mechanisms: first, it executes local, on-policy rollouts and filters for pivots: informative intermediate turns where sampled actions exhibit high variance in outcomes; second, it utilizes rewards for functional-equivalent actions rather than demanding strict string matching with the SFT data demonstration. We theoretically show that these mechanisms incentivize strong learning signals with high natural gradient norm, while maximally preserving policy probability ordering on actions unrelated to training tasks. In comparison to standard SFT on identical data, we demonstrate that PivotRL achieves +4.17% higher in-domain accuracy on average across four agentic domains, and +10.04% higher OOD accuracy in non-agentic tasks. Notably, on agentic coding tasks, PivotRL achieves competitive accuracy with E2E RL with 4x fewer rollout turns. PivotRL is adopted by NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B, acting as the workhorse in production-scale agentic post-training.

AI.tldr: PivotRL是一种新型的强化学习框架，在SFT轨迹上操作，结合了SFT的计算效率和端到端RL的OOD泛化能力，通过局部策略展开和功能等价奖励机制实现高效训练。
AI.motivation: 解决长视野智能体任务中监督微调（SFT）计算效率高但泛化能力差，而端到端强化学习（E2E RL）泛化好但计算成本高的矛盾。
AI.method: 1. 在现有SFT轨迹上执行局部策略展开，筛选出关键转折点（pivots）——即采样动作结果方差高的信息丰富中间步骤；2. 使用功能等价动作的奖励机制，而非要求与SFT演示数据的严格字符串匹配。
AI.result: 1. 在四个智能体领域平均获得+4.17%的域内准确率提升；2. 在非智能体任务中获得+10.04%的OOD准确率提升；3. 在智能体编码任务中，用比E2E RL少4倍的展开步骤达到竞争性准确率。
AI.conclusion: PivotRL成功平衡了计算效率与泛化能力，已被NVIDIA的Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B采用，成为生产规模智能体后训练的核心方法。

title: Conversation Tree Architecture: A Structured Framework for Context-Aware Multi-Branch LLM Conversations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed for extended, multi-topic conversations, yet the flat, append-only structure of current conversation interfaces introduces a fundamental limitation: all context accumulates in a single unbounded window, causing topically distinct threads to bleed into one another and progressively degrade response quality. We term this failure mode logical context poisoning. In this paper, we introduce the Conversation Tree Architecture (CTA), a hierarchical framework that organizes LLM conversations as trees of discrete, context-isolated nodes. Each node maintains its own local context window; structured mechanisms govern how context flows between parent and child nodes, downstream on branch creation and upstream on branch deletion. We additionally introduce volatile nodes, transient branches whose local context must be selectively merged upward or permanently discarded before purging. We formalize the architecture's primitives, characterize the open design problems in context flow, relate our framework to prior work in LLM memory management, and describe a working prototype implementation. The CTA provides a principled foundation for structured conversational context management and extends naturally to multi-agent settings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出对话树架构（CTA），通过树状结构组织LLM对话，解决传统扁平对话结构中上下文污染问题，实现主题隔离的上下文管理。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM对话采用扁平、仅追加的单一上下文窗口结构，导致不同主题的对话内容相互污染，造成"逻辑上下文中毒"问题，随着对话延长响应质量逐渐下降。
AI.method: 引入对话树架构（CTA），将对话组织为离散、上下文隔离的节点树。每个节点维护独立的本地上下文窗口，通过结构化机制控制父子节点间的上下文流动：分支创建时向下游流动，分支删除时向上游流动。还引入了易失节点来处理需要选择性合并或丢弃的临时分支。
AI.result: 提出了CTA的原始形式化定义，描述了上下文流动的开放设计问题，将框架与现有LLM内存管理工作联系起来，并实现了一个工作原型。
AI.conclusion: CTA为结构化对话上下文管理提供了原则性基础，可自然扩展到多智能体设置，解决了LLM长对话中的上下文污染问题。

title: PiLoT: Neural Pixel-to-3D Registration for UAV-based Ego and Target Geo-localization
summary: We present PiLoT, a unified framework that tackles UAV-based ego and target geo-localization. Conventional approaches rely on decoupled pipelines that fuse GNSS and Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) for ego-pose estimation, and active sensors like laser rangefinders for target localization. However, these methods are susceptible to failure in GNSS-denied environments and incur substantial hardware costs and complexity. PiLoT breaks this paradigm by directly registering live video stream against a geo-referenced 3D map. To achieve robust, accurate, and real-time performance, we introduce three key contributions: 1) a Dual-Thread Engine that decouples map rendering from core localization thread, ensuring both low latency while maintaining drift-free accuracy; 2) a large-scale synthetic dataset with precise geometric annotations (camera pose, depth maps). This dataset enables the training of a lightweight network that generalizes in a zero-shot manner from simulation to real data; and 3) a Joint Neural-Guided Stochastic-Gradient Optimizer (JNGO) that achieves robust convergence even under aggressive motion. Evaluations on a comprehensive set of public and newly collected benchmarks show that PiLoT outperforms state-of-the-art methods while running over 25 FPS on NVIDIA Jetson Orin platform. Our code and dataset is available at: https://github.com/Choyaa/PiLoT.

AI.tldr: PiLoT是一个统一的无人机定位框架，通过将实时视频流与地理参考3D地图直接配准，解决了GNSS拒绝环境下的自我定位和目标定位问题，实现了超过25FPS的实时性能。
AI.motivation: 传统无人机定位方法依赖GNSS和VIO的分离管道进行自我姿态估计，并使用激光测距仪等主动传感器进行目标定位。这些方法在GNSS拒绝环境中容易失效，且硬件成本高、复杂度大。需要一种更鲁棒、低成本、能在GNSS拒绝环境下工作的统一解决方案。
AI.method: 1) 双线程引擎：将地图渲染与核心定位线程解耦，确保低延迟和无漂移精度；2) 大规模合成数据集：提供精确的几何标注（相机姿态、深度图），用于训练轻量级网络，实现从仿真到真实数据的零样本泛化；3) 联合神经引导随机梯度优化器(JNGO)：即使在剧烈运动下也能实现鲁棒收敛。
AI.result: 在公共和新收集的基准测试上，PiLoT优于现有最先进方法，同时在NVIDIA Jetson Orin平台上运行速度超过25FPS。
AI.conclusion: PiLoT通过直接视频流与3D地图配准的统一框架，解决了传统方法在GNSS拒绝环境中的局限性，实现了鲁棒、准确、实时的无人机自我和目标定位，硬件成本更低。

title: Persona Vectors in Games: Measuring and Steering Strategies via Activation Vectors
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous decision-makers in strategic settings, yet we have limited tools for understanding their high-level behavioral traits. We use activation steering methods in game-theoretic settings, constructing persona vectors for altruism, forgiveness, and expectations of others by contrastive activation addition. Evaluating on canonical games, we find that activation steering systematically shifts both quantitative strategic choices and natural-language justifications. However, we also observe that rhetoric and strategy can diverge under steering. In addition, vectors for self-behavior and expectations of others are partially distinct. Our results suggest that persona vectors offer a promising mechanistic handle on high-level traits in strategic environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用激活导向方法在博弈论环境中构建人格向量，通过对比激活加法创建利他主义、宽恕和他人期望的人格特征，发现激活导向能系统性地改变战略选择和语言解释，但言辞与策略可能存在分歧。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署为战略环境中的自主决策者，但我们缺乏理解其高级行为特征的工具。研究旨在开发理解LLMs在战略环境中高级行为特征的方法。
AI.method: 使用激活导向方法在博弈论环境中构建人格向量，通过对比激活加法创建利他主义、宽恕和他人期望的人格特征，并在经典博弈游戏中评估这些向量对模型行为的影响。
AI.result: 激活导向能系统性地改变战略选择和语言解释，但言辞与策略可能存在分歧。自我行为向量和他人期望向量部分独立，表明这些特征在模型内部有不同表征。
AI.conclusion: 人格向量为理解战略环境中高级行为特征提供了有前景的机制性工具，但需要进一步研究言辞与策略之间的差异以及不同人格特征之间的独立性。

title: MEMO: Human-like Crisp Edge Detection Using Masked Edge Prediction
summary: Learning-based edge detection models trained with cross-entropy loss often suffer from thick edge predictions, which deviate from the crisp, single-pixel annotations typically provided by humans. While previous approaches to achieving crisp edges have focused on designing specialized loss functions or modifying network architectures, we show that a carefully designed training and inference strategy alone is sufficient to achieve human-like edge quality. In this work, we introduce the Masked Edge Prediction MOdel (MEMO), which produces both accurate and crisp edges using only cross-entropy loss. We first construct a large-scale synthetic edge dataset to pre-train MEMO, enhancing its generalization ability. Subsequent fine-tuning on downstream datasets requires only a lightweight module comprising 1.2\% additional parameters. During training, MEMO learns to predict edges under varying ratios of input masking. A key insight guiding our inference is that thick edge predictions typically exhibit a confidence gradient: high in the center and lower toward the boundaries. Leveraging this, we propose a novel progressive prediction strategy that sequentially finalizes edge predictions in order of prediction confidence, resulting in thinner and more precise contours. Our method achieves visually appealing, post-processing-free, human-like edge maps and outperforms prior methods on crispness-aware evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出MEMO模型，通过创新的训练和推理策略实现单像素级清晰边缘检测，无需特殊损失函数或架构修改
AI.motivation: 基于交叉熵损失的边缘检测模型通常产生过厚的边缘预测，与人类标注的单像素级清晰边缘不符。现有方法多依赖特殊损失函数或网络架构修改，而本文探索仅通过训练和推理策略实现人类级边缘质量
AI.method: 1) 构建大规模合成边缘数据集预训练MEMO模型；2) 训练时学习在不同输入掩蔽比例下预测边缘；3) 推理时利用厚边缘预测中的置信度梯度特性，提出渐进预测策略，按置信度顺序逐步确定边缘预测
AI.result: MEMO在清晰度感知评估中优于先前方法，产生视觉吸引人、无需后处理、人类级别的边缘图，仅需1.2%额外参数进行下游微调
AI.conclusion: 通过精心设计的训练和推理策略，仅使用交叉熵损失即可实现准确且清晰的边缘检测，无需依赖特殊损失函数或网络架构修改

title: The Myhill-Nerode Theorem for Bounded Interaction: Canonical Abstractions via Agent-Bounded Indistinguishability
summary: Any capacity-limited observer induces a canonical quotient on its environment: two situations that no bounded agent can distinguish are, for that agent, the same. We formalise this for finite POMDPs. A fixed probe family of finite-state controllers induces a closed-loop Wasserstein pseudometric on observation histories and a probe-exact quotient merging histories that no controller in the family can distinguish. The quotient is canonical, minimal, and unique-a bounded-interaction analogue of the Myhill-Nerode theorem. For clock-aware probes, it is exactly decision-sufficient for objectives that depend only on the agent's observations and actions; for latent-state rewards, we use an observation-Lipschitz approximation bound. The main theorem object is the clock-aware quotient; scalable deterministic-stationary experiments study a tractable coarsening with gap measured on small exact cases and explored empirically at larger scale. We validate theorem-level claims on Tiger and GridWorld. We also report operational case studies on Tiger, GridWorld, and RockSample as exploratory diagnostics of approximation behavior and runtime, not as theorem-facing evidence when no exact cross-family certificate is available; heavier stress tests are archived in the appendix and artifact package.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于有限状态控制器族的POMDP环境商空间构建方法，通过合并有界智能体无法区分的观测历史，形成规范的最小商空间，类似于Myhill-Nerode定理的有界交互版本。
AI.motivation: 任何容量有限的观测者都会在其环境中诱导出一个规范商空间：两个有界智能体无法区分的情况对该智能体而言是相同的。本文旨在为有限POMDP形式化这一概念，为有界交互提供理论框架。
AI.method: 使用固定探针族（有限状态控制器）在观测历史上诱导闭环Wasserstein伪度量，构建探针精确商空间合并控制器族无法区分的观测历史。对于时钟感知探针，该商空间对仅依赖于观测和行动的目标是决策充分的；对于潜在状态奖励，使用观测-Lipschitz近似边界。
AI.result: 构建的商空间是规范的、最小的且唯一的，是有界交互的Myhill-Nerode定理类比。通过确定性平稳实验验证了定理级声明在Tiger和GridWorld上的有效性，并在Tiger、GridWorld和RockSample上进行了操作案例研究。
AI.conclusion: 提出的时钟感知商空间为有限POMDP中的有界交互提供了理论基础，通过合并无法区分的观测历史构建最小商空间，为近似行为提供了可扩展的分析框架，并在多个基准问题上验证了理论主张。

title: enhancing reasoning accuracy in large language models during inference time
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) often exhibit strong linguistic abilities while remaining unreliable on multi-step reasoning tasks, particularly when deployed without additional training or fine-tuning. In this work, we study inference-time techniques to improve the reasoning accuracy of LLMs. We systematically evaluate three classes of inference-time strategies: (i) self-consistency via stochastic decoding, where the model is sampled multiple times using controlled temperature and nucleus sampling and the most frequent final answer is selected; (ii) dual-model reasoning agreement, where outputs from two independent models are compared and only consistent reasoning traces are trusted; and (iii) self-reflection, where the model critiques and revises its own reasoning. Across all evaluated methods, we employ Chain-of-Thought (CoT) [1] prompting to elicit explicit intermediate reasoning steps before generating final answers. In this work, we provide a controlled comparative evaluation across three inference-time strategies under identical prompting and verification settings. Our experiments on LLM [2] show that self-consistency with nucleus sampling and controlled temperature value yields the substantial gains, achieving a 9% to 15% absolute improvement in accuracy over greedy single-pass decoding, well-suited for low-risk domains, offering meaningful gains with minimal overhead. The dual-model approach provides additional confirmation for model reasoning steps thus more appropriate for moderate-risk domains, where higher reliability justifies additional compute. Self-reflection offers only marginal improvements, suggesting limited effectiveness for smaller non-reasoning models at inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了三种推理时策略提升大语言模型推理准确性的效果：自一致性采样、双模型一致性验证和自反思。实验表明自一致性采样效果最佳，双模型验证适合中等风险场景，自反思效果有限。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然具备较强的语言能力，但在多步推理任务上表现不稳定，特别是在不进行额外训练或微调的情况下。本研究旨在探索推理时技术来提升LLMs的推理准确性。
AI.method: 系统评估三种推理时策略：(1) 自一致性采样：通过控制温度和核采样多次采样模型，选择最频繁的最终答案；(2) 双模型一致性验证：比较两个独立模型的输出，只信任一致的推理轨迹；(3) 自反思：模型批判和修订自己的推理。所有方法都使用思维链提示来引出显式的中间推理步骤。
AI.result: 自一致性采样结合核采样和受控温度值效果最佳，相比贪婪单次解码实现了9%到15%的绝对准确率提升，适合低风险领域；双模型方法为模型推理步骤提供额外确认，更适合中等风险领域；自反思仅带来边际改进，对较小的非推理模型在推理时效果有限。
AI.conclusion: 自一致性采样是提升LLM推理准确性的有效推理时策略，在计算开销最小的情况下提供显著收益；双模型验证在需要更高可靠性的场景中有价值；自反思在当前设置下效果有限，可能更适合更大的推理专用模型。

title: ME-IQA: Memory-Enhanced Image Quality Assessment via Re-Ranking
summary: Reasoning-induced vision-language models (VLMs) advance image quality assessment (IQA) with textual reasoning, yet their scalar scores often lack sensitivity and collapse to a few values, so-called discrete collapse. We introduce ME-IQA, a plug-and-play, test-time memory-enhanced re-ranking framework. It (i) builds a memory bank and retrieves semantically and perceptually aligned neighbors using reasoning summaries, (ii) reframes the VLM as a probabilistic comparator to obtain pairwise preference probabilities and fuse this ordinal evidence with the initial score under Thurstone's Case V model, and (iii) performs gated reflection and consolidates memory to improve future decisions. This yields denser, distortion-sensitive predictions and mitigates discrete collapse. Experiments across multiple IQA benchmarks show consistent gains over strong reasoning-induced VLM baselines, existing non-reasoning IQA methods, and test-time scaling alternatives.

AI.tldr: ME-IQA：一个即插即用的测试时记忆增强重排序框架，通过构建记忆库、将VLM重构为概率比较器，并使用Thurstone模型融合排序证据，解决VLM在图像质量评估中的离散崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 推理诱导的视觉语言模型（VLMs）通过文本推理推进了图像质量评估（IQA），但其标量评分通常缺乏敏感性，并会坍缩到少数几个值（即离散崩溃问题）。
AI.method: 1. 构建记忆库并使用推理摘要检索语义和感知对齐的邻居；2. 将VLM重构为概率比较器，获取成对偏好概率，并在Thurstone Case V模型下融合排序证据与初始评分；3. 执行门控反射并巩固记忆以改进未来决策。
AI.result: 在多个IQA基准测试中，ME-IQA相比强大的推理诱导VLM基线、现有非推理IQA方法以及测试时缩放替代方案，均显示出一致的性能提升，产生更密集、对失真更敏感的预测，并缓解了离散崩溃问题。
AI.conclusion: ME-IQA框架有效解决了VLM在图像质量评估中的离散崩溃问题，通过记忆增强和概率比较机制显著提升了评分敏感性和预测质量。

title: Silent Commitment Failure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models: Evidence of Governability Divergence Across Architectures
comment: 39 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Preprint. Submitted to NIST CAISI (Docket NIST-2025-0035, March 2026). Also available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.18971110
summary: As large language models are deployed as autonomous agents with tool execution privileges, a critical assumption underpins their security architecture: that model errors are detectable at runtime. We present empirical evidence that this assumption fails for two of three instruction-following models evaluable for conflict detection. We introduce governability -- the degree to which a model's errors are detectable before output commitment and correctable once detected -- and demonstrate it varies dramatically across models. In six models across twelve reasoning domains, two of three instruction-following models exhibited silent commitment failure: confident, fluent, incorrect output with zero warning signal. The remaining model produced a detectable conflict signal 57 tokens before commitment under greedy decoding. We show benchmark accuracy does not predict governability, correction capacity varies independently of detection, and identical governance scaffolds produce opposite effects across models. A 2x2 experiment shows a 52x difference in spike ratio between architectures but only +/-0.32x variation from fine-tuning, suggesting governability is fixed at pretraining. We propose a Detection and Correction Matrix classifying model-task combinations into four regimes: Governable, Monitor Only, Steer Blind, and Ungovernable.

AI.tldr: 研究发现大语言模型作为自主代理时存在"静默承诺失败"问题，即模型会自信地输出错误结果而不发出警告，且模型的可治理性在预训练阶段就已固定。
AI.motivation: 当前大语言模型安全架构基于一个关键假设：模型错误在运行时是可检测的。本文旨在验证这一假设是否成立，并研究模型的可治理性差异。
AI.method: 在6个模型、12个推理领域进行实验，评估指令跟随模型的冲突检测能力。引入"可治理性"概念，通过检测与纠正两个维度分析模型行为。进行2x2实验比较架构差异和微调影响。
AI.result: 2/3的指令跟随模型表现出静默承诺失败（自信流畅的错误输出无警告），剩余模型在贪婪解码下能在承诺前57个token发出可检测冲突信号。基准准确率无法预测可治理性，架构差异导致52倍峰值比率变化，而微调仅产生±0.32倍变化。
AI.conclusion: 模型的可治理性在预训练阶段就已固定，不同模型-任务组合可分为四种治理机制：可治理、仅监控、盲目引导和不可治理。当前安全架构假设存在缺陷，需要新的治理框架。

title: Does Peer Observation Help? Vision-Sharing Collaboration for Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) systems are fundamentally constrained by partial observability, as an agent can only accumulate knowledge from locations it has personally visited. As multiple robots increasingly coexist in shared environments, a natural question arises: can agents navigating the same space benefit from each other's observations? In this work, we introduce Co-VLN, a minimalist, model-agnostic framework for systematically investigating whether and how peer observations from concurrently navigating agents can benefit VLN. When independently navigating agents identify common traversed locations, they exchange structured perceptual memory, effectively expanding each agent's receptive field at no additional exploration cost. We validate our framework on the R2R benchmark under two representative paradigms (the learning-based DUET and the zero-shot MapGPT), and conduct extensive analytical experiments to systematically reveal the underlying dynamics of peer observation sharing in VLN. Results demonstrate that vision-sharing enabled model yields substantial performance improvements across both paradigms, establishing a strong foundation for future research in collaborative embodied navigation.

AI.tldr: Co-VLN框架让多个机器人在共享环境中导航时，可以交换彼此访问过的位置信息，从而在不增加探索成本的情况下扩展每个机器人的感知范围，显著提升导航性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言导航系统受限于部分可观测性，每个智能体只能积累自己访问过的位置信息。随着多个机器人在共享环境中共存，研究它们是否能通过共享彼此的观察来相互受益。
AI.method: 提出Co-VLN框架，当独立导航的智能体识别出共同遍历的位置时，交换结构化的感知记忆。该框架与模型无关，在R2R基准上验证了两种代表性范式：基于学习的DUET和零样本的MapGPT。
AI.result: 视觉共享使模型在两种范式下都获得了显著的性能提升，为协作式具身导航的未来研究奠定了坚实基础。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性地研究同行观察共享在VLN中的底层动态，证明了智能体间共享观察可以显著提升导航性能，为多智能体协作导航提供了有效框架。

title: Beyond Memorization: Distinguishing between Reductive and Epistemic Reasoning in LLMs using Classic Logic Puzzles
summary: Epistemic reasoning requires agents to infer the state of the world from partial observations and information about other agents' knowledge. Prior work evaluating LLMs on canonical epistemic puzzles interpreted their behavior through a dichotomy between epistemic reasoning and brittle memorization. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in recent models, memorization is better understood as a special case of reduction, where a new instance is mapped onto a known problem. Instead, we introduce a reduction ladder, a sequence of modifications that progressively move instances away from a canonical epistemic puzzle, making reduction increasingly difficult while preserving the underlying logic. We find that while some large models succeed via reduction, other models fail early, and all models struggle once epistemic reasoning is required.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"还原阶梯"框架，挑战LLMs在认知推理问题上的表现，认为传统二分法（认知推理vs机械记忆）不完整，指出记忆是还原的特殊情况，并展示模型在远离典型问题时表现下降
AI.motivation: 传统评估LLMs在认知推理谜题上的表现时，采用认知推理与机械记忆的二分法框架，但这种框架不完整。需要更细致地理解模型如何通过还原（将新实例映射到已知问题）来处理认知推理任务。
AI.method: 引入"还原阶梯"方法：创建一系列逐步修改的实例，这些实例逐渐远离典型的认知推理谜题，使还原变得越来越困难，同时保持底层逻辑不变。通过这个阶梯评估不同模型的表现。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）一些大型模型通过还原成功处理问题；2）其他模型在早期就失败；3）所有模型在真正需要认知推理时都表现困难。表明模型主要依赖还原而非真正的认知推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 记忆应被视为还原的特殊情况，而非与认知推理对立的机制。还原阶梯揭示了模型处理认知推理问题的局限性，即使大型模型也主要依赖还原而非真正的认知推理能力。

title: DomAgent: Leveraging Knowledge Graphs and Case-Based Reasoning for Domain-Specific Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown impressive capabilities in code generation. However, because most LLMs are trained on public domain corpora, directly applying them to real-world software development often yields low success rates, as these scenarios frequently require domain-specific knowledge. In particular, domain-specific tasks usually demand highly specialized solutions, which are often underrepresented or entirely absent in the training data of generic LLMs. To address this challenge, we propose DomAgent, an autonomous coding agent that bridges this gap by enabling LLMs to generate domain-adapted code through structured reasoning and targeted retrieval. A core component of DomAgent is DomRetriever, a novel retrieval module that emulates how humans learn domain-specific knowledge, by combining conceptual understanding with experiential examples. It dynamically integrates top-down knowledge-graph reasoning with bottom-up case-based reasoning, enabling iterative retrieval and synthesis of structured knowledge and representative cases to ensure contextual relevance and broad task coverage. DomRetriever can operate as part of DomAgent or independently with any LLM for flexible domain adaptation. We evaluate DomAgent on an open benchmark dataset in the data science domain (DS-1000) and further apply it to real-world truck software development tasks. Experimental results show that DomAgent significantly enhances domain-specific code generation, enabling small open-source models to close much of the performance gap with large proprietary LLMs in complex, real-world applications. The code is available at: https://github.com/Wangshuaiia/DomAgent.

AI.tldr: DomAgent是一个自主编码代理，通过结构化推理和针对性检索，帮助LLM生成领域适应的代码，解决通用LLM在特定领域代码生成成功率低的问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在代码生成方面表现出色，但由于主要基于公开领域语料训练，在需要领域特定知识的真实软件开发场景中成功率较低。领域特定任务通常需要高度专业化的解决方案，而这些在通用LLM的训练数据中往往不足或缺失。
AI.method: 提出DomAgent自主编码代理，核心组件是DomRetriever检索模块。该模块模拟人类学习领域知识的方式，结合概念理解与经验示例，动态集成自上而下的知识图谱推理和自下而上的案例推理，实现迭代检索和结构化知识与代表性案例的合成。
AI.result: 在数据科学领域基准数据集(DS-1000)和真实卡车软件开发任务上的实验表明，DomAgent显著提升了领域特定代码生成能力，使小型开源模型在复杂实际应用中能够大幅缩小与大型专有LLM的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: DomAgent通过结构化推理和针对性检索有效解决了LLM在领域特定代码生成中的局限性，为领域适应提供了灵活解决方案，既可作为DomAgent的一部分运行，也可与任何LLM独立配合使用。

title: Benchmarking Bengali Dialectal Bias: A Multi-Stage Framework Integrating RAG-Based Translation and Human-Augmented RLAIF
summary: Large language models (LLMs) frequently exhibit performance biases against regional dialects of low-resource languages. However, frameworks to quantify these disparities remain scarce. We propose a two-phase framework to evaluate dialectal bias in LLM question-answering across nine Bengali dialects. First, we translate and gold-label standard Bengali questions into dialectal variants adopting a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline to prepare 4,000 question sets. Since traditional translation quality evaluation metrics fail on unstandardized dialects, we evaluate fidelity using an LLM-as-a-judge, which human correlation confirms outperforms legacy metrics. Second, we benchmark 19 LLMs across these gold-labeled sets, running 68,395 RLAIF evaluations validated through multi-judge agreement and human fallback. Our findings reveal severe performance drops linked to linguistic divergence. For instance, responses to the highly divergent Chittagong dialect score 5.44/10, compared to 7.68/10 for Tangail. Furthermore, increased model scale does not consistently mitigate this bias. We contribute a validated translation quality evaluation method, a rigorous benchmark dataset, and a Critical Bias Sensitivity (CBS) metric for safety-critical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段框架评估LLM在孟加拉语九种方言上的问答性能偏见，发现方言差异导致严重性能下降，模型规模扩大不能持续缓解这种偏见。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在低资源语言区域方言上经常表现出性能偏见，但目前缺乏量化这些差异的框架。需要系统评估LLM在不同方言上的表现差异。
AI.method: 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段将标准孟加拉语问题翻译成九种方言变体，使用RAG管道准备4000个问题集，用LLM作为评判者评估翻译保真度；第二阶段在19个LLM上对这些黄金标注集进行基准测试，进行68,395个RLAIF评估，通过多评判者协议和人工回退验证。
AI.result: 发现严重的性能下降与语言差异相关：高度差异的吉大港方言得分5.44/10，而坦盖尔方言得7.68/10。模型规模增加不能持续缓解这种偏见。提出了翻译质量评估方法、基准数据集和关键偏见敏感性指标。
AI.conclusion: LLM在方言上存在显著性能偏见，方言差异越大性能下降越严重。需要专门的方法来评估和缓解方言偏见，特别是在安全关键应用中。

title: Predictive Regularization Against Visual Representation Degradation in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: While Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel at vision-language tasks, the cost of their language-driven training on internal visual foundational competence remains unclear. In this paper, we conduct a detailed diagnostic analysis to unveil a pervasive issue: visual representation degradation in MLLMs. Specifically, we find that compared to the initial visual features, the visual representation in the middle layers of LLM exhibits both a degradation in global function and patch structure. We attribute this phenomenon to a visual sacrifice driven by the singular text-generation objective, where the model compromises its visual fidelity to optimize for answer generation. We argue that a robust MLLM requires both strong cross-modal reasoning and core visual competence, and propose Predictive Regularization (PRe) to force degraded intermediate features to predict initial visual features, thereby maintaining the inherent visual attributes of the MLLM's internal representations. Extensive experiments confirm that mitigating this visual degradation effectively boosts vision-language performance, underscoring the critical importance of fostering robust internal visual representations within MLLMs for comprehensive multimodal understanding.

AI.tldr: MLLMs在视觉语言任务中表现出色，但其语言驱动的训练对内部视觉基础能力的影响尚不明确。研究发现MLLMs存在视觉表征退化问题，并提出预测正则化方法来缓解这一问题。
AI.motivation: 虽然多模态大语言模型在视觉语言任务上表现优异，但其语言驱动的训练过程是否损害了模型内部的视觉基础能力仍不清楚。作者希望诊断MLLMs是否存在视觉表征退化问题，并探索如何保持模型的视觉能力。
AI.method: 通过详细诊断分析揭示MLLMs中的视觉表征退化现象，并提出预测正则化方法。该方法强制退化的中间特征预测初始视觉特征，从而保持MLLM内部表征的固有视觉属性。
AI.result: 研究发现MLLMs确实存在普遍的视觉表征退化问题，中间层的视觉表征在全局功能和补丁结构上都出现退化。实验证实缓解这种视觉退化能有效提升视觉语言性能。
AI.conclusion: 强大的MLLM需要同时具备强大的跨模态推理能力和核心视觉能力。视觉表征退化是由单一文本生成目标驱动的视觉牺牲导致的，通过预测正则化保持内部视觉表征的完整性对于全面的多模态理解至关重要。

title: Behavioural feasible set: Value alignment constraints on AI decision support
summary: When organisations adopt commercial AI systems for decision support, they inherit value judgements embedded by vendors that are neither transparent nor renegotiable. The governance puzzle is not whether AI can support decisions but which recommendations the system can actually produce given how its vendor has configured it. I formalise this as a behavioural feasible set, the range of recommendations reachable under vendor-imposed alignment constraints, and characterise diagnostic thresholds for when organisational requirements exceed the system's flexibility. In scenario-based experiments using binary decision scenarios and multi-stakeholder ranking tasks, I show that alignment materially compresses this set. Comparing pre- and post-alignment variants of an open-weight model isolates the mechanism: alignment makes the system substantially less able to shift its recommendation even under legitimate contextual pressure. Leading commercial models exhibit comparable or greater rigidity. In multi-stakeholder tasks, alignment shifts implied stakeholder priorities rather than neutralising them, meaning organisations adopt embedded value orientations set upstream by the vendor. Organisations thus face a governance problem that better prompting cannot resolve: selecting a vendor partially determines which trade-offs remain negotiable and which stakeholder priorities are structurally embedded.

AI.tldr: 商业AI系统的价值判断由供应商预先配置且不可协商，组织采用时会继承这些隐含的价值取向，形成行为可行集压缩问题。
AI.motivation: 组织采用商业AI决策支持系统时，会继承供应商预先配置且不透明的价值判断，这些价值取向既不可见也不可重新协商，导致组织面临治理困境。
AI.method: 提出行为可行集概念，即供应商施加的对齐约束下系统可达到的推荐范围；通过场景实验（二元决策和多利益相关者排序任务）比较对齐前后模型的灵活性；使用开源权重模型进行机制隔离分析。
AI.result: 对齐显著压缩了行为可行集，使系统在合法情境压力下调整推荐的能力大幅降低；主流商业模型表现出相当或更大的刚性；在多利益相关者任务中，对齐会转移而非消除隐含的利益相关者优先级。
AI.conclusion: 组织面临无法通过优化提示解决的治理问题：选择供应商部分决定了哪些权衡可协商，哪些利益相关者优先级被结构性地嵌入系统，组织会继承供应商预先设定的价值取向。

title: Conspiracy Frame: a Semiotically-Driven Approach for Conspiracy Theories Detection
summary: Conspiracy theories are anti-authoritarian narratives that lead to social conflict, impacting how people perceive political information. To help in understanding this issue, we introduce the Conspiracy Frame: a fine-grained semantic representation of conspiratorial narratives derived from frame-semantics and semiotics, which spawned the Conspiracy Frames (Con.Fra.) dataset: a corpus of Telegram messages annotated at span-level. The Conspiracy Frame and Con.Fra. dataset contribute to the implementation of a more generalizable understanding and recognition of conspiracy theories. We observe the ability of LLMs to recognize this phenomenon in-domain and out-of-domain, investigating the role that frames may have in supporting this task. Results show that, while the injection of frames in an in-context approach does not lead to clear increase of performance, it has potential; the mapping of annotated spans with FrameNet shows abstract semantic patterns (e.g., `Kinship', `Ingest\_substance') that potentially pave the way for a more semantically- and semiotically-aware detection of conspiratorial narratives.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了"阴谋论框架"这一细粒度语义表示方法，并创建了Con.Fra.数据集，用于分析和检测阴谋论叙事。研究探索了LLMs在识别阴谋论方面的能力，发现框架注入方法虽未显著提升性能但具有潜力。
AI.motivation: 阴谋论作为反权威叙事会导致社会冲突，影响人们对政治信息的认知。为了帮助理解这一问题，需要开发能够更普遍理解和识别阴谋论的方法。
AI.method: 基于框架语义学和符号学提出了"阴谋论框架"这一细粒度语义表示方法，创建了Con.Fra.数据集（Telegram消息的跨度级标注语料库）。研究探索了LLMs在领域内和跨领域识别阴谋论的能力，并调查了框架在支持这一任务中的作用。
AI.result: 结果显示，虽然上下文方法中注入框架并未带来明显的性能提升，但具有潜力。通过FrameNet映射标注跨度发现了抽象的语义模式（如"亲属关系"、"摄入物质"），这可能为更语义和符号学感知的阴谋论叙事检测铺平道路。
AI.conclusion: 阴谋论框架和Con.Fra.数据集有助于实现更普遍化的阴谋论理解和识别。框架方法虽然当前效果有限，但为基于语义和符号学特征的阴谋论检测提供了新的研究方向。

title: Safety as Computation: Certified Answer Reuse via Capability Closure in Task-Oriented Dialogue
summary: We introduce a new paradigm for task-oriented dialogue systems: safety certification as a computational primitive for answer reuse. Current systems treat each turn independently, recomputing answers via retrieval or generation even when they are already derivable from prior state. We show that in capability-based systems, the safety certification step computes a fixed-point closure cl(At) that already contains every answer reachable from the current configuration. We operationalize this insight with a Certified Answer Store (CAS) augmented by Pre-Answer Blocks (PAB): at each certified turn, the system materializes all derivable follow-up answers together with minimal provenance witnesses. Subsequent queries are answered in sub-millisecond time via formal containment checks, eliminating redundant retrieval and generation.

AI.tldr: 提出任务导向对话系统新范式：将安全认证作为答案重用的计算原语，通过认证答案存储和预答案块实现子毫秒级响应
AI.motivation: 现有系统将每个对话轮次独立处理，即使答案已可从先前状态推导出，仍通过检索或生成重新计算答案，导致效率低下
AI.method: 基于能力系统，利用安全认证步骤计算固定点闭包cl(At)，包含当前配置下所有可达答案；实现认证答案存储(CAS)和预答案块(PAB)，在每个认证轮次物化所有可推导的后续答案及其最小溯源见证
AI.result: 后续查询通过形式包含检查在亚毫秒时间内回答，消除冗余检索和生成，显著提升系统效率
AI.conclusion: 安全认证可作为任务导向对话系统中答案重用的有效计算原语，通过认证答案存储机制实现高效响应

title: Task-Specific Efficiency Analysis: When Small Language Models Outperform Large Language Models
comment: Accepted for publication at ESANN 2025. This is a task-specific efficiency analysis comparing small language models
summary: Large Language Models achieve remarkable performance but incur substantial computational costs unsuitable for resource-constrained deployments. This paper presents the first comprehensive task-specific efficiency analysis comparing 16 language models across five diverse NLP tasks. We introduce the Performance-Efficiency Ratio (PER), a novel metric integrating accuracy, throughput, memory, and latency through geometric mean normalization. Our systematic evaluation reveals that small models (0.5--3B parameters) achieve superior PER scores across all given tasks. These findings establish quantitative foundations for deploying small models in production environments prioritizing inference efficiency over marginal accuracy gains.

AI.tldr: 本文首次对16个语言模型在5个NLP任务上进行全面的任务特定效率分析，提出PER指标，发现小模型（0.5-3B参数）在所有任务中表现最优
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然性能优异但计算成本高昂，不适合资源受限的部署环境，需要建立量化的效率评估框架
AI.method: 引入性能效率比（PER）指标，通过几何平均归一化整合准确率、吞吐量、内存和延迟；对16个语言模型在5个多样化NLP任务上进行系统评估
AI.result: 小模型（0.5-3B参数）在所有任务中获得了最优的PER分数，表明在推理效率优先的生产环境中，小模型具有更好的综合表现
AI.conclusion: 为在生产环境中部署小模型提供了量化基础，当推理效率比边际准确率提升更重要时，小模型是更优选择

title: PlanaReLoc: Camera Relocalization in 3D Planar Primitives via Region-Based Structure Matching
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. 20 pages, 15 figures. Code at https://github.com/3dv-casia/PlanaReLoc
summary: While structure-based relocalizers have long strived for point correspondences when establishing or regressing query-map associations, in this paper, we pioneer the use of planar primitives and 3D planar maps for lightweight 6-DoF camera relocalization in structured environments. Planar primitives, beyond being fundamental entities in projective geometry, also serve as region-based representations that encapsulate both structural and semantic richness. This motivates us to introduce PlanaReLoc, a streamlined plane-centric paradigm where a deep matcher associates planar primitives across the query image and the map within a learned unified embedding space, after which the 6-DoF pose is solved and refined under a robust framework. Through comprehensive experiments on the ScanNet and 12Scenes datasets across hundreds of scenes, our method demonstrates the superiority of planar primitives in facilitating reliable cross-modal structural correspondences and achieving effective camera relocalization without requiring realistically textured/colored maps, pose priors, or per-scene training. The code and data are available at https://github.com/3dv-casia/PlanaReLoc .

AI.tldr: PlanaReLoc：首个使用平面基元和3D平面地图进行轻量级6自由度相机重定位的方法，在结构化环境中通过深度匹配器关联查询图像与地图中的平面基元，无需纹理地图、姿态先验或逐场景训练。
AI.motivation: 传统基于结构的重定位方法主要依赖点对应关系，而平面基元作为投影几何的基本实体，能够封装结构和语义信息，为结构化环境中的相机重定位提供更丰富的区域表示。
AI.method: 提出PlanaReLoc平面中心范式：1）使用深度匹配器在学习的统一嵌入空间中关联查询图像和地图中的平面基元；2）在鲁棒框架下求解并优化6自由度姿态。
AI.result: 在ScanNet和12Scenes数据集上进行了数百个场景的综合实验，证明了平面基元在促进可靠的跨模态结构对应和实现有效相机重定位方面的优越性，无需真实纹理/彩色地图、姿态先验或逐场景训练。
AI.conclusion: 平面基元是结构化环境中轻量级6自由度相机重定位的有效表示，PlanaReLoc方法展示了平面中心范式在跨模态结构对应和姿态估计方面的潜力。

title: Multi-Perspective LLM Annotations for Valid Analyses in Subjective Tasks
summary: Large language models are increasingly used to annotate texts, but their outputs reflect some human perspectives better than others. Existing methods for correcting LLM annotation error assume a single ground truth. However, this assumption fails in subjective tasks where disagreement across demographic groups is meaningful. Here we introduce Perspective-Driven Inference, a method that treats the distribution of annotations across groups as the quantity of interest, and estimates it using a small human annotation budget. We contribute an adaptive sampling strategy that concentrates human annotation effort on groups where LLM proxies are least accurate. We evaluate on politeness and offensiveness rating tasks, showing targeted improvements for harder-to-model demographic groups relative to uniform sampling baselines, while maintaining coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出Perspective-Driven Inference方法，通过自适应采样策略，用有限人工标注预算估计不同人群的标注分布，改善LLM在主观任务中对特定人群的建模偏差。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM标注纠错方法假设单一真实标注，但在主观任务中不同人群的标注差异具有意义，且LLM对不同人群视角的反映存在偏差。
AI.method: 提出Perspective-Driven Inference方法，将跨人群的标注分布作为关注量，采用自适应采样策略，将人工标注资源集中在LLM代理最不准确的人群上。
AI.result: 在礼貌性和冒犯性评分任务上评估，相比均匀采样基线，该方法对更难建模的人群实现了针对性改进，同时保持了覆盖范围。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够有效利用有限人工标注预算，更准确地估计不同人群的主观标注分布，解决LLM在反映多元人类视角时的偏差问题。

title: EruDiff: Refactoring Knowledge in Diffusion Models for Advanced Text-to-Image Synthesis
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models have achieved remarkable fidelity in synthesizing images from explicit text prompts, yet exhibit a critical deficiency in processing implicit prompts that require deep-level world knowledge, ranging from natural sciences to cultural commonsense, resulting in counter-factual synthesis. This paper traces the root of this limitation to a fundamental dislocation of the underlying knowledge structures, manifesting as a chaotic organization of implicit prompts compared to their explicit counterparts. In this paper, we propose EruDiff, which aims to refactor the knowledge within diffusion models. Specifically, we develop the Diffusion Knowledge Distribution Matching (DK-DM) to register the knowledge distribution of intractable implicit prompts with that of well-defined explicit anchors. Furthermore, to rectify the inherent biases in explicit prompt rendering, we employ the Negative-Only Reinforcement Learning (NO-RL) strategy for fine-grained correction. Rigorous empirical evaluations demonstrate that our method significantly enhances the performance of leading diffusion models, including FLUX and Qwen-Image, across both the scientific knowledge benchmark (i.e., Science-T2I) and the world knowledge benchmark (i.e., WISE), underscoring the effectiveness and generalizability. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiefan-guo/erudiff.

AI.tldr: EruDiff通过知识分布匹配和负向强化学习改进扩散模型处理隐式提示的能力，在科学和世界知识基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前文本到图像扩散模型在处理需要深层世界知识的隐式提示时存在不足，导致反事实合成，这源于知识结构的基本错位。
AI.method: 提出EruDiff框架：1) 扩散知识分布匹配(DK-DM)，将隐式提示的知识分布与明确定义的显式锚点对齐；2) 负向强化学习(NO-RL)策略，纠正显式提示渲染中的固有偏差。
AI.result: 在FLUX和Qwen-Image等主流扩散模型上，该方法在科学知识基准(Science-T2I)和世界知识基准(WISE)上均显著提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: EruDiff通过重构扩散模型中的知识结构，有效解决了隐式提示处理问题，证明了方法的有效性和泛化能力。

title: Unified-MAS: Universally Generating Domain-Specific Nodes for Empowering Automatic Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Automatic Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) generation has emerged as a promising paradigm for solving complex reasoning tasks. However, existing frameworks are fundamentally bottlenecked when applied to knowledge-intensive domains (e.g., healthcare and law). They either rely on a static library of general nodes like Chain-of-Thought, which lack specialized expertise, or attempt to generate nodes on the fly. In the latter case, the orchestrator is not only bound by its internal knowledge limits but must also simultaneously generate domain-specific logic and optimize high-level topology, leading to a severe architectural coupling that degrades overall system efficacy. To bridge this gap, we propose Unified-MAS that decouples granular node implementation from topological orchestration via offline node synthesis. Unified-MAS operates in two stages: (1) Search-Based Node Generation retrieves external open-world knowledge to synthesize specialized node blueprints, overcoming the internal knowledge limits of LLMs; and (2) Reward-Based Node Optimization utilizes a perplexity-guided reward to iteratively enhance the internal logic of bottleneck nodes. Extensive experiments across four specialized domains demonstrate that integrating Unified-MAS into four Automatic-MAS baselines yields a better performance-cost trade-off, achieving up to a 14.2% gain while significantly reducing costs. Further analysis reveals its robustness across different designer LLMs and its effectiveness on conventional tasks such as mathematical reasoning.

AI.tldr: Unified-MAS提出了一种新的多智能体系统生成框架，通过离线节点合成将细粒度节点实现与拓扑编排解耦，解决了现有方法在知识密集型领域中的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动多智能体系统生成框架在知识密集型领域（如医疗和法律）存在根本性瓶颈：要么依赖缺乏专业知识的通用节点库，要么需要实时生成节点。后者不仅受限于LLM内部知识限制，还必须同时生成领域特定逻辑和优化高层拓扑，导致严重的架构耦合，降低系统效能。
AI.method: Unified-MAS采用两阶段方法：1) 基于搜索的节点生成：检索外部开放世界知识合成专业化节点蓝图，克服LLM内部知识限制；2) 基于奖励的节点优化：使用困惑度引导的奖励迭代增强瓶颈节点的内部逻辑。
AI.result: 在四个专业领域的广泛实验表明，将Unified-MAS集成到四个自动MAS基线中获得了更好的性能-成本权衡，实现了高达14.2%的性能提升，同时显著降低成本。进一步分析显示其在不同设计者LLM上的鲁棒性，以及在传统任务（如数学推理）上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Unified-MAS通过解耦节点实现与拓扑编排，有效解决了知识密集型领域中自动多智能体系统生成的瓶颈问题，提供了一种更高效、成本更低的解决方案。

title: Efficient Fine-Tuning Methods for Portuguese Question Answering: A Comparative Study of PEFT on BERTimbau and Exploratory Evaluation of Generative LLMs
summary: Although large language models have transformed natural language processing, their computational costs create accessibility barriers for low-resource languages such as Brazilian Portuguese. This work presents a systematic evaluation of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) and quantization techniques applied to BERTimbau for Question Answering on SQuAD-BR, the Brazilian Portuguese translation of SQuAD v1. We evaluate 40 configurations combining four PEFT methods (LoRA, DoRA, QLoRA, QDoRA) across two model sizes (Base: 110M, Large: 335M parameters). Our findings reveal three critical insights: (1) LoRA achieves 95.8\% of baseline performance on BERTimbau-Large while reducing training time by 73.5\% (F1=81.32 vs 84.86); (2) higher learning rates (2e-4) substantially improve PEFT performance, with F1 gains of up to +19.71 points over standard rates; and (3) larger models show twice the quantization resilience (loss of 4.83 vs 9.56 F1 points). These results demonstrate that encoder-based models can be efficiently fine-tuned for extractive Brazilian Portuguese QA with substantially lower computational cost than large generative LLMs, promoting more sustainable approaches aligned with \textit{Green AI} principles. An exploratory evaluation of Tucano and Sabiá on the same extractive QA benchmark shows that while generative models can reach competitive F1 scores with LoRA fine-tuning, they require up to 4.2$\times$ more GPU memory and 3$\times$ more training time than BERTimbau-Base, reinforcing the efficiency advantage of smaller encoder-based architectures for this task.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了参数高效微调（PEFT）和量化技术在巴西葡萄牙语问答任务上的应用，发现LoRA方法在BERTimbau-Large上能达到基线95.8%性能，同时减少73.5%训练时间，证明了编码器模型在低资源语言任务上的高效性。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的计算成本高昂，为巴西葡萄牙语等低资源语言创建了可访问性障碍。本研究旨在探索参数高效微调和量化技术，以降低计算成本，促进更可持续的绿色AI方法。
AI.method: 在SQuAD-BR（巴西葡萄牙语版SQuAD v1）上对BERTimbau进行系统评估，测试40种配置组合，包括四种PEFT方法（LoRA、DoRA、QLoRA、QDoRA）和两种模型规模（Base：110M参数，Large：335M参数），并探索性评估了Tucano和Sabiá生成模型。
AI.result: 1) LoRA在BERTimbau-Large上达到基线95.8%性能，训练时间减少73.5%（F1=81.32 vs 84.86）；2) 更高学习率（2e-4）显著提升PEFT性能，F1增益最高达+19.71分；3) 大模型量化韧性是小模型的两倍（损失4.83 vs 9.56 F1分）；4) 生成模型需要4.2倍GPU内存和3倍训练时间。
AI.conclusion: 编码器模型可以通过参数高效微调在巴西葡萄牙语抽取式问答任务上实现高效优化，计算成本远低于大型生成式LLM，符合绿色AI原则。较小的编码器架构在该任务上具有明显效率优势。

title: MERIT: Multi-domain Efficient RAW Image Translation
summary: RAW images captured by different camera sensors exhibit substantial domain shifts due to varying spectral responses, noise characteristics, and tone behaviors, complicating their direct use in downstream computer vision tasks. Prior methods address this problem by training domain-specific RAW-to-RAW translators for each source-target pair, but such approaches do not scale to real-world scenarios involving multiple types of commercial cameras. In this work, we introduce MERIT, the first unified framework for multi-domain RAW image translation, which leverages a single model to perform translations across arbitrary camera domains. To address domain-specific noise discrepancies, we propose a sensor-aware noise modeling loss that explicitly aligns the signal-dependent noise statistics of the generated images with those of the target domain. We further enhance the generator with a conditional multi-scale large kernel attention module for improved context and sensor-aware feature modeling. To facilitate standardized evaluation, we introduce MDRAW, the first dataset tailored for multi-domain RAW image translation, comprising both paired and unpaired RAW captures from five diverse camera sensors across a wide range of scenes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MERIT outperforms prior models in both quality (5.56 dB improvement) and scalability (80% reduction in training iterations).

AI.tldr: MERIT是首个统一的多域RAW图像翻译框架，使用单一模型处理任意相机域间的转换，通过传感器感知噪声建模和多尺度大核注意力模块提升性能，在质量和可扩展性上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 不同相机传感器捕获的RAW图像存在显著域偏移（光谱响应、噪声特性、色调行为差异），这限制了其在计算机视觉任务中的直接使用。现有方法需要为每个源-目标对训练特定域翻译器，无法扩展到涉及多种商业相机的真实场景。
AI.method: 提出MERIT统一框架：1）传感器感知噪声建模损失，显式对齐生成图像与目标域的信号相关噪声统计；2）条件多尺度大核注意力模块，增强上下文和传感器感知特征建模；3）构建MDRAW数据集，包含五种不同相机传感器的配对和非配对RAW图像。
AI.result: MERIT在质量上提升5.56 dB，训练迭代次数减少80%，显著优于现有模型。MDRAW数据集为多域RAW图像翻译提供了标准化评估基准。
AI.conclusion: MERIT是首个能够处理任意相机域间RAW图像翻译的统一框架，通过创新的噪声建模和注意力机制，在保持高质量输出的同时大幅提升了可扩展性，为实际应用中的多相机RAW图像处理提供了有效解决方案。

title: Stabilizing Iterative Self-Training with Verified Reasoning via Symbolic Recursive Self-Alignment
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop on World Models. 10 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables
summary: Recursive self-improvement--where a model iteratively trains on its own outputs--promises sustained capability growth but faces a fundamental obstacle: recursive drift. As models train on self-generated data across multiple iterations, errors in intermediate reasoning compound, leading to mode collapse and performance degradation. We propose Neuro-Symbolic Recursive Self-Alignment (NSRSA), which stabilizes iterative self-training by embedding a symbolic verification subsystem that gates training data quality at the reasoning step level. Unlike outcome-only filtering (which admits "lucky guesses" with flawed reasoning), NSRSA verifies each arithmetic operation via sympy, checks logical flow consistency across reasoning steps, and enforces domain constraints. We evaluate NSRSA on GSM8K using Qwen3-4B-Thinking across 5 self-training iterations under five conditions: no verification, outcome verification, majority voting, full NSRSA symbolic verification, and NSRSA with DPO. Our filtering analysis shows that NSRSA rejects approximately 34% of correct-answer solutions that pass outcome verification, eliminating "lucky guesses" with flawed reasoning from the training set. We further demonstrate that constructing DPO preference pairs from NSRSA verification teaches the model to distinguish sound from flawed reasoning (reward accuracy 46% to 63%). NSRSA provides an extensible framework that demonstrates how external symbolic verification can make recursive self-improvement measurable and reliable within domains where automated verification is available.

AI.tldr: NSRSA通过符号验证子系统稳定递归自训练，在推理步骤级别过滤数据质量，消除"幸运猜测"并防止递归漂移
AI.motivation: 递归自改进面临递归漂移的根本障碍：模型在多轮迭代中训练自身输出时，中间推理错误会累积，导致模式崩溃和性能下降
AI.method: 提出神经符号递归自对齐(NSRSA)，嵌入符号验证子系统，在推理步骤级别进行数据质量控制：通过sympy验证算术运算，检查推理步骤间的逻辑流一致性，并强制执行领域约束
AI.result: 在GSM8K上使用Qwen3-4B-Thinking进行5轮自训练，NSRSA拒绝了约34%通过结果验证的正确答案解决方案，消除了训练集中的"幸运猜测"；使用NSRSA验证构建DPO偏好对，使模型区分合理与有缺陷推理的能力从46%提升到63%
AI.conclusion: NSRSA提供了一个可扩展框架，展示了外部符号验证如何使递归自改进在自动验证可用的领域中变得可测量和可靠

title: Semantic Shift: the Fundamental Challenge in Text Embedding and Retrieval
summary:
Transformer-based embedding models rely on pooling to map variable-length text into a single vector, enabling efficient similarity search but also inducing well-known geometric pathologies such as anisotropy and length-induced embedding collapse. Existing accounts largely describe \emph{what} these pathologies look like, yet provide limited insight into \emph{when} and \emph{why} they harm downstream retrieval. In this work, we argue that the missing causal factor is \emph{semantic shift}: the intrinsic, structured evolution and dispersion of semantics within a text.
  We first present a theoretical analysis of \emph{semantic smoothing} in Transformer embeddings: as the semantic diversity among constituent sentences increases, the pooled representation necessarily shifts away from every individual sentence embedding, yielding a smoothed and less discriminative vector. Building on this foundation, we formalize semantic shift as a computable measure integrating local semantic evolution and global semantic dispersion. Through controlled experiments across corpora and multiple embedding models, we show that semantic shift aligns closely with the severity of embedding concentration and predicts retrieval degradation, whereas text length alone does not. Overall, semantic shift offers a unified and actionable lens for understanding embedding collapse and for diagnosing when anisotropy becomes harmful.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义偏移是导致Transformer嵌入模型几何病理（如各向异性和长度诱导嵌入坍缩）的根本原因，而非文本长度本身。通过理论分析和实验验证，语义偏移能更好地预测检索性能下降。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要描述Transformer嵌入模型中的几何病理（如各向异性和长度诱导嵌入坍缩）的表现，但缺乏对这些病理何时以及为何损害下游检索性能的深入理解。本文旨在填补这一空白，寻找导致这些问题的根本因果因素。
AI.method: 首先对Transformer嵌入中的语义平滑进行理论分析：随着组成句子间语义多样性的增加，池化表示必然偏离每个单独句子嵌入，产生平滑且区分度较低的向量。在此基础上，将语义偏移形式化为一个可计算的度量，整合局部语义演化和全局语义分散。通过跨语料库和多个嵌入模型的受控实验进行验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，语义偏移与嵌入集中严重程度密切相关，并能预测检索性能下降，而文本长度本身则不能。语义偏移提供了一个统一的、可操作的视角来理解嵌入坍缩，并诊断各向异性何时变得有害。
AI.conclusion: 语义偏移是导致Transformer嵌入模型几何病理的根本因果因素，为理解嵌入坍缩和诊断各向异性问题提供了统一的理论框架和实用工具。这一发现有助于更准确地预测和解决嵌入模型在下游检索任务中的性能问题。

title: Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Collaborative multi-agent large language models (LLMs) can solve complex reasoning tasks by decomposing roles and aggregating diverse hypotheses. Yet, reinforcement learning (RL) for such systems is often undermined by credit assignment: a shared global reward obscures individual contributions, inflating update variance and encouraging free-riding. We introduce Counterfactual Credit Policy Optimization (CCPO), a framework that assigns agent-specific learning signals by estimating each agent's marginal contribution through counterfactual trajectories. CCPO builds dynamic counterfactual baselines that simulate outcomes with an agent's contribution removed, yielding role-sensitive advantages for policy optimization. To further improve stability under heterogeneous tasks and data distributions, we propose a global-history-aware normalization scheme that calibrates advantages using global rollout statistics. We evaluate CCPO on two collaboration topologies: a sequential Think--Reason dyad and multi-agent voting. Across mathematical and logical reasoning benchmarks, CCPO mitigates free-riding and outperforms strong multi-agent RL baselines, yielding finer-grained and more effective credit assignment for collaborative LLM training. Our code is available at https://github.com/bhai114/ccpo.

AI.tldr: CCPO是一个为协作多智能体LLM设计的强化学习框架，通过反事实轨迹估计每个智能体的边际贡献来解决信用分配问题，减少搭便车现象，提高训练效果。
AI.motivation: 协作多智能体LLM系统在复杂推理任务中面临信用分配问题：共享的全局奖励掩盖了个体贡献，导致更新方差增大和搭便车现象，影响学习效果。
AI.method: 提出反事实信用策略优化（CCPO）框架：1）通过构建动态反事实基线，模拟移除智能体贡献后的结果，生成角色敏感的奖励信号；2）引入全局历史感知的归一化方案，利用全局rollout统计校准奖励，提高异构任务和数据分布下的稳定性。
AI.result: 在顺序思考-推理双智能体和多智能体投票两种协作拓扑结构上测试，CCPO在数学和逻辑推理基准上优于现有多智能体RL基线，有效缓解搭便车现象，实现更细粒度和有效的信用分配。
AI.conclusion: CCPO通过反事实信用分配机制解决了协作多智能体LLM训练中的信用分配问题，提高了学习效率和协作效果，为多智能体LLM系统提供了更有效的训练框架。

title: PROMPT2BOX: Uncovering Entailment Structure among LLM Prompts
summary: To discover the weaknesses of LLMs, researchers often embed prompts into a vector space and cluster them to extract insightful patterns. However, vector embeddings primarily capture topical similarity. As a result, prompts that share a topic but differ in specificity, and consequently in difficulty, are often represented similarly, making fine-grained weakness analysis difficult. To address this limitation, we propose PROMPT2BOX, which embeds prompts into a box embedding space using a trained encoder. The encoder, trained on existing and synthesized datasets, outputs box embeddings that capture not only semantic similarity but also specificity relations between prompts (e.g., "writing an adventure story" is more specific than "writing a story"). We further develop a novel dimension reduction technique for box embeddings to facilitate dataset visualization and comparison. Our experiments demonstrate that box embeddings consistently capture prompt specificity better than vector baselines. On the downstream task of creating hierarchical clustering trees for 17 LLMs from the UltraFeedback dataset, PROMPT2BOX can identify 8.9\% more LLM weaknesses than vector baselines and achieves an approximately 33\% stronger correlation between hierarchical depth and instruction specificity.

AI.tldr: PROMPT2BOX提出使用盒子嵌入空间替代传统向量嵌入，以同时捕捉提示的语义相似性和特异性关系，从而更精细地分析LLM弱点。
AI.motivation: 传统向量嵌入主要捕捉主题相似性，但无法区分共享主题但不同特异性（难度）的提示，这限制了LLM弱点的细粒度分析。
AI.method: 提出PROMPT2BOX方法，使用训练好的编码器将提示嵌入到盒子嵌入空间，该编码器在现有和合成数据集上训练，能同时捕捉语义相似性和特异性关系。还开发了盒子嵌入的新颖降维技术以支持数据集可视化和比较。
