In this work, we formalize Active Testing in NLP and we conduct an extensive benchmarking of existing approaches across 18 datasets and 4 embedding strategies spanning 4 different NLP tasks. The experiments show annotation reductions of up to 95%, with performance estimation accuracy difference from the full test set within 1%. Our analysis reveals variations in method effectiveness across different data characteristics and task types, with no single approach emerging as universally superior. Lastly, to address the limitation of requiring a predefined annotation budget in existing sample selection strategies, we introduce an adaptive stopping criterion that automatically determines the optimal number of samples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并系统评估了NLP中的主动测试框架，通过选择信息量最大的测试样本进行标注，在保持性能评估准确性的同时，将标注成本降低高达95%。
AI.motivation: NLP中人工标注成本和时间是主要瓶颈，特别是测试数据标注要求高质量标签，传统方法需要标注整个测试集，资源消耗巨大。主动测试框架旨在选择最有信息量的测试样本进行标注，以最小化成本并准确评估模型性能。
AI.method: 1) 形式化NLP中的主动测试框架；2) 在18个数据集和4种嵌入策略上对现有方法进行广泛基准测试，涵盖4个NLP任务；3) 引入自适应停止准则，自动确定最优样本数量，解决现有方法需要预定义标注预算的限制。
AI.result: 实验显示标注减少高达95%，性能估计准确性与完整测试集差异在1%以内。分析表明不同方法在不同数据特征和任务类型上效果存在差异，没有单一方法在所有情况下都最优。自适应停止准则能有效确定最优样本数量。
AI.conclusion: 主动测试是减少NLP测试标注成本的有效框架，能大幅降低资源需求同时保持评估准确性。方法效果受数据特征和任务类型影响，需要根据具体情况选择合适策略。自适应停止准则解决了预定义预算的限制，提高了实用性。

title: CoVFT: Context-aware Visual Fine-tuning for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve remarkable progress in cross-modal perception and reasoning, yet a fundamental question remains unresolved: should the vision encoder be fine-tuned or frozen? Despite the success of models such as LLaVA and Qwen-VL, inconsistent design choices and heterogeneous training setups hinder a unified understanding of visual fine-tuning (VFT) in MLLMs. Through a configuration-aligned benchmark, we find that existing VFT methods fail to consistently outperform the frozen baseline across multimodal tasks. Our analysis suggests that this instability arises from visual preference conflicts, where the context-agnostic nature of vision encoders induces divergent parameter updates under diverse multimodal context. To address this issue, we propose the Context-aware Visual Fine-tuning (CoVFT) framework, which explicitly incorporates multimodal context into visual adaptation. By integrating a Context Vector Extraction (CVE) and a Contextual Mixture-of-Experts (CoMoE) module, CoVFT decomposes conflicting optimization signals and enables stable, context-sensitive visual updates. Extensive experiments on 12 multimodal benchmarks demonstrate that CoVFT achieves state-of-the-art performance with superior stability. Notably, fine-tuning a 7B MLLM with CoVFT surpasses the average performance of its 13B counterpart, revealing substantial untapped potential in visual encoder optimization within MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了CoVFT框架，通过上下文感知的视觉微调解决多模态大语言模型中视觉编码器微调不稳定的问题，在12个基准测试中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在跨模态感知和推理方面取得显著进展，但视觉编码器应该微调还是冻结这一基本问题仍未解决。现有方法设计选择不一致、训练设置异质，且现有视觉微调方法在多模态任务中无法稳定超越冻结基线，存在视觉偏好冲突问题。
AI.method: 提出上下文感知视觉微调框架，包含上下文向量提取模块和上下文混合专家模块，将多模态上下文显式融入视觉适应过程，分解冲突的优化信号，实现稳定、上下文敏感的视觉更新。
AI.result: 在12个多模态基准测试中达到最先进性能，具有优越的稳定性。使用CoVFT微调的7B模型超越了13B模型的平均性能，揭示了视觉编码器优化的巨大潜力。
AI.conclusion: 视觉编码器微调的不稳定性源于视觉偏好冲突，CoVFT框架通过上下文感知的视觉适应有效解决了这一问题，为多模态大语言模型的视觉编码器优化提供了新思路。

title: Tacit Knowledge Management with Generative AI: Proposal of the GenAI SECI Model
comment: This paper is intended to be submitted to AHFE2026
summary: The emergence of generative AI is bringing about a significant transformation in knowledge management. Generative AI has the potential to address the limitations of conventional knowledge management systems, and it is increasingly being deployed in real-world settings with promising results. Related research is also expanding rapidly. However, much of this work focuses on research and practice related to the management of explicit knowledge. While fragmentary efforts have been made regarding the management of tacit knowledge using generative AI, the modeling and systematization that handle both tacit and explicit knowledge in an integrated manner remain insufficient. In this paper, we propose the "GenAI SECI" model as an updated version of the knowledge creation process (SECI) model, redesigned to leverage the capabilities of generative AI. A defining feature of the "GenAI SECI" model is the introduction of "Digital Fragmented Knowledge", a new concept that integrates explicit and tacit knowledge within cyberspace. Furthermore, a concrete system architecture for the proposed model is presented, along with a comparison with prior research models that share a similar problem awareness and objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"GenAI SECI"模型，作为知识创造过程(SECI)模型的更新版本，通过引入"数字碎片化知识"概念，利用生成式AI能力集成管理显性和隐性知识。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI正在变革知识管理，但现有研究主要关注显性知识管理，对于利用生成式AI集成管理显性和隐性知识的建模和系统化工作仍不足。
AI.method: 提出"GenAI SECI"模型作为SECI模型的更新版本，引入"数字碎片化知识"新概念，将显性和隐性知识在赛博空间集成，并设计了具体的系统架构。
AI.result: 提出了一个更新的知识创造过程模型，能够利用生成式AI能力处理显性和隐性知识，并与具有相似问题意识和目标的前人研究模型进行了比较。
AI.conclusion: "GenAI SECI"模型为利用生成式AI集成管理显性和隐性知识提供了理论框架和系统架构，填补了现有研究的不足。

title: Riding Brainwaves in LLM Space: Understanding Activation Patterns Using Individual Neural Signatures
summary: Consumer-grade EEG is entering everyday devices, from earbuds to headbands, raising the question of whether language models can be adapted to individual neural responses. We test this by asking whether frozen LLM representations encode person-specific EEG signals, directions in activation space that predict one person's brain activity but not another's. Using word-level EEG from 30 participants reading naturalistic sentences (ZuCo corpus), we train a separate linear probe for each person, mapping hidden states from a frozen Qwen 2.5 7B to that individual's EEG power. Person-specific probes outperform a single population probe on every EEG feature tested; for high-gamma power, the person-specific probe achieves rho = 0.183, a ninefold improvement over the population probe (rho = 0.020, p < 10^-4). A negative control, fixation count, shows no person-specific advantage (p = 0.360); fixation count reflects word length and frequency rather than individual cognition. The individual directions are temporally stable (split-half cosine = 0.824), non-transferable across people (self rho = 0.369 vs. other rho = 0.143, p < 10^-19), and distinct from the shared population signal: person-specific probes retain predictive power after the population component is removed. The person-specific signal concentrates in the model's deep layers, rising consistently with depth and peaking at Layer 24 of 28. The results are consistent across architectures (LLaMA 3.1 8B) and survive word-level confound controls. Frozen language models contain stable, person-specific neural directions in their deep layers, providing a geometric foundation for EEG-driven personalization.

AI.tldr: 研究发现冻结的大语言模型（Qwen 2.5 7B）的深层表示中编码了稳定、个体特异性的神经信号方向，这些方向能够预测个人脑电图活动，为EEG驱动的个性化应用提供几何基础。
AI.motivation: 随着消费级EEG设备进入日常设备（如耳塞、头带），研究语言模型能否适应个体神经反应变得重要。本文旨在探索冻结LLM表示是否编码个体特异性的EEG信号。
AI.method: 使用ZuCo语料库中30名参与者阅读自然句子的单词级EEG数据。为每个参与者训练单独的线性探针，将冻结的Qwen 2.5 7B的隐藏状态映射到个体的EEG功率。比较个体特异性探针与群体探针的性能。
AI.result: 个体特异性探针在所有EEG特征上都优于群体探针。对于高伽马功率，个体特异性探针达到rho=0.183，比群体探针（rho=0.020）提高9倍。个体特异性方向具有时间稳定性（分半余弦=0.824），在个体间不可迁移，且集中在模型的深层（第24层达到峰值）。
AI.conclusion: 冻结语言模型的深层包含稳定、个体特异性的神经方向，为EEG驱动的个性化提供了几何基础，表明LLM表示能够编码个体神经特征。

title: Taming Sampling Perturbations with Variance Expansion Loss for Latent Diffusion Models
summary: Latent diffusion models have emerged as the dominant framework for high-fidelity and efficient image generation, owing to their ability to learn diffusion processes in compact latent spaces. However, while previous research has focused primarily on reconstruction accuracy and semantic alignment of the latent space, we observe that another critical factor, robustness to sampling perturbations, also plays a crucial role in determining generation quality. Through empirical and theoretical analyses, we show that the commonly used $β$-VAE-based tokenizers in latent diffusion models, tend to produce overly compact latent manifolds that are highly sensitive to stochastic perturbations during diffusion sampling, leading to visual degradation. To address this issue, we propose a simple yet effective solution that constructs a latent space robust to sampling perturbations while maintaining strong reconstruction fidelity. This is achieved by introducing a Variance Expansion loss that counteracts variance collapse and leverages the adversarial interplay between reconstruction and variance expansion to achieve an adaptive balance that preserves reconstruction accuracy while improving robustness to stochastic sampling. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach consistently enhances generation quality across different latent diffusion architectures, confirming that robustness in latent space is a key missing ingredient for stable and faithful diffusion sampling.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现潜在扩散模型中常用的β-VAE分词器会产生过于紧凑的潜在流形，对扩散采样中的随机扰动高度敏感，导致视觉质量下降。作者提出通过方差扩展损失构建对采样扰动鲁棒的潜在空间，在保持重建精度的同时提高生成质量。
AI.motivation: 以往研究主要关注潜在空间的重建精度和语义对齐，但作者发现另一个关键因素——对采样扰动的鲁棒性——对生成质量同样至关重要。现有β-VAE分词器产生的潜在流形过于紧凑，对扩散采样中的随机扰动高度敏感，导致视觉退化。
AI.method: 提出方差扩展损失来抵消方差崩溃，利用重建和方差扩展之间的对抗性相互作用实现自适应平衡。该方法在保持重建精度的同时提高对随机采样的鲁棒性，构建对采样扰动鲁棒的潜在空间。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在不同潜在扩散架构中一致提升生成质量，证实潜在空间的鲁棒性是实现稳定和忠实扩散采样的关键缺失要素。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间的鲁棒性对扩散生成质量至关重要，提出的方差扩展损失方法能有效构建鲁棒潜在空间，在保持重建精度的同时显著提升生成稳定性。

title: A Context Engineering Framework for Improving Enterprise AI Agents based on Digital-Twin MDP
summary: Despite rapid progress in AI agents for enterprise automation and decision-making, their real-world deployment and further performance gains remain constrained by limited data quality and quantity, complex real-world reasoning demands, difficulties with self-play, and the lack of reliable feedback signals. To address these challenges, we propose a lightweight, model-agnostic framework for improving LLM-based enterprise agents via offline reinforcement learning (RL). The proposed Context Engineering via DT-MDP (DT-MDP-CE) framework comprises three key components: (1) A Digital-Twin Markov Decision Process (DT-MDP), which abstracts the agent's reasoning behavior as a finite MDP; (2) A robust contrastive inverse RL, which, armed with the DT-MDP, to efficiently estimate a well-founded reward function and induces policies from mixed-quality offline trajectories; and (3) RL-guided context engineering, which uses the policy obtained from the integrated process of (1) and (2), to improve the agent's decision-making behavior. As a case study, we apply the framework to a representative task in the enterprise-oriented domain of IT automation. Extensive experimental results demonstrate consistent and significant improvements over baseline agents across a wide range of evaluation settings, suggesting that the framework can generalize to other agents sharing similar characteristics in enterprise environments.

AI.tldr: 提出DT-MDP-CE框架，通过离线强化学习改进企业级AI代理，解决数据质量、复杂推理和反馈信号不足的问题，在IT自动化任务中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 企业AI代理在现实部署中面临数据质量数量有限、复杂推理需求、自博弈困难以及可靠反馈信号缺乏等约束，限制了其性能提升和实际应用。
AI.method: 提出DT-MDP-CE框架：1) DT-MDP将代理推理行为抽象为有限MDP；2) 鲁棒对比逆强化学习估计奖励函数并从混合质量离线轨迹推导策略；3) RL引导的上下文工程使用获得的策略改进代理决策行为。
AI.result: 在IT自动化代表性任务中应用该框架，广泛的实验结果表明，在各种评估设置下相比基线代理均获得一致且显著的改进。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量级、模型无关的框架能有效提升LLM企业代理性能，可推广到具有类似特征的其他企业环境代理中。

title: Retrieving Climate Change Disinformation by Narrative
summary: Detecting climate disinformation narratives typically relies on fixed taxonomies, which do not accommodate emerging narratives. Thus, we re-frame narrative detection as a retrieval task: given a narrative's core message as a query, rank texts from a corpus by alignment with that narrative. This formulation requires no predefined label set and can accommodate emerging narratives. We repurpose three climate disinformation datasets (CARDS, Climate Obstruction, climate change subset of PolyNarrative) for retrieval evaluation and propose SpecFi, a framework that generates hypothetical documents to bridge the gap between abstract narrative descriptions and their concrete textual instantiations. SpecFi uses community summaries from graph-based community detection as few-shot examples for generation, achieving a MAP of 0.505 on CARDS without access to narrative labels. We further introduce narrative variance, an embedding-based difficulty metric, and show via partial correlation analysis that standard retrieval degrades on high-variance narratives (BM25 loses 63.4% of MAP), while SpecFi-CS remains robust (32.7% loss). Our analysis also reveals that unsupervised community summaries converge on descriptions close to expert-crafted taxonomies, suggesting that graph-based methods can surface narrative structure from unlabeled text.

AI.tldr: 将气候虚假信息叙事检测重构为检索任务，使用SpecFi框架生成假设文档来弥合抽象叙事描述与具体文本实例之间的差距，无需预定义标签集即可处理新兴叙事。
AI.motivation: 传统基于固定分类法的气候虚假信息叙事检测方法无法适应新兴叙事，需要一种无需预定义标签集、能灵活处理新叙事的解决方案。
AI.method: 将叙事检测重构为检索任务：以叙事核心信息为查询，从语料库中检索相关文本。提出SpecFi框架，利用基于图的社区检测生成的社区摘要作为少样本示例，生成假设文档来连接抽象叙事描述与具体文本实例。
AI.result: SpecFi在CARDS数据集上达到0.505的MAP，无需访问叙事标签。引入叙事方差作为难度指标，发现标准检索方法在高方差叙事上性能显著下降（BM25损失63.4% MAP），而SpecFi-CS保持相对稳健（损失32.7%）。无监督社区摘要与专家构建的分类法接近。
AI.conclusion: 将叙事检测重构为检索任务并采用SpecFi框架是有效的，能够处理新兴叙事且无需预定义标签。基于图的方法可以从无标签文本中提取叙事结构，为气候虚假信息检测提供了灵活且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Learning Progressive Adaptation for Multi-Modal Tracking
summary: Due to the limited availability of paired multi-modal data, multi-modal trackers are typically built by adopting pre-trained RGB models with parameter-efficient fine-tuning modules. However, these fine-tuning methods overlook advanced adaptations for applying RGB pre-trained models and fail to modulate a single specific modality, cross-modal interactions, and the prediction head. To address the issues, we propose to perform Progressive Adaptation for Multi-Modal Tracking (PATrack). This innovative approach incorporates modality-dependent, modality-entangled, and task-level adapters, effectively bridging the gap in adapting RGB pre-trained networks to multi-modal data through a progressive strategy. Specifically, modality-specific information is enhanced through the modality-dependent adapter, decomposing the high- and low-frequency components, which ensures a more robust feature representation within each modality. The inter-modal interactions are introduced in the modality-entangled adapter, which implements a cross-attention operation guided by inter-modal shared information, ensuring the reliability of features conveyed between modalities. Additionally, recognising that the strong inductive bias of the prediction head does not adapt to the fused information, a task-level adapter specific to the prediction head is introduced. In summary, our design integrates intra-modal, inter-modal, and task-level adapters into a unified framework. Extensive experiments on RGB+Thermal, RGB+Depth, and RGB+Event tracking tasks demonstrate that our method shows impressive performance against state-of-the-art methods. Code is available at https://github.com/ouha1998/Learning-Progressive-Adaptation-for-Multi-Modal-Tracking.

AI.tldr: PATrack提出了一种渐进式适配方法，通过模态依赖、模态纠缠和任务级适配器，将RGB预训练模型有效适配到多模态跟踪任务中。
AI.motivation: 由于配对多模态数据有限，现有方法通常采用参数高效微调模块来适配RGB预训练模型，但这些方法忽视了高级适配策略，未能有效调制单一特定模态、跨模态交互和预测头。
AI.method: 提出渐进式多模态跟踪适配（PATrack），包含三个核心组件：1）模态依赖适配器通过分解高低频分量增强模态特定信息；2）模态纠缠适配器通过跨模态注意力实现模态间交互；3）任务级适配器专门适配预测头以适应融合信息。
AI.result: 在RGB+热成像、RGB+深度和RGB+事件跟踪任务上的大量实验表明，该方法相比最先进方法表现出令人印象深刻的性能。
AI.conclusion: PATrack通过渐进式适配策略，将模态内、模态间和任务级适配器集成到统一框架中，有效解决了RGB预训练模型适配多模态数据的问题。

title: SpecTM: Spectral Targeted Masking for Trustworthy Foundation Models
summary: Foundation models are now increasingly being developed for Earth observation (EO), yet they often rely on stochastic masking that do not explicitly enforce physics constraints; a critical trustworthiness limitation, in particular for predictive models that guide public health decisions. In this work, we propose SpecTM (Spectral Targeted Masking), a physics-informed masking design that encourages the reconstruction of targeted bands from cross-spectral context during pretraining. To achieve this, we developed an adaptable multi-task (band reconstruction, bio-optical index inference, and 8-day-ahead temporal prediction) self-supervised learning (SSL) framework that encodes spectrally intrinsic representations via joint optimization, and evaluated it on a downstream microcystin concentration regression model using NASA PACE hyperspectral imagery over Lake Erie. SpecTM achieves R^2 = 0.695 (current week) and R^2 = 0.620 (8-day-ahead) predictions surpassing all baseline models by (+34% (0.51 Ridge) and +99% (SVR 0.31)) respectively. Our ablation experiments show targeted masking improves predictions by +0.037 R^2 over random masking. Furthermore, it outperforms strong baselines with 2.2x superior label efficiency under extreme scarcity. SpecTM enables physics-informed representation learning across EO domains and improves the interpretability of foundation models.

AI.tldr: 提出SpecTM（光谱目标掩码），一种物理信息掩码设计，通过预训练期间从跨光谱上下文重建目标波段，提升地球观测基础模型的物理约束和可信度。
AI.motivation: 当前地球观测基础模型通常依赖随机掩码，缺乏明确的物理约束，这对于指导公共卫生决策的预测模型是一个关键的可信度限制。需要开发能够编码光谱内在表示的物理信息学习方法。
AI.method: 提出SpecTM（光谱目标掩码），一种物理信息掩码设计，通过多任务自监督学习框架（波段重建、生物光学指数推断和8天前时间预测）联合优化编码光谱内在表示，使用NASA PACE高光谱图像在伊利湖上进行微囊藻毒素浓度回归评估。
AI.result: SpecTM在微囊藻毒素浓度预测上达到R²=0.695（当前周）和R²=0.620（8天前），分别超过所有基线模型（+34%和+99%）。目标掩码比随机掩码提升+0.037 R²，在极端稀缺条件下具有2.2倍的标签效率优势。
AI.conclusion: SpecTM实现了跨地球观测领域的物理信息表示学习，提升了基础模型的可解释性，为物理约束的预测模型提供了有效的自监督学习方法。

title: Dual-Space Knowledge Distillation with Key-Query Matching for Large Language Models with Vocabulary Mismatch
summary: Large language models (LLMs) achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across language tasks, but are costly to deploy due to their size and resource demands. Knowledge Distillation (KD) addresses this by training smaller Student models to mimic larger Teacher models, improving efficiency without significant performance loss. Dual-Space Knowledge Distillation with Cross-Model Attention (DSKD-CMA) has emerged as a SOTA method for KD between LLMs with distinct tokenizers, yet its internal workings remain largely opaque. In this work, we systematically analyse the attention mechanism of DSKD-CMA through manual token alignment probing and heatmap visualisations, revealing both strengths and limitations. Building on this, we introduce a novel method, DSKD-CMA-GA, based on Generative Adversarial (GA) learning, to address the mismatched distributions between the keys and queries computed from distinct models. Experiments show modest but consistent ROUGE-L gains in text generation quality, particularly on out-of-distribution data (+0.37 on average), narrowing the gap between cross- and same-tokenizer KD.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了DSKD-CMA注意力机制，并提出基于生成对抗学习的DSKD-CMA-GA方法，以解决跨模型键查询分布不匹配问题，在文本生成质量上获得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型虽然性能优越但部署成本高，知识蒸馏通过训练小模型模仿大模型来提高效率。DSKD-CMA是跨不同分词器LLM之间知识蒸馏的SOTA方法，但其内部工作机制不透明，且存在跨模型键查询分布不匹配问题。
AI.method: 1. 通过手动token对齐探测和热力图可视化系统分析DSKD-CMA注意力机制；2. 提出基于生成对抗学习的新方法DSKD-CMA-GA，解决跨模型键查询分布不匹配问题。
AI.result: 实验显示在文本生成质量上获得适度但一致的ROUGE-L提升，特别是在分布外数据上平均提升+0.37，缩小了跨分词器和同分词器知识蒸馏之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: DSKD-CMA-GA通过生成对抗学习有效解决了跨模型键查询分布不匹配问题，在保持知识蒸馏效率优势的同时，提升了文本生成质量，特别是在分布外数据上表现更优。

title: Frequency Switching Mechanism for Parameter-E!cient Multi-Task Learning
summary: Multi-task learning (MTL) aims to enable a single model to solve multiple tasks efficiently; however, current parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods remain largely limited to single-task adaptation. We introduce \textbf{Free Sinewich}, a parameter-efficient multi-task learning framework that enables near-zero-cost weight modulation via frequency switching (\textbf{Free}). Specifically, a \textbf{Sine-AWB (Sinewich)} layer combines low-rank factors and convolutional priors into a single kernel, which is then modulated elementwise by a sinusoidal transformation to produce task-specialized weights. A lightweight Clock Net is introduced to produce bounded frequencies that stabilize this modulation during training. Theoretically, sine modulation enhances the rank of low-rank adapters, while frequency separation decorrelates the weights of different tasks. On dense prediction benchmarks, Free Sinewich achieves state-of-the-art performance-efficiency trade-offs (e.g., up to +5.39\% improvement over single-task fine-tuning with only 6.53M trainable parameters), offering a compact and scalable paradigm based on frequency-based parameter sharing. Project page: \href{https://casperliuliuliu.github.io/projects/Free-Sinewich/}{https://casperliuliuliu.github.io/projects/Free-Sinewich}.

AI.tldr: Free Sinewich是一个参数高效的多任务学习框架，通过频率切换实现近乎零成本的权重调制，在密集预测任务上实现了最先进的性能-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 当前参数高效微调方法主要局限于单任务适应，而多任务学习需要让单个模型高效解决多个任务，因此需要开发参数高效的多任务学习框架。
AI.method: 提出Free Sinewich框架，包含Sine-AWB层（结合低秩因子和卷积先验）和Clock Net。通过正弦变换对内核进行逐元素调制生成任务专用权重，Clock Net产生有界频率以稳定训练期间的调制。
AI.result: 在密集预测基准测试中，Free Sinewich实现了最先进的性能-效率权衡（例如，仅用6.53M可训练参数，比单任务微调提升高达+5.39%），提供了基于频率参数共享的紧凑可扩展范式。
AI.conclusion: Free Sinewich通过频率切换实现参数高效的多任务学习，正弦调制增强了低秩适配器的秩，频率分离使不同任务的权重去相关，为多任务学习提供了紧凑可扩展的解决方案。

title: MARCUS: An agentic, multimodal vision-language model for cardiac diagnosis and management
summary: Cardiovascular disease remains the leading cause of global mortality, with progress hindered by human interpretation of complex cardiac tests. Current AI vision-language models are limited to single-modality inputs and are non-interactive. We present MARCUS (Multimodal Autonomous Reasoning and Chat for Ultrasound and Signals), an agentic vision-language system for end-to-end interpretation of electrocardiograms (ECGs), echocardiograms, and cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) independently and as multimodal input. MARCUS employs a hierarchical agentic architecture comprising modality-specific vision-language expert models, each integrating domain-trained visual encoders with multi-stage language model optimization, coordinated by a multimodal orchestrator. Trained on 13.5 million images (0.25M ECGs, 1.3M echocardiogram images, 12M CMR images) and our novel expert-curated dataset spanning 1.6 million questions, MARCUS achieves state-of-the-art performance surpassing frontier models (GPT-5 Thinking, Gemini 2.5 Pro Deep Think). Across internal (Stanford) and external (UCSF) test cohorts, MARCUS achieves accuracies of 87-91% for ECG, 67-86% for echocardiography, and 85-88% for CMR, outperforming frontier models by 34-45% (P<0.001). On multimodal cases, MARCUS achieved 70% accuracy, nearly triple that of frontier models (22-28%), with 1.7-3.0x higher free-text quality scores. Our agentic architecture also confers resistance to mirage reasoning, whereby vision-language models derive reasoning from unintended textual signals or hallucinated visual content. MARCUS demonstrates that domain-specific visual encoders with an agentic orchestrator enable multimodal cardiac interpretation. We release our models, code, and benchmark open-source.

AI.tldr: MARCUS是一个多模态自主推理系统，专门用于心电图、超声心动图和心脏磁共振成像的端到端解释，采用分层代理架构，在心脏疾病诊断中超越了前沿AI模型。
AI.motivation: 心血管疾病是全球主要死因，现有AI视觉语言模型仅限于单模态输入且缺乏交互性，无法满足复杂心脏测试的临床需求。
AI.method: 采用分层代理架构，包含特定模态的视觉语言专家模型（整合领域训练的视觉编码器和多阶段语言模型优化），由多模态协调器统一协调。训练数据包括1350万张图像和160万个专家标注的问题。
AI.result: 在内部（斯坦福）和外部（UCSF）测试队列中，MARCUS在ECG准确率达87-91%，超声心动图67-86%，CMR 85-88%，比前沿模型提升34-45%。多模态病例准确率达70%，是前沿模型的近3倍，文本质量评分高1.7-3.0倍。
AI.conclusion: 领域特定的视觉编码器与代理协调器相结合，能够实现多模态心脏图像解释，显著超越现有前沿模型，并具有抵抗幻觉推理的能力。作者开源了模型、代码和基准。

title: Autoregressive vs. Masked Diffusion Language Models: A Controlled Comparison
comment: 10 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Code and checkpoints at https://github.com/caiovicentino/arche
summary: We present a controlled empirical comparison between autoregressive (AR) and masked diffusion (MDLM) language models. Both models are trained on identical data (50M tokens from TinyStories), identical compute budget (20,000 steps, batch size 32, sequence length 512), and identical hardware (NVIDIA H100 80GB), isolating the generation paradigm as the sole variable. We report three findings. First, both paradigms achieve comparable training throughput (~50K tokens/second), with MDLM requiring only 4.7% more wall-clock time. Second, AR converges faster and begins overfitting by step 14,000, while MDLM converges more slowly and is still improving at step 20,000, suggesting different compute-optimal training regimes. Third, quantitative diversity analysis over 1,000 generated samples reveals a structural diversity-fluency trade-off: AR produces fluent but repetitive outputs (99.8% begin with the same word), while MDLM generates more diverse narratives (93.4% unique 5-word openings, higher Distinct-n, lower Self-BLEU), at the cost of occasional grammatical inconsistencies. All code, trained checkpoints, and data pipelines are released for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 该研究在相同数据、计算预算和硬件条件下，对比了自回归(AR)和掩码扩散(MDLM)语言模型，发现两者训练吞吐量相当，但AR收敛更快而过拟合早，MDLM收敛慢但持续改进；AR生成流畅但重复性高，MDLM生成更多样但有语法不一致问题。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是在控制所有其他变量的情况下，系统比较自回归和掩码扩散这两种主要语言生成范式，了解它们在训练效率、收敛行为和生成质量方面的差异。
AI.method: 研究方法采用控制实验设计：在相同数据（TinyStories的5000万token）、相同计算预算（20,000步，批量大小32，序列长度512）和相同硬件（NVIDIA H100 80GB）条件下训练AR和MDLM模型，隔离生成范式作为唯一变量。
AI.result: 研究结果包括：1）两种范式训练吞吐量相当（约50K tokens/秒），MDLM仅需多4.7%的墙钟时间；2）AR收敛更快但在14,000步开始过拟合，MDLM收敛更慢但在20,000步仍在改进；3）AR生成流畅但重复性高（99.8%以相同词开头），MDLM生成更多样（93.4%独特的5词开头，更高的Distinct-n，更低的Self-BLEU）但偶尔有语法不一致问题。
AI.conclusion: 结论表明两种生成范式存在结构性差异：AR在流畅性方面表现更好但多样性有限，MDLM在多样性方面优势明显但语法一致性稍差；两种范式需要不同的计算最优训练策略；研究为生成模型选择提供了实证依据。

title: CVT-Bench: Counterfactual Viewpoint Transformations Reveal Unstable Spatial Representations in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on single-view spatial reasoning tasks, yet it remains unclear whether they maintain stable spatial state representations under counterfactual viewpoint changes. We introduce a controlled diagnostic benchmark that evaluates relational consistency under hypothetical camera orbit transformations without re-rendering images. Across 100 synthetic scenes and 6,000 relational queries, we measure viewpoint consistency, 360° cycle agreement, and relational stability over sequential transformations. Despite high single-view accuracy, state-of-the-art MLLMs exhibit systematic degradation under counterfactual viewpoint changes, with frequent violations of cycle consistency and rapid decay in relational stability. We further evaluate multiple input representations, visual input, textual bounding boxes, and structured scene graphs, and show that increasing representational structure improves stability. Our results suggest that single-view spatial accuracy overestimates the robustness of induced spatial representations and that representation structure plays a critical role in counterfactual spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: MLLMs在单视角空间推理任务上表现良好，但在反事实视角变化下空间状态表示的稳定性存在问题，结构化表示能改善稳定性。
AI.motivation: 研究多模态大语言模型在反事实视角变化下是否保持稳定的空间状态表示，评估其空间推理的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入受控诊断基准，评估假设相机轨道变换下的关系一致性，使用100个合成场景和6000个关系查询，测量视角一致性、360°循环一致性和序列变换下的关系稳定性。
AI.result: 尽管单视角准确率高，但最先进的MLLMs在反事实视角变化下表现出系统性退化，频繁违反循环一致性，关系稳定性快速衰减。结构化表示（如场景图）能改善稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 单视角空间准确性高估了诱导空间表示的鲁棒性，表示结构在反事实空间推理中起关键作用。

title: Multiperspectivity as a Resource for Narrative Similarity Prediction
summary: Predicting narrative similarity can be understood as an inherently interpretive task: different, equally valid readings of the same text can produce divergent interpretations and thus different similarity judgments, posing a fundamental challenge for semantic evaluation benchmarks that encode a single ground truth. Rather than treating this multiperspectivity as a challenge to overcome, we propose to incorporate it in the decision making process of predictive systems. To explore this strategy, we created an ensemble of 31 LLM personas. These range from practitioners following interpretive frameworks to more intuitive, lay-style characters. Our experiments were conducted on the SemEval-2026 Task 4 dataset, where the system achieved an accuracy score of 0.705. Accuracy improves with ensemble size, consistent with Condorcet Jury Theorem-like dynamics under weakened independence. Practitioner personas perform worse individually but produce less correlated errors, yielding larger ensemble gains under majority voting. Our error analysis reveals a consistent negative association between gender-focused interpretive vocabulary and accuracy across all persona categories, suggesting either attention to dimensions not relevant for the benchmark or valid interpretations absent from the ground truth. This finding underscores the need for evaluation frameworks that account for interpretive plurality.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出通过集成多个LLM角色来应对叙事相似性评估中的多视角挑战，在SemEval-2026任务4数据集上达到0.705准确率，发现集成规模提升性能，实践者角色个体表现较差但误差相关性低，性别相关词汇与准确性呈负相关。
AI.motivation: 叙事相似性预测本质上是解释性任务，同一文本的不同有效解读会产生不同的相似性判断，这对编码单一真实标签的语义评估基准构成了根本挑战。研究旨在将这种多视角性纳入预测系统的决策过程中，而不是将其视为需要克服的障碍。
AI.method: 创建了31个LLM角色的集成系统，包括遵循解释框架的实践者和更直观的普通风格角色。在SemEval-2026 Task 4数据集上进行实验，采用多数投票机制，分析集成规模、角色类型对性能的影响，并进行误差分析。
AI.result: 系统达到0.705的准确率，集成规模增加时性能提升，符合弱化独立性下的Condorcet陪审团定理动态。实践者角色个体表现较差但产生较少相关误差，在多数投票下获得更大的集成增益。误差分析显示所有角色类别中，性别相关解释词汇与准确性呈一致的负相关。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了考虑解释多样性的评估框架的必要性，多视角集成方法能够有效应对叙事相似性评估中的解释性挑战，性别相关词汇的负相关可能表明基准未涵盖的有效解释维度，或注意力集中在不相关的维度上。

title: The Semantic Ladder: A Framework for Progressive Formalization of Natural Language Content for Knowledge Graphs and AI Systems
summary: Semantic data and knowledge infrastructures must reconcile two fundamentally different forms of representation: natural language, in which most knowledge is created and communicated, and formal semantic models, which enable machine-actionable integration, interoperability, and reasoning. Bridging this gap remains a central challenge, particularly when full semantic formalization is required at the point of data entry. Here, we introduce the Semantic Ladder, an architectural framework that enables the progressive formalization of data and knowledge. Building on the concept of modular semantic units as identifiable carriers of meaning, the framework organizes representations across levels of increasing semantic explicitness, ranging from natural language text snippets to ontology-based and higher-order logical models. Transformations between levels support semantic enrichment, statement structuring, and logical modelling while preserving semantic continuity and traceability. This approach enables the incremental construction of semantic knowledge spaces, reduces the semantic parsing burden, and supports the integration of heterogeneous representations, including natural language, structured semantic models, and vector-based embeddings. The Semantic Ladder thereby provides a foundation for scalable, interoperable, and AI-ready data and knowledge infrastructures.

AI.tldr: 提出"语义阶梯"架构框架，支持从自然语言到形式化语义模型的渐进式形式化，解决知识表示中的语言-形式化鸿沟问题
AI.motivation: 语义数据和知识基础设施需要调和两种根本不同的表示形式：自然语言（知识创建和传播的主要形式）和形式化语义模型（支持机器可操作的集成、互操作和推理）。弥合这一鸿沟是核心挑战，特别是在数据录入点需要完全语义形式化时
AI.method: 引入"语义阶梯"架构框架，基于模块化语义单元作为可识别意义载体，组织从自然语言文本片段到本体基础和高阶逻辑模型的不同语义明确性级别的表示。支持语义丰富化、陈述结构化和逻辑建模的层级间转换，同时保持语义连续性和可追溯性
AI.result: 该框架支持增量构建语义知识空间，减少语义解析负担，并支持异构表示（包括自然语言、结构化语义模型和基于向量的嵌入）的集成
AI.conclusion: 语义阶梯为可扩展、可互操作且AI就绪的数据和知识基础设施提供了基础，解决了自然语言与形式化语义模型之间的表示鸿沟问题

title: ReDiffuse: Rotation Equivariant Diffusion Model for Multi-focus Image Fusion
summary: Diffusion models have achieved impressive performance on multi-focus image fusion (MFIF). However, a key challenge in applying diffusion models to the ill-posed MFIF problem is that defocus blur can make common symmetric geometric structures (e.g., textures and edges) appear warped and deformed, often leading to unexpected artifacts in the fused images. Therefore, embedding rotation equivariance into diffusion networks is essential, as it enables the fusion results to faithfully preserve the original orientation and structural consistency of geometric patterns underlying the input images. Motivated by this, we propose ReDiffuse, a rotation-equivariant diffusion model for MFIF. Specifically, we carefully construct the basic diffusion architectures to achieve end-to-end rotation equivariance. We also provide a rigorous theoretical analysis to evaluate its intrinsic equivariance error, demonstrating the validity of embedding equivariance structures. ReDiffuse is comprehensively evaluated against various MFIF methods across four datasets (Lytro, MFFW, MFI-WHU, and Road-MF). Results demonstrate that ReDiffuse achieves competitive performance, with improvements of 0.28-6.64\% across six evaluation metrics. The code is available at https://github.com/MorvanLi/ReDiffuse.

AI.tldr: ReDiffuse是一个用于多焦点图像融合的旋转等变扩散模型，通过嵌入旋转等变性来解决传统扩散模型在处理失焦模糊时产生的几何结构扭曲问题。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型在多焦点图像融合中表现出色，但失焦模糊会导致对称几何结构（如纹理和边缘）出现扭曲变形，从而在融合图像中产生意外伪影。因此，将旋转等变性嵌入扩散网络至关重要，这能使融合结果忠实保留输入图像底层几何模式的原始方向和结构一致性。
AI.method: 提出ReDiffuse，一个用于多焦点图像融合的旋转等变扩散模型。精心构建基本扩散架构以实现端到端的旋转等变性，并提供严格的理论分析来评估其内在等变误差，证明嵌入等变结构的有效性。
AI.result: 在四个数据集（Lytro、MFFW、MFI-WHU和Road-MF）上全面评估ReDiffuse与各种多焦点图像融合方法。结果表明，ReDiffuse在六个评估指标上实现了0.28-6.64%的性能提升，具有竞争优势。
AI.conclusion: ReDiffuse通过嵌入旋转等变性有效解决了多焦点图像融合中几何结构扭曲的问题，在多个数据集上表现出优越性能，验证了等变结构嵌入的有效性。

title: Enhancing Document-Level Machine Translation via Filtered Synthetic Corpora and Two-Stage LLM Adaptation
summary: In Machine Translation, Large Language Models (LLMs) have generally underperformed compared to conventional encoder-decoder systems and thus see limited adoption. However, LLMs excel at modeling contextual information, making them a natural fit for document-level translation tasks where coherence across sentences is crucial. Despite this potential, document-level MT with LLMs faces two key challenges: (1) the scarcity of large-scale, high-quality document-level parallel data; and (2) the propensity of LLMs to introduce hallucinations and omissions during generation. To address these challenges, we propose a two-stage fine-tuning strategy leveraging LLM-augmented document-level data. First, we augment data by converting summarization data into document-level parallel data using a LLM, and then filter it using multiple metrics, leveraging sacreBLEU, COMET, and LaBSE-based cosine similarity-to improve data quality. Finally, we employ a two-stage fine-tuning strategy: first fine-tuning on the abundant sentence-level MT resources, and then on the filtered document-level corpus.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种两阶段微调策略，利用LLM增强文档级数据来解决文档级机器翻译中数据稀缺和幻觉问题
AI.motivation: LLM在机器翻译中表现通常不如传统编码器-解码器系统，但LLM擅长建模上下文信息，适合文档级翻译任务。然而文档级MT面临两大挑战：1) 大规模高质量文档级平行数据稀缺；2) LLM在生成时容易产生幻觉和遗漏
AI.method: 提出两阶段微调策略：首先使用LLM将摘要数据转换为文档级平行数据，然后使用sacreBLEU、COMET和LaBSE余弦相似度等多指标过滤以提高数据质量。最后采用两阶段微调：先在丰富的句子级MT资源上微调，然后在过滤后的文档级语料上微调
AI.result: 论文摘要未提供具体实验结果，但提出的方法旨在解决文档级机器翻译中的数据稀缺和质量问题
AI.conclusion: 通过LLM增强文档级数据和两阶段微调策略，可以克服文档级机器翻译中的数据稀缺和幻觉问题，提升LLM在文档级翻译任务中的性能

title: One Pool Is Not Enough: Multi-Cluster Memory for Practical Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Test-time adaptation (TTA) adapts pre-trained models to distribution shifts at inference using only unlabeled test data. Under the Practical TTA (PTTA) setting, where test streams are temporally correlated and non-i.i.d., memory has become an indispensable component for stable adaptation, yet existing methods universally store amples in a single unstructured pool. We show that this single-cluster design is fundamentally mismatched to PTTA: a stream clusterability analysis reveals that test streams are inherently multi-modal, with the optimal number of mixture components consistently far exceeding one. To close this structural gap, we propose Multi-Cluster Memory (MCM), a plug-and-play framework that organizes stored samples into multiple clusters using lightweight pixel-level statistical descriptors. MCM introduces three complementary mechanisms: descriptor-based cluster assignment to capture distinct distributional modes, Adjacent Cluster Consolidation (ACC) to bound memory usage by merging the most similar temporally adjacent clusters, and Uniform Cluster Retrieval (UCR) to ensure balanced supervision across all modes during adaptation. Integrated with three contemporary TTA methods on CIFAR-10-C, CIFAR-100-C, ImageNet-C, and DomainNet, MCM achieves consistent improvements across all 12 configurations, with gains up to 5.00% on ImageNet-C and 12.13% on DomainNet. Notably, these gains scale with distributional complexity: larger label spaces with greater multi-modality benefit most from multi-cluster organization. GMM-based memory diagnostics further confirm that MCM maintains near-optimal distributional balance, entropy, and mode coverage, whereas single-cluster memory exhibits persistent imbalance and progressive mode loss. These results establish memory organization as a key design axis for practical test-time adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MCM框架，通过多聚类内存组织解决实际测试时适应中单聚类设计与多模态测试流不匹配的问题，在多个数据集上取得显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有TTA方法在PTTA设置下普遍使用单聚类内存设计，但实际测试流具有多模态特性，这种结构不匹配限制了适应效果。
AI.method: 提出多聚类内存框架，包含三个机制：基于描述符的聚类分配、相邻聚类合并控制内存使用、均匀聚类检索确保平衡监督。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10-C、CIFAR-100-C、ImageNet-C和DomainNet上，MCM在12个配置中均取得一致改进，ImageNet-C提升达5.00%，DomainNet提升达12.13%。
AI.conclusion: 多聚类内存组织是实际测试时适应的关键设计维度，能有效维持分布平衡、熵和模态覆盖，而单聚类内存则存在持续不平衡和渐进模态丢失问题。

title: Gumbel Distillation for Parallel Text Generation
summary: The slow, sequential nature of autoregressive (AR) language models has driven the adoption of parallel decoding methods. However, these non-AR models often sacrifice generation quality as they struggle to model the complex joint distribution of token sequences. To narrow this performance gap, we introduce Gumbel Distillation, a novel distillation technique that enables parallel decoders to learn this distribution effectively. Our method leverages the Gumbel-Max trick to create a deterministic mapping from a latent Gumbel noise space to the output tokens of a high-performing AR teacher. As a model-agnostic technique, Gumbel Distillation seamlessly integrates with diverse parallel decoding architectures, including MDLM and BD3-LM. Experiments on LM1B and OpenWebText show that Gumbel Distillation substantially improves the generation quality of parallel language models, achieving a 30.0% improvement in MAUVE score and 10.5% in generative perplexity over MDLM trained on OpenWebText dataset. Code available at https://github.com/hxixixh/gumbel-distill.

AI.tldr: 提出Gumbel Distillation蒸馏技术，通过Gumbel-Max技巧建立确定性映射，让并行解码器从自回归教师模型学习token序列的联合分布，显著提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归语言模型生成速度慢，而并行解码方法虽然速度快但生成质量下降，因为它们难以建模token序列的复杂联合分布。
AI.method: 利用Gumbel-Max技巧创建从潜在Gumbel噪声空间到高性能自回归教师模型输出token的确定性映射，这是一种模型无关的蒸馏技术，可与多种并行解码架构集成。
AI.result: 在LM1B和OpenWebText数据集上的实验表明，Gumbel Distillation显著提升了并行语言模型的生成质量，在OpenWebText数据集上训练的MDLM模型上，MAUVE分数提升了30.0%，生成困惑度提升了10.5%。
AI.conclusion: Gumbel Distillation是一种有效的蒸馏技术，能够缩小并行解码器与自回归模型之间的性能差距，同时保持并行生成的速度优势。

title: MS-CustomNet: Controllable Multi-Subject Customization with Hierarchical Relational Semantics
summary: Diffusion-based text-to-image generation has advanced significantly, yet customizing scenes with multiple distinct subjects while maintaining fine-grained control over their interactions remains challenging. Existing methods often struggle to provide explicit user-defined control over the compositional structure and precise spatial relationships between subjects. To address this, we introduce MS-CustomNet, a novel framework for multi-subject customization. MS-CustomNet allows zero-shot integration of multiple user-provided objects and, crucially, empowers users to explicitly define these hierarchical arrangements and spatial placements within the generated image. Our approach ensures individual subject identity preservation while learning and enacting these user-specified inter-subject compositions. We also present the MSI dataset, derived from COCO, to facilitate training on such complex multi-subject compositions. MS-CustomNet offers enhanced, fine-grained control over multi-subject image generation. Our method achieves a DINO-I score of 0.61 for identity preservation and a YOLO-L score of 0.94 for positional control in multi-subject customization tasks, demonstrating its superior capability in generating high-fidelity images with precise, user-directed multi-subject compositions and spatial control.

AI.tldr: MS-CustomNet是一个用于多主体定制的新框架，允许零样本集成多个用户提供的对象，并让用户明确定义层次结构和空间关系，在保持个体身份的同时实现精确的多主体构图控制。
AI.motivation: 当前基于扩散的文本到图像生成方法在多主体场景定制方面存在不足，难以提供对构图结构和主体间空间关系的显式用户控制。现有方法在保持多个不同主体身份的同时，无法实现对它们交互关系的细粒度控制。
AI.method: 提出了MS-CustomNet框架，支持多主体零样本定制，允许用户显式定义层次安排和空间布局。该方法在保持个体主体身份的同时，学习和执行用户指定的主体间构图关系。还创建了基于COCO的MSI数据集来训练复杂的多主体构图。
AI.result: 在多主体定制任务中，MS-CustomNet获得了0.61的DINO-I身份保持分数和0.94的YOLO-L位置控制分数，表明其在生成具有精确用户导向多主体构图和空间控制的高保真图像方面具有优越能力。
AI.conclusion: MS-CustomNet为多主体图像生成提供了增强的细粒度控制，能够生成具有精确用户导向构图和空间关系的高质量图像，解决了现有方法在多主体定制方面的局限性。

title: Incentivizing Generative Zero-Shot Learning via Outcome-Reward Reinforcement Learning with Visual Cues
summary: Recent advances in zero-shot learning (ZSL) have demonstrated the potential of generative models. Typically, generative ZSL synthesizes visual features conditioned on semantic prototypes to model the data distribution of unseen classes, followed by training a classifier on the synthesized data. However, the synthesized features often remain task-agnostic, leading to degraded performance. Moreover, inferring a faithful distribution from semantic prototypes alone is insufficient for classes that are semantically similar but visually distinct. To address these and advance ZSL, we propose RLVC, an outcome-reward reinforcement learning RL framework with visual cues for generative ZSL. At its core, RL empowers the generative model to self-evolve, implicitly enhancing its generation capability. In particular, RLVC updates the generative model using an outcome-based reward, encouraging the synthesis of task-relevant features. Furthermore, we introduce class-wise visual cues that (i) align synthesized features with visual prototypes and (ii) stabilize the RL training updates. For the training process, we present a novel cold-start strategy. Comprehensive experiments and analyses on three prevalent ZSL benchmarks demonstrate that RLVC achieves state-of-the-art results with a 4.7% gain.

AI.tldr: 提出RLVC框架，通过强化学习优化生成式零样本学习，利用视觉线索和基于结果的奖励机制提升特征生成质量，在三个基准测试上实现4.7%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 当前生成式零样本学习中，合成的视觉特征通常是任务无关的，导致性能下降。同时，仅从语义原型推断分布对于语义相似但视觉差异大的类别不够充分。
AI.method: 提出RLVC框架：1) 使用基于结果的奖励强化学习，鼓励生成任务相关特征；2) 引入类别级视觉线索，对齐合成特征与视觉原型并稳定训练；3) 提出新颖的冷启动策略。
AI.result: 在三个主流零样本学习基准测试上取得了最先进的结果，性能提升了4.7%。
AI.conclusion: RLVC框架通过强化学习自我进化生成模型，结合视觉线索和基于结果的奖励机制，有效解决了生成式零样本学习中特征合成质量不足的问题。

title: MemDLM: Memory-Enhanced DLM Training
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer attractive advantages over Auto-Regressive (AR) models, such as full-attention parallel decoding and flexible generation. However, they suffer from a notable train-inference mismatch: DLMs are trained with a static, single-step masked prediction objective, but deployed through a multi-step progressive denoising trajectory. We propose MemDLM (Memory-Enhanced DLM), which narrows this gap by embedding a simulated denoising process into training via Bi-level Optimization. An inner loop updates a set of fast weights, forming a Parametric Memory that captures the local trajectory experience of each sample, while an outer loop updates the base model conditioned on this memory. By offloading memorization pressure from token representations to parameters, MemDLM yields faster convergence and lower training loss. Moreover, the inner loop can be re-enabled at inference time as an adaptation step, yielding additional gains on long-context understanding. We find that, when activated at inference time, this Parametric Memory acts as an emergent in-weight retrieval mechanism, helping MemDLM further reduce token-level attention bottlenecks on challenging Needle-in-a-Haystack retrieval tasks. Code: https://github.com/JarvisPei/MemDLM.

AI.tldr: MemDLM通过双层优化将模拟去噪过程嵌入训练，使用参数化记忆捕获样本轨迹经验，缩小扩散语言模型的训练-推理差距，提升收敛速度和长上下文理解能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型(DLMs)相比自回归模型具有并行解码和灵活生成的优势，但存在显著的训练-推理不匹配问题：DLMs使用静态单步掩码预测目标训练，却通过多步渐进去噪轨迹部署。
AI.method: 提出MemDLM，通过双层优化将模拟去噪过程嵌入训练。内循环更新快速权重形成参数化记忆，捕获每个样本的局部轨迹经验；外循环基于该记忆更新基础模型。将记忆压力从词元表示卸载到参数。
AI.result: MemDLM实现了更快的收敛速度和更低的训练损失。推理时重新启用内循环作为适应步骤，在长上下文理解上获得额外增益。参数化记忆在推理时表现为涌现的权重内检索机制，在Needle-in-a-Haystack检索任务上减少词元级注意力瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: MemDLM通过参数化记忆和双层优化有效缩小了扩散语言模型的训练-推理差距，提升了模型性能和长上下文理解能力，同时揭示了参数化记忆作为权重内检索机制的新颖特性。

title: GIDE: Unlocking Diffusion LLMs for Precise Training-Free Image Editing
summary: While Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multi-modal generation, performing precise, training-free image editing remains an open challenge. Unlike continuous diffusion models, the discrete tokenization inherent in DLLMs hinders the application of standard noise inversion techniques, often leading to structural degradation during editing. In this paper, we introduce GIDE (Grounded Inversion for DLLM Image Editing), a unified framework designed to bridge this gap. GIDE incorporates a novel Discrete Noise Inversion mechanism that accurately captures latent noise patterns within the discrete token space, ensuring high-fidelity reconstruction. We then decompose the editing pipeline into grounding, inversion, and refinement stages. This design enables GIDE supporting various editing instructions (text, point and box) and operations while strictly preserving the unedited background. Furthermore, to overcome the limitations of existing single-step evaluation protocols, we introduce GIDE-Bench, a rigorous benchmark comprising 805 compositional editing scenarios guided by diverse multi-modal inputs. Extensive experiments on GIDE-Bench demonstrate that GIDE significantly outperforms prior training-free methods, improving Semantic Correctness by 51.83% and Perceptual Quality by 50.39%. Additional evaluations on ImgEdit-Bench confirm its broad applicability, demonstrating consistent gains over trained baselines and yielding photorealistic consistency on par with leading models.

AI.tldr: GIDE是一个用于扩散大语言模型图像编辑的统一框架，通过离散噪声反演机制解决DLLM中精确训练免费编辑的挑战，支持多种编辑指令并保持背景不变，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型在多模态生成方面表现出色，但在精确、无需训练的图片编辑方面仍面临挑战。由于DLLM固有的离散标记化特性，阻碍了标准噪声反演技术的应用，导致编辑过程中结构退化。
AI.method: GIDE框架包含三个主要阶段：1）离散噪声反演机制，在离散标记空间中准确捕捉潜在噪声模式；2）将编辑流程分解为定位、反演和细化阶段；3）支持文本、点和框等多种编辑指令，同时严格保护未编辑背景。
AI.result: 在GIDE-Bench基准测试（包含805个组合编辑场景）上，GIDE显著优于现有训练免费方法，语义正确性提升51.83%，感知质量提升50.39%。在ImgEdit-Bench上的评估也显示其优于训练基线，并达到与领先模型相当的照片级一致性。
AI.conclusion: GIDE成功解决了DLLM中训练免费图像编辑的挑战，通过离散噪声反演机制实现了高保真重建，支持多模态编辑指令，并在多个基准测试中表现出卓越性能，为DLLM图像编辑提供了有效的统一框架。

title: TiCo: Time-Controllable Training for Spoken Dialogue Models
summary: We propose TiCo, a simple post-training method for enabling spoken dialogue models (SDMs) to follow time-constrained instructions and generate responses with controllable duration. This capability is valuable for real-world spoken language systems such as voice assistants and interactive agents, where controlling response duration can improve interaction quality. However, despite their strong ability to generate natural spoken responses, existing models lack time awareness and struggle to follow duration-related instructions (e.g., "Please generate a response lasting about 15 seconds"). Through an empirical evaluation of both open-source and commercial SDMs, we show that they frequently fail to satisfy such time-control requirements. TiCo addresses this limitation by enabling models to estimate elapsed speaking time during generation through Spoken Time Markers (STM) (e.g., <10.6 seconds>). These markers help the model maintain awareness of time and adjust the remaining content to meet the target duration. TiCo is simple and efficient: it requires only a small amount of data and no additional question-answer pairs, relying instead on self-generation and reinforcement learning. Experimental results show that TiCo significantly improves adherence to duration constraints while preserving response quality.

AI.tldr: TiCo是一种简单的后训练方法，使语音对话模型能够遵循时间约束指令并生成可控时长的响应，通过语音时间标记帮助模型在生成过程中估计已用时间。
AI.motivation: 现实世界的语音系统（如语音助手和交互代理）需要控制响应时长以提高交互质量，但现有语音对话模型缺乏时间意识，难以遵循时长相关指令。
AI.method: TiCo通过语音时间标记（如<10.6秒>）使模型在生成过程中估计已用说话时间，帮助模型保持时间意识并调整剩余内容以满足目标时长。该方法简单高效，仅需少量数据且无需额外问答对，依赖自生成和强化学习。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，TiCo显著提高了对时长约束的遵循度，同时保持了响应质量。
AI.conclusion: TiCo成功解决了语音对话模型缺乏时间意识的问题，为语音系统提供了可控时长的响应生成能力，改善了交互质量。

title: DSCSNet: A Dynamic Sparse Compression Sensing Network for Closely-Spaced Infrared Small Target Unmixing
summary: Due to the limitations of optical lens focal length and detector resolution, distant clustered infrared small targets often appear as mixed spots. The Close Small Object Unmixing (CSOU) task aims to recover the number, sub-pixel positions, and radiant intensities of individual targets from these spots, which is a highly ill-posed inverse problem. Existing methods struggle to balance the rigorous sparsity guarantees of model-driven approaches and the dynamic scene adaptability of data-driven methods. To address this dilemma, this paper proposes a Dynamic Sparse Compressed Sensing Network (DSCSNet), a deep-unfolded network that couples the Alternating Direction Method of Multipliers (ADMM) with learnable parameters. Specifically, we embed a strict $\ell_1$-norm sparsity constraint into the auxiliary variable update step of ADMM to replace the traditional $\ell_2$-norm smoothness-promoting terms, which effectively preserves the discrete energy peaks of small targets. We also integrate a self-attention-based dynamic thresholding mechanism into the reconstruction stage, which adaptively adjusts the sparsification intensity using the sparsity-enhanced information from the iterative process. These modules are jointly optimized end-to-end across the three iterative steps of ADMM. Retaining the physical logic of compressed sensing, DSCSNet achieves robust sparsity induction and scene adaptability, thus enhancing the unmixing accuracy and generalization in complex infrared scenarios. Extensive experiments on the synthetic infrared dataset CSIST-100K demonstrate that DSCSNet outperforms state-of-the-art methods in key metrics such as CSO-mAP and sub-pixel localization error.

AI.tldr: 提出DSCSNet网络，将ADMM算法与可学习参数结合，解决红外小目标分离问题，在稀疏性保证和场景适应性间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 由于光学镜头焦距和探测器分辨率限制，远距离集群红外小目标常呈现为混合斑点。现有方法难以平衡模型驱动方法的严格稀疏性保证和数据驱动方法的动态场景适应性。
AI.method: 提出动态稀疏压缩感知网络(DSCSNet)，将ADMM算法展开为深度网络并嵌入可学习参数。在ADMM辅助变量更新步骤中嵌入严格的ℓ₁范数稀疏约束，替代传统的ℓ₂范数平滑项；在重建阶段集成基于自注意力的动态阈值机制，自适应调整稀疏化强度。
AI.result: 在合成红外数据集CSIST-100K上的大量实验表明，DSCSNet在CSO-mAP和亚像素定位误差等关键指标上优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: DSCSNet在保持压缩感知物理逻辑的同时，实现了鲁棒的稀疏性诱导和场景适应性，提高了复杂红外场景下的分离精度和泛化能力。

title: Boundary-Aware Instance Segmentation in Microscopy Imaging
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2026
summary:
Accurate delineation of individual cells in microscopy videos is essential for studying cellular dynamics, yet separating touching or overlapping instances remains a persistent challenge. Although foundation-model for segmentation such as SAM have broadened the accessibility of image segmentation, they still struggle to separate nearby cell instances in dense microscopy scenes without extensive prompting.
  We propose a prompt-free, boundary-aware instance segmentation framework that predicts signed distance functions (SDFs) instead of binary masks, enabling smooth and geometry-consistent modeling of cell contours. A learned sigmoid mapping converts SDFs into probability maps, yielding sharp boundary localization and robust separation of adjacent instances. Training is guided by a unified Modified Hausdorff Distance (MHD) loss that integrates region- and boundary-based terms.
  Evaluations on both public and private high-throughput microscopy datasets demonstrate improved boundary accuracy and instance-level performance compared to recent SAM-based and foundation-model approaches. Source code is available at: https://github.com/ThomasMendelson/BAISeg.git

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无提示、边界感知的实例分割框架，通过预测有符号距离函数（SDFs）来精确分离显微镜视频中接触或重叠的细胞实例，相比SAM等基础模型在密集场景中表现更优。
AI.motivation: 显微镜视频中细胞实例的精确分割对于研究细胞动力学至关重要，但分离接触或重叠的细胞实例仍然是一个持续挑战。虽然像SAM这样的基础分割模型拓宽了图像分割的可访问性，但在没有大量提示的情况下，它们仍然难以分离密集显微镜场景中相邻的细胞实例。
AI.method: 提出了一种无提示、边界感知的实例分割框架，预测有符号距离函数（SDFs）而不是二进制掩码，实现对细胞轮廓的平滑和几何一致性建模。通过学习的sigmoid映射将SDFs转换为概率图，产生锐利的边界定位和相邻实例的鲁棒分离。训练由统一的改进Hausdorff距离（MHD）损失指导，该损失整合了基于区域和边界的项。
AI.result: 在公共和私有高通量显微镜数据集上的评估表明，与最近的基于SAM的方法和基础模型方法相比，该方法在边界精度和实例级性能方面都有所改进。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种有效的无提示实例分割方法，通过SDF建模和改进的损失函数，在密集细胞场景中实现了更好的边界精度和实例分离性能，为显微镜图像分析提供了实用工具。

title: JANUS: A Lightweight Framework for Jailbreaking Text-to-Image Models via Distribution Optimization
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models such as Stable Diffusion and DALLE remain susceptible to generating harmful or Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content under jailbreak attacks despite deployed safety filters. Existing jailbreak attacks either rely on proxy-loss optimization instead of the true end-to-end objective, or depend on large-scale and costly RL-trained generators. Motivated by these limitations, we propose JANUS , a lightweight framework that formulates jailbreak as optimizing a structured prompt distribution under a black-box, end-to-end reward from the T2I system and its safety filters. JANUS replaces a high-capacity generator with a low-dimensional mixing policy over two semantically anchored prompt distributions, enabling efficient exploration while preserving the target semantics. On modern T2I models, we outperform state-of-the-art jailbreak methods, improving ASR-8 from 25.30% to 43.15% on Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo with consistently higher CLIP and NSFW scores. JANUS succeeds across both open-source and commercial models. These findings expose structural weaknesses in current T2I safety pipelines and motivate stronger, distribution-aware defenses. Warning: This paper contains model outputs that may be offensive.

AI.tldr: JANUS是一种轻量级框架，通过优化结构化提示分布在黑盒端到端奖励下实现文本到图像模型的越狱攻击，相比现有方法效果更好且更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像模型的越狱攻击方法存在两个主要问题：要么依赖代理损失优化而非真正的端到端目标，要么需要大规模且昂贵的RL训练生成器。这些限制促使研究者开发更高效、更有效的越狱方法。
AI.method: JANUS框架将越狱攻击形式化为在文本到图像系统及其安全过滤器提供的黑盒端到端奖励下优化结构化提示分布。它用两个语义锚定提示分布上的低维混合策略替代高容量生成器，实现高效探索同时保持目标语义。
AI.result: 在现代文本到图像模型上，JANUS超越了最先进的越狱方法，将Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large Turbo的ASR-8从25.30%提升到43.15%，同时保持更高的CLIP和NSFW分数。该方法在开源和商业模型上都取得了成功。
AI.conclusion: JANUS的成功暴露了当前文本到图像安全管道的结构性弱点，表明需要更强、分布感知的防御措施来应对这类越狱攻击。

title: Positional Segmentor-Guided Counterfactual Fine-Tuning for Spatially Localized Image Synthesis
summary: Counterfactual image generation enables controlled data augmentation, bias mitigation, and disease modeling. However, existing methods guided by external classifiers or regressors are limited to subject-level factors (e.g., age) and fail to produce localized structural changes, often resulting in global artifacts. Pixel-level guidance using segmentation masks has been explored, but requires user-defined counterfactual masks, which are tedious and impractical. Segmentor-guided Counterfactual Fine-Tuning (Seg-CFT) addressed this by using segmentation-derived measurements to supervise structure-specific variables, yet it remains restricted to global interventions. We propose Positional Seg-CFT, which subdivides each structure into regional segments and derives independent measurements per region, enabling spatially localized and anatomically coherent counterfactuals. Experiments on coronary CT angiography show that Pos-Seg-CFT generates realistic, region-specific modifications, providing finer spatial control for modeling disease progression.

AI.tldr: 提出Positional Seg-CFT方法，通过将解剖结构细分为区域片段并独立测量，实现空间局部化且解剖一致的反事实图像生成，相比现有方法提供更精细的空间控制。
AI.motivation: 现有反事实图像生成方法存在局限性：基于外部分类器/回归器的方法只能处理主体级因素（如年龄），无法产生局部结构变化且常产生全局伪影；基于分割掩码的方法需要用户定义反事实掩码，繁琐不实用；Seg-CFT方法虽然使用分割测量监督结构特定变量，但仍限于全局干预。
AI.method: 提出Positional Seg-CFT方法，将每个解剖结构细分为区域片段，为每个区域派生独立测量值，从而实现空间局部化和解剖一致的反事实生成。该方法在冠状动脉CT血管造影数据上进行实验验证。
AI.result: 实验表明，Pos-Seg-CFT能够生成真实、区域特定的修改，为疾病进展建模提供更精细的空间控制。相比现有方法，该方法能够产生空间局部化且解剖一致的反事实图像。
AI.conclusion: Positional Seg-CFT通过区域细分和独立测量，实现了空间局部化的反事实图像生成，为疾病建模提供了更精细的空间控制能力，克服了现有方法的局限性。

title: Reframing Long-Tailed Learning via Loss Landscape Geometry
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026. 11 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables
summary: Balancing performance trade-off on long-tail (LT) data distributions remains a long-standing challenge. In this paper, we posit that this dilemma stems from a phenomenon called "tail performance degradation" (the model tends to severely overfit on head classes while quickly forgetting tail classes) and pose a solution from a loss landscape perspective. We observe that different classes possess divergent convergence points in the loss landscape. Besides, this divergence is aggravated when the model settles into sharp and non-robust minima, rather than a shared and flat solution that is beneficial for all classes. In light of this, we propose a continual learning inspired framework to prevent "tail performance degradation". To avoid inefficient per-class parameter preservation, a Grouped Knowledge Preservation module is proposed to memorize group-specific convergence parameters, promoting convergence towards a shared solution. Concurrently, our framework integrates a Grouped Sharpness Aware module to seek flatter minima by explicitly addressing the geometry of the loss landscape. Notably, our framework requires neither external training samples nor pre-trained models, facilitating the broad applicability. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate significant performance gains over state-of-the-art methods. The code is available at:https://gkp-gsa.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出GKP-GSA框架解决长尾数据分布中的性能权衡问题，通过分组知识保存和分组锐度感知模块，避免尾部性能退化，无需外部数据或预训练模型。
AI.motivation: 长尾数据分布中性能权衡的长期挑战源于"尾部性能退化"现象：模型容易在头部类别上过拟合，同时快速遗忘尾部类别。从损失景观视角看，不同类别在损失景观中具有不同的收敛点，当模型陷入尖锐、非鲁棒的最小值时，这种差异会加剧。
AI.method: 提出受持续学习启发的GKP-GSA框架：1) 分组知识保存模块：记忆组特定的收敛参数，促进向共享解决方案的收敛，避免低效的逐类参数保存；2) 分组锐度感知模块：通过显式处理损失景观的几何形状来寻找更平坦的最小值。框架无需外部训练样本或预训练模型。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试上进行了广泛实验，相比最先进方法取得了显著的性能提升。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过损失景观视角分析长尾学习问题，提出的GKP-GSA框架能有效防止尾部性能退化，促进模型收敛到对各类别都有益的共享平坦解决方案，具有广泛适用性。

title: A Large-Scale Remote Sensing Dataset and VLM-based Algorithm for Fine-Grained Road Hierarchy Classification
summary: In this work, we present SYSU-HiRoads, a large-scale hierarchical road dataset, and RoadReasoner, a vision-language-geometry framework for automatic multi-grade road mapping from remote sensing imagery. SYSU-HiRoads is built from GF-2 imagery covering 3631 km2 in Henan Province, China, and contains 1079 image tiles at 0.8 m spatial resolution. Each tile is annotated with dense road masks, vectorized centerlines, and three-level hierarchy labels, enabling the joint training and evaluation of segmentation, topology reconstruction, and hierarchy classification. Building on this dataset, RoadReasoner is designed to generate robust road surface masks, topology-preserving road networks, and semantically coherent hierarchy assignments. We strengthen road feature representation and network connectivity by explicitly enhancing frequency-sensitive cues and multi-scale context. Moreover, we perform hierarchy inference at the skeleton-segment level with geometric descriptors and geometry-aware textual prompts, queried by vision-language models to obtain linguistically interpretable grade decisions. Experiments on SYSU-HiRoads and the CHN6-CUG dataset show that RoadReasoner surpasses state-of-the-art road extraction baselines and produces accurate and semantically consistent road hierarchy maps with 72.6% OA, 64.2% F1 score, and 60.6% SegAcc. The dataset and code will be publicly released to support automated transport infrastructure mapping, road inventory updating, and broader infrastructure management applications.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了SYSU-HiRoads大规模分层道路数据集和RoadReasoner视觉-语言-几何框架，用于从遥感影像自动生成多等级道路地图
AI.motivation: 现有道路提取方法通常只关注道路分割或拓扑重建，缺乏对道路等级层次结构的理解，这限制了其在交通基础设施管理和道路库存更新中的应用。需要一种能够同时处理道路表面分割、拓扑重建和层次分类的综合解决方案。
AI.method:
1. 构建SYSU-HiRoads数据集：基于GF-2影像，覆盖3631平方公里，包含1079个0.8米分辨率图像块，标注了密集道路掩码、矢量化中心线和三级层次标签。
2. 开发RoadReasoner框架：通过增强频率敏感线索和多尺度上下文来加强道路特征表示和网络连通性。
3. 层次推理：在骨架段级别使用几何描述符和几何感知文本提示，通过视觉语言模型查询获得语言可解释的等级决策。
AI.result: 在SYSU-HiRoads和CHN6-CUG数据集上的实验表明，RoadReasoner超越了最先进的道路提取基线方法，生成了准确且语义一致的道路层次地图，达到72.6%的总体准确率、64.2%的F1分数和60.6%的分割准确率。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一个综合的数据集和框架，能够同时进行道路分割、拓扑重建和层次分类，为自动化交通基础设施制图、道路库存更新和更广泛的基础设施管理应用提供了有力支持。数据集和代码将公开释放以促进相关研究。

title: Plant Taxonomy Meets Plant Counting: A Fine-Grained, Taxonomic Dataset for Counting Hundreds of Plant Species
comment: Accepted by CVPR 2026. Project page: https://github.com/tiny-smart/TPC-268
summary: Visually cataloging and quantifying the natural world requires pushing the boundaries of both detailed visual classification and counting at scale. Despite significant progress, particularly in crowd and traffic analysis, the fine-grained, taxonomy-aware plant counting remains underexplored in vision. In contrast to crowds, plants exhibit nonrigid morphologies and physical appearance variations across growth stages and environments. To fill this gap, we present TPC-268, the first plant counting benchmark incorporating plant taxonomy. Our dataset couples instance-level point annotations with Linnaean labels (kingdom -> species) and organ categories, enabling hierarchical reasoning and species-aware evaluation. The dataset features 10,000 images with 678,050 point annotations, includes 268 countable plant categories over 242 plant species in Plantae and Fungi, and spans observation scales from canopy-level remote sensing imagery to tissue-level microscopy. We follow the problem setting of class-agnostic counting (CAC), provide taxonomy-consistent, scale-aware data splits, and benchmark state-of-the-art regression- and detection-based CAC approaches. By capturing the biodiversity, hierarchical structure, and multi-scale nature of botanical and mycological taxa, TPC-268 provides a biologically grounded testbed to advance fine-grained class-agnostic counting. Dataset and code are available at https://github.com/tiny-smart/TPC-268.

AI.tldr: TPC-268是首个结合植物分类学的植物计数基准数据集，包含10,000张图像、678,050个点标注，涵盖268个可计数植物类别和242个物种，支持从冠层遥感图像到组织显微图像的多尺度分析。
AI.motivation: 当前视觉领域在人群和交通计数方面已有显著进展，但针对植物的细粒度、分类学感知的计数研究仍然不足。植物具有非刚性形态，在不同生长阶段和环境条件下外观变化大，需要专门的基准数据集来推动这一领域发展。
AI.method: 构建TPC-268数据集，包含实例级点标注、林奈分类标签（界->种）和器官类别，支持分层推理和物种感知评估。采用类无关计数（CAC）问题设置，提供分类学一致、尺度感知的数据划分，并对最先进的回归和检测基CAC方法进行基准测试。
AI.result: 数据集包含10,000张图像、678,050个点标注，涵盖268个可计数植物类别、242个植物和真菌物种，观测尺度从冠层级遥感图像到组织级显微图像。为细粒度类无关计数提供了生物学基础测试平台。
AI.conclusion: TPC-268通过捕捉生物多样性、分层结构和多尺度特性，为推进细粒度类无关计数提供了生物学基础测试平台，填补了植物计数基准的空白。数据集和代码已开源。

title: QMoP: Query Guided Mixture-of-Projector for Efficient Visual Token Compression
summary: Multimodal large language models suffer from severe computational and memory bottlenecks, as the number of visual tokens far exceeds that of textual tokens. While recent methods employ projector modules to align and compress visual tokens into text-aligned features, they typically depend on fixed heuristics that limit adaptability across diverse scenarios. In this paper, we first propose Query Guided Mixture-of-Projector (QMoP), a novel and flexible framework that adaptively compresses visual tokens via three collaborative branches: (1) a pooling-based branch for coarse-grained global semantics, (2) a resampler branch for extracting high-level semantic representations, and (3) a pruning-based branch for fine-grained token selection to preserve critical visual detail. To adaptively coordinate these branches, we introduce the Query Guided Router (QGR), which dynamically selects and weights the outputs from different branches based on both visual input and textual queries. A Mixture-of-Experts-style fusion mechanism is designed to aggregate the outputs, harnessing the strengths of each strategy while suppressing noise. To systematically evaluate the effects of Visual Token Compression, we also develop VTCBench, a dedicated benchmark for evaluating the information loss induced by visual token compression. Extensive experiments demonstrate that despite relying on fundamental compression modules, QMoP outperforms strong baselines and delivers significant savings in memory, computation, and inference time.

AI.tldr: QMoP提出了一种自适应视觉令牌压缩框架，通过三个协作分支和查询引导路由器动态压缩视觉令牌，显著降低多模态大语言模型的计算和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型面临严重的计算和内存瓶颈，因为视觉令牌数量远超过文本令牌。现有方法通常依赖固定启发式方法，限制了在不同场景下的适应性。
AI.method: 提出了查询引导混合投影器(QMoP)框架，包含三个协作分支：基于池化的粗粒度全局语义分支、重采样器的高层语义表示分支、基于剪枝的细粒度令牌选择分支。通过查询引导路由器(QGR)动态选择和加权不同分支输出，采用专家混合式融合机制聚合结果。
AI.result: 实验表明，尽管依赖基础压缩模块，QMoP优于强基线方法，在内存、计算和推理时间方面带来显著节省。同时开发了VTCBench基准来系统评估视觉令牌压缩的信息损失。
AI.conclusion: QMoP提供了一种灵活有效的视觉令牌压缩解决方案，通过自适应分支协调和融合机制，在保持关键视觉细节的同时显著降低计算开销。

title: DepthTCM: High Efficient Depth Compression via Physics-aware Transformer-CNN Mixed Architecture
summary: We propose DepthTCM, a physics-aware end-to-end framework for depth map compression. In our framework of DepthTCM, the high-bit depth map is first converted to a conventional 3-channel image representation losslessly using a method inspired by a physical sinusoidal fringe pattern based profiliometry system, then the 3-channel color image is encoded and decoded by a recently developed Transformer-CNN mixed neural network architecture. Specifically, DepthTCM maps depth to a smooth 3-channel using multiwavelength depth (MWD) encoding, then globally quantized the MWD encoded representation to 4 bits per channel to reduce entropy, and finally is compressed using a learned codec that combines convolutional and Transformer layers. Experiment results demonstrate the advantage of our proposed method. On Middlebury 2014, DepthTCM reaches 0.307 bpp while preserving 99.38% accuracy, a level of fidelity commensurate with lossless PNG. We additionally demonstrate practical efficiency and scalability, reporting average end-to-end inference times of 41.48 ms (encoder) and 47.45 ms (decoder) on the ScanNet++ iPhone RGB-D subset. Ablations validate our design choices: relative to 8-bit quantization, 4-bit quantization reduces bitrate by 66% while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality, with only a marginal 0.68 dB PSNR change and a 0.04% accuracy difference. In addition, Transformer--CNN blocks further improve PSNR by up to 0.75 dB over CNN-only architectures.

AI.tldr: DepthTCM是一个基于物理感知的端到端深度图压缩框架，通过多波长深度编码将高比特深度图无损转换为3通道图像，然后使用Transformer-CNN混合神经网络进行压缩，在保持高精度的同时显著降低比特率。
AI.motivation: 深度图压缩在计算机视觉和机器人应用中至关重要，但传统方法难以在保持高精度的同时实现高效压缩。需要一种既能保留深度信息物理特性，又能利用现代神经网络优势的压缩方法。
AI.method: 1. 使用多波长深度编码将高比特深度图无损转换为3通道图像表示；2. 对MWD编码表示进行全局量化至每通道4比特以降低熵；3. 采用结合卷积和Transformer层的学习编解码器进行压缩。
AI.result: 在Middlebury 2014数据集上达到0.307 bpp，同时保持99.38%的精度；在ScanNet++ iPhone RGB-D子集上，平均端到端推理时间为编码41.48ms，解码47.45ms；4比特量化相比8比特减少66%比特率，PSNR仅下降0.68dB；Transformer-CNN块相比纯CNN架构提升PSNR达0.75dB。
AI.conclusion: DepthTCM框架成功实现了深度图的高效压缩，在保持接近无损PNG质量的同时显著降低比特率，证明了物理感知编码与Transformer-CNN混合架构的有效结合。

title: When Models Judge Themselves: Unsupervised Self-Evolution for Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Recent progress in multimodal large language models has led to strong performance on reasoning tasks, but these improvements largely rely on high-quality annotated data or teacher-model distillation, both of which are costly and difficult to scale.To address this, we propose an unsupervised self-evolution training framework for multimodal reasoning that achieves stable performance improvements without using human-annotated answers or external reward models. For each input, we sample multiple reasoning trajectories and jointly model their within group structure.We use the Actor's self-consistency signal as a training prior, and introduce a bounded Judge based modulation to continuously reweight trajectories of different quality.We further model the modulated scores as a group level distribution and convert absolute scores into relative advantages within each group, enabling more robust policy updates. Trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) on unlabeled data, our method consistently improves reasoning performance and generalization on five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, offering a scalable path toward self-evolving multimodal models.The code are available at https://dingwu1021.github.io/SelfJudge/.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督自进化训练框架，通过组内相对策略优化提升多模态推理性能，无需人工标注或外部奖励模型
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大语言模型的推理能力提升主要依赖高质量标注数据或教师模型蒸馏，这两种方法成本高昂且难以扩展。需要一种无需人工标注的无监督方法来提升多模态推理能力。
AI.method: 提出无监督自进化训练框架，对每个输入采样多个推理轨迹并建模其组内结构。使用Actor的自一致性信号作为训练先验，引入有界Judge调制机制持续重新加权不同质量的轨迹。将调制后的分数建模为组级分布，将绝对分数转换为组内相对优势，实现更稳健的策略更新。使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）在未标注数据上进行训练。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准测试中，该方法持续提升了推理性能和泛化能力，为自进化多模态模型提供了可扩展的路径。
AI.conclusion: 提出的无监督自进化训练框架通过组相对策略优化，能够在无需人工标注答案或外部奖励模型的情况下，稳定提升多模态推理性能，为构建可扩展的自进化多模态模型提供了有效方案。

title: Text-Image Conditioned 3D Generation
comment: CVPR 2026. Project page: https://jumpat.github.io/tigon-page Code: https://github.com/Jumpat/tigon
summary: High-quality 3D assets are essential for VR/AR, industrial design, and entertainment, motivating growing interest in generative models that create 3D content from user prompts. Most existing 3D generators, however, rely on a single conditioning modality: image-conditioned models achieve high visual fidelity by exploiting pixel-aligned cues but suffer from viewpoint bias when the input view is limited or ambiguous, while text-conditioned models provide broad semantic guidance yet lack low-level visual detail. This limits how users can express intent and raises a natural question: can these two modalities be combined for more flexible and faithful 3D generation? Our diagnostic study shows that even simple late fusion of text- and image-conditioned predictions outperforms single-modality models, revealing strong cross-modal complementarity. We therefore formalize Text-Image Conditioned 3D Generation, which requires joint reasoning over a visual exemplar and a textual specification. To address this task, we introduce TIGON, a minimalist dual-branch baseline with separate image- and text-conditioned backbones and lightweight cross-modal fusion. Extensive experiments show that text-image conditioning consistently improves over single-modality methods, highlighting complementary vision-language guidance as a promising direction for future 3D generation research. Project page: https://jumpat.github.io/tigon-page

AI.tldr: TIGON提出了一种结合文本和图像双模态条件的3D生成方法，通过简单的双分支架构和跨模态融合，解决了单模态方法在视觉保真度和语义指导方面的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型主要依赖单一条件模态：图像条件模型虽然能实现高视觉保真度，但在输入视角有限或模糊时存在视角偏差；文本条件模型提供广泛的语义指导，但缺乏低层次视觉细节。这限制了用户表达意图的能力，需要探索如何结合两种模态实现更灵活和准确的3D生成。
AI.method: 提出了TIGON方法，这是一个极简的双分支基线架构，包含独立的图像条件分支和文本条件分支，以及轻量级的跨模态融合模块。该方法将文本-图像条件3D生成形式化为一个需要同时考虑视觉示例和文本规范的任务。
AI.result: 诊断研究表明，即使是简单的文本和图像条件预测的后期融合也能超越单模态模型，显示出强烈的跨模态互补性。大量实验证明，文本-图像条件化方法在多个指标上持续优于单模态方法。
AI.conclusion: 文本-图像条件化显著提升了3D生成性能，突出了视觉-语言互补指导作为未来3D生成研究的有前景方向。TIGON作为一个简单有效的基线，为多模态3D生成提供了新的思路。

title: BHDD: A Burmese Handwritten Digit Dataset
comment: 4 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Dataset available at https://github.com/baseresearch/BHDD
summary: We introduce the Burmese Handwritten Digit Dataset (BHDD), a collection of 87,561 grayscale images of handwritten Burmese digits in ten classes. Each image is 28x28 pixels, following the MNIST format. The training set has 60,000 samples split evenly across classes; the test set has 27,561 samples with class frequencies as they arose during collection. Over 150 people of different ages and backgrounds contributed samples. We analyze the dataset's class distribution, pixel statistics, and morphological variation, and identify digit pairs that are easily confused due to the round shapes of the Myanmar script. Simple baselines (an MLP, a two-layer CNN, and an improved CNN with batch normalization and augmentation) reach 99.40%, 99.75%, and 99.83% test accuracy respectively. BHDD is available under CC BY-SA 4.0 at https://github.com/baseresearch/BHDD

AI.tldr: 介绍了缅甸手写数字数据集BHDD，包含87,561张28x28像素灰度图像，分为10类，训练集60,000张，测试集27,561张，超过150人参与采集，提供了基线模型性能
AI.motivation: 为缅甸手写数字识别研究提供标准数据集，填补缅甸文字手写数字识别数据集的空白
AI.method: 收集了超过150名不同年龄和背景的人手写的缅甸数字，创建了87,561张28x28像素灰度图像的数据集，遵循MNIST格式，分析了数据集的类别分布、像素统计和形态变化
AI.result: 数据集包含87,561张图像，训练集60,000张，测试集27,561张；基线模型性能：MLP达到99.40%准确率，两层CNN达到99.75%准确率，改进的CNN（批归一化和数据增强）达到99.83%准确率
AI.conclusion: BHDD数据集为缅甸手写数字识别研究提供了有价值的资源，基线模型表现出色，数据集在CC BY-SA 4.0许可下公开可用

title: Identity-Consistent Video Generation under Large Facial-Angle Variations
summary: Single-view reference-to-video methods often struggle to preserve identity consistency under large facial-angle variations. This limitation naturally motivates the incorporation of multi-view facial references. However, simply introducing additional reference images exacerbates the \textit{copy-paste} problem, particularly the \textbf{\textit{view-dependent copy-paste}} artifact, which reduces facial motion naturalness. Although cross-paired data can alleviate this issue, collecting such data is costly. To balance the consistency and naturalness, we propose $\mathrm{Mv}^2\mathrm{ID}$, a multi-view conditioned framework under in-paired supervision. We introduce a region-masking training strategy to prevent shortcut learning and extract essential identity features by encouraging the model to aggregate complementary identity cues across views. In addition, we design a reference decoupled-RoPE mechanism that assigns distinct positional encoding to video and conditioning tokens for better modeling of their heterogeneous properties. Furthermore, we construct a large-scale dataset with diverse facial-angle variations and propose dedicated evaluation metrics for identity consistency and motion naturalness. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly improves identity consistency while maintaining motion naturalness, outperforming existing approaches trained with cross-paired data.

AI.tldr: Mv²ID：一种多视角条件框架，通过区域掩码训练策略和参考解耦RoPE机制，解决单视角参考视频方法在大面部角度变化下的身份一致性不足问题，同时避免多视角引入的视图依赖复制粘贴伪影。
AI.motivation: 单视角参考视频方法在大面部角度变化下难以保持身份一致性，而简单地引入多视角参考图像会加剧"复制粘贴"问题，特别是视图依赖的复制粘贴伪影，降低面部运动自然度。虽然交叉配对数据可以缓解此问题，但收集成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出Mv²ID多视角条件框架，采用区域掩码训练策略防止捷径学习，通过鼓励模型聚合跨视角的互补身份特征来提取本质身份特征。设计参考解耦RoPE机制，为视频和条件token分配不同的位置编码以更好地建模它们的异构特性。构建大规模数据集并提出专门的身份一致性和运动自然度评估指标。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法显著提高了身份一致性，同时保持了运动自然度，优于使用交叉配对数据训练的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: Mv²ID框架在非配对监督下有效平衡了身份一致性和运动自然度，通过创新的训练策略和机制设计解决了多视角参考视频生成中的关键挑战。

title: ThinkJEPA: Empowering Latent World Models with Large Vision-Language Reasoning Model
summary: Recent progress in latent world models (e.g., V-JEPA2) has shown promising capability in forecasting future world states from video observations. Nevertheless, dense prediction from a short observation window limits temporal context and can bias predictors toward local, low-level extrapolation, making it difficult to capture long-horizon semantics and reducing downstream utility. Vision--language models (VLMs), in contrast, provide strong semantic grounding and general knowledge by reasoning over uniformly sampled frames, but they are not ideal as standalone dense predictors due to compute-driven sparse sampling, a language-output bottleneck that compresses fine-grained interaction states into text-oriented representations, and a data-regime mismatch when adapting to small action-conditioned datasets. We propose a VLM-guided JEPA-style latent world modeling framework that combines dense-frame dynamics modeling with long-horizon semantic guidance via a dual-temporal pathway: a dense JEPA branch for fine-grained motion and interaction cues, and a uniformly sampled VLM \emph{thinker} branch with a larger temporal stride for knowledge-rich guidance. To transfer the VLM's progressive reasoning signals effectively, we introduce a hierarchical pyramid representation extraction module that aggregates multi-layer VLM representations into guidance features compatible with latent prediction. Experiments on hand-manipulation trajectory prediction show that our method outperforms both a strong VLM-only baseline and a JEPA-predictor baseline, and yields more robust long-horizon rollout behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出VLM引导的JEPA风格潜在世界建模框架，结合密集帧动态建模与长时程语义引导，通过双时间路径提升轨迹预测性能
AI.motivation: 现有潜在世界模型（如V-JEPA2）从短观察窗口进行密集预测，限制了时间上下文，偏向局部低层次外推，难以捕捉长时程语义；而视觉语言模型（VLMs）虽提供强语义基础，但因稀疏采样、语言输出瓶颈和数据不匹配问题，不适合作为独立的密集预测器
AI.method: 采用双时间路径框架：密集JEPA分支用于细粒度运动和交互线索，均匀采样的VLM"思考者"分支以更大时间步长提供知识丰富的引导；引入分层金字塔表示提取模块，聚合多层VLM表示为与潜在预测兼容的引导特征
AI.result: 在手部操作轨迹预测实验中，该方法优于纯VLM基线和JEPA预测器基线，产生更鲁棒的长时程推演行为
AI.conclusion: VLM引导的JEPA框架成功结合了密集帧动态建模与长时程语义引导的优势，在轨迹预测任务中表现出色，为世界建模提供了新的有效方法

title: F4Splat: Feed-Forward Predictive Densification for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting methods enable single-pass reconstruction and real-time rendering. However, they typically adopt rigid pixel-to-Gaussian or voxel-to-Gaussian pipelines that uniformly allocate Gaussians, leading to redundant Gaussians across views. Moreover, they lack an effective mechanism to control the total number of Gaussians while maintaining reconstruction fidelity. To address these limitations, we present F4Splat, which performs Feed-Forward predictive densification for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting, introducing a densification-score-guided allocation strategy that adaptively distributes Gaussians according to spatial complexity and multi-view overlap. Our model predicts per-region densification scores to estimate the required Gaussian density and allows explicit control over the final Gaussian budget without retraining. This spatially adaptive allocation reduces redundancy in simple regions and minimizes duplicate Gaussians across overlapping views, producing compact yet high-quality 3D representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our model achieves superior novel-view synthesis performance compared to prior uncalibrated feed-forward methods, while using significantly fewer Gaussians.

AI.tldr: F4Splat提出了一种前馈3D高斯溅射方法，通过密度分数引导的自适应高斯分配策略，在保持重建质量的同时显著减少高斯数量。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3D高斯溅射方法采用刚性像素到高斯或体素到高斯的流水线，均匀分配高斯导致视图间冗余，且缺乏有效控制高斯总数同时保持重建保真度的机制。
AI.method: F4Splat采用前馈预测性致密化策略，引入密度分数引导的分配机制，根据空间复杂度和多视图重叠自适应分布高斯。模型预测每个区域的密度分数来估计所需高斯密度，并允许显式控制最终高斯预算而无需重新训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，F4Splat在保持高质量重建的同时，使用显著更少的高斯数量，实现了优于先前未校准前馈方法的新视角合成性能。
AI.conclusion: F4Splat通过自适应高斯分配策略解决了现有方法的冗余问题，实现了紧凑且高质量的3D表示，为实时渲染提供了更高效的解决方案。

title: WorldCache: Content-Aware Caching for Accelerated Video World Models
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) power high-fidelity video world models but remain computationally expensive due to sequential denoising and costly spatio-temporal attention. Training-free feature caching accelerates inference by reusing intermediate activations across denoising steps; however, existing methods largely rely on a Zero-Order Hold assumption i.e., reusing cached features as static snapshots when global drift is small. This often leads to ghosting artifacts, blur, and motion inconsistencies in dynamic scenes. We propose \textbf{WorldCache}, a Perception-Constrained Dynamical Caching framework that improves both when and how to reuse features. WorldCache introduces motion-adaptive thresholds, saliency-weighted drift estimation, optimal approximation via blending and warping, and phase-aware threshold scheduling across diffusion steps. Our cohesive approach enables adaptive, motion-consistent feature reuse without retraining. On Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B evaluated on PAI-Bench, WorldCache achieves \textbf{2.3$\times$} inference speedup while preserving \textbf{99.4\%} of baseline quality, substantially outperforming prior training-free caching approaches. Our code can be accessed on \href{https://umair1221.github.io/World-Cache/}{World-Cache}.

AI.tldr: WorldCache提出了一种感知约束的动态缓存框架，通过运动自适应阈值、显著性加权漂移估计、混合与变形优化近似以及相位感知阈值调度，在保持99.4%基线质量的同时实现2.3倍推理加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散变换器(DiTs)虽然能生成高质量视频，但计算成本高昂。现有的免训练特征缓存方法主要依赖零阶保持假设，在动态场景中容易产生重影、模糊和运动不一致等问题。
AI.method: 提出WorldCache框架，包含：1)运动自适应阈值；2)显著性加权漂移估计；3)通过混合与变形进行最优近似；4)跨扩散步骤的相位感知阈值调度。这些技术共同实现自适应、运动一致的特征重用，无需重新训练。
AI.result: 在Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B模型上，使用PAI-Bench评估，WorldCache实现了2.3倍的推理加速，同时保持了99.4%的基线质量，显著优于先前的免训练缓存方法。
AI.conclusion: WorldCache通过感知约束的动态缓存框架，有效解决了现有特征缓存方法在动态场景中的局限性，在保持视频质量的同时大幅提升推理效率。
