In our pipeline, Burst Auto-Exposure Network (BAENet) estimates the optimal exposure time for each burst image based on a preview image, as well as motion magnitude and gain. Subsequently, a burst image restoration network reconstructs a high-quality image from burst images captured using these optimal exposure times. For training, we introduce a differentiable burst simulator and a three-stage training strategy. Our experiments demonstrate that our pipeline achieves state-of-the-art restoration quality. Furthermore, we validate the effectiveness of our approach on a real-world camera system, demonstrating its practicality.

AI.tldr: DEBIR提出了一种新颖的爆发图像恢复管道，通过动态预测适合拍摄环境的曝光时间来提升恢复质量，包括BAENet网络预测最优曝光时间，以及可微分爆发模拟器和三阶段训练策略。
AI.motivation: 爆发图像恢复通常使用手动设计的曝光设置，这些设置显著影响最终恢复性能，但寻找最优曝光设置的问题一直被忽视。本文旨在解决这一关键问题。
AI.method: 提出了DEBIR管道，包含：1) BAENet网络基于预览图像、运动幅度和增益估计每个爆发图像的最优曝光时间；2) 爆发图像恢复网络从使用最优曝光时间捕获的图像中重建高质量图像；3) 引入了可微分爆发模拟器和三阶段训练策略。
AI.result: 实验表明该管道实现了最先进的恢复质量，并在真实相机系统上验证了其有效性，证明了其实用性。
AI.conclusion: DEBIR通过动态预测最优曝光时间显著提升了爆发图像恢复性能，解决了传统方法中曝光设置优化被忽视的问题，并在实际应用中表现出良好的实用性。

title: Not All Layers Are Created Equal: Adaptive LoRA Ranks for Personalized Image Generation
summary: Low Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is the de facto fine-tuning strategy to generate personalized images from pre-trained diffusion models. Choosing a good rank is extremely critical, since it trades off performance and memory consumption, but today the decision is often left to the community's consensus, regardless of the personalized subject's complexity. The reason is evident: the cost of selecting a good rank for each LoRA component is combinatorial, so we opt for practical shortcuts such as fixing the same rank for all components. In this paper, we take a first step to overcome this challenge. Inspired by variational methods that learn an adaptive width of neural networks, we let the ranks of each layer freely adapt during fine-tuning on a subject. We achieve it by imposing an ordering of importance on the rank's positions, effectively encouraging the creation of higher ranks when strictly needed. Qualitatively and quantitatively, our approach, LoRA$^2$, achieves a competitive trade-off between DINO, CLIP-I, and CLIP-T across 29 subjects while requiring much less memory and lower rank than high rank LoRA versions. Code: https://github.com/donaldssh/NotAllLayersAreCreatedEqual.

AI.tldr: LoRA²：一种自适应秩选择的LoRA微调方法，通过变分方法让每层网络的秩在微调过程中自适应调整，实现性能与内存消耗的更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 当前LoRA微调中秩的选择通常基于社区共识，没有考虑个性化主题的复杂性。固定所有组件的秩虽然实用，但无法实现最优的性能与内存平衡。手动为每个LoRA组件选择合适秩的成本是组合性的，因此需要一种自适应的方法。
AI.method: 受变分方法学习神经网络自适应宽度的启发，LoRA²让每层的秩在主题微调过程中自由适应。通过施加秩位置的重要性排序，有效鼓励在严格需要时创建更高的秩。这种方法避免了固定秩的限制，让网络根据实际需求动态调整各层的复杂度。
AI.result: 在29个主题上的定性和定量评估显示，LoRA²在DINO、CLIP-I和CLIP-T指标上实现了有竞争力的平衡，同时比高秩LoRA版本需要更少的内存和更低的秩。该方法在保持性能的同时显著降低了计算资源需求。
AI.conclusion: LoRA²首次解决了LoRA微调中秩选择的挑战，通过自适应秩调整实现了更好的性能-内存权衡。该方法为个性化图像生成提供了更高效的微调策略，代码已开源供社区使用。

title: Image-Conditioned Adaptive Parameter Tuning for Visual Odometry Frontends
summary: Resource-constrained autonomous robots rely on sparse direct and semi-direct visual-(inertial)-odometry (VO) pipelines, as they provide a favorable tradeoff between accuracy, robustness, and computational cost. However, the performance of most systems depends critically on hand-tuned hyperparameters governing feature detection, tracking, and outlier rejection. These parameters are typically fixed during deployment, even though their optimal values vary with scene characteristics such as texture density, illumination, motion blur, and sensor noise, leading to brittle performance in real-world environments. We propose the first image-conditioned reinforcement learning framework for online tuning of VO frontend parameters, effectively embedding the expert into the system. Our key idea is to formulate the frontend configuration as a sequential decision-making problem and learn a policy that directly maps visual input to feature detection and tracking parameters. The policy uses a lightweight texture-aware CNN encoder and a privileged critic during training. Unlike prior RL-based approaches that rely solely on internal VO statistics, our method observes the image content and proactively adapts parameters before tracking degrades. Experiments on TartanAirV2 and TUM RGB-D show 3x longer feature tracks and 3x lower computational cost, despite training entirely in simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出首个基于图像条件强化学习的VO前端参数在线调优框架，通过视觉输入直接映射到特征检测和跟踪参数，实现自适应配置
AI.motivation: 传统VO系统的性能严重依赖于手动调优的超参数，这些参数在部署时通常固定不变，但实际最优值会随场景特征（纹理密度、光照、运动模糊等）变化，导致在真实环境中性能脆弱
AI.method: 将前端配置建模为序列决策问题，学习一个策略直接映射视觉输入到特征检测和跟踪参数。使用轻量级纹理感知CNN编码器和训练期间的privileged critic，不同于先前仅依赖内部VO统计的RL方法
AI.result: 在TartanAirV2和TUM RGB-D数据集上实验显示，特征跟踪长度提升3倍，计算成本降低3倍，尽管完全在仿真中训练
AI.conclusion: 提出的图像条件强化学习框架能够有效嵌入专家知识到系统中，实现VO前端参数的自适应在线调优，显著提升跟踪性能和计算效率

title: The Universal Normal Embedding
summary: Generative models and vision encoders have largely advanced on separate tracks, optimized for different goals and grounded in different mathematical principles. Yet, they share a fundamental property: latent space Gaussianity. Generative models map Gaussian noise to images, while encoders map images to semantic embeddings whose coordinates empirically behave as Gaussian. We hypothesize that both are views of a shared latent source, the Universal Normal Embedding (UNE): an approximately Gaussian latent space from which encoder embeddings and DDIM-inverted noise arise as noisy linear projections. To test our hypothesis, we introduce NoiseZoo, a dataset of per-image latents comprising DDIM-inverted diffusion noise and matching encoder representations (CLIP, DINO). On CelebA, linear probes in both spaces yield strong, aligned attribute predictions, indicating that generative noise encodes meaningful semantics along linear directions. These directions further enable faithful, controllable edits (e.g., smile, gender, age) without architectural changes, where simple orthogonalization mitigates spurious entanglements. Taken together, our results provide empirical support for the UNE hypothesis and reveal a shared Gaussian-like latent geometry that concretely links encoding and generation. Code and data are available https://rbetser.github.io/UNE/

AI.tldr: 论文提出通用正态嵌入（UNE）假设，认为生成模型和视觉编码器共享近似高斯潜在空间，并通过NoiseZoo数据集验证了DDIM反演噪声和编码器表示在语义上的线性对齐关系。
AI.motivation: 生成模型和视觉编码器虽然发展路径不同，但都基于潜在空间的高斯性。作者假设它们共享一个共同的潜在源——通用正态嵌入（UNE），即一个近似高斯的潜在空间，编码器嵌入和DDIM反演噪声都是其噪声线性投影。
AI.method: 引入NoiseZoo数据集，包含每张图像的潜在表示（DDIM反演扩散噪声和匹配的编码器表示如CLIP、DINO）。在CelebA数据集上，通过两个空间的线性探针进行属性预测，验证语义对齐。使用正交化方法减少虚假纠缠，实现可控编辑。
AI.result: 两个空间的线性探针都能产生强且对齐的属性预测，表明生成噪声沿线性方向编码有意义的语义。这些方向能够实现忠实、可控的编辑（如微笑、性别、年龄），无需架构修改。正交化有效缓解了虚假纠缠。
AI.conclusion: 结果为UNE假设提供了实证支持，揭示了连接编码和生成的共享高斯类潜在几何结构。这表明生成模型和视觉编码器在潜在表示上存在根本性联系，为跨模态理解和生成提供了新视角。

title: Camera-Agnostic Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splats via Descriptor-Based Beta Evidence
summary:
The pruning of 3D Gaussian splats is essential for reducing their complexity to enable efficient storage, transmission, and downstream processing. However, most of the existing pruning strategies depend on camera parameters, rendered images, or view-dependent measures. This dependency becomes a hindrance in emerging camera-agnostic exchange settings, where splats are shared directly as point-based representations (e.g., .ply). In this paper, we propose a camera-agnostic, one-shot, post-training pruning method for 3D Gaussian splats that relies solely on attribute-derived neighbourhood descriptors. As our primary contribution, we introduce a hybrid descriptor framework that captures structural and appearance consistency directly from the splat representation. Building on these descriptors, we formulate pruning as a statistical evidence estimation problem and introduce a Beta evidence model that quantifies per-splat reliability through a probabilistic confidence score.
  Experiments conducted on standardized test sequences defined by the ISO/IEC MPEG Common Test Conditions (CTC) demonstrate that our approach achieves substantial pruning while preserving reconstruction quality, establishing a practical and generalizable alternative to existing camera-dependent pruning strategies.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种相机无关的单次训练后剪枝方法，用于3D高斯泼溅，仅依赖属性导出的邻域描述符，通过Beta证据模型量化每个泼溅的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有3D高斯泼溅剪枝策略大多依赖相机参数、渲染图像或视图相关度量，这在相机无关交换设置中成为障碍，需要一种不依赖相机信息的剪枝方法。
AI.method: 提出混合描述符框架，直接从泼溅表示中捕捉结构和外观一致性；将剪枝建模为统计证据估计问题，引入Beta证据模型，通过概率置信分数量化每个泼溅的可靠性。
AI.result: 在ISO/IEC MPEG CTC定义的标准测试序列上实验表明，该方法实现了显著的剪枝效果，同时保持了重建质量，为现有相机依赖剪枝策略提供了实用且可泛化的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为3D高斯泼溅提供了一种相机无关、单次训练后的剪枝解决方案，仅基于属性导出的邻域描述符，通过统计证据估计实现有效剪枝，适用于新兴的相机无关交换场景。

title: Timing In stand-up Comedy: Text, Audio, Laughter, Kinesics (TIC-TALK): Pipeline and Database for the Multimodal Study of Comedic Timing
summary: Stand-up comedy, and humor in general, are often studied through their verbal content. Yet live performance relies just as much on embodied presence and audience feedback. We introduce TIC-TALK, a multimodal resource with 5,400+ temporally aligned topic segments capturing language, gesture, and audience response across 90 professionally filmed stand-up comedy specials (2015-2024). The pipeline combines BERTopic for 60 s thematic segmentation with dense sentence embeddings, Whisper-AT for 0.8 s laughter detection, a fine-tuned YOLOv8-cls shot classifier, and YOLOv8s-pose for raw keypoint extraction at 1 fps. Raw 17-joint skeletal coordinates are retained without prior clustering, enabling the computation of continuous kinematic signals-arm spread, kinetic energy, and trunk lean-that serve as proxies for performance dynamics. All streams are aligned by hierarchical temporal containment without resampling, and each topic segment stores its sentence-BERT embedding for downstream similarity and clustering tasks. As a concrete use case, we study laughter dynamics across 24 thematic topics: kinetic energy negatively predicts audience laughter rate (r = -0.75, N = 24), consistent with a stillness-before-punchline pattern; personal and bodily content elicits more laughter than geopolitical themes; and shot close-up proportion correlates positively with laughter (r = +0.28), consistent with reactive montage.

AI.tldr: TIC-TALK是一个多模态数据集，包含90个专业单口喜剧特别节目（2015-2024年）的5400多个时间对齐主题片段，整合了语言、手势和观众反应数据，用于研究喜剧表演的动态特征。
AI.motivation: 传统喜剧研究主要关注语言内容，但现场表演同样依赖身体表现和观众反馈。目前缺乏整合语言、手势和观众反应的多模态资源来全面研究喜剧表演的动态特征。
AI.method: 开发了一个多模态处理流程：使用BERTopic进行60秒主题分割和密集句子嵌入，Whisper-AT进行0.8秒笑声检测，微调YOLOv8-cls进行镜头分类，YOLOv8s-pose以1fps提取原始关键点。保留原始17关节骨骼坐标，计算连续运动学信号（手臂展开、动能、躯干倾斜）。所有流通过分层时间包含对齐，无需重采样。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）动能与观众笑声率呈负相关（r=-0.75），符合"笑点前静止"模式；2）个人和身体内容比地缘政治主题引发更多笑声；3）特写镜头比例与笑声呈正相关（r=+0.28），符合反应性蒙太奇理论。
AI.conclusion: TIC-TALK提供了一个全面的多模态资源，能够研究喜剧表演中语言、身体动作和观众反应的复杂互动。研究发现的身体动态模式为理解喜剧表演的节奏和效果提供了新视角。

title: Uncertainty-guided Compositional Alignment with Part-to-Whole Semantic Representativeness in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
summary: While Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable performance, their Euclidean embeddings remain limited in capturing hierarchical relationships such as part-to-whole or parent-child structures, and often face challenges in multi-object compositional scenarios. Hyperbolic VLMs mitigate this issue by better preserving hierarchical structures and modeling part-whole relations (i.e., whole scene and its part images) through entailment. However, existing approaches do not model that each part has a different level of semantic representativeness to the whole. We propose UNcertainty-guided Compositional Hyperbolic Alignment (UNCHA) for enhancing hyperbolic VLMs. UNCHA models part-to-whole semantic representativeness with hyperbolic uncertainty, by assigning lower uncertainty to more representative parts and higher uncertainty to less representative ones for the whole scene. This representativeness is then incorporated into the contrastive objective with uncertainty-guided weights. Finally, the uncertainty is further calibrated with an entailment loss regularized by entropy-based term. With the proposed losses, UNCHA learns hyperbolic embeddings with more accurate part-whole ordering, capturing the underlying compositional structure in an image and improving its understanding of complex multi-object scenes. UNCHA achieves state-of-the-art performance on zero-shot classification, retrieval, and multi-label classification benchmarks. Our code and models are available at: https://github.com/jeeit17/UNCHA.git.

AI.tldr: UNCHA提出了一种不确定性引导的双曲视觉语言模型对齐方法，通过双曲不确定性建模部分到整体的语义代表性，提升多对象场景理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现有双曲视觉语言模型虽然能更好地保持层次结构，但未能建模每个部分对整体具有不同语义代表性的问题，限制了在复杂多对象场景中的理解能力。
AI.method: 提出UNCHA方法：1) 使用双曲不确定性建模部分到整体的语义代表性，为更具代表性的部分分配较低不确定性；2) 将代表性融入对比目标，使用不确定性引导的权重；3) 通过基于熵的正则化项校准不确定性。
AI.result: UNCHA在零样本分类、检索和多标签分类基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，学习到的双曲嵌入具有更准确的部分-整体排序，能更好地捕捉图像中的组合结构。
AI.conclusion: 通过不确定性引导的双曲对齐方法，UNCHA显著提升了视觉语言模型对复杂多对象场景的理解能力，为层次化视觉表示学习提供了有效解决方案。

title: Mamba-VMR: Multimodal Query Augmentation via Generated Videos for Precise Temporal Grounding
comment: The paper is accepted by CVPR-2026
summary: Text-driven video moment retrieval (VMR) remains challenging due to limited capture of hidden temporal dynamics in untrimmed videos, leading to imprecise grounding in long sequences. Traditional methods rely on natural language queries (NLQs) or static image augmentations, overlooking motion sequences and suffering from high computational costs in Transformer-based architectures. Existing approaches fail to integrate subtitle contexts and generated temporal priors effectively, we therefore propose a novel two-stage framework for enhanced temporal grounding. In the first stage, LLM-guided subtitle matching identifies relevant textual cues from video subtitles, fused with the query to generate auxiliary short videos via text-to-video models, capturing implicit motion information as temporal priors. In the second stage, augmented queries are processed through a multi-modal controlled Mamba network, extending text-controlled selection with video-guided gating for efficient fusion of generated priors and long sequences while filtering noise. Our framework is agnostic to base retrieval models and widely applicable for multimodal VMR. Experimental evaluations on the TVR benchmark demonstrate significant improvements over state-of-the-art methods, including reduced computational overhead and higher recall in long-sequence grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架增强视频时刻检索：第一阶段用LLM匹配字幕生成辅助短视频作为时序先验；第二阶段用多模态可控Mamba网络融合先验与长序列，降低计算成本并提升长序列定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有视频时刻检索方法存在局限性：1) 难以捕捉未修剪视频中的隐藏时序动态；2) 依赖自然语言查询或静态图像增强，忽略运动序列；3) Transformer架构计算成本高；4) 未能有效整合字幕上下文和生成的时序先验。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段使用LLM引导的字幕匹配从视频字幕中识别相关文本线索，与查询融合后通过文本到视频模型生成辅助短视频，捕获隐含运动信息作为时序先验。第二阶段通过多模态可控Mamba网络处理增强查询，扩展文本控制选择并加入视频引导门控，高效融合生成的先验与长序列同时过滤噪声。
AI.result: 在TVR基准测试中，相比现有最先进方法取得显著改进：1) 降低计算开销；2) 在长序列定位中实现更高的召回率。
AI.conclusion: 提出的两阶段框架通过LLM引导的字幕匹配生成时序先验，结合多模态可控Mamba网络实现高效融合，解决了传统方法在捕捉时序动态、计算效率和字幕上下文整合方面的不足，为多模态视频时刻检索提供了通用解决方案。

title: Beyond Strict Pairing: Arbitrarily Paired Training for High-Performance Infrared and Visible Image Fusion
summary: Infrared and visible image fusion(IVIF) combines complementary modalities while preserving natural textures and salient thermal signatures. Existing solutions predominantly rely on extensive sets of rigidly aligned image pairs for training. However, acquiring such data is often impractical due to the costly and labour-intensive alignment process. Besides, maintaining a rigid pairing setting during training restricts the volume of cross-modal relationships, thereby limiting generalisation performance. To this end, this work challenges the necessity of Strictly Paired Training Paradigm (SPTP) by systematically investigating UnPaired and Arbitrarily Paired Training Paradigms (UPTP and APTP) for high-performance IVIF. We establish a theoretical objective of APTP, reflecting the complementary nature between UPTP and SPTP. More importantly, we develop a practical framework capable of significantly enriching cross-modal relationships even with severely limited and unaligned training data. To validate our propositions, three end-to-end lightweight baselines, alongside a set of innovative loss functions, are designed to cover three classic frameworks (CNN, Transformer, GAN). Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed APTP and UPTP are feasible and capable of training models on a severely limited and content-inconsistent infrared and visible dataset, achieving performance comparable to that of a dataset 100$\times$ larger in SPTP. This finding fundamentally alleviates the cost and difficulty of data collection while enhancing model robustness from the data perspective, delivering a feasible solution for IVIF studies. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/yanglinDeng/IVIF_unpair}{\textcolor{blue}{https://github.com/yanglinDeng/IVIF\_unpair}}.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了红外与可见光图像融合中严格配对训练范式的必要性，系统研究了非配对和任意配对训练范式，开发了能在严重有限且未对齐数据上显著丰富跨模态关系的实用框架。
AI.motivation: 现有红外与可见光图像融合方法主要依赖大量严格对齐的图像对进行训练，但获取这种数据成本高、劳动密集。严格的配对设置限制了跨模态关系的丰富性，从而限制了模型的泛化性能。
AI.method: 提出了非配对训练范式（UPTP）和任意配对训练范式（APTP），建立了APTP的理论目标。开发了一个实用框架，即使在严重有限且未对齐的训练数据下也能显著丰富跨模态关系。设计了三个轻量级基线模型（CNN、Transformer、GAN）和创新的损失函数。
AI.result: 实验表明，APTP和UPTP是可行的，能够在严重有限且内容不一致的红外与可见光数据集上训练模型，达到与100倍大严格配对数据集相当的性能。这从根本上降低了数据收集的成本和难度，同时从数据角度增强了模型鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究挑战了红外与可见光图像融合中严格配对训练范式的必要性，为非配对和任意配对训练提供了可行解决方案，显著降低了数据收集成本，增强了模型鲁棒性，为IVIF研究提供了新思路。

title: Beyond Matching to Tiles: Bridging Unaligned Aerial and Satellite Views for Vision-Only UAV Navigation
comment: Accepted as a conference paper by CVPR2026
summary: Recent advances in cross-view geo-localization (CVGL) methods have shown strong potential for supporting unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) navigation in GNSS-denied environments. However, existing work predominantly focuses on matching UAV views to onboard map tiles, which introduces an inherent trade-off between accuracy and storage overhead, and overlooks the importance of the UAV's heading during navigation. Moreover, the substantial discrepancies and varying overlaps in cross-view scenarios have been insufficiently considered, limiting their generalization to real-world scenarios. In this paper, we present Bearing-UAV, a purely vision-driven cross-view navigation method that jointly predicts UAV absolute location and heading from neighboring features, enabling accurate, lightweight, and robust navigation in the wild. Our method leverages global and local structural features and explicitly encodes relative spatial relationships, making it robust to cross-view variations, misalignment, and feature-sparse conditions. We also present Bearing-UAV-90k, a multi-city benchmark for evaluating cross-view localization and navigation. Extensive experiments show encouraging results that Bearing-UAV yields lower localization error than previous matching/retrieval paradigm across diverse terrains. Our code and dataset will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: Bearing-UAV是一种纯视觉驱动的跨视图导航方法，联合预测无人机绝对位置和航向，在GNSS拒止环境中实现准确、轻量、鲁棒的导航。
AI.motivation: 现有跨视图地理定位方法主要关注无人机视图与地图瓦片的匹配，存在精度与存储开销的权衡问题，且忽视了航向信息的重要性。同时，跨视图场景中的显著差异和重叠变化未得到充分考虑，限制了实际应用。
AI.method: 提出Bearing-UAV方法，利用全局和局部结构特征，显式编码相对空间关系，联合预测无人机绝对位置和航向。该方法对跨视图变化、不对齐和特征稀疏条件具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 实验表明Bearing-UAV在不同地形下比之前的匹配/检索范式具有更低的定位误差。同时发布了Bearing-UAV-90k多城市基准数据集用于评估跨视图定位和导航。
AI.conclusion: Bearing-UAV提供了一种准确、轻量、鲁棒的纯视觉导航方案，解决了现有方法在精度-存储权衡和航向预测方面的局限性，在GNSS拒止环境中具有实际应用价值。

title: Seeing is Improving: Visual Feedback for Iterative Text Layout Refinement
summary: Recent advances in Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have enabled automated generation of structured layouts from natural language descriptions. Existing methods typically follow a code-only paradigm that generates code to represent layouts, which are then rendered by graphic engines to produce final images. However, they are blind to the rendered visual outcome, making it difficult to guarantee readability and aesthetics. In this paper, we identify visual feedback as a critical factor in layout generation and propose Visual Feedback Layout Model (VFLM), a self-improving framework that leverages visual feedback iterative refinement. VFLM is capable of performing adaptive reflective generation, which leverages visual information to reflect on previous issues and iteratively generates outputs until satisfactory quality is achieved. It is achieved through reinforcement learning with a visually grounded reward model that incorporates OCR accuracy. By rewarding only the final generated outcome, we can effectively stimulate the model's iterative and reflective generative capabilities. Experiments across multiple benchmarks show that VFLM consistently outperforms advanced MLLMs, existing layout models, and code-only baselines, establishing visual feedback as critical for design-oriented MLLMs. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/FolSpark/VFLM.

AI.tldr: VFLM是一个利用视觉反馈进行迭代优化的布局生成框架，通过强化学习和OCR准确性奖励机制，显著提升了多模态大语言模型在布局生成任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有基于代码生成的布局方法无法看到渲染后的视觉效果，难以保证可读性和美观性。视觉反馈被认为是布局生成中的关键因素。
AI.method: 提出视觉反馈布局模型(VFLM)，这是一个自改进框架，利用视觉反馈进行迭代优化。采用自适应反思生成机制，通过强化学习结合基于OCR准确性的视觉奖励模型，仅对最终生成结果进行奖励，从而激发模型的迭代和反思生成能力。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试中，VFLM始终优于先进的多模态大语言模型、现有布局模型和纯代码基线方法，证明了视觉反馈对于面向设计的MLLMs至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 视觉反馈是布局生成中的关键因素，VFLM框架通过视觉反馈迭代优化显著提升了布局生成的质量，为设计导向的多模态大语言模型提供了重要改进方向。

title: Climate Prompting: Generating the Madden-Julian Oscillation using Video Diffusion and Low-Dimensional Conditioning
summary: Generative Deep Learning is a powerful tool for modeling of the Madden-Julian oscillation (MJO) in the tropics, yet its relationship to traditional theoretical frameworks remains poorly understood. Here we propose a video diffusion model, trained on atmospheric reanalysis, to synthetize long MJO sequences conditioned on key low-dimensional metrics. The generated MJOs capture key features including composites, power spectra and multiscale structures including convectively coupled waves, despite some bias. We then prompt the model to generate more tractable MJOs based on intentionally idealized low-dimensional conditionings, for example a perpetual MJO, an isolated modulation by seasons and/or the El Nino-Southern Oscillation, and so on. This enables deconstructing the underlying processes and identifying physical drivers. The present approach provides a practical framework for bridging the gap between low-dimensional MJO theory and high-resolution atmospheric complexity and will help tropical atmosphere prediction.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用视频扩散模型生成MJO序列，通过低维条件控制来连接传统理论与高分辨率大气复杂性，为热带大气预测提供新框架。
AI.motivation: 生成式深度学习在模拟热带MJO方面很强大，但其与传统理论框架的关系仍不清楚。需要建立连接低维MJO理论与高分辨率大气复杂性的实用框架。
AI.method: 提出基于大气再分析数据训练的视频扩散模型，合成受关键低维指标条件控制的长MJO序列，并生成更易处理的理想化MJO（如永久MJO、季节/ENSO调制等）。
AI.result: 生成的MJO捕捉了关键特征（合成图、功率谱、多尺度结构包括对流耦合波），尽管存在一些偏差。通过理想化条件控制，能够解构底层过程并识别物理驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为弥合低维MJO理论与高分辨率大气复杂性之间的差距提供了实用框架，将有助于热带大气预测。

title: SpatialReward: Verifiable Spatial Reward Modeling for Fine-Grained Spatial Consistency in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Recent advances in text-to-image (T2I) generation via reinforcement learning (RL) have benefited from reward models that assess semantic alignment and visual quality. However, most existing reward models pay limited attention to fine-grained spatial relationships, often producing images that appear plausible overall yet contain inaccuracies in object positioning. In this work, we present \textbf{SpatialReward}, a verifiable reward model explicitly designed to evaluate spatial layouts in generated images. SpatialReward adopts a multi-stage pipeline: a \emph{Prompt Decomposer} extracts entities, attributes, and spatial metadata from free-form prompts; expert detectors provide accurate visual grounding of object positions and attributes; and a vision-language model applies chain-of-thought reasoning over grounded observations to assess complex spatial relations that are challenging for rule-based methods. To more comprehensively evaluate spatial relationships in generated images, we introduce \textbf{SpatRelBench}, a benchmark covering object attributes, orientation, inter-object relations, and rendered text placement. Experiments on Stable Diffusion and FLUX show that incorporating SpatialReward into RL training consistently improves spatial consistency and overall generation quality, with results aligned more closely to human judgments. These findings indicate that verifiable reward models hold considerable potential for enabling more accurate and controllable optimization in text-to-image generation models.

AI.tldr: SpatialReward是一个用于评估生成图像中空间布局的奖励模型，通过多阶段流程提取提示中的空间信息并评估空间关系，结合到RL训练中能提升空间一致性和生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像生成的奖励模型主要关注语义对齐和视觉质量，但对细粒度空间关系关注不足，导致生成的图像整体看似合理但包含对象定位不准确的问题。
AI.method: SpatialReward采用多阶段流程：1) Prompt Decomposer从自由格式提示中提取实体、属性和空间元数据；2) 专家检测器提供对象位置和属性的准确视觉定位；3) 视觉语言模型通过链式推理评估复杂空间关系。同时提出了SpatRelBench基准来全面评估空间关系。
AI.result: 在Stable Diffusion和FLUX上的实验表明，将SpatialReward整合到RL训练中能持续改善空间一致性和整体生成质量，结果更符合人类判断。
AI.conclusion: 可验证的奖励模型在实现更准确和可控的文本到图像生成模型优化方面具有相当大的潜力。

title: 3D-Layout-R1: Structured Reasoning for Language-Instructed Spatial Editing
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) and Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown impressive reasoning abilities, yet they struggle with spatial understanding and layout consistency when performing fine-grained visual editing. We introduce a Structured Reasoning framework that performs text-conditioned spatial layout editing via scene-graph reasoning. Given an input scene graph and a natural-language instruction, the model reasons over the graph to generate an updated scene graph that satisfies the text condition while maintaining spatial coherence. By explicitly guiding the reasoning process through structured relational representations, our approach improves both interpretability and control over spatial relationships. We evaluate our method on a new text-guided layout editing benchmark encompassing sorting, spatial alignment, and room-editing tasks. Our training paradigm yields an average 15% improvement in IoU and 25% reduction in center-distance error compared to Chain of Thought Fine-tuning (CoT-SFT) and vanilla GRPO baselines. Compared to SOTA zero-shot LLMs, our best models achieve up to 20% higher mIoU, demonstrating markedly improved spatial precision.

AI.tldr: 提出结构化推理框架，通过场景图推理进行文本条件空间布局编辑，显著提升空间理解和布局一致性
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型和视觉语言模型在细粒度视觉编辑中，虽然展示了强大的推理能力，但在空间理解和布局一致性方面存在不足，需要更结构化的方法来改善空间关系的控制
AI.method: 引入结构化推理框架，基于输入场景图和自然语言指令，通过场景图推理生成满足文本条件且保持空间一致性的更新场景图，利用结构化关系表示指导推理过程
AI.result: 在新构建的文本引导布局编辑基准测试中，相比CoT-SFT和GRPO基线，IoU平均提升15%，中心距离误差减少25%；相比SOTA零样本LLMs，最佳模型mIoU提升高达20%，空间精度显著改善
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理框架通过显式利用场景图表示，有效提升了文本条件空间布局编辑的精度和一致性，为细粒度视觉编辑提供了更可控和可解释的方法

title: Thermal Topology Collapse: Universal Physical Patch Attacks on Infrared Vision Systems
summary: Although infrared pedestrian detectors have been widely deployed in visual perception tasks, their vulnerability to physical adversarial attacks is becoming increasingly apparent. Existing physical attack methods predominantly rely on instance-specific online optimization and rigid pattern design, leading to high deployment costs and insufficient physical robustness. To address these limitations, this work proposes the Universal Physical Patch Attack (UPPA), the first universal physical attack method in the infrared domain. This method employs geometrically constrained parameterized Bezier blocks to model perturbations and utilizes the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) algorithm to perform unified optimization across the global data distribution, thus maintaining topological stability under dynamic deformations. In the physical deployment phase, we materialize the optimized digital perturbations into physical cold patches, achieving a continuous and smooth low-temperature distribution that naturally aligns with the thermal radiation characteristics of infrared imaging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UPPA achieves an outstanding physical attack success rate without any online computational overhead, while also exhibiting strong cross-domain generalization and reliable black-box transferability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种红外行人检测器的通用物理攻击方法UPPA，使用参数化贝塞尔块建模扰动，通过粒子群优化算法实现全局优化，并将数字扰动转化为物理冷贴片，实现了高效的无在线计算攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有红外行人检测器的物理攻击方法主要依赖实例特定的在线优化和刚性模式设计，导致部署成本高且物理鲁棒性不足。需要一种更高效、通用的物理攻击方法来解决这些限制。
AI.method: 提出UPPA方法：1) 使用几何约束的参数化贝塞尔块建模扰动；2) 采用粒子群优化算法在全局数据分布上进行统一优化，保持动态变形下的拓扑稳定性；3) 将优化后的数字扰动转化为物理冷贴片，实现连续平滑的低温分布，与红外成像的热辐射特性自然对齐。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，UPPA在无需任何在线计算开销的情况下实现了出色的物理攻击成功率，同时表现出强大的跨域泛化能力和可靠的黑盒可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: UPPA是红外领域首个通用物理攻击方法，通过参数化建模和全局优化策略，解决了现有方法部署成本高和物理鲁棒性不足的问题，为红外行人检测器的安全性研究提供了新思路。

title: UniMotion: A Unified Framework for Motion-Text-Vision Understanding and Generation
summary: We present UniMotion, to our knowledge the first unified framework for simultaneous understanding and generation of human motion, natural language, and RGB images within a single architecture. Existing unified models handle only restricted modality subsets (e.g., Motion-Text or static Pose-Image) and predominantly rely on discrete tokenization, which introduces quantization errors and disrupts temporal continuity. UniMotion overcomes both limitations through a core principle: treating motion as a first-class continuous modality on equal footing with RGB. A novel Cross-Modal Aligned Motion VAE (CMA-VAE) and symmetric dual-path embedders construct parallel continuous pathways for Motion and RGB within a shared LLM backbone. To inject visual-semantic priors into motion representations without requiring images at inference, we propose Dual-Posterior KL Alignment (DPA), which distills a vision-fused encoder's richer posterior into the motion-only encoder. To address the cold-start problem -- where text supervision alone is too sparse to calibrate the newly introduced motion pathway -- we further propose Latent Reconstruction Alignment (LRA), a self-supervised pre-training strategy that uses dense motion latents as unambiguous conditions to co-calibrate the embedder, backbone, and flow head, establishing a stable motion-aware foundation for all downstream tasks. UniMotion achieves state-of-the-art performance across seven tasks spanning any-to-any understanding, generation, and editing among the three modalities, with especially strong advantages on cross-modal compositional tasks.

AI.tldr: UniMotion是首个统一框架，可在单一架构中同时理解和生成人体运动、自然语言和RGB图像，解决了现有模型仅处理有限模态子集、依赖离散标记化的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有统一模型只能处理有限的模态子集（如运动-文本或静态姿态-图像），且主要依赖离散标记化，这会引入量化误差并破坏时间连续性。需要一种能平等处理运动作为连续模态的统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 使用新颖的跨模态对齐运动VAE（CMA-VAE）和对称双路径嵌入器，在共享LLM主干中构建运动和RGB的并行连续路径；2) 提出双后验KL对齐（DPA），将视觉融合编码器的丰富后验蒸馏到纯运动编码器中；3) 提出潜在重建对齐（LRA），一种自监督预训练策略，使用密集运动潜在作为明确条件来共同校准嵌入器、主干和流头。
AI.result: UniMotion在涵盖三种模态之间的任意到任意理解、生成和编辑的七个任务上实现了最先进的性能，在跨模态组合任务上具有特别强的优势。
AI.conclusion: UniMotion通过将运动作为一等连续模态处理，构建了统一的跨模态理解和生成框架，解决了现有方法的局限性，并在多个任务上取得了优异性能。

title: Deep S2P: Integrating Learning Based Stereo Matching Into the Satellite Stereo Pipeline
summary: Digital Surface Model generation from satellite imagery is a core task in Earth observation and is commonly addressed using classical stereoscopic matching algorithms in satellite pipelines as in the Satellite Stereo Pipeline (S2P). While recent learning-based stereo matchers achieve state-of-the-art performance on standard benchmarks, their integration into operational satellite pipelines remains challenging due to differences in viewing geometry and disparity assumptions. In this work, we integrate several modern learning-based stereo matchers, including StereoAnywhere, MonSter, Foundation Stereo, and a satellite fine-tuned variant of MonSter, into the Satellite Stereo Pipeline, adapting the rectification stage to enforce compatible disparity polarity and range. We release the corresponding code to enable reproducible use of these methods in large-scale Earth observation workflows. Experiments on satellite imagery show consistent improvements over classical cost-volume-based approaches in terms of Digital Surface Model accuracy, although commonly used metrics such as mean absolute error exhibit saturation effects. Qualitative results reveal substantially improved geometric detail and sharper structures, highlighting the need for evaluation strategies that better reflect perceptual and structural fidelity. At the same time, performance over challenging surface types such as vegetation remains limited across all evaluated models, indicating open challenges for learning-based stereo in natural environments.

AI.tldr: 将现代学习型立体匹配算法集成到卫星立体处理流程中，相比传统方法在数字表面模型精度上有所提升，但植被等复杂表面仍存在挑战
AI.motivation: 尽管学习型立体匹配算法在标准基准测试中表现优异，但由于视角几何和视差假设的差异，将其集成到操作卫星处理流程中仍具挑战性
AI.method: 将StereoAnywhere、MonSter、Foundation Stereo等现代学习型立体匹配算法集成到卫星立体处理流程中，调整校正阶段以确保兼容的视差极性和范围
AI.result: 实验显示相比传统基于代价体积的方法，在数字表面模型精度上有持续改进，但常用指标如平均绝对误差表现出饱和效应；定性结果显示几何细节和结构清晰度显著提升
AI.conclusion: 学习型立体匹配算法在卫星图像处理中显示出潜力，但需要更好的评估策略来反映感知和结构保真度，同时植被等复杂表面类型仍是所有评估模型的共同挑战

title: End-to-End Training for Unified Tokenization and Latent Denoising
comment: First two authors contributed equally. Project: https://xingjianbai.com/unite-tokenization-generation/ Code: https://github.com/ShivamDuggal4/UNITE-tokenization-generation
summary: Latent diffusion models (LDMs) enable high-fidelity synthesis by operating in learned latent spaces. However, training state-of-the-art LDMs requires complex staging: a tokenizer must be trained first, before the diffusion model can be trained in the frozen latent space. We propose UNITE - an autoencoder architecture for unified tokenization and latent diffusion. UNITE consists of a Generative Encoder that serves as both image tokenizer and latent generator via weight sharing. Our key insight is that tokenization and generation can be viewed as the same latent inference problem under different conditioning regimes: tokenization infers latents from fully observed images, whereas generation infers them from noise together with text or class conditioning. Motivated by this, we introduce a single-stage training procedure that jointly optimizes both tasks via two forward passes through the same Generative Encoder. The shared parameters enable gradients to jointly shape the latent space, encouraging a "common latent language". Across image and molecule modalities, UNITE achieves near state of the art performance without adversarial losses or pretrained encoders (e.g., DINO), reaching FID 2.12 and 1.73 for Base and Large models on ImageNet 256 x 256. We further analyze the Generative Encoder through the lenses of representation alignment and compression. These results show that single stage joint training of tokenization & generation from scratch is feasible.

AI.tldr: UNITE提出了一种统一的自动编码器架构，通过权重共享实现图像标记化和潜在扩散生成，单阶段训练即可达到接近SOTA的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在扩散模型需要复杂的多阶段训练：先训练标记器，再在冻结的潜在空间中训练扩散模型。这种分离训练过程增加了复杂性，且可能无法优化共享的潜在表示。
AI.method: 提出UNITE架构，包含一个生成编码器，通过权重共享同时作为图像标记器和潜在生成器。核心洞察是将标记化和生成视为相同潜在推理问题在不同条件下的变体。采用单阶段训练程序，通过同一生成编码器的两次前向传播联合优化两个任务。
AI.result: 在图像和分子模态上，UNITE无需对抗损失或预训练编码器即可达到接近SOTA的性能。在ImageNet 256×256上，Base和Large模型分别达到FID 2.12和1.73。分析显示生成编码器在表示对齐和压缩方面表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 单阶段联合训练标记化和生成任务是可行的，共享参数能够共同塑造潜在空间，促进"共同潜在语言"的形成，简化了潜在扩散模型的训练流程。

title: A Latent Representation Learning Framework for Hyperspectral Image Emulation in Remote Sensing
summary: Synthetic hyperspectral image (HSI) generation is essential for large-scale simulation, algorithm development, and mission design, yet traditional radiative transfer models remain computationally expensive and often limited to spectrum-level outputs. In this work, we propose a latent representation-based framework for hyperspectral emulation that learns a latent generative representation of hyperspectral data. The proposed approach supports both spectrum-level and spatial-spectral emulation and can be trained either in a direct one-step formulation or in a two-step strategy that couples variational autoencoder (VAE) pretraining with parameter-to-latent interpolation. Experiments on PROSAIL-simulated vegetation data and Sentinel-3 OLCI imagery demonstrate that the method outperforms classical regression-based emulators in reconstruction accuracy, spectral fidelity, and robustness to real-world spatial variability. We further show that emulated HSIs preserve performance in downstream biophysical parameter retrieval, highlighting the practical relevance of emulated data for remote sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于潜在表示的HSI生成框架，支持光谱级和空间-光谱级仿真，在植被数据和卫星影像上优于传统回归方法
AI.motivation: 传统辐射传输模型计算成本高且通常仅限于光谱级输出，需要高效的合成高光谱图像生成方法用于大规模仿真、算法开发和任务设计
AI.method: 基于潜在表示的HSI仿真框架，学习高光谱数据的潜在生成表示，支持光谱级和空间-光谱级仿真，可采用直接一步训练或VAE预训练与参数到潜在插值的两步策略
AI.result: 在PROSAIL模拟植被数据和Sentinel-3 OLCI影像上，该方法在重建精度、光谱保真度和对真实空间变异性的鲁棒性方面优于经典回归仿真器，仿真HSI在下游生物物理参数反演中保持性能
AI.conclusion: 提出的潜在表示框架为高光谱仿真提供了高效解决方案，仿真数据在遥感应用中具有实际相关性，能够保持下游任务的性能

title: The Golden Subspace: Where Efficiency Meets Generalization in Continual Test-Time Adaptation
summary: Continual Test-Time Adaptation (CTTA) aims to enable models to adapt online to unlabeled data streams under distribution shift without accessing source data. Existing CTTA methods face an efficiency-generalization trade-off: updating more parameters improves adaptation but severely reduces online inference efficiency. An ideal solution is to achieve comparable adaptation with minimal feature updates; we call this minimal subspace the golden subspace. We prove its existence in a single-step adaptation setting and show that it coincides with the row space of the pretrained classifier. To enable online maintenance of this subspace, we introduce the sample-wise Average Gradient Outer Product (AGOP) as an efficient proxy for estimating the classifier weights without retraining. Building on these insights, we propose Guided Online Low-rank Directional adaptation (GOLD), which uses a lightweight adapter to project features onto the golden subspace and learns a compact scaling vector while the subspace is dynamically updated via AGOP. Extensive experiments on classification and segmentation benchmarks, including autonomous-driving scenarios, demonstrate that GOLD attains superior efficiency, stability, and overall performance. Our code is available at https://github.com/AIGNLAI/GOLD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GOLD方法解决持续测试时适应中的效率-泛化权衡问题，通过识别"黄金子空间"并利用平均梯度外积在线维护，实现高效的特征适应。
AI.motivation: 现有持续测试时适应方法面临效率与泛化的权衡：更新更多参数能改善适应效果但严重降低在线推理效率。需要找到既能有效适应又最小化特征更新的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出GOLD方法：1）证明黄金子空间的存在性及其与预训练分类器行空间的关系；2）引入样本级平均梯度外积作为高效代理来估计分类器权重；3）使用轻量适配器将特征投影到黄金子空间，学习紧凑缩放向量，同时通过AGOP动态更新子空间。
AI.result: 在分类和分割基准测试（包括自动驾驶场景）上的广泛实验表明，GOLD在效率、稳定性和整体性能方面均达到优越表现。
AI.conclusion: GOLD方法通过识别并在线维护黄金子空间，成功解决了持续测试时适应中的效率-泛化权衡问题，实现了高效且有效的在线适应。

title: SatGeo-NeRF: Geometrically Regularized NeRF for Satellite Imagery
summary: We present SatGeo-NeRF, a geometrically regularized NeRF for satellite imagery that mitigates overfitting-induced geometric artifacts observed in current state-of-the-art models using three model-agnostic regularizers. Gravity-Aligned Planarity Regularization aligns depth-inferred, approximated surface normals with the gravity axis to promote local planarity, coupling adjacent rays via a corresponding surface approximation to facilitate cross-ray gradient flow. Granularity Regularization enforces a coarse-to-fine geometry-learning scheme, and Depth-Supervised Regularization stabilizes early training for improved geometric accuracy. On the DFC2019 satellite reconstruction benchmark, SatGeo-NeRF improves the Mean Altitude Error by 13.9% and 11.7% relative to state-of-the-art baselines such as EO-NeRF and EO-GS.

AI.tldr: SatGeo-NeRF通过三种模型无关的正则化器改进卫星图像的NeRF重建，减少过拟合导致的几何伪影，在DFC2019基准上比现有方法提升11-14%的精度。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进的卫星图像NeRF模型存在过拟合导致的几何伪影问题，需要改进几何正则化来提高重建精度。
AI.method: 提出三种模型无关的正则化器：1) 重力对齐平面正则化，将深度推断的表面法线与重力轴对齐以促进局部平面性；2) 粒度正则化，实施从粗到细的几何学习方案；3) 深度监督正则化，稳定早期训练以提高几何精度。
AI.result: 在DFC2019卫星重建基准上，SatGeo-NeRF相比EO-NeRF和EO-GS等最先进基线，平均高度误差分别改善了13.9%和11.7%。
AI.conclusion: SatGeo-NeRF通过几何正则化有效减少了卫星图像NeRF重建中的几何伪影，显著提升了重建精度。

title: Cross-Instance Gaussian Splatting Registration via Geometry-Aware Feature-Guided Alignment
summary: We present Gaussian Splatting Alignment (GSA), a novel method for aligning two independent 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) models via a similarity transformation (rotation, translation, and scale), even when they are of different objects in the same category (e.g., different cars). In contrast, existing methods can only align 3DGS models of the same object (e.g., the same car) and often must be given true scale as input, while we estimate it successfully. GSA leverages viewpoint-guided spherical map features to obtain robust correspondences and introduces a two-step optimization framework that aligns 3DGS models while keeping them fixed. First, we apply an iterative feature-guided absolute orientation solver as our coarse registration, which is robust to poor initialization (e.g., 180 degrees misalignment or a 10x scale gap). Next, we use a fine registration step that enforces multi-view feature consistency, inspired by inverse radiance-field formulations. The first step already achieves state-of-the-art performance, and the second further improves results. In the same-object case, GSA outperforms prior works, often by a large margin, even when the other methods are given the true scale. In the harder case of different objects in the same category, GSA vastly surpasses them, providing the first effective solution for category-level 3DGS registration and unlocking new applications. Project webpage: https://bgu-cs-vil.github.io/GSA-project/

AI.tldr: GSA是一种新颖的3D高斯泼溅模型对齐方法，能够通过相似变换（旋转、平移、缩放）对齐两个独立的3DGS模型，即使它们是同一类别中的不同物体（如不同的汽车）。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只能对齐同一物体的3DGS模型，且通常需要已知真实尺度作为输入。需要一种能够对齐同一类别不同物体且能自动估计尺度的3DGS对齐方法。
AI.method: 采用视点引导的球形图特征获取鲁棒对应关系，引入两步优化框架：1）迭代特征引导的绝对方向求解器进行粗配准，对初始化不敏感；2）受逆辐射场公式启发的精细配准步骤，强制执行多视图特征一致性。
AI.result: 在同一物体情况下，GSA显著优于现有方法；在同一类别不同物体的更困难情况下，GSA大幅超越现有方法，为类别级3DGS配准提供了首个有效解决方案。
AI.conclusion: GSA是首个有效的类别级3DGS配准方法，能够处理同一类别不同物体的对齐，自动估计尺度，解锁了新的应用可能性。

title: MultiBind: A Benchmark for Attribute Misbinding in Multi-Subject Generation
summary: Subject-driven image generation is increasingly expected to support fine-grained control over multiple entities within a single image. In multi-reference workflows, users may provide several subject images, a background reference, and long, entity-indexed prompts to control multiple people within one scene. In this setting, a key failure mode is cross-subject attribute misbinding: attributes are preserved, edited, or transferred to the wrong subject. Existing benchmarks and metrics largely emphasize holistic fidelity or per-subject self-similarity, making such failures hard to diagnose. We introduce MultiBind, a benchmark built from real multi-person photographs. Each instance provides slot-ordered subject crops with masks and bounding boxes, canonicalized subject references, an inpainted background reference, and a dense entity-indexed prompt derived from structured annotations. We also propose a dimension-wise confusion evaluation protocol that matches generated subjects to ground-truth slots and measures slot-to-slot similarity using specialists for face identity, appearance, pose, and expression. By subtracting the corresponding ground-truth similarity matrices, our method separates self-degradation from true cross-subject interference and exposes interpretable failure patterns such as drift, swap, dominance, and blending. Experiments on modern multi-reference generators show that MultiBind reveals binding failures that conventional reconstruction metrics miss.

AI.tldr: MultiBind是一个用于评估多参考图像生成中跨主体属性错误绑定的新基准，通过真实多人照片构建，提供槽位有序的主体裁剪和密集实体索引提示，并提出维度混淆评估协议来诊断绑定失败模式。
AI.motivation: 在多参考图像生成中，用户提供多个主体图像、背景参考和实体索引提示来控制单张图像中的多个实体。现有基准和指标主要关注整体保真度或每个主体的自相似性，难以诊断跨主体属性错误绑定（如属性被保留、编辑或转移到错误主体）这一关键失败模式。
AI.method: 构建MultiBind基准：从真实多人照片构建实例，提供槽位有序的主体裁剪（带掩码和边界框）、规范化主体参考、修复的背景参考以及从结构化注释派生的密集实体索引提示。提出维度混淆评估协议：将生成的主体与真实槽位匹配，使用面部身份、外观、姿势和表情等专家模型测量槽位到槽位的相似度，通过减去相应的真实相似度矩阵来分离自退化与真正的跨主体干扰。
AI.result: MultiBind能够揭示传统重建指标遗漏的绑定失败。实验表明，现代多参考生成器在MultiBind上显示出绑定失败，包括漂移、交换、主导和混合等可解释的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: MultiBind基准和维度混淆评估协议为多参考图像生成中的跨主体属性错误绑定提供了有效的诊断工具，能够分离自退化与跨主体干扰，暴露传统指标难以检测的绑定失败模式。

title: FeatDistill: A Feature Distillation Enhanced Multi-Expert Ensemble Framework for Robust AI-generated Image Detection
comment: 6th place (6/507) technical report at the NTIRE 2026: Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild Challenge
summary:
The rapid iteration and widespread dissemination of deepfake technology have posed severe challenges to information security, making robust and generalizable detection of AI-generated forged images increasingly important. In this paper, we propose FeatDistill, an AI-generated image detection framework that integrates feature distillation with a multi-expert ensemble, developed for the NTIRE Challenge on Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild. The framework explicitly targets three practical bottlenecks in real-world forensics: degradation interference, insufficient feature representation, and limited generalization.
  Concretely, we build a four-backbone Vision Transformer (ViT) ensemble composed of CLIP and SigLIP variants to capture complementary forensic cues. To improve data coverage, we expand the training set and introduce comprehensive degradation modeling, which exposes the detector to diverse quality variations and synthesis artifacts commonly encountered in unconstrained scenarios. We further adopt a two-stage training paradigm: the model is first optimized with a standard binary classification objective, then refined by dense feature-level self-distillation for representation alignment. This design effectively mitigates overfitting and enhances semantic consistency of learned features.
  At inference time, the final prediction is obtained by averaging the probabilities from four independently trained experts, yielding stable and reliable decisions across unseen generators and complex degradations. Despite the ensemble design, the framework remains efficient, requiring only about 10 GB peak GPU memory. Extensive evaluations in the NTIRE challenge setting demonstrate that FeatDistill achieves strong robustness and generalization under diverse ``in-the-wild'' conditions, offering an effective and practical solution for real-world deepfake image detection.

AI.tldr: FeatDistill是一个用于AI生成图像检测的框架，通过特征蒸馏和多专家集成来解决真实世界取证中的三个瓶颈问题：退化干扰、特征表示不足和泛化能力有限。
AI.motivation: 深度伪造技术的快速迭代和广泛传播对信息安全构成了严重挑战，使得对AI生成的伪造图像进行鲁棒且可泛化的检测变得越来越重要。本文针对真实世界取证中的三个实际瓶颈：退化干扰、特征表示不足和泛化能力有限，提出了解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 构建了由CLIP和SigLIP变体组成的四骨干Vision Transformer集成，以捕捉互补的取证线索；2. 扩展训练集并引入全面的退化建模，使检测器暴露于各种质量变化和合成伪影；3. 采用两阶段训练范式：先用标准二元分类目标优化模型，然后通过密集特征级自蒸馏进行表示对齐；4. 推理时通过平均四个独立训练专家的概率获得最终预测。
AI.result: 在NTIRE挑战赛设置下的广泛评估表明，FeatDistill在多样化的"野外"条件下实现了强大的鲁棒性和泛化能力。尽管采用集成设计，该框架仍然高效，仅需约10GB峰值GPU内存。
AI.conclusion: FeatDistill为真实世界深度伪造图像检测提供了一个有效且实用的解决方案，通过特征蒸馏和多专家集成的方法，在未见过的生成器和复杂退化条件下实现了稳定可靠的检测性能。

title: GeoFlow: Real-Time Fine-Grained Cross-View Geolocalization via Iterative Flow Prediction
comment: Accepted at the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR 2026)
summary: Accurate and fast localization is vital for safe autonomous navigation in GPS-denied areas. Fine-Grained Cross-View Geolocalization (FG-CVG) aims to estimate the precise 2-Degree-of-Freedom (2-DoF) location of a ground image relative to a satellite image. However, current methods force a difficult trade-off, with high-accuracy models being slow for real-time use. In this paper, we introduce GeoFlow, a new approach that offers a lightweight and highly efficient framework that breaks this accuracy-speed trade-off. Our technique learns a direct probabilistic mapping, predicting the displacement (in distance and direction) required to correct any given location hypothesis. This is complemented by our novel inference algorithm, Iterative Refinement Sampling (IRS). Instead of trusting a single prediction, IRS refines a population of hypotheses, allowing them to iteratively 'flow' from random starting points to a robust, converged consensus. Even its iterative nature, this approach offers flexible inference-time scaling, allowing a direct trade-off between performance and computation without any re-training. Experiments on the KITTI and VIGOR datasets show that GeoFlow achieves state-of-the-art efficiency, running at real-time speeds of 29 FPS while maintaining competitive localization accuracy. This work opens a new path for the development of practical real-time geolocalization systems.

AI.tldr: GeoFlow是一种用于细粒度跨视角地理定位的新方法，通过概率映射和迭代优化采样算法，在保持高精度的同时实现实时处理速度（29 FPS），打破了传统方法在精度和速度之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 在GPS拒止区域，准确快速的定位对于自动驾驶导航至关重要。现有的细粒度跨视角地理定位方法面临一个困难权衡：高精度模型速度慢，无法满足实时应用需求。
AI.method: 提出GeoFlow框架，学习从地面图像到卫星图像的直接概率映射，预测修正位置假设所需的位移（距离和方向）。采用新颖的推理算法——迭代优化采样（IRS），通过迭代优化一组假设，使其从随机起点"流动"到稳健的收敛共识。
AI.result: 在KITTI和VIGOR数据集上的实验表明，GeoFlow实现了最先进的效率，以29 FPS的实时速度运行，同时保持了有竞争力的定位精度。该方法支持灵活的推理时缩放，无需重新训练即可在性能和计算之间直接权衡。
AI.conclusion: GeoFlow打破了细粒度跨视角地理定位中精度与速度的权衡，为实用的实时地理定位系统开发开辟了新路径。

title: Unified Spatiotemporal Token Compression for Video-LLMs at Ultra-Low Retention
summary: Video large language models (Video-LLMs) face high computational costs due to large volumes of visual tokens. Existing token compression methods typically adopt a two-stage spatiotemporal compression strategy, relying on stage-specific metrics and an implicit assumption of spatiotemporal separability. Under extremely low retention ratios, however, such approaches often result in unbalanced allocation and loss of visual evidence essential for question answering. We reformulate token compression as a spatiotemporal allocation task within a global token retention pool. We propose a unified selection mechanism that integrates attention weights and semantic similarity to globally select tokens with high contribution and low redundancy. Unselected tokens are merged via clustering and refilled, preserving information integrity. Inside the LLM, we further introduce text-aware merging to perform secondary compression based on query relevance. Without requiring retraining, our method serves as a plug-and-play module compatible with existing Video-LLMs. Experiments show that retaining only about 2% of visual tokens preserves 90.1% of baseline performance across multiple benchmarks, while reducing FLOPs to roughly 2.6%. These benefits generalize across diverse backbones, decreasing end-to-end inference latency and memory consumption. Our unified spatiotemporal token compression strategy establishes the state-of-the-art in video understanding under ultra-low token retention.

AI.tldr: 提出一种统一的时空令牌压缩策略，通过全局令牌保留池和文本感知合并，在仅保留约2%视觉令牌的情况下保持90.1%的基线性能，显著降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型面临高计算成本问题，现有令牌压缩方法采用两阶段时空压缩策略，在极低保留率下会导致视觉证据丢失和不平衡分配，影响问答准确性。
AI.method: 1) 将令牌压缩重新定义为全局令牌保留池中的时空分配任务；2) 提出统一选择机制，结合注意力权重和语义相似性全局选择高贡献、低冗余令牌；3) 未选中令牌通过聚类和重填充保留信息完整性；4) 在LLM内部引入文本感知合并进行基于查询相关性的二次压缩。
AI.result: 仅保留约2%视觉令牌即可保持90.1%的基线性能，将FLOPs降低至约2.6%，减少端到端推理延迟和内存消耗，在多个基准测试中表现优异，适用于不同骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 提出的统一时空令牌压缩策略在超低令牌保留率下实现了视频理解的最先进性能，作为即插即用模块兼容现有Video-LLMs，无需重新训练。

title: GeoFusion-CAD: Structure-Aware Diffusion with Geometric State Space for Parametric 3D Design
comment: Accepted to CVPR 2026 (Findings). Includes supplementary material
summary: Parametric Computer-Aided Design (CAD) is fundamental to modern 3D modeling, yet existing methods struggle to generate long command sequences, especially under complex geometric and topological dependencies. Transformer-based architectures dominate CAD sequence generation due to their strong dependency modeling, but their quadratic attention cost and limited context windowing hinder scalability to long programs. We propose GeoFusion-CAD, an end-to-end diffusion framework for scalable and structure-aware generation. Our proposal encodes CAD programs as hierarchical trees, jointly capturing geometry and topology within a state-space diffusion process. Specifically, a lightweight C-Mamba block models long-range structural dependencies through selective state transitions, enabling coherent generation across extended command sequences. To support long-sequence evaluation, we introduce DeepCAD-240, an extended benchmark that increases the sequence length ranging from 40 to 240 while preserving sketch-extrusion semantics from the ABC dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GeoFusion-CAD achieves superior performance on both short and long command ranges, maintaining high geometric fidelity and topological consistency where Transformer-based models degrade. Our approach sets new state-of-the-art scores for long-sequence parametric CAD generation, establishing a scalable foundation for next-generation CAD modeling systems. Code and datasets are available at GitHub.

AI.tldr: GeoFusion-CAD：基于扩散模型的参数化CAD生成框架，通过层次化树结构和状态空间扩散处理长序列生成，在DeepCAD-240基准上超越Transformer方法
AI.motivation: 现有参数化CAD生成方法（特别是基于Transformer的）在处理长命令序列时面临挑战，二次注意力成本和有限上下文窗口限制了其可扩展性，难以处理复杂的几何和拓扑依赖关系
AI.method: 提出GeoFusion-CAD端到端扩散框架：1）将CAD程序编码为层次化树结构，联合捕捉几何和拓扑信息；2）采用状态空间扩散过程；3）使用轻量级C-Mamba块通过选择性状态转移建模长程结构依赖
AI.result: 在DeepCAD-240扩展基准（序列长度40-240）上，GeoFusion-CAD在短序列和长序列范围均表现优异，保持高几何保真度和拓扑一致性，而Transformer模型在长序列上性能下降
AI.conclusion: GeoFusion-CAD为参数化CAD长序列生成建立了新的最先进方法，为下一代CAD建模系统提供了可扩展的基础框架

title: 6D Robotic OCT Scanning of Curved Tissue Surfaces
summary: Optical coherence tomography (OCT) is a non-invasive volumetric imaging modality with high spatial and temporal resolution. For imaging larger tissue structures, OCT probes need to be moved to scan the respective area. For handheld scanning, stitching of the acquired OCT volumes requires overlap to register the images. For robotic scanning and stitching, a typical approach is to restrict the motion to translations, as this avoids a full hand-eye calibration, which is complicated by the small field of view of most OCT probes. However, stitching by registration or by translational scanning are limited when curved tissue surfaces need to be scanned. We propose a marker for full six-dimensional hand-eye calibration of a robot mounted OCT probe. We show that the calibration results in highly repeatable estimates of the transformation. Moreover, we evaluate robotic scanning of two phantom surfaces to demonstrate that the proposed calibration allows for consistent scanning of large, curved tissue surfaces. As the proposed approach is not relying on image registration, it does not suffer from a potential accumulation of errors along a scan path. We also illustrate the improvement compared to conventional 3D-translational robotic scanning.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于机器人安装OCT探头的六自由度手眼标定标记方法，实现大曲率组织表面的精确扫描和拼接
AI.motivation: 传统OCT扫描拼接方法在扫描曲面组织时存在局限：手持扫描需要图像重叠配准，机器人扫描通常限制为平移运动以避免复杂的手眼标定，但这些方法无法有效处理大曲率表面
AI.method: 提出一种标记方法，用于机器人安装OCT探头的完整六自由度手眼标定，不依赖图像配准，避免误差累积
AI.result: 标定结果具有高度可重复性，在两个体模表面上的机器人扫描实验表明，该方法能够实现大曲率组织表面的一致扫描，相比传统三维平移扫描有明显改进
AI.conclusion: 提出的六自由度手眼标定方法解决了曲面组织扫描的挑战，不依赖图像配准避免了误差累积，为机器人OCT扫描大曲率表面提供了有效解决方案

title: Tuning Real-World Image Restoration at Inference: A Test-Time Scaling Paradigm for Flow Matching Models
summary: Although diffusion-based real-world image restoration (Real-IR) has achieved remarkable progress, efficiently leveraging ultra-large-scale pre-trained text-to-image (T2I) models and fully exploiting their potential remain significant challenges. To address this issue, we propose ResFlow-Tuner, an image restoration framework based on the state-of-the-art flow matching model, FLUX.1-dev, which integrates unified multi-modal fusion (UMMF) with test-time scaling (TTS) to achieve unprecedented restoration performance. Our approach fully leverages the advantages of the Multi-Modal Diffusion Transformer (MM-DiT) architecture by encoding multi-modal conditions into a unified sequence that guides the synthesis of high-quality images. Furthermore, we introduce a training-free test-time scaling paradigm tailored for image restoration. During inference, this technique dynamically steers the denoising direction through feedback from a reward model (RM), thereby achieving significant performance gains with controllable computational overhead. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple standard benchmarks. This work not only validates the powerful capabilities of the flow matching model in low-level vision tasks but, more importantly, proposes a novel and efficient inference-time scaling paradigm suitable for large pre-trained models.

AI.tldr: ResFlow-Tuner是一个基于FLUX.1-dev流匹配模型的图像修复框架，通过统一多模态融合和测试时缩放技术，在多个基准测试中实现了最先进的修复性能。
AI.motivation: 尽管基于扩散模型的真实世界图像修复取得了显著进展，但如何高效利用超大规模预训练文本到图像模型并充分挖掘其潜力仍然是重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出ResFlow-Tuner框架：1）采用统一多模态融合技术，将多模态条件编码为统一序列指导高质量图像合成；2）引入无需训练的测试时缩放范式，在推理时通过奖励模型的反馈动态引导去噪方向，实现可控计算开销下的性能提升。
AI.result: 在多个标准基准测试中实现了最先进的性能表现，验证了流匹配模型在低级视觉任务中的强大能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作不仅验证了流匹配模型在低级视觉任务中的强大能力，更重要的是提出了一种适用于大型预训练模型的新型高效推理时缩放范式。

title: GTSR: Subsurface Scattering Awared 3D Gaussians for Translucent Surface Reconstruction
summary: Reconstructing translucent objects from multi-view images is a difficult problem. Previously, researchers have used differentiable path tracing and the neural implicit field, which require relatively large computational costs. Recently, many works have achieved good reconstruction results for opaque objects based on a 3DGS pipeline with much higher efficiency. However, such methods have difficulty dealing with translucent objects, because they do not consider the optical properties of translucent objects. In this paper, we propose a novel 3DGS-based pipeline (GTSR) to reconstruct the surface geometry of translucent objects. GTSR combines two sets of Gaussians, surface and interior Gaussians, which are used to model the surface and scattering color when lights pass translucent objects. To render the appearance of translucent objects, we introduce a method that uses the Fresnel term to blend two sets of Gaussians. Furthermore, to improve the reconstructed details of non-contour areas, we introduce the Disney BSDF model with deferred rendering to enhance constraints of the normal and depth. Experimental results demonstrate that our method outperforms baseline reconstruction methods on the NeuralTO Syn dataset while showing great real-time rendering performance. We also extend the dataset with new translucent objects of varying material properties and demonstrate our method can adapt to different translucent materials.

AI.tldr: 提出基于3DGS的GTSR管道，用于重建半透明物体的表面几何，通过表面和内部高斯模型结合Fresnel项混合渲染，并使用Disney BSDF模型增强细节约束。
AI.motivation: 现有基于3DGS的方法难以处理半透明物体，因为它们没有考虑半透明物体的光学特性。虽然可微分路径追踪和神经隐式场方法能处理，但计算成本较高。
AI.method: 提出GTSR管道：1) 使用表面高斯和内部高斯两套高斯模型分别建模表面和光线穿过半透明物体时的散射颜色；2) 引入Fresnel项混合两套高斯进行渲染；3) 使用Disney BSDF模型配合延迟渲染增强法线和深度约束，改善非轮廓区域细节。
AI.result: 在NeuralTO Syn数据集上优于基线重建方法，同时展现出优异的实时渲染性能。扩展数据集包含不同材质特性的半透明物体，证明方法能适应不同半透明材料。
AI.conclusion: GTSR是一种高效且有效的半透明物体表面几何重建方法，通过创新的高斯模型设计和渲染技术，解决了现有3DGS方法在处理半透明物体时的局限性。

title: DTVI: Dual-Stage Textual and Visual Intervention for Safe Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-Image (T2I) diffusion models have demonstrated strong generation ability, but their potential to generate unsafe content raises significant safety concerns. Existing inference-time defense methods typically perform category-agnostic token-level intervention in the text embedding space, which fails to capture malicious semantics distributed across the full token sequence and remains vulnerable to adversarial prompts. In this paper, we propose DTVI, a dual-stage inference-time defense framework for safe T2I generation. Unlike existing methods that intervene on specific token embeddings, our method introduces category-aware sequence-level intervention on the full prompt embedding to better capture distributed malicious semantics, and further attenuates the remaining unsafe influences during the visual generation stage. Experimental results on real-world unsafe prompts, adversarial prompts, and multiple harmful categories show that our method achieves effective and robust defense while preserving reasonable generation quality on benign prompts, obtaining an average Defense Success Rate (DSR) of 94.43% across sexual-category benchmarks and 88.56 across seven unsafe categories, while maintaining generation quality on benign prompts.

AI.tldr: DTVI是一个双阶段推理时防御框架，通过类别感知的序列级干预和视觉生成阶段的不安全影响衰减，有效防御文本到图像扩散模型中的不安全内容生成。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时防御方法通常在文本嵌入空间进行类别无关的令牌级干预，无法捕捉分布在完整令牌序列中的恶意语义，且容易受到对抗性提示的攻击。
AI.method: 提出DTVI双阶段防御框架：1）在文本嵌入空间引入类别感知的序列级干预，更好地捕捉分布式恶意语义；2）在视觉生成阶段进一步衰减剩余的不安全影响。
AI.result: 在真实世界不安全提示、对抗性提示和多个有害类别上，DTVI实现了有效且鲁棒的防御，在性类别基准上平均防御成功率达94.43%，在七个不安全类别上达88.56%，同时保持良性提示的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: DTVI通过双阶段序列级干预方法，显著提升了文本到图像扩散模型的安全防御能力，解决了现有方法在捕捉分布式恶意语义和对抗性提示方面的局限性。

title: FontCrafter: High-Fidelity Element-Driven Artistic Font Creation with Visual In-Context Generation
summary: Artistic font generation aims to synthesize stylized glyphs based on a reference style. However, existing approaches suffer from limited style diversity and coarse control. In this work, we explore the potential of element-driven artistic font generation. Elements are the fundamental visual units of a font, serving as reference images for the desired style. Conceptually, we categorize elements into object elements (e.g., flowers or stones) with distinct structures and amorphous elements (e.g., flames or clouds) with unstructured textures. We introduce FontCrafter, an element-driven framework for font creation, and construct a large-scale dataset, ElementFont, which contains diverse element types and high-quality glyph images. However, achieving high-fidelity reconstruction of both texture and structure of reference elements remains challenging. To address this, we propose an in-context generation strategy that treats element images as visual context and uses an inpainting model to transfer element styles into glyph regions at the pixel level. To further control glyph shapes, we design a lightweight Context-aware Mask Adapter (CMA) that injects shape information. Moreover, a training-free attention redirection mechanism enables region-aware style control and suppresses stroke hallucination. In addition, edge repainting is applied to make boundaries more natural. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FontCrafter achieves strong zero-shot generation performance, particularly in preserving structural and textural fidelity, while also supporting flexible controls such as style mixture.

AI.tldr: FontCrafter：基于元素驱动的艺术字体生成框架，通过视觉上下文生成策略和注意力重定向机制，实现高保真的结构和纹理重建，支持灵活的风格控制。
AI.motivation: 现有艺术字体生成方法存在风格多样性有限和控制粒度粗糙的问题。本文探索元素驱动的艺术字体生成，将元素作为字体风格的基本视觉单元，旨在实现更丰富多样的风格和更精细的控制。
AI.method: 提出FontCrafter框架，包含：1）构建大规模ElementFont数据集；2）上下文生成策略，将元素图像作为视觉上下文，使用修复模型在像素级将元素风格转移到字形区域；3）轻量级上下文感知掩码适配器（CMA）注入形状信息；4）无需训练的注意力重定向机制实现区域感知风格控制；5）边缘重绘使边界更自然。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，FontCrafter在零样本生成方面表现优异，特别是在保持结构和纹理保真度方面，同时支持灵活的控制如风格混合。
AI.conclusion: FontCrafter通过元素驱动的框架解决了艺术字体生成中的风格多样性和控制精度问题，实现了高保真的结构和纹理重建，为艺术字体创作提供了更灵活的控制能力。

title: SpatialBoost: Enhancing Visual Representation through Language-Guided Reasoning
summary: Despite the remarkable success of large-scale pre-trained image representation models (i.e., vision encoders) across various vision tasks, they are predominantly trained on 2D image data and therefore often fail to capture 3D spatial relationships between objects and backgrounds in the real world, constraining their effectiveness in many downstream applications. To address this, we propose SpatialBoost, a scalable framework that enhances the spatial awareness of existing pre-trained vision encoders by injecting 3D spatial knowledge expressed in linguistic descriptions. The core idea involves converting dense 3D spatial information from 2D images into linguistic expressions, which is then used to inject such spatial knowledge into vision encoders through a Large Language Model (LLM). To this end, we adopt a multi-turn Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning process that progressively incorporates dense spatial knowledge and builds hierarchical spatial understanding. To validate effectiveness, we adapt SpatialBoost to state-of-the-art vision encoders such as DINOv3, and evaluate its performance gains on a wide range of benchmarks requiring both 3D perception and general vision abilities. For instance, SpatialBoost improves DINOv3 performance from 55.9 to 59.7 mIoU on ADE20K, achieving state-of-the-art performance with 3.8% gain over the pre-trained DINOv3.

AI.tldr: SpatialBoost是一个可扩展的框架，通过语言描述向预训练视觉编码器注入3D空间知识，提升其空间感知能力
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模预训练视觉编码器主要在2D图像数据上训练，缺乏对真实世界3D空间关系的理解，限制了在下游应用中的效果
AI.method: 将2D图像中的密集3D空间信息转换为语言表达，通过大语言模型（LLM）使用多轮思维链（CoT）推理过程，渐进式地注入空间知识并建立层次化空间理解
AI.result: 在DINOv3等先进视觉编码器上应用SpatialBoost，在需要3D感知和通用视觉能力的广泛基准测试中取得显著性能提升，如ADE20K数据集上mIoU从55.9提升到59.7，相对提升3.8%
AI.conclusion: SpatialBoost能够有效增强现有预训练视觉编码器的空间感知能力，通过语言媒介注入3D空间知识，在多个视觉任务上实现性能提升

title: P-Flow: Prompting Visual Effects Generation
summary: Recent advancements in video generation models have significantly improved their ability to follow text prompts. However, the customization of dynamic visual effects, defined as temporally evolving and appearance-driven visual phenomena like object crushing or explosion, remains underexplored. Prior works on motion customization or control mainly focus on low-level motions of the subject or camera, which can be guided using explicit control signals such as motion trajectories. In contrast, dynamic visual effects involve higher-level semantics that are more naturally suited for control via text prompts. However, it is hard and time-consuming for humans to craft a single prompt that accurately specifies these effects, as they require complex temporal reasoning and iterative refinement over time. To address this challenge, we propose P-Flow, a novel training-free framework for customizing dynamic visual effects in video generation without modifying the underlying model. By leveraging the semantic and temporal reasoning capabilities of vision-language models, P-Flow performs test-time prompt optimization, refining prompts based on the discrepancy between the visual effects of the reference video and the generated output. Through iterative refinement, the prompts evolve to better induce the desired dynamic effect in novel scenes. Experiments demonstrate that P-Flow achieves high-fidelity and diverse visual effect customization and outperforms other models on both text-to-video and image-to-video generation tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/showlab/P-Flow.

AI.tldr: P-Flow是一个无需训练的框架，通过视觉语言模型进行测试时提示优化，实现动态视觉效果的定制化视频生成。
AI.motivation: 当前视频生成模型在遵循文本提示方面已有显著进步，但动态视觉效果（如物体破碎、爆炸等随时间演变的视觉现象）的定制化研究不足。现有方法主要关注主体或摄像机的低级运动控制，而动态视觉效果涉及更高级的语义，更适合通过文本提示控制，但人工编写准确描述复杂时间演变的提示既困难又耗时。
AI.method: 提出P-Flow框架，无需修改底层模型或进行额外训练。利用视觉语言模型的语义和时间推理能力，在测试时进行提示优化：基于参考视频视觉效果与生成输出之间的差异，迭代优化文本提示，使提示逐步演化以更好地在新场景中诱导所需的动态效果。
AI.result: 实验表明，P-Flow在文本到视频和图像到视频生成任务中均能实现高保真度和多样化的视觉效果定制，并优于其他模型。
AI.conclusion: P-Flow通过测试时提示优化有效解决了动态视觉效果定制化的挑战，无需修改基础模型即可实现高质量的视频生成效果定制。

title: Principled Steering via Null-space Projection for Jailbreak Defense in Vision-Language Models
summary: As vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly deployed in open-world scenarios, they can be easily induced by visual jailbreak attacks to generate harmful content, posing serious risks to model safety and trustworthy usage. Recent activation steering methods inject directional vectors into model activations during inference to induce refusal behaviors and have demonstrated effectiveness. However, a steering vector may both enhance refusal ability and cause over-refusal, thereby degrading model performance on benign inputs. Moreover, due to the lack of theoretical interpretability, these methods still suffer from limited robustness and effectiveness. To better balance safety and utility, we propose NullSteer, a null-space projected activation defense framework. Our method constructs refusal directions within model activations through a linear transformation: it maintains zero perturbation within the benign subspace while dynamically inducing refusal along potentially harmful directions, thereby theoretically achieving safety enhancement without impairing the model's general capabilities. Extensive experiments show that NullSteer significantly reduces harmful outputs under various jailbreak attacks (average ASR reduction over 15 percent on MiniGPT-4) while maintaining comparable performance to the original model on general benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出NullSteer防御框架，通过零空间投影激活防御，在增强视觉语言模型安全性的同时保持其正常功能性能
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在开放世界场景中容易受到视觉越狱攻击，生成有害内容，现有激活导向方法虽然能诱导拒绝行为，但会导致过度拒绝，降低模型在良性输入上的性能，且缺乏理论可解释性
AI.method: 提出NullSteer零空间投影激活防御框架，通过线性变换在模型激活中构建拒绝方向：在良性子空间保持零扰动，同时在潜在有害方向上动态诱导拒绝，理论上实现安全增强而不损害模型一般能力
AI.result: 实验表明NullSteer在各种越狱攻击下显著减少有害输出（在MiniGPT-4上平均ASR降低超过15%），同时在通用基准测试中保持与原始模型相当的性能
AI.conclusion: NullSteer框架有效平衡了安全性和实用性，通过零空间投影方法在理论上保证安全增强的同时不损害模型性能，为解决视觉语言模型安全问题提供了新思路

title: StreamingClaw Technical Report
summary: Applications such as embodied intelligence rely on a real-time perception-decision-action closed loop, posing stringent challenges for streaming video understanding. However, current agents suffer from fragmented capabilities, such as supporting only offline video understanding, lacking long-term multimodal memory mechanisms, or struggling to achieve real-time reasoning and proactive interaction under streaming inputs. These shortcomings have become a key bottleneck for preventing them from sustaining perception, making real-time decisions, and executing actions in real-world environments. To alleviate these issues, we propose StreamingClaw, a unified agent framework for streaming video understanding and embodied intelligence. It is also an OpenClaw-compatible framework that supports real-time, multimodal streaming interaction. StreamingClaw integrates five core capabilities: (1) It supports real-time streaming reasoning. (2) It supports reasoning about future events and proactive interaction under the online evolution of interaction objectives. (3) It supports multimodal long-term storage, hierarchical evolution, and efficient retrieval of shared memory across multiple agents. (4) It supports a closed-loop of perception-decision-action. In addition to conventional tools and skills, it also provides streaming tools and action-centric skills tailored for real-world physical environments. (5) It is compatible with the OpenClaw framework, allowing it to fully leverage the resources and support of the open-source community. With these designs, StreamingClaw integrates online real-time reasoning, multimodal long-term memory, and proactive interaction within a unified framework. Moreover, by translating decisions into executable actions, it enables direct control of the physical world, supporting practical deployment of embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: StreamingClaw是一个用于流式视频理解和具身智能的统一代理框架，支持实时推理、多模态长期记忆和主动交互，实现感知-决策-动作闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 当前智能体存在能力碎片化问题：仅支持离线视频理解、缺乏长期多模态记忆机制、难以在流式输入下实现实时推理和主动交互，这成为在真实环境中持续感知、实时决策和执行动作的关键瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出StreamingClaw统一代理框架，具备五大核心能力：1) 支持实时流式推理；2) 支持未来事件推理和在线交互目标演化下的主动交互；3) 支持多模态长期存储、分层演化和跨代理共享内存高效检索；4) 支持感知-决策-动作闭环，提供流式工具和面向物理环境的动作中心技能；5) 兼容OpenClaw框架，可充分利用开源社区资源。
AI.result: StreamingClaw将在线实时推理、多模态长期记忆和主动交互集成到统一框架中，通过将决策转化为可执行动作，实现对物理世界的直接控制，支持具身交互的实际部署。
AI.conclusion: StreamingClaw解决了当前智能体在流式视频理解和具身智能中的关键瓶颈，通过统一框架实现了实时推理、长期记忆和主动交互的集成，为实际环境中的感知-决策-动作闭环提供了可行解决方案。

title: Biophysics-Enhanced Neural Representations for Patient-Specific Respiratory Motion Modeling
comment: Accepted for publication at the Journal of Machine Learning for Biomedical Imaging (MELBA) https://melba-journal.org/2026:008
summary: A precise spatial delivery of the radiation dose is crucial for the treatment success in radiotherapy. In the lung and upper abdominal region, respiratory motion introduces significant treatment uncertainties, requiring special motion management techniques. To address this, respiratory motion models are commonly used to infer the patient-specific respiratory motion and target the dose more efficiently. In this work, we investigate the possibility of using implicit neural representations (INR) for surrogate-based motion modeling. Therefore, we propose physics-regularized implicit surrogate-based modeling for respiratory motion (PRISM-RM). Our new integrated respiratory motion model is free of a fixed reference breathing state. Unlike conventional pairwise registration techniques, our approach provides a trajectory-aware spatio-temporally continuous and diffeomorphic motion representation, improving generalization to extrapolation scenarios. We introduce biophysical constraints, ensuring physiologically plausible motion estimation across time beyond the training data. Our results show that our trajectory-aware approach performs on par in interpolation and improves the extrapolation ability compared to our initially proposed INR-based approach. Compared to sequential registration-based approaches both our approaches perform equally well in interpolation, but underperform in extrapolation scenarios. However, the methodical features of INRs make them particularly effective for respiratory motion modeling, and with their performance steadily improving, they demonstrate strong potential for advancing this field.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的物理正则化呼吸运动建模方法（PRISM-RM），用于放疗中呼吸运动管理，实现了无固定参考状态的连续时空运动表示，在插值和外推场景中表现出色。
AI.motivation: 在肺部和上腹部区域的放疗中，呼吸运动会导致显著的治疗不确定性，需要特殊的运动管理技术。传统的呼吸运动模型通常需要固定参考状态，且在处理外推场景时泛化能力有限。本研究旨在探索使用隐式神经表示（INR）进行基于替代标志的呼吸运动建模，以提供更连续、更生理合理的运动估计。
AI.method: 提出了PRISM-RM方法，这是一种基于隐式神经表示的物理正则化呼吸运动建模方法。该方法不依赖于固定的参考呼吸状态，而是提供轨迹感知的时空连续且微分同胚的运动表示。引入了生物物理约束，确保在训练数据之外的时间范围内也能获得生理合理的运动估计。
AI.result: 轨迹感知方法在插值场景中表现与最初提出的INR方法相当，但在外推能力方面有所改进。与基于顺序配准的方法相比，两种INR方法在插值场景中表现相当，但在外推场景中表现稍逊。然而，INR的方法特性使其特别适合呼吸运动建模，随着性能的持续改进，显示出推动该领域发展的强大潜力。
AI.conclusion: 隐式神经表示为呼吸运动建模提供了有前景的新方法，特别是其轨迹感知的连续时空表示能力和物理正则化约束，能够提高运动估计的生理合理性和外推能力。虽然在外推场景中仍需改进，但INR的方法优势使其在放疗运动管理领域具有重要应用潜力。

title: DA-VAE: Plug-in Latent Compression for Diffusion via Detail Alignment
summary: Reducing token count is crucial for efficient training and inference of latent diffusion models, especially at high resolution. A common strategy is to build high-compression image tokenizers with more channels per token. However, when trained only for reconstruction, high-dimensional latent spaces often lose meaningful structure, making diffusion training harder. Existing methods address this with extra objectives such as semantic alignment or selective dropout, but usually require costly diffusion retraining. Pretrained diffusion models, however, already exhibit a structured, lower-dimensional latent space; thus, a simpler idea is to expand the latent dimensionality while preserving this structure. We therefore propose \textbf{D}etail-\textbf{A}ligned VAE, which increases the compression ratio of a pretrained VAE with only lightweight adaptation of the pretrained diffusion backbone. DA-VAE uses an explicit latent layout: the first $C$ channels come directly from the pretrained VAE at a base resolution, while an additional $D$ channels encode higher-resolution details. A simple detail-alignment mechanism encourages the expanded latent space to retain the structure of the original one. With a warm-start fine-tuning strategy, our method enables $1024 \times 1024$ image generation with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using only $32 \times 32$ tokens, $4\times$ fewer than the original model, within 5 H100-days. It further unlocks $2048 \times 2048$ generation with SD3.5, achieving a $6\times$ speedup while preserving image quality. We also validate the method and its design choices quantitatively on ImageNet.

AI.tldr: 提出DA-VAE方法，通过扩展预训练VAE的潜在空间维度来减少token数量，同时保持原有结构，实现高分辨率图像生成的高效训练和推理。
AI.motivation: 减少token数量对潜在扩散模型的高效训练和推理至关重要，尤其是在高分辨率下。现有方法通常需要昂贵的扩散重新训练，而预训练扩散模型已经具有结构化的低维潜在空间。
AI.method: 提出Detail-Aligned VAE (DA-VAE)，使用显式潜在布局：前C个通道来自预训练VAE的基础分辨率，额外D个通道编码更高分辨率细节。通过细节对齐机制鼓励扩展的潜在空间保留原始结构，采用热启动微调策略。
AI.result: 使用Stable Diffusion 3.5实现1024×1024图像生成仅需32×32 tokens（比原始模型少4倍），在5个H100天内完成。进一步解锁2048×2048生成，实现6倍加速同时保持图像质量。在ImageNet上定量验证了方法和设计选择。
AI.conclusion: DA-VAE通过轻量级适应预训练扩散骨干，有效提高了VAE的压缩比，实现了高分辨率图像生成的高效token减少，同时保持了图像质量。

title: OpenEarth-Agent: From Tool Calling to Tool Creation for Open-Environment Earth Observation
summary: Earth Observation (EO) is essential for perceiving dynamic land surface changes, yet deploying autonomous EO in open environments is hindered by the immense diversity of multi-source data and heterogeneous tasks. While remote sensing agents have emerged to streamline EO workflows, existing tool-calling agents are confined to closed environments. They rely on pre-defined tools and are restricted to narrow scope, limiting their generalization to the diverse data and tasks. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OpenEarth-Agent, the first tool-creation agent framework tailored for open-environment EO. Rather than calling predefined tools, OpenEarth-Agent employs adaptive workflow planning and tool creation to generalize to unseen data and tasks. This adaptability is bolstered by an open-ended integration of multi-stage tools and cross-domain knowledge bases, enabling robust execution in the entire EO pipeline across multiple application domains. To comprehensively evaluate EO agents in open environments, we propose OpenEarth-Bench, a novel benchmark comprising 596 real-world, full-pipeline cases across seven application domains, explicitly designed to assess agents' adaptive planning and tool creation capabilities. Only essential pre-trained model tools are provided in this benchmark, devoid of any other predefined task-specific tools. Extensive experiments demonstrate that OpenEarth-Agent successfully masters full-pipeline EO across multiple domains in the open environment. Notably, on the cross-benchmark Earth-Bench, our tool-creating agent equipped with 6 essential pre-trained models achieves performance comparable to tool-calling agents relying on 104 specialized tools, and significantly outperforms them when provided with the complete toolset. In several cases, the created tools exhibit superior robustness to data anomalies compared to human-engineered counterparts.

AI.tldr: OpenEarth-Agent：首个面向开放环境地球观测的工具创建智能体框架，通过自适应工作流规划和工具创建来应对多源数据和异构任务，而非依赖预定义工具。
AI.motivation: 地球观测在感知动态地表变化中至关重要，但开放环境中部署自主EO面临多源数据多样性和任务异构性的挑战。现有遥感智能体局限于封闭环境，依赖预定义工具且范围狭窄，难以泛化到多样数据和任务。
AI.method: 提出OpenEarth-Agent框架，采用自适应工作流规划和工具创建机制，而非调用预定义工具。通过多阶段工具的开放式集成和跨领域知识库增强适应性，支持完整EO流程的鲁棒执行。同时提出OpenEarth-Bench基准测试，包含7个应用领域的596个真实案例。
AI.result: OpenEarth-Agent成功掌握开放环境中跨多个领域的完整EO流程。在跨基准Earth-Bench测试中，仅配备6个基本预训练模型的工具创建智能体，其性能与依赖104个专用工具的工具调用智能体相当；当提供完整工具集时显著优于后者。在某些案例中，创建的工具对数据异常表现出比人工设计工具更强的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: OpenEarth-Agent通过工具创建而非工具调用的创新方法，有效解决了开放环境地球观测中的泛化挑战，为自主EO系统的发展提供了新方向。

title: ACPO: Counteracting Likelihood Displacement in Vision-Language Alignment with Asymmetric Constraints
summary: While Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become the de facto approach for aligning Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs), it suffers from Likelihood Displacement, where the probability of both chosen and rejected responses collapses. This optimization flaw is especially detrimental in multimodal settings: the erosion of chosen likelihoods -- a failure we term Visual Anchor Collapse -- causes models to abandon visual evidence for strong language priors, precipitating significant hallucinations. To address this, we propose Asymmetric Constrained Preference Optimization (ACPO), a modality-agnostic alignment mechanism that applies dynamic, target-oriented scaling to preference optimization. ACPO derives a complexity-aware scaling coefficient applied exclusively to the rejected reward, asymmetrically suppressing the gradient flow on the rejected term while preserving the chosen distribution as a gradient-stable reference. While fundamentally a general-purpose objective, breaking this gradient symmetry is crucial for multimodal tasks, as it mitigates the suppression of visual tokens by language priors. Experiments on InternVL models demonstrate that ACPO effectively reverses the chosen-reward degradation of standard DPO.
